2025-01.daily_overview: On the morning of New Year's Day, after completing their first 10 km run of the new year with his running buddy Chen Jie, Yin Hao officially registered for the Sheshan Half Marathon, set his core goal for the year, and started a new year full of hope.

events.name: New Year's morning run preparation and meet-up
events.description: At 5:30 in the morning, Yin Hao got up in his rented apartment at No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai. He put on his running gear (windbreaker, compression tights, running shoes), drank warm water, and did some simple stretching. At 5:45, he walked to the entrance of the Guangfulin Cultural Heritage Park and met up with his running buddy Chen Jie (a coach at Songjiang District Vitality Fitness Center). The two wished each other a happy New Year, exchanged today's running plan, and confirmed a 10 km pace target of 5 minutes 50 seconds per kilometer.

events.name: 10 km New Year Run
events.description: At 6:00 in the morning, Yin Hao and Chen Jie started running from the entrance of Guangfulin Park and jogged 10 km along the lakeside trail. The two maintained a steady pace of about 5 minutes 50 seconds per kilometer, passing scenic spots such as Zhiye Zen Temple and the Ancient Pottery Art Museum. In the faint winter morning light, with thin ice on the lake, Yin Hao breathed smoothly and kept a good rhythm, while Chen Jie occasionally encouraged him and reminded him about cadence and landing posture. At exactly 7:00, the two finished the 10 km with an average heart rate of 152 bpm. Yin Hao felt relaxed and comfortable.

events.name: Review annual running data and set goals
events.description: At about 7:10 after the run, the two sat on a park bench to rest. Yin Hao opened his sports watch to check his 2024 running data: total mileage of about 800 kilometers and an average pace of 6 minutes 5 seconds per kilometer. Chen Jie acknowledged the performance and suggested taking the Sheshan Half Marathon in May 2025 as a stage goal, with systematic training to break his personal best. The two discussed a training framework: running three times a week (tempo run, interval run, long distance), one strength training session, and LSD on weekends. Yin Hao agreed and decided to sign up immediately.

events.name: Signed up for the Sheshan Half Marathon and set a goal.
events.description: At 7:30 in the morning, Yin Hao logged onto the Sheshan Half Marathon official website on his phone in Guangfulin Park, entered his personal information, emergency contact (his father Yin Jianguo) and running experience, paid the registration fee and received a confirmation SMS. He excitedly showed the confirmation to Chen Jie, officially setting "finish within 2 hours 10 minutes" as his core goal for 2025 and resolving to improve his condition through systematic training.

events.name: Going Home to Relax and New Year Wishes
events.description: At 8 a.m., Yin Hao walked home, bathed, changed into casual clothes, and used his phone to send New Year's Day greeting WeChat messages to his parents, older brother, and several fellow soldiers. Then he turned on the stereo to play light music, flipped through a running magazine, and enjoyed the leisure of the New Year's Day holiday.

2025-01.daily_overview: On the first working day after the holiday, Yin Hao and his mentor established a preparation plan for the senior technician exam and drew up a detailed study schedule, taking a key step toward career advancement. In the early morning he completed strength training at home, maintaining his exercise habit.

events.name: Early morning strength training
events.description: At 6 a.m., Yin Hao used the Keep app at home to complete a 30-minute strength training session, including push-ups, squats, resistance band rows, and planks, supplementing core strength for his running training.

events.name: Discussing the annual plan and certification goals with the mentor.
events.description: At 9 a.m., in the workshop office of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., Yin Hao discussed his personal annual plan with his master Sun Jianguo and formally proposed the goal of obtaining a senior CNC machine tool operator technician certificate. Master Sun expressed approval, promised full guidance throughout the process, and seriously reminded him that he needed to systematically study the theory and complete the practical assessment, requiring at least half a year of spare time. Yin Hao carefully noted the key points.

events.name: Create a study schedule and record reflections
events.description: After the discussion, Yin Hao immediately added the certification to his personal work plan. Taking into account his full-time job (40 hours per week) and spare time, he drafted a preliminary study schedule: theory study from 19:00 to 20:00 after work on weekdays, hands-on review from 9:00 to 11:00 on Saturday mornings, and note sorting on Sunday afternoons. He took a photo of the draft and saved it as a phone memo, and in the evening wrote down the day's gains in detail in his notebook.

2025-01.daily_overview: On Friday, Yin Hao did a tempo run in the early morning and then got to work. After work, he systematically searched at home for materials for the senior technician certification exam, cleaned up his computer disk, and built up resources for long-term study.

events.name: Morning tempo run.
events.description: At 6 a.m., just as dawn was breaking, Yin Hao put on his running shoes and did a 5-kilometer tempo run along Guangfulin Road at a pace of 5 minutes 40 seconds per kilometer. He felt slightly cool but his stride was light. After the run, he stretched, then went home to shower and change.

events.name: Searching for certification study materials
events.description: At 7 p.m., Yin Hao opened his laptop at home, connected to WiFi, and searched online for the exam syllabus, the designated textbook Modern CNC Technology, and past exam papers for the senior CNC machine tool operator technician certificate. He also bookmarked free course links from IMOOC and Bilibili, and sorted the important resources into his phone's memo app.

events.name: Clean up the computer disk.
events.description: While searching for information, he noticed the computer was running slowly. Yin Hao used system tools to clean up temporary files and cache, organized the document folders, and improved the computer's speed, creating a good environment for subsequent study.

2025-01.daily_overview: On Saturday, Yin Hao studied CNC theory on his own at home in the morning, helped neighbor Aunt Chen repair a door lock in the afternoon, and had a barbecue dinner with close friends Gao Zhiyuan and Ma Xiaofeng in the evening. It was their first gathering of the new year, and they talked freely about recent news and the fun of drones, agreeing to try things together in the future.

events.name: Theoretical study in the morning.
events.description: At 9 a.m., Yin Hao sat at the desk and used his phone to read the electronic CNC machining theory materials he had organized earlier, focusing on reviewing G-code and M-code commands, and took several pages of notes. Outside the window it was drizzling; the room was quiet, and the study efficiency was good.

events.name: Help Aunt Chen repair the door lock.
events.description: At 2 p.m., Aunt Chen, a neighbor, came to ask for help because the lock cylinder on her security door was sticking. Yin Hao took out his toolbox, removed the lock cylinder, cleaned off the rust, and oiled it, successfully fixing it. Aunt Chen gave him some homemade pastries to thank him, and the two chatted for a while about community happenings.

events.name: Scheduled dinner gathering
events.description: At 12 noon, Yin Hao discussed with Gao Zhiyuan and Ma Xiaofeng in the WeChat group 'Songjiang Three Brothers' and agreed to have dinner that evening at a barbecue restaurant near Songjiang University Town, with the time set for 6:30.

events.name: Heading to the dinner gathering
events.description: At 6:30 p.m., Yin Hao, holding a folding umbrella, walked from his residence on Guangfulin Road to the "Northeasterner" barbecue restaurant near the university town, about 1.5 kilometers. Gao Zhiyuan and Ma Xiaofeng also arrived separately from their residences.

events.name: Barbecue gathering and sharing.
events.description: At 7 p.m., the three sat down in the private room and ordered several plates of lamb skewers, grilled chicken wings, and beer. Gao Zhiyuan took out his phone and played the sunrise video shot with a drone while camping at Dianshan Lake on New Year's Day. In the footage, the morning light crossed Sheshan Hill, and Yin Hao and Ma Xiaofeng both exclaimed in admiration. Gao Zhiyuan suggested Yin Hao get a DJI Mini 4 Pro. Yin Hao said that with recent rent increases and heavy spending on exam preparation, he had neither the money nor the free time for now, but he noted the model for later. The three also shared work anecdotes and New Year plans.

events.name: Returning home to tidy up
events.description: At 9:30 p.m., the dinner gathering ended. After saying goodbye to his friends, Yin Hao walked home. After washing up, he lay in bed and recalled the drone topic from the gathering. Although it had been put aside for now, he felt hopeful about trying aerial photography in the future. After saving the drone model in his memo, he fell asleep peacefully.

2025-01.daily_overview: On Sunday, Yin Hao went to the repair shop in the morning to learn small appliance repair from Master Chen Jianguo. In the afternoon, he did the year-end cleaning at home, and in the evening he had a video call with his parents, enjoying a plain yet fulfilling day off.

events.name: Going to the repair shop to learn repairs.
events.description: At 9 a.m., Yin Hao took an old rice cooker to Chen Jianguo's appliance repair shop in Songjiang District. Under Master Chen's guidance, he disassembled and tested it, found that the heating plate was damaged, and after replacing it with a new part, the rice cooker worked normally again. He learned multimeter measuring techniques and recorded the repair steps.

events.name: Afternoon deep cleaning.
events.description: At 1 p.m., Yin Hao returned to the rental apartment and did a thorough year-end cleaning: organized the wardrobe, washed the quilt covers and bed sheets, wiped the kitchen grease, cleaned out the refrigerator, and rearranged the desk area to improve the study environment.

events.name: Video call with parents
events.description: At 8 p.m., Yin Hao had a video call with his parents via WeChat and reported on his recent work and health. His mother, Wang Xiuying, reminded him to pay attention to his diet and keep warm. His father, Yin Jianguo, asked about the maintenance of his tools and equipment and encouraged him to focus on exam preparation with peace of mind. The call lasted about 30 minutes, with a warm atmosphere.

2025-01.daily_overview: On a Monday workday, Yin Hao added a Hangzhou girl, Lin Yue, through a fellow soldier's introduction, but their first chat was awkward and brief, leaving him feeling frustrated. In the evening, he chatted with his childhood friend Zhang Wei, got some encouragement, and they agreed to play games together on the weekend.

events.name: Added Lin Yue on WeChat.
events.description: At 7 p.m., Yin Hao returned to his home in Songjiang after work and received a WeChat contact card for Lin Yue sent by his comrade-in-arms Zhang Jianguo. He added her as a friend by scanning the QR code and sent a brief self-introduction: "Hello, I'm Yin Hao, Zhang Jianguo's comrade-in-arms." Since Zhang Jianguo had already mentioned it in advance, the friend request went through smoothly.

events.name: First awkward chat
events.description: About ten minutes after adding her, Yin Hao sent a greeting: 'Are you busy at work today?' The other person replied: 'Not bad.' After hesitating for a while, Yin Hao sent: 'Have you eaten?' Lin Yue replied: 'Yes.' The conversation then stopped. Yin Hao felt a bit dejected and sat on the sofa staring blankly at his phone.

events.name: Chatting with childhood friend Zhang Wei
events.description: At 9 p.m., Yin Hao opened the WeChat chat with his childhood friend Zhang Wei. Zhang Wei shared how things were going at his job at the 4S car dealership and mentioned the new season update in Honor of Kings. Yin Hao said he had just added a girl from Hangzhou but the conversation wasn't going smoothly. Zhang Wei encouraged him, "Keep chatting, don't rush — we'll play Honor of Kings together later." The two then discussed game tactics, and Yin Hao felt a bit better.

2025-01.daily_overview: On Tuesday, Yin Hao ran 6 kilometers in the early morning and then went to work. In the evening, he tried to chat with Lin Yue again, but the conversation still fell flat, and he felt down. During work, he was reminded by his master for being distracted. After work, he listened to music alone to relieve his mood.

events.name: Morning run 6 kilometers.
events.description: At 6:20 in the morning, Yin Hao completed a 6 km tempo run around the residential area at a pace of 5 minutes 50 seconds per kilometer. While running, he thought about how to start a conversation with Lin Yue, but could not sort it out. After the run, he stretched, showered, and got ready for work.

events.name: Trying again to break the awkward silence in the chat.
events.description: At 8 p.m., Yin Hao proactively sent a message to Lin Yue, asking, 'What hobbies do you usually have?' She replied, 'Watching TV series.' He followed up, 'What type of series do you like?' Lin Yue only replied, 'Period drama.' Yin Hao couldn't find common ground, so he had to say, 'Then when you have time, you can try the Shanghainese restaurant I recommended.' Lin Yue didn't respond. The conversation went cold again, and Yin Hao felt down.

events.name: Reminded for being distracted at work
events.description: While operating the CNC machine in the morning, Yin Hao was briefly distracted by repeatedly recalling a failed chat scenario and almost entered the wrong parameters. His master Sun Jianguo noticed in time and reminded him to concentrate. Yin Hao apologized and forced himself to refocus, but his efficiency was slightly lower for the rest of the day.

events.name: Listen to music to relieve stress.
events.description: After 9 p.m., Yin Hao lay in bed playing soft music on his phone. He closed his eyes and reviewed the day, gradually calming down. He briefly noted his mood in a diary app, hoping tomorrow would be better.

2025-01.daily_overview: On Wednesday, after several failed chat attempts, Yin Hao turned to personal finance and set up a monthly 500-yuan automatic investment. In the evening, while playing Honor of Kings, he lost focus and was scolded. Feeling low, he decided to uninstall the game temporarily and focus on reality.

events.name: The conversation fell flat again
events.description: At 7 p.m., Yin Hao forwarded a WeChat official account article about Shanghai food to Lin Yue with the comment, "This place's Shanghainese braised pork looks good." Lin Yue replied half an hour later, "Looks okay." Yin Hao then asked, "What do you usually do on weekends?" The other replied, "Overtime." Helpless, Yin Hao just answered, "Thanks for your hard work," and after that the two had no further communication. He put down his phone and felt that he had no idea how to socialize.

events.name: Learning about and setting up a regular fund investment plan
events.description: At 8 p.m., to take his mind off things, Yin Hao browsed posts about dollar-cost averaging into index funds on a personal finance forum and learned about the features of the CSI 300 ETF and DCA strategies. He decided to put 500 yuan from his monthly surplus into forced savings. He then opened the Alipay app, went to the fund section, selected the CSI 300 ETF feeder fund, set up an automatic deduction of 500 yuan on the 15th of each month, and linked his salary card. After reading the risk warning carefully, he confirmed and took a screenshot of the DCA page.

events.name: Got distracted by Honor of Kings, was scolded, and uninstalled it.
events.description: At 10 p.m., Yin Hao tried to relieve his emotions through Honor of Kings, but because he was feeling irritable, he made operational mistakes and was verbally attacked by his teammates. He logged off early, became even more doubtful about his social skills, and in a fit of anger uninstalled the game, deciding to temporarily stay away from the virtual world and focus on real life.

events.name: Diary reflection
events.description: At 11 p.m., Yin Hao wrote in his diary: Socializing has always been my weak point. Maybe I should start with what I'm good at and take it slowly. Then he turned off the light and went to sleep.

2025-01.daily_overview: On Thursday, Yin Hao's work team received an urgent order, did high-precision machining all day, and worked overtime until 8 p.m. Then he had dinner with his mentor, Wang Lei, and Liu Zhiqiang, discussing certification and career development. In the evening, his first invitation to Lin Yue was rejected, making him feel down; he reinstalled a mobile game but lost repeatedly, causing severe insomnia.

events.name: Discuss the emergency order processing plan.
events.description: At 9 a.m., the workshop received an order for a batch of precision shaft parts, requiring delivery within three days. Yin Hao and his mentor Sun Jianguo immediately discussed the machining plan in the workshop office, adjusted CNC machine tool parameters, optimized the program, and divided up the work.

events.name: Working overtime to machine parts
events.description: From morning until 8 p.m., Yin Hao and Sun Jianguo took shifts operating the CNC machine tools to perform rough and finish machining of the parts. Because the precision requirements were high, they repeatedly measured key dimensions and fine-tuned the cutting parameters to ensure every part was qualified. Although tired, Yin Hao felt fulfilled by the technical challenge.

events.name: Team dinner after working overtime.
events.description: At 8:30 p.m., Yin Hao suggested a gathering after work, and Master Sun, Wang Lei, and Liu Zhiqiang agreed. The four went to a Sichuan restaurant near Songjiang University Town and ordered boiled fish, twice-cooked pork, and more. Master Sun asked Yin Hao about his progress in studying for the certification exam and shared his own experience taking it back in the day; Wang Lei suggested teaming up for Honor of Kings on the weekend; Liu Zhiqiang talked about interesting stories from programming debugging. Yin Hao felt the harmony of the team and resolved to work harder.

events.name: The first attempt to invite Lin Yue was rejected.
events.description: After getting home at 10 pm, Yin Hao plucked up his courage and sent Lin Yue a message inviting her to dinner on the weekend: "Are you free this weekend? I know a very good Shanghainese restaurant." Lin Yue replied, "I'm pretty busy this week. Let's talk some other time." Yin Hao felt he had been politely turned down and was disappointed.

events.name: Reinstalled mobile game, consecutive losses, insomnia
events.description: At 11 p.m., utterly frustrated, Yin Hao re-downloaded Honor of Kings to numb himself, but his restless mind led to repeated misplays and three consecutive defeats. He angrily shut down the game, played old songs on loop, lay in bed staring at the ceiling, and didn't fall into a groggy sleep until around 1 a.m.

It was physically demanding, but the technical progress was evident.

Considering that he lived alone in Shanghai, he decided to buy insurance the next day. He took screenshots of the important clauses and saved them.

2025-01.daily_overview: On Saturday, after his morning run, Yin Hao had in-depth WeChat interactions with Lin Yue, and their feelings for each other quickly warmed up. In the morning, he successfully purchased medical and accident insurance. In the afternoon, after delivering an urgent part and receiving praise, he went to Dianshan Lake to enjoy winter fishing with his fishing buddy Wu Zhiqiang. In the evening, he video-called his mother and teamed up with his former comrades-in-arms for online games — a full and delightful day.

events.name: Morning run and in-depth conversation.
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, after finishing a 5-kilometer morning run at Songjiang Sports Center, Yin Hao exchanged thoughts on the week’s training with his fellow runner Chen Jie. He then used his phone to take photos of the running track around the Guangfulin Cultural Relics Park and sent them to Lin Yue, with the note, “Another 5 kilometers today, and the weather is great!” Lin Yue replied quickly, sharing photos of her morning run by the West Lake in Hangzhou. Yin Hao also sent a photo of breakfast at the company cafeteria (xiaolongbao and soy milk), and Lin Yue responded with Hangzhou’s signature breakfast, pianchuan noodles. The two chatted from morning running habits to food preferences, and their WeChat interaction lasted the whole morning, with their relationship clearly warming up.

events.name: Purchase medical and accident insurance.
events.description: At 9 a.m., Yin Hao filled in personal information and health declarations at home via the Ant Insurance app, and paid a total annual premium of 650 yuan for million-yuan medical insurance and accident insurance. After carefully reading the terms, he confirmed the purchase, took a screenshot of the electronic policy and uploaded it to Baidu Netdisk as a backup, and set a renewal reminder in his phone calendar.

events.name: Delivered urgent parts and received praise
events.description: At 2 p.m., Yin Hao and Master Sun Jianguo submitted the final batch of 200 precision shaft parts after finishing machining for quality inspection, and all passed. After delivering them to the warehouse, the workshop director publicly praised the team for completing the urgent order ahead of schedule, and Yin Hao felt a strong sense of accomplishment.

events.name: Winter fishing at Dianshan Lake
events.description: At 3:30 p.m., Yin Hao drove a Lavida to Dianshan Lake in Qingpu to meet Wu Zhiqiang, who was already waiting at the fishing spot. The two cast their lines in a sheltered bay, using heavily fishy bait plus bloodworms. With light winter bites, they fished patiently and exchanged tips on winter bait and spot selection. By 5:30 p.m., Yin Hao had caught 4 crucian carp and 1 small carp. After taking photos of the catch, he released the small carp and took the crucian carp home. Brother Wu shared the jigging technique, and Yin Hao recorded it in his memo.

events.name: Video call with mother.
events.description: At 8:30 p.m., Yin Hao proactively made a WeChat video call with his mother, Wang Xiuying, showed her photos of the day's catch, and told her the insurance had been purchased. His mother urged him to dress warmly as the temperature was dropping and said she had sent hometown cured meat and clams. Yin Hao asked about his father's health and learned that all was well. The call lasted 20 minutes and had a warm atmosphere.

events.name: Teaming up with comrades to play Honor of Kings
events.description: At 9:30 p.m., Yin Hao logged into the re-installed Honor of Kings and invited his comrades Zhang Jianguo and Zhou Xiaofeng to form a team for ranked matches. He played the jungler hero Kai, coordinating tactics through voice chat, and won three consecutive matches. The joy of victory lifted his spirits, and he played until 11:30 at night before logging off to rest.

events.name: Long-distance training run, 14 km

The two ran 14 kilometers along the lakeside greenway at a pace of 6:10 per kilometer, passing the Guangfulin Ruins and the university town on the way. Yin Hao felt a little tired in the latter half but pushed through to finish, with an average heart rate of 155. They stretched thoroughly after the run. Chen Jie praised his steady condition and encouraged him to keep it up.

events.name: Ice pack and muscle relaxation

When he got home, he applied an ice pack to his knees and ankles for 15 minutes and used a foam roller to relax, to prevent injury. He carefully recorded how this long-distance run felt and planned to add 1 kilometer next time.

events.name: Purchase exam preparation materials.

events.name: Make a detailed study plan.

He printed the schedule and stuck it in front of his desk, and set a daily reminder in his phone calendar.

2025-01.daily_overview: On Monday, Yin Hao went to Songjiang District Central Hospital for his annual physical examination. All indicators were good, which boosted his confidence in his health. In the afternoon, he continued with work and tried bringing his own healthy lunch for the first time, starting to adjust his diet.

events.name: Go to the health checkup center on an empty stomach.
events.description: At 6 a.m., Yin Hao left home on an empty stomach, carrying his ID card and medical examination form, and drove to the Health Examination Center of Songjiang District Central Hospital. He arrived at 7 a.m., signed in, and queued.

events.name: Complete the health check-up items in order.
events.description: Starting at 7:30, under the guidance of medical staff, Yin Hao completed blood draw (complete blood count, liver and kidney function), electrocardiogram, abdominal ultrasound, height and weight measurement (178 cm / 70.8 kg), and other items in turn. The process went smoothly and was completed in about 1 hour.

events.name: Listened to the physical exam results and returned
events.description: At 9 a.m., the physical examination doctor interpreted the preliminary results on site, told him that all indicators were normal, and advised him to maintain a regular routine and exercise while reducing fat intake. Yin Hao took careful notes, then left the hospital, bought eggs and soy milk on the way as breakfast, and arrived at the company at 10 a.m. to start work.

events.name: First time bringing a healthy packed lunch
events.description: At noon, Yin Hao took out lettuce, chicken breast, and multigrain rice he had bought from the supermarket in the staff lounge, simply mixed them into a salad with a little soy sauce. His colleague Wang Lei asked curiously, and he explained that after his physical exam he wanted to make some dietary adjustments.

events.name: Morning running and diet optimization plan
events.description: At 6 a.m., after completing a 6-kilometer tempo run, Yin Hao checked yesterday's physical examination report. In light of his half-marathon training goal, he decided to strictly stick to bringing mixed-grain rice and chicken breast salad for lunch, increase vegetables and reduce red meat for dinner, and continue taking multivitamin tablets. He exchanged thoughts on the dietary adjustment with his running buddy Chen Jie via WeChat and received encouragement.

events.name: Buy healthy ingredients and vitamins

He put the vitamin tablets in a conspicuous place on his workstation to remind himself to take one every day.

events.name: Brought a healthy homemade lunch for the first time and took vitamins.
events.description: At noon, Yin Hao took out the mixed-grain rice and chicken breast salad he had brought from his lunch box and ate them in the staff lounge. His colleague Wang Lei teased him, saying he had become a fitness enthusiast. Yin Hao smiled and replied that he was preparing for a half marathon. After the meal, he took a multivitamin tablet and recorded it in the memo on his phone.

events.name: Received a package from my mother.
events.description: At 4 p.m., Yin Hao received a call from the courier. After work, he went to the community mailbox to pick up the package. Inside were preserved meat and clam specialties sent by his mother, Wang Xiuying. He put the food in the fridge and sent a WeChat message to thank her and let her know he was safe. His mother told him to take care of his health and drink more soup. Yin Hao decided to eat preserved meat only once a week and stick to a healthy diet the rest of the time.

2025-01.daily_overview: On Wednesday, Yin Hao received the landlord's rent increase notice and reluctantly renewed the lease. The cramped space and leaking problems in the rental apartment triggered strong anxiety about buying a house. Late at night, after calculating his income and expenses, he lay awake all night because of his meager savings, and the pressure of life suddenly increased. The first automatic deduction for the fund investment succeeded, but it could not hide his financial embarrassment. That day he still insisted on bringing a healthy lunch and taking vitamins.

events.name: Received the lease renewal contract and signed it.
events.description: At 7:00 in the morning, the landlord Li Xiuying sent the annual lease renewal contract via WeChat, notifying that the rent would increase by 200 yuan from the original price. After receiving the message in his rented attic, Yin Hao decided after brief consideration to renew the lease. He read the terms carefully, signed it, scanned it, and sent it back. As he signed, he looked around the cramped room with water stains on the ceiling and felt a surge of dissatisfaction with his living conditions.

events.name: Triggered home-buying anxiety.
events.description: After signing, Yin Hao sat alone in the attic, carefully looking at the leak stains and the cramped layout. Recalling the many times he had reported repairs that never fully solved the problem, he deeply felt the instability of renting and, for the first time, strongly realized that he needed a house of his own. He took photos and sent them to his father, but did not mention his idea of buying a house.

events.name: First automatic fund investment deduction
events.description: At 10 a.m., Alipay automatically deducted 500 yuan from the bank card according to the regular investment plan and successfully purchased shares of the CSI 300 ETF feeder fund. Yin Hao saw the deduction notification, silently took a screenshot and saved it, thinking this was a little capital saved for the future.

events.name: Keep up healthy lunch and take medication
events.description: At noon, Yin Hao ate his usual multigrain rice with chicken breast salad that he had brought from home, and took vitamins. Despite feeling heavy-hearted, he still followed the diet adjustment plan, hoping to at least be physically healthy.

events.name: Reconciling income and expenses late into the night
events.description: At 9 p.m., Yin Hao opened his mobile bookkeeping app and carefully calculated the past year's income and expenses. He found that after deducting rent, food, transportation, and other costs, his monthly surplus was less than 1,000 yuan, and his annual savings were only about 10,000 yuan. This result made him realize how far he was from a down payment for a house, and anxiety spread. He started searching for housing prices in Shanghai's suburbs, and the more he looked, the more desperate he felt.

events.name: Sleepless all night.
events.description: At 1 a.m., Yin Hao lay in bed tossing and turning, unable to sleep. He kept calculating in his mind the housing prices around Shanghai and his meager savings. For the first time, the idea that he had to buy a home clearly surfaced, but the enormous financial pressure and uncertainty kept him awake all night. He didn't fall into an exhausted, drowsy sleep until 2 a.m. Before sleeping, he set his alarm and decided to continue his early-rising routine tomorrow.

2025-01.daily_overview: Yin Hao took a day of annual leave and visited Shanghai Disneyland with Gao Zhiyuan and Ma Xiaofeng. It was his first visit to Disney. The three set off by car in the early morning, experienced popular attractions all day, and watched a spectacular fireworks show in the evening. Although it cost a lot, they thoroughly enjoyed themselves and did not get home until late at night.

events.name: Gathered in the early morning and set off
events.description: Yin Hao got up at 5:50, checked the ticketing app and his belongings, and put on a thick down jacket. At 7:00, Gao Zhiyuan and Ma Xiaofeng arrived downstairs one after another. The three met up, confirmed the tour route, and set off with Yin Hao driving his own economy car. Via the G60 Shanghai-Kunming Expressway and then the S1 Yingbin Expressway, they arrived at the Disney parking lot around 8:00.

events.name: Enter the park and visit Tomorrowland.
events.description: After entering the park through security by scanning his ID card at 8:30, they headed straight for TRON Lightcycle Power Run and waited in line for about 40 minutes. Yin Hao rode it for the first time; the thrill made him shout excitedly, and Gao Zhiyuan laughed, saying, 'You're from the military and you're still afraid of this?' The three took a group photo as a souvenir.

events.name: Visited Adventure Isle and multiple attractions
events.description: At 10:30 they headed to Adventure Isle, waited 60 minutes for Soaring over the Horizon, and the immersive round-the-world journey made Yin Hao marvel again and again. Then they rode Pirates of the Caribbean: Battle for the Sunken Treasure and the Seven Dwarfs Mine Train. At noon they ate at Barbossa's Bistro, and Yin Hao insisted on paying about 250 yuan for the meal. While waiting in line in the afternoon, it suddenly began to drizzle, and the three hurriedly bought rain ponchos and continued playing.

events.name: Night fireworks show and return trip.
events.description: At 19:00, they arrived early at Gardens of Imagination to save spots, and at 20:00 watched the 'Ignite the Dream' light and fireworks show. The stunning projections and fireworks made Yin Hao feel like he was back in his childhood. At 20:40, they drove back to Songjiang. On the way, the three excitedly discussed the experience in the car and concluded that the per-person cost was about 800 yuan. They arrived at the neighborhood at 21:30, Gao Zhiyuan and Ma Xiaofeng took a taxi home, and Yin Hao organized the photos, sent them to his parents, and shared them on Moments.

2025-01.daily_overview: On Saturday, his day off, Yin Hao had planned to do housework, but he ran into his neighbor Aunt Chen Xiuying in the hallway who asked for help repairing a rice cooker. He enthusiastically helped, from diagnosing the problem to buying replacement parts and fixing it in one go. Aunt Chen insisted he stay for dinner, and over braised pork they chatted about everyday matters, bringing the neighbors closer. In the afternoon, he unexpectedly received a WeChat message from Lin Yue, and they talked for about half an hour, sharing their weekend plans.

events.name: Encountered in the hallway and accepted the repair request.
events.description: At 2 p.m., when Yin Hao went downstairs to take out the trash, he ran into Aunt Chen. Aunt Chen mentioned that her rice cooker was powered on but not heating up, and she was about to call a repairman. Yin Hao offered to take a look, and Aunt Chen gladly agreed.

events.name: Diagnosis and parts purchase
events.description: Yin Hao went home to get tools such as a multimeter, then in Aunt Chen's kitchen he opened the bottom cover of the rice cooker and tested the power board and thermostat, determining that the thermostat contacts were oxidized. He walked to the nearby Zhiqiang Hardware Store and bought a matching KSD301 thermostat for 8 yuan.

events.name: Replace the thermostat and test it
events.description: Back at Aunt Chen's house, he skillfully used a soldering iron to desolder the old part, installed the new thermostat, put the shell back, and powered it on for a test. The rice cooker heated up normally. Aunt Chen thanked him again and again.

events.name: Having dinner together for an in-depth exchange.
events.description: Aunt Chen insisted on keeping him for a meal and cooked Shanghainese braised pork, steamed sea bass, and sweet-and-sour spare ribs in her own kitchen. Yin Hao helped set out bowls and chopsticks and serve rice, and the two ate and chatted. Aunt Chen asked if he was adapting to Shanghai. Yin Hao shared his military experiences and feelings about living alone; the atmosphere was warm.

events.name: Chatting with Lin Yue on WeChat
events.description: During a break in the afternoon repairs, his phone vibrated. Lin Yue suddenly sent a WeChat message asking what he was doing. Yin Hao took a photo of the bottom shell of a rice cooker and explained that he was helping a neighbor fix things. The two chatted about their weekend lives. Lin Yue said she was walking by West Lake in Hangzhou, while Yin Hao talked about his trip to Disneyland. Before they knew it, half an hour had passed.

events.name: Post-meal cleanup and farewells
events.description: After the meal, Yin Hao took the initiative to wash the dishes and wipe down the stove, and also checked the faucet for Aunt Chen. After cleaning up, he said goodbye and returned to his place. Aunt Chen walked him to the door and told him to take good care of himself. Yin Hao smiled and agreed, and invited her to come by when she had time.

2025-01.daily_overview: Early Sunday morning, Yin Hao and his running buddy Chen Jie completed a 15-kilometer long-distance training run at Songjiang University Town, laying an important foundation for his half-marathon goal. After the run, the two exchanged fueling strategies, and Yin Hao's confidence grew. In the afternoon, he adjusted his training plan according to Chen Jie's advice, and in the evening he did some simple programming study.

events.name: Get up early, prepare, and meet up
events.description: Woke up at 5:30 a.m., washed up and warmed up, ate a banana and half a slice of whole wheat bread, and put on a heart rate strap and running watch. At 6:00, drove to Songjiang University Town and met Chen Jie at the Wenhui Road starting point.

events.name: 15 km long-distance training
events.description: At 6:30, the two of them started running along the University City loop road at a pace of 6:15 per kilometer, with a water break at the 7.5 km mark. Yin Hao maintained a steady rhythm throughout, finishing in about 1 hour 33 minutes. This was a key step in his transition from 10 km to a half marathon. At the 12 km mark, the old injury on his right ankle felt slightly sore, but it eased after he adjusted his landing posture.

events.name: Post-run stretching and conversation
events.description: After the run, he did 10 minutes of static stretching by the track and had some sports drink. Chen Jie shared a race-day strategy of taking energy gel every 5 km. Yin Hao asked about pace distribution techniques and felt more confident about breaking 2 hours. The two agreed to do an 18 km pace run next week.

events.name: Adjust the training plan
events.description: After returning home, Yin Hao synced this training data to his fitness app and sent a screenshot to the runners' group. Following Chen Jie's advice, he rearranged the next two weeks' plan on his phone calendar: adding interval runs on Wednesdays, LSD on weekends, and adjusting the half-marathon target pace to 6 min/km. The discomfort in his right ankle made him decide to apply an ice pack for a while in the evening.

2025-01.daily_overview: On Chinese New Year's Eve, Yin Hao got up early to help his parents clean the courtyard. In the morning, while checking the old family home, he found a leak in the agricultural water pump and used his repair skills to replace the seal ring, with his father guiding and praising him. In the afternoon, father and son put up Spring Festival couplets while his mother prepared the New Year's Eve dinner. At dinner, the father and son had a few drinks; after drinking, his father suggested selling the old house to help him buy a home. Yin Hao firmly refused, saying he wanted to rely on himself. The New Year's Eve was spent with family affection interwoven with his stubbornness about the future.

events.name: Helping with dusting and discovering a water pump failure
events.description: Woke up at 7:30 in the morning. Yin Hao helped his mother sweep the yard and clean the windows. In the corner of the yard, he found an idle agricultural water pump. His father said it would be needed in spring, but it made an abnormal noise when rotating. Yin Hao volunteered to inspect and repair it.

events.name: Repair the water pump.
events.description: Yin Hao brought the toolbox he had brought from Shanghai, disassembled the water pump, and found that the sealing ring had aged and caused water seepage, and the impeller was slightly stuck. He skillfully replaced the sealing ring and cleaned the impeller. After reassembling, he tested the pump; the water flow was strong and the vibration was reduced. His father sighed that the skills he had developed in the military and in Shanghai had not been lost. During the repair, a neighbor uncle passed by, stopped to watch, and praised him.

events.name: Putting up Spring Festival couplets and preparing the New Year's Eve dinner
events.description: In the afternoon, the father and son pasted the Spring Festival couplet 'Spring breeze brings peace into the home; auspicious qi fills the door with a hundred blessings' on the door frame of the main room. The mother was busy at the stove, frying tofu balls and braising pork belly. Yin Hao also helped make wontons. His mother taught him hand over hand how to pinch the pleats, and his clumsy movements made her laugh.

events.name: New Year's Eve dinner and the topic of selling the house
events.description: At 7 p.m., the family sat around the table for a reunion dinner, and Yin Hao had some Rudong aged wine with his father. After a few rounds of drinks, his father mentioned that someone in town had sold their house to help their child buy a home in a big city, and tentatively asked whether Yin Hao also wanted to sell the old family house, saying the money could be his down payment. Yin Hao refused categorically, stressing that he wanted to buy a home around Shanghai on his own ability and did not want to use his parents' retirement money. The father and son talked about this for more than half an hour. In the end, his father sighed and said he understood, but he was still worried inside.

events.name: New Year's Eve vigil and a brief chat.
events.description: After dinner, Yin Hao helped his mother clean up the kitchen, and the three of them watched the Spring Festival Gala. His mother asked if he was seeing anyone in Shanghai. Yin Hao vaguely said he had just met a girl, and his mother happily asked a few more questions. They stayed up for New Year's Eve until midnight, set off firecrackers, and then went to sleep.

start_state.location: Hometown in Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province
start_state.mood: Full of energy, ready to share some of my parents' burdens.

end_state.location: Hometown in Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province
end_state.mood: He felt enveloped by family love, but the pressure from his father's proposal intertwined with his desire for independence, leaving him a bit weighed down.

Seeing that Zhang Wei had put on weight, he dragged him to run together. In the morning he went to town to buy gifts. At noon he had a small gathering with Zhang Wei, who announced his wedding and invited him to be the best man. Although Yin Hao felt financial pressure, he happily agreed. In the afternoon he went home to accompany his parents in receiving a few neighbors who came to pay New Year calls.

events.name: Ran into Zhang Wei during morning run

Seeing that Zhang Wei was round, Yin Hao encouraged him to run a stretch together. Zhang Wei barely managed 2 kilometers and was panting heavily, but said he was going to start exercising to lose weight. The two chatted about recent developments while jogging and agreed to get together properly on the third day of the Lunar New Year.

events.name: Gift purchase

He also picked out a small gift for Zhang Wei. The supermarket was crowded, and queuing for checkout took half an hour.

During the meal, Zhang Wei officially announced that he would be getting married at the end of the year and invited Yin Hao to be his best man. Although Yin Hao thought this might mean spending more money while saving for a house, he was happy for his childhood friend and readily agreed. The two recalled the embarrassing incident of stealing melons as teenagers and laughed heartily. They also roughly discussed the wedding process, and Yin Hao jotted down the key points he remembered in his phone memo.

events.name: Hosting at home and coping with Mother's pressure to marry.

His mother again mentioned to the neighbor that Yin Hao was not yet married, with a hint of anxiety in her words. Yin Hao smiled helplessly and changed the subject. In the evening, his older female cousin Chen Xiaowen called to pay New Year's greetings, and they briefly agreed to meet on the second day of the Lunar New Year.

2025-12.daily_overview: A crucial day: the practical final of the skills competition. Yin Hao got up at 5:45 a.m. and arrived early to prepare. From morning to afternoon, he focused fully on five-axis machining; although he encountered small hiccups, he completed it smoothly. In the afternoon, he proactively communicated with the experts and gained valuable feedback. Although he did not win a prize, he gained a lot. After returning home in the evening, he immediately reviewed and summarized the day, organizing his insights to identify directions for improvement. A tiring but fulfilling day.

events.name: Pre-final preparation and machine tool inspection.
events.description: At 7:30 a.m. on December 5, 2025, Yin Hao arrived at the five-axis machining competition venue at the Shanghai Workers' Skills Competition Center. He completed the finals check-in, received his workstation number and competition credentials, and immediately went to his workstation to conduct a full inspection of the assigned five-axis CNC machine tool: the coolant level was sufficient, the lubrication system was normal, and all tools in the tool magazine were intact. He skillfully installed his own precision fixture and lever-type dial indicator, and ran a dry-run program to verify the machine tool's accuracy. At 8:15, after confirming everything was ready, he briefly discussed the competition rules with the other competitors in his group and quietly waited for the official start.

events.name: Five-axis linkage machining practical final.
events.description: At 9:00 a.m., the practical final officially began. Yin Hao needed to independently machine a complex impeller within the specified time. He focused on reading the drawings, used UG to write the machining program, and planned roughing, semi-finishing, and finishing. During machining, he calmly monitored the cutting conditions; when slight cutting vibration occurred halfway through roughing, he immediately paused, readjusted the position of the workpiece clamping plate, and continued after the vibration was eliminated. After 4.5 hours of continuous operation, he successfully completed the part at 13:30 and submitted it to the judges. During the process, the equipment ran safely with no violations.

events.name: Post-match technical exchange and industry networking
events.description: At 14:00 in the afternoon the competition results were announced. Yin Hao ranked fourth and did not make the medal list. He accepted it calmly, then took the initiative to consult the head of the judging panel (Zhang Zhengming, senior expert of the Shanghai CNC Industry Association). Zhang Zhengming analyzed in detail his shortcomings in surface finish in finishing, and suggested using a smaller ball-end milling cutter and reducing the feed rate. Afterward, Yin Hao exchanged WeChat contacts with contestants including Wang Hai, a technician from Baosteel, and Chen Hua, an engineer from Shanghai Electric, and was added to an industry technology exchange group. He also specifically consulted two senior industry veterans (Li Guodong, senior technician, and Zhao Wei, national technical expert) about long-term career development paths, and did not leave the competition venue until 16:30 after continuous discussion.

events.name: Post-race review and recording
events.description: At 19:00 that evening, Yin Hao returned to his rented room in Songjiang. Without taking a rest, he immediately opened his laptop and created a new Excel spreadsheet. He took photos of the competition drawings and pasted them in, then wrote down in detail his programming approach, the problems he actually encountered (vibration), and the solutions. He highlighted that the reason the finishing process failed to achieve adequate smoothness was that the last cutting pass left too much allowance and the spindle speed was not matched. He wrote down Zhang Zhengming's suggestions one by one and made a targeted training plan. After finishing, he sent a thank-you message via WeChat to the senior colleague he had just met. The entire review lasted about 1 hour and was completed at 20:00.

After returning home, he tried making low-fat chicken breast meatballs in an air fryer. In the afternoon, he stayed home watching renovation tutorial videos and helped his neighbor Aunt Chen repair a circuit that had tripped. In the evening, he received homemade shredded radish cakes from Aunt Chen in return. At night, he played two rounds of online games with Gao Zhiyuan and Ma Xiaofeng and felt relaxed.

events.name: At the food market, he bought a week's worth of healthy ingredients and tried a new dish.
events.description: On the morning of December 6, 2025, Yin Hao drove to the vegetable market on Guangfulin Road in Songjiang District and, according to his healthy eating plan, made supplementary purchases for the coming week: two large pieces of chicken breast, lettuce, tomatoes, eggs, a carton of pure milk, and a fresh sea bass. He deliberately picked more leafy greens, intending to try a new salad combination. After returning home, he followed a video and used an air fryer to try making chicken breast and vegetable balls; the taste was acceptable.

events.name: Watching videos on wall treatment and waterproofing construction
events.description: In the afternoon, Yin Hao opened Bilibili at home and bookmarked several detailed tutorials on scraping old paint off walls, applying putty, and applying waterproof coating in kitchens and bathrooms. He took notes while watching, gained a preliminary understanding of scraper angles and key points for waterproofing application, and accumulated theoretical knowledge for the upcoming DIY renovation.

events.name: Helped neighbor Aunt Chen inspect and repair a tripped circuit
events.description: At around 3 p.m., neighbor Aunt Chen knocked on the door for help, saying the circuit breaker in her home had tripped and couldn't be reset. Yin Hao took a test pen and screwdriver over to check and found that the kitchen outlet had short-circuited due to dampness. He helped disassemble the outlet, dried it, rewired it, and restored power. Aunt Chen thanked him repeatedly and brought over a plate of homemade shredded radish cakes in the evening, which Yin Hao accepted and had as an extra dish for dinner.

events.name: Playing online games with Gao Zhiyuan and Ma Xiaofeng.
events.description: At 8:00 PM, Yin Hao opened Honor of Kings and played ranked matches with Gao Zhiyuan and Ma Xiaofeng via voice chat in the "Songjiang Three Brothers" WeChat group. The three coordinated well and logged off happily after three straight wins. Between games, Gao Zhiyuan shared his embarrassing incident while learning to park a car, making everyone laugh.

In the afternoon he deepened his renovation study, made a list of construction tools, and went to a hardware and building materials store to buy small tools such as scrapers and protective film. In the evening he called Chen Jianguo, the repair shop owner, to ask for tips on scraping walls, preparing for the start of work next week. The pace of life was relaxed and orderly.

events.name: Additional shopping for leafy greens and dairy products
events.description: On the morning of December 7, 2025, Yin Hao rode his bicycle to the vegetable market, bought leafy greens that don't keep well such as tender spinach and baby bok choy, and picked a large carton of unsweetened yogurt for breakfast. On the way, he restocked a carton of plain milk at the supermarket. After returning home, he washed and drained the vegetables and portioned them into sealed bags for easy use on workdays.

events.name: Organize renovation tool list and buy the tools in person
events.description: In the afternoon, Yin Hao continued learning about home renovation and made a DIY tool list based on actual needs: putty knives, roller brushes, bristle brushes, sandpaper holders, mixing buckets, floor protection film, and more. He saved the list to his phone's memo app, then biked to a nearby hardware and building materials store, where he bought a putty knife, sandpaper, and protection film on the spot. He planned to buy the remaining tools online during Double 12.

events.name: Ask Chen Jianguo about his experience with wall scraping.
events.description: In the evening, Yin Hao contacted Chen Jianguo, the owner of the repair shop, via WeChat voice call to ask for tips on removing old wall surfaces. Master Chen explained in detail the angle at which to hold the scraper, how to apply force, and clever tricks for dealing with stubborn paint. Yin Hao jotted them all down and felt more confident about the upcoming renovation.

2025-12.daily_overview: On Monday, a workday, Yin Hao maintained a healthy diet. In the evening, he had an in-depth video call with his father, finalized the initial plan for kitchen and bathroom waterproofing and wall renovation in the new home, and immediately searched online for materials, planning to make purchases during Double 12. Before going to bed, he reviewed a chapter of the PLC programming online course, handling study and home renovation in parallel.

events.name: Video-called his father to discuss the renovation plan for the new house.
events.description: At 20:00 on the evening of December 8, 2025, Yin Hao had a WeChat video call with his father Yin Jianguo, who was in his hometown in Rudong County, Nantong, Jiangsu. He described in detail the layout and current bare-shell condition of the new house. Relying on years of mechanical maintenance and home improvement experience, his father suggested prioritizing kitchen and bathroom waterproofing and whole-house wall renovation, and recommended material brands one by one: Nippon Paint Odorless 120 latex paint and DAVCO flexible waterproof coating, while estimating the approximate quantities. Yin Hao listened carefully and recorded the key points one by one in his phone memo. The father and son also had a preliminary discussion on the construction steps. The call lasted about 40 minutes.

events.name: Searched online for renovation materials and added them to the shopping cart.
events.description: After the video call ended, Yin Hao immediately opened the Taobao app and, based on his father's advice and his own notes, searched for Nippon latex paint, Davco waterproof coating, and auxiliary materials such as roller brushes, putty knives, and protective film. He carefully compared prices, sales volume, and user reviews across different stores, added the products that met his needs to the shopping cart one by one, and prepared to place orders for the upcoming Double 12 promotion.

events.name: Evening PLC programming online course
events.description: After organizing the shopping cart, Yin Hao opened the Open University of China learning platform, reviewed Lecture 6 of 'Advanced PLC Programming' that he had missed last week, and simulated several ladder diagrams on the computer using code examples. He studied until 22:30 before washing up and going to bed.

2025-12.daily_overview: Payday arrived, and the year-end bonus hitting his account delighted Yin Hao. He quickly made a financial plan, transferring most of it to his loan repayment account and setting aside a small portion as flexible funds. In the evening, he shared the joy with his girlfriend Lin Yue over video call and finalized their plan to visit IKEA on New Year's Day. Lin Yue officially told him she had been successfully transferred to the Shanghai branch and would report next Monday. Both their relationship and finances were on solid ground.

events.name: Received salary and year-end bonus and checked them.
events.description: At 10:00 AM on December 10, 2025, Yin Hao received a bank SMS notification while working in the workshop, showing that December's basic salary and annual performance bonus had been credited, totaling 15,000 yuan after tax. During a work break, he checked the amount and confirmed it was correct, and his mood immediately lightened.

events.name: Transfer funds to the loan repayment account and savings account
events.description: At noon, Yin Hao used the mobile banking app to transfer 10,000 yuan from his salary card to the designated mortgage repayment account, ensuring sufficient funds for the first automatic deduction on the 20th of this month. In the afternoon, he transferred the remaining 5,000 yuan to a demand savings account as a reserve fund for going home for the Spring Festival and the subsequent soft furnishing of the new house, maintaining liquidity.

events.name: Shared the good news with girlfriend Lin Yue via video and planned a meeting
events.description: At 20:00 in the evening, Yin Hao had a WeChat video call with his girlfriend Lin Yue. He showed her the screenshot of the bonus arriving in his account, and excitedly shared the progress of the loan disbursement and the news that he would soon get the keys. Lin Yue also told him good news: she had successfully applied to transfer to the Shanghai branch and would officially report next Monday (December 15). They happily discussed going to IKEA in Shanghai after New Year's Day to choose furniture, and made an initial schedule for bringing Lin Yue back to Nantong to meet his parents during the Spring Festival. Lin Yue promised to ask for leave from her company as soon as possible, and Yin Hao felt warm at heart.

events.name: Update the renovation budget section in the shared family ledger.
events.description: In the evening, Yin Hao opened the bookkeeping app he shared with Lin Yue, recorded the year-end bonus deposit and transfer in categories, and added a 5,000 yuan soft furnishing fund in the decoration budget section, with the note 'prepared for IKEA purchases'.

After placing the order, he immediately reported to his father, and the father and son chatted on WeChat for a while about construction details. Late at night, he was too excited to sleep, got up again and opened the computer to draw a living room layout, but then realized there was an important presentation tomorrow, so he forced himself to fall asleep before 23:30.

events.name: Comparing and selecting decoration materials and adding them to the shopping cart during the day.
events.description: During the day on December 12, 2025, Yin Hao used work intervals and his lunch break to repeatedly compare specifications and prices on Taobao and JD.com on his phone for latex paint, waterproof coating, painting tools, and protective film. He focused on an official flagship store of Nippon Paint and a highly rated tool store, selected items for promotional bundles, and claimed the platform's category coupon of 300 yuan off purchases over 2,000 yuan, getting ready to place the order in the evening.

events.name: At exactly 8 p.m., placed and paid for an order using a coupon
events.description: At 20:00 on the evening of December 12, 2025, Yin Hao opened the Taobao and JD.com apps on time and entered the shopping cart to confirm the items: 2 buckets of Nippon Paint Odorless 120 latex paint, a set of Davco flexible waterproof coating, a painting tool set (including roller, brush, and tray), and floor protective film. He carefully checked that the shipping address was his current rental apartment, and completed the payment using a threshold discount coupon. But he realized he had an important presentation tomorrow and forced himself to put down his phone and fall asleep before 23:30.

2025-12.daily_overview: Saturday was packed: in the morning, he completed the year's final presentation on the spirit of craftsmanship and received a volunteer service certificate, boosting his professional reputation; in the afternoon, he went on the year's last long-distance bike ride, enjoying the winter sunshine; in the evening, he checked logistics and sorted out the documents for picking up the keys. After the ride, due to the cold air, he drank a large bowl of hot soup at dinner, and his weight rose slightly.

events.name: Craftsmanship spirit presentation and received a volunteer service certificate
events.description: On the morning of December 13, 2025, Yin Hao did a final rehearsal of his presentation PPT in his home study, then took his ID and drove to the meeting hall of the Songjiang District Federation of Trade Unions. At 9:00 a.m., he gave the final craftsman-spirit lecture of the year, telling the story of his growth from a soldier to a CNC operator and conveying his passion for technology. The audience of about 50 responded enthusiastically with continuous applause. After the lecture, leaders of the Songjiang District Federation of Trade Unions presented him with the annual volunteer service certificate, commending his contributions to multiple public lectures over the past year.

events.name: Attended the presentation summary exchange to build connections
events.description: After the presentation, Yin Hao attended the annual craftsman spirit presentation summary and exchange meeting organized by the Federation of Trade Unions. At the meeting, he had in-depth exchanges with several senior technicians from industries such as shipbuilding and precision machining. They exchanged contact information and agreed to discuss technology in the future. This exchange laid the foundation for possible cross-industry cooperation later on.

events.name: Check the delivery status of renovation materials bought online
events.description: After returning home in the afternoon, Yin Hao checked his orders on Taobao and JD.com on his phone. The four orders — latex paint, waterproof coating, painting tools, and protective film — had been shipped by different couriers and were expected to arrive in Songjiang, Shanghai around December 15. He recorded the tracking numbers one by one in his memo app, preparing to receive the goods.

events.name: The last weekend ride of the year
events.description: At 2:00 p.m. on December 13, 2025, Yin Hao put on thermal cycling gear, fastened his helmet and gloves, mounted his road bike, and went on the last weekend ride of the year. He chose a familiar route in the city: starting from his home in Guangfulin, Songjiang, via Husong Highway to Zizhu Science and Technology Park in Minhang, then returning along the Huangpu River waterfront trail, about 35 kilometers in total. Although the temperature was only around 8°C, it was sunny. During the ride, he took a few winter photos of the riverside scenery and returned home at 5 p.m.

events.name: Organize the documents needed for picking up the keys.
events.description: In the evening, Yin Hao took out the document folder from the drawer, arranged his ID card, house purchase contract, loan disbursement certificate and other materials in order, and put them into his backpack after verifying the information. He also saved the agent's contact number and the transaction center address as a note on his phone to ensure smooth processing early the next morning.

2025-12.daily_overview: On Sunday, Yin Hao remotely urged his mother to recheck her blood pressure and received good results, temporarily setting aside his worries about family health. In the morning, the bank loan disbursement notice made him excited, and he immediately confirmed with the agent to pick up the keys the next day. In the afternoon, his mother's follow-up examination was normal, and in the evening he shared the good news with his older brother. In the early evening, he began light cleaning as a warm-up for the new home renovation, but he accidentally scraped old putty and developed a blister on his right palm. After treating the wound, he still insisted on organizing and packing the tools, getting ready to start at full capacity the next day.

events.name: WeChat video call to remind mother to have her blood pressure rechecked.
events.description: At 9:00 AM on December 14, 2025, Yin Hao contacted his mother Wang Xiuying, who was far away in his hometown of Nantong, via WeChat video, asked how she had been lately, and repeatedly urged her to go to the community hospital today for a blood pressure follow-up. His mother said she felt fine and agreed to go in the morning. Only then did Yin Hao feel somewhat relieved and end the call.

events.name: Received the bank's loan disbursement notice and scheduled an appointment to collect the keys.
events.description: At 10:30 a.m., Yin Hao's phone text message alert sounded, showing that the personal housing loan had been successfully disbursed to the seller's account. He immediately called Manager Li, the real estate agent, to confirm the disbursement had arrived, and made an appointment for 9:00 a.m. on December 15 (Monday) at the Songjiang District Real Estate Transaction Center to complete the procedures for receiving the keys. After hanging up, Yin Hao clenched his fist and made a 'Yes' gesture.

events.name: Mother completed the blood pressure recheck and reported the results
events.description: On the afternoon of December 14, 2025, following her son's instructions, Wang Xiuying went alone to the Juegang Town Community Health Service Center in Rudong County. The doctor measured her blood pressure at 128/82 mmHg. The result was well controlled, and he advised her to continue her current medication and lifestyle. Wang Xiuying took a photo of the record and sent it to Yin Hao via WeChat.

events.name: Confirm that his mother's blood pressure is stable and remind her to continue taking her medication.
events.description: At 15:00 in the afternoon, Yin Hao received a photo from his mother showing her blood pressure recheck results. After examining it carefully, he felt much relieved. He replied to his mother via WeChat voice message, praising her for staying consistent, and told her that as usual he would buy her blood pressure medication monthly through an online pharmacy and have it shipped directly home. His mother's laughter came through, warming his heart.

events.name: Shared the good news of the loan disbursement in the family group
events.description: In the evening, Yin Hao posted a message in the family WeChat group: 'The bank has released the loan, we're getting the keys tomorrow!' and added a victory emoji. His older brother Yin Tao instantly replied with three thumbs-up, while his father simply responded, 'Good boy, be steady, and follow the plan for the renovation.' Yin Hao smiled, put down his phone, and began browsing the renovation notes he had saved earlier.

events.name: Pre-organized renovation tools and accidentally got a blister
events.description: At 18:00 in the evening, Yin Hao could not contain his eagerness to get working. He took out the scraper, sandpaper, protective film, and other tools he had bought, wiped and organized them. He tried using the scraper to practice removing old paint from the old wooden wall on the balcony of his rented apartment. Because he used too much force and was not wearing gloves, a blister soon formed on his right palm. He immediately disinfected it with alcohol and put on a band-aid, but this did not stop him from neatly packing the tools into a plastic box to prepare for tomorrow's transport.

2025-12.daily_overview: Worked normally in the morning; took leave in the afternoon and went to the transaction center to get the new house keys; in the evening, did a simple inspection and initial planning of the new house.

events.name: Completed Monday's routine production tasks in the workshop in the morning
events.description: At 8:00 a.m. on December 15, 2025, Yin Hao arrived at the manufacturing workshop in Songjiang District and began his Monday routine production tasks. He operated the CNC machine to machine parts, completed product spot-check records, and was in good working condition.

events.name: After the lunch break, asked team leader Wang Lei for half a day of leave.
events.description: At 12:00 noon, Yin Hao hastily finished lunch in the cafeteria, then found team leader Wang Lei, explained that he needed to pick up the keys to his new house today and asked for half a day off. Wang Lei readily agreed. After signing the leave request form, Yin Hao left the factory at 12:30.

events.name: Received the renovation materials ordered online during Double 12 at the rental apartment.
events.description: Around 1 p.m., Yin Hao first returned to his rented apartment and received two large boxes delivered by the courier (one from Taobao and one from JD.com). He opened them one by one and checked carefully: the latex paint bucket was intact with no dents, the waterproof coating was tightly packed, the painting tools were complete in variety, and the protective film was not damaged. After confirming everything was correct, he signed the delivery receipt and temporarily placed the materials in the living room.

events.name: Drove to the property transaction center to pick up the keys to the new house
events.description: At 14:00 on December 15, 2025, Yin Hao took his documents folder and drove to the Songjiang District Real Estate Transaction Center. At 14:30, he completed the procedures at the counter with his ID card, purchase contract, and bank disbursement certificate, and officially received the keychain for a second-hand apartment in a residential community in Songjiang. As he signed the handover documents, his hand trembled slightly.

events.name: Visited the new apartment and completed the property registration
events.description: After receiving the keys, Yin Hao immediately drove to the new housing community. He first went to the property management office to complete occupancy registration, verify the owner information, and obtain an access card. Then he unlocked his own door with the key and stood in the center of the rough-finished apartment, looking around. Although it was empty, a sense of belonging welled up. He checked the water pipes and electrical circuits in the kitchen and bathroom one by one to see whether they were preliminarily usable, and confirmed they were basically fine.

events.name: Shared the real view of the new apartment with his mother via WeChat video.
events.description: At 3:30 PM, Yin Hao dialed his mother Wang Xiuying on WeChat video in his new house. He slowly swept the phone camera across every corner of the living room and bedroom, and said excitedly, “Mom, this is our home now!” On the other side of the screen, seeing that her son had a house of his own in Shanghai, his mother was so moved that her eyes reddened, and she kept saying “good.” Yin Hao said firmly, “Mom, when you come later, you'll have a place to stay.” The call lasted about 10 minutes.

events.name: Take photos of the new house and send them to the family group chat.
events.description: After the video call ended, Yin Hao used his phone to carefully take photos of the original condition of the living room, master bedroom, second bedroom, kitchen, and bathroom, and sent them to the family group chat via WeChat to share the good news of getting the new house with his father Yin Jianguo and brother Yin Tao. His father replied, 'Hurry up and take measurements; tomorrow I'll draw you the water and electricity diagram.' His brother sent a red envelope to congratulate.

events.name: Go to the building materials market to buy urgently needed tools and reinforcement coating.
events.description: At 16:00, after inspecting the new house, Yin Hao drove to a building materials market 3 kilometers away. On site, he bought a scraper, sandpaper holder, mixing bucket, brush, roller, protective film, and a small bucket of waterproof coating (in case the coating ordered online was insufficient or had not arrived), and also rented an industrial vacuum cleaner. He planned to start cleaning and construction the next day.

events.name: Load the first batch of renovation materials onto the vehicle and transport them to the new apartment.
events.description: At 17:00, Yin Hao returned to his rental apartment. He loaded the latex paint buckets and some tools stacked in the living room into the trunk and back seat of his private car for the first trip. He carefully secured them to prevent tipping over, then drove to the new housing community.

events.name: Unload the goods and store them in the storage room of the new house.
events.description: After arriving at the new house, Yin Hao unloaded the first batch of materials from the car, moved them all into the ground-floor storage room, stacked them against the wall, and lightly covered them with protective film to ensure safety.

events.name: Return to the rental apartment to load the second batch of materials.
events.description: After unloading the first batch, Yin Hao drove the empty vehicle back to the rental apartment, loaded the remaining buckets of waterproof coating, painting tools, protective film, and other items, and prepared for the second transport.

events.name: Transported again and completed moving all materials.
events.description: At around 18:00, Yin Hao drove to the new house for the second time, moved the second batch of materials into the storage room, and combined them with the first batch. He counted all the items: 2 buckets of latex paint, 1 set of waterproof coating + 1 small bucket, 2 tool sets, and 2 rolls of protective film, confirming everything had arrived.

events.name: Take photos of the renovation materials in the storage room for the record
events.description: After stacking everything neatly, Yin Hao took a few photos with his phone of the overall view of the storage room and the material details as an acceptance record. He then closed the storage room door and prepared to leave.

events.name: Checked and photographed the original condition of the new house before renovation.
events.description: At 18:30 in the evening, Yin Hao inspected the whole house again and used his phone to photograph the original state of every wall, every pipe, and the floor, as a reference for later renovation comparison. He also marked several hollow spots that needed priority treatment in his phone's memo, but did not start construction immediately.

events.name: Video call with girlfriend Lin Yue to share the joy of getting the keys
events.description: At 20:00, Yin Hao returned to the rental apartment. Too busy to eat dinner, he first connected a WeChat video call with his girlfriend Lin Yue. He turned the phone camera toward the new house keys in his hand and the photos of the unfinished apartment he had taken in the afternoon on his phone, excitedly describing the process of receiving the keys. Lin Yue was happy for him and also reminded him to rest. The two agreed to go to IKEA on the first weekend after New Year's Day to buy furnishings such as beds and sofas, and once again confirmed the itinerary for returning to Nantong during the Spring Festival (Lin Yue had already requested leave from her company).

events.name: Record important milestones in the phone calendar and upload progress to the family group chat.
events.description: After the video call, Yin Hao opened the calendar app on his phone and entered one by one Lin Yue's confirmed leave dates (compensatory leave arranged after she reports to work on January 2), the IKEA shopping day (the weekend of January 7-8), and the date for returning to Nantong for Spring Festival (departing on January 27), setting reminders in advance. Then he sent the photos of the whole house in its bare-shell state taken today to the family WeChat group, with the message 'Got the keys, work starts tomorrow!' His father and elder brother both liked it. Looking at the packed schedule on the calendar, he felt his life was accelerating toward a new stage.

During the day, I efficiently completed machine tool operations and data recording in the workshop. After work, I signed for the JD.com renovation auxiliary materials, then immediately joined the evening running group's interval training. After the training, I went to the new house and thoroughly cleaned the kitchen and bathroom floor bases and applied the first coat of waterproof coating. I waited for it to dry and then finished up. events.name: Morning core training and weighing.
events.description: At 6:15 in the morning, he got up, spread out a yoga mat in the living room, followed a plank instructional video for 15 minutes of core training (plank with alternating arm raises, side plank), then weighed 70.2kg on an empty stomach and took a multivitamin.

events.name: Sign for renovation auxiliary materials.
events.description: After getting off work in the afternoon, I returned to the rented apartment and received the package from JD.com containing latex paint, waterproof coating, and painting tools. After carefully checking that the paint buckets had no leaks, the waterproof materials were well sealed, and the tool count was correct, I signed for the delivery and stacked the materials neatly in the corner of the living room.

events.name: Evening 10 km interval running training
events.description: At 7 p.m., he met up with running group partners Wang Lei, Liu Zhiqiang, and Zhang Wei at Songjiang Sports Center for a 10-kilometer training run. He clearly felt that the renovation over the previous two weeks had consumed some of his energy, but he still actively added 4 sets of 400-meter interval runs to improve endurance, and recorded the split pace for each kilometer one by one (average pace 5:38). After the training, he led everyone through serious stretching and relaxation, shared winter warm-up and hydration tips, and the team's coordination became smoother.

events.name: Thoroughly clean the floor substrate in the kitchen and bathroom
events.description: After a quick rinse following the run, drove to the new house. Using a flashlight, carefully inspected the kitchen and bathroom floors, scraped off residual mortar particles with a scraper, swept away dust with a broom, then mopped the floor with a wet mop to ensure the base was level and free of loose dust and grease, preparing it for waterproofing.

events.name: Apply the first coat of waterproof coating to the kitchen and bathroom floors.
events.description: After cleaning the base surface, take out the waterproof coating and mix it as required. Apply it evenly to the kitchen and bathroom floors with a roller and brush, paying special attention to wall corners and pipe roots to ensure no spots are missed. After application, close the doors and windows and let the waterproof layer dry naturally; do not apply a second coat.

events.name: Before bed: keeping accounts and stretching
events.description: Returning to the rented apartment near midnight, he opened the bookkeeping app and entered today's expenses on renovation materials, washed up briefly, then did 5 minutes of meditation and stretching to relieve shoulder and neck fatigue before going to sleep.
