After getting off work, he received the last batch of decoration auxiliary materials from Taobao, then went to the new house to apply the second coat of waterproof coating on the kitchen and bathroom floors and started the water ponding test. Midway, he video-called his mother to show the wall scraping progress in the living room and master bedroom; after her reminders, he felt even more motivated. Late at night, he finished the base layer treatment of the living room and master bedroom walls, laying the foundation for applying putty. Before bed, he kept accounts and stretched to relax.

events.name: Morning core training and weighing.
events.description: Got up at 6:20, did 15 minutes of core training in the living room (plank, hip raises, etc.), weighed in on an empty stomach at 70.0 kg, took vitamins, and prepared a lunchbox.

events.name: Commuting to work by bike
events.description: At 7:20 a.m., put on winter cycling clothes, rode a shared bike along Guangfulin Road to the company, a 15-minute ride, as a daily cardio supplement.

events.name: Received the final batch of home renovation deliveries.
events.description: After getting off work in the afternoon, returned to the rented apartment and signed for the last package delivered from Taobao, which contained the remaining two buckets of latex paint, an additional waterproof coating, and disposable protective film. Checked the items one by one, confirmed the quantities matched the order, then stacked the materials in the corner of the living room. At this point, all the renovation auxiliary materials bought during Double 12 had arrived.

events.name: Applied the second coat of waterproof coating to the kitchen and bathroom floors and began the water retention test
events.description: After receiving the package, I went straight to the new apartment. First, I applied a second coat of waterproof coating to the kitchen and bathroom floors, spreading it evenly and paying extra attention to the corners and pipe roots. After finishing, I waited about 30 minutes for the coating to dry on the surface, then filled the kitchen and bathroom floors with about 2-3 cm of water to begin the water retention test. I marked the water level and planned to observe for leaks after 24 hours.

events.name: Clean the living room walls and prepare for a video call
events.description: After the water tightness test began, brought tools to the living room, first swept and cleaned the wall area where the old paint had been removed, then adjusted the angle with the phone stand to ensure the camera could clearly capture the living room and master bedroom walls, and then sent a WeChat message to mother Wang Xiuying to confirm the time for a later video call.

events.name: Showed renovation progress to mother via WeChat video call.
events.description: At 8 p.m., he made a video call on time to his mother, who was at home in Rudong County, Nantong, Jiangsu. He pointed the camera at the living room and master bedroom walls where the old paint had been scraped off, and explained in detail the putty application process and the estimated time required. Seeing that her son was taking on such heavy physical work on his own, his mother worriedly reminded him again and again to balance work and rest and not overdo it, and told him that the sofa covers she had sewn by hand were finished. Yin Hao agreed to buy groceries and cook soup on the weekend to nourish himself, and the mother and son chatted about everyday things for a while before hanging up.

events.name: Removed the old paint layer from the living room and master bedroom walls.
events.description: After ending the phone call with his mother, he put on a mask and goggles, started in the living room, and used a scraper and sander to remove old paint and peeling coatings. First he roughly scraped large areas, then sanded until basically smooth, continuously using a broom to clear fallen paint chips, and being careful to protect the corners where water pipes were exposed. After finishing the living room, he moved to the master bedroom and handled it in the same way. After more than two hours of continuous work, the old paint on the living room and master bedroom walls was largely removed.

events.name: Fine-sand and clean dust off the living room and master bedroom walls
events.description: After the scraping was done, inspection found stubborn old paint remaining in corners and around switch boxes, so he switched to a small scraper for focused removal. Then he restarted the sander and carefully sanded the living room and master bedroom walls to ensure a smooth, even surface. Late at night, he thoroughly cleaned the dust and debris from the walls and floor with a broom and a borrowed industrial vacuum, preparing for the next day's putty application. When he left, the two rooms were clean and tidy.

events.name: Keeping accounts, stretching, and going to sleep
events.description: Returned to the rental apartment at nearly 23:00. After recording expenses, took a shower and did a simple 5-minute leg stretch to relieve the muscle tension from squatting for a long time while scraping walls.

start_state.mood: Stayed focused and planned the evening renovation work

end_state.location: Inside the rented apartment
end_state.mood: Although extremely exhausted, the renovation made great progress, and I felt gratified inside.

events.name: Preparing review materials for the digital transformation project
events.description: In the morning at my workstation in the workshop, during work breaks I retrieved recent data collection logs, organized the records of the data collection and feedback segment I am responsible for, and drafted three specific suggestions based on practical bottlenecks and optimization ideas: increasing data collection frequency, optimizing sensor placement, and introducing a caching mechanism to reduce latency. I prepared a speaking outline for the afternoon review meeting. I also did a 5-minute stretch during the break.

events.name: Attended the digital transformation project review meeting
events.description: At 2 p.m., he went to the company meeting room on time to attend the digital transformation project review meeting jointly organized by the production department and the technical department. He proactively shared his experience and shortcomings from the practical stage and systematically put forward three suggestions on adjusting sensor distribution and improving the data feedback process. The technical department manager evaluated them on the spot and decided to adopt them immediately, and asked Yin Hao to continue participating in the optimization and implementation afterward.

events.name: Discussed next year's plans with mentor Sun Jianguo
events.description: After the review meeting, Master Sun Jianguo stopped Yin Hao in the workshop corridor, and the two briefly discussed the direction of technical upgrades for next year. Yin Hao suggested introducing an offline programming system into daily operations to improve efficiency; Master Sun approved and advised him to first collect relevant materials, then the two would discuss in more detail next week and submit a project initiation application to the technical department.

events.name: Evening routine 10 km run
events.description: At 7:00 p.m., he completed the routine 10-kilometer training run at Songjiang Sports Center with Wang Lei, Liu Zhiqiang, and Zhang Wei. Since the daytime meetings had drained his energy, he deliberately kept the pace at 5:32 and gradually increased it to 5:20 in the final 2 kilometers. After the training, he led the group through a 15-minute stretching session and taught them foam roller techniques for relaxing leg muscles. After the run, Zhang Wei teased, “You've been doing the renovation like you've had a shot of adrenaline these days—you don't even complain about being tired when running.” Everyone burst into laughter.

events.name: Morning core training and weighing.
events.description: Woke up at 6:15, did 15 minutes of core training, weighed in at 69.8 kg, took vitamins, and brought the bento prepared in advance.

events.name: Commuting to work by bike
events.description: At 7:25 in the morning, I rode out by bike and observed the fallen-leaf scenery on Guangfulin Road along the way, feeling calm.

events.name: Preparing for the Winter Solstice dumpling-wrapping event
events.description: In the afternoon, taking advantage of a work break, I officially posted the notice for the Winter Solstice dumpling-making event in the homeowner WeChat group of Guangfulin Road Community, stating that it would be held at 9 a.m. on December 21 in the community activity room, and calling on neighbors to bring their own rolling pins and signature fillings. Then I privately messaged Aunt Chen (Chen Xiuying), my neighbor across the hall, and the two of us agreed: Aunt Chen would be responsible for on-site coordination and sharing old Shanghai Winter Solstice customs, while Yin Hao would be responsible for buying ingredients and hosting the event.

events.name: Apply base and finish coats of putty
events.description: After work, he had a simple dinner and hurried to the new house. First, he mixed the base leveling putty and applied it in sequence starting from the living room with a large scraper, focusing on flatness and doing his best to smooth the wall corner lines. After the base layer was surface-dry, he immediately mixed a fine top-coat putty and applied a second thin coat. Sometimes bending down, sometimes reaching high, he did not finish coating all the walls in the house until late at night, with his arms sore and swollen. After finishing, he checked the walls and waited for them to dry, planning to sand and paint the next day.

events.name: Before bed: keeping accounts and stretching
events.description: Back at the rental apartment, he quickly logged the renovation materials and rent expenses, then did a 10-minute full-body stretch after a hot shower to relieve fatigue.

2025-12.daily_overview: The first month's mortgage payment was automatically deducted, and the fund investment plan was also deducted, marking the start of my loan repayment life. In the early morning, I bought pork ribs at the vegetable market to fulfill my promise to my mother, then purchased healthy ingredients. In the morning, I thoroughly sanded yesterday's putty layer and cleaned up the dust; afterward, I spent the rest of the day applying latex paint to the walls and finishing the renovation. When my father did a video acceptance check, he couldn't hide his pride. In the evening, I stewed pork rib soup for myself to replenish my energy. Before going to bed, I kept the accounts and updated the renovation progress.

events.name: Morning core training and weighing.
events.description: Got up at 6:00; even though it was the weekend, he still did 15 minutes of core training, weighed 69.7 kg on an empty stomach, and took vitamins.

events.name: First month's mortgage payment and automatic fund investment deduction
events.description: In the morning, the bank automatically deducted the first month's mortgage payment of about 6,200 yuan, and the monthly fund investment of 500 yuan on the 20th was also deducted as usual. After receiving the text message, he logged into mobile banking to confirm, and marked the entries as first-month mortgage payment and regular investment in the bookkeeping app.

events.name: Go to the vegetable market to buy pork ribs, following mother's advice.
events.description: At 7:30 in the morning, I drove to the market near Guangfulin Road and specifically bought fresh pork ribs, winter melon, and goji berries, planning to make a slow-cooked soup in the evening to build up strength. Recalling my mother's distressed look during the video call the day before yesterday, I quietly decided to take good care of myself no matter how busy I am.

events.name: Week 3 healthy ingredients shopping.
events.description: After buying the pork ribs, I stopped by the supermarket on the way and did the weekly grocery shopping. Following my healthy meal plan, I stocked up on mixed grains, eggs, chicken breast, broccoli, carrots, and so on, and also picked up two pieces of soft tofu to increase plant protein. Pushing the cart, I selected items quickly and checked out in less than half an hour.

events.name: Thoroughly sanded the putty layer applied yesterday.
events.description: After returning from buying groceries (around 8:30), changed into old clothes and started sanding the putty layer applied yesterday. First used sandpaper to smooth the uneven areas of the wall, then used fine sandpaper to polish the whole area, and finally used a vacuum cleaner to thoroughly remove the dust. It took about 1.5 hours, preparing the wall for primer.

events.name: Apply primer and two coats of topcoat
events.description: At 10:30 in the morning, he carried a paint bucket and a new roller back to the new house. First he lightly sanded the putty layer with sandpaper (it had actually been sanded before, so this was just a quick check), then applied the primer according to the instructions. After the primer dried, he opened the first bucket of finish paint and rolled it evenly in one direction starting from the bedroom, striving for uniform color. After lunch he did not rest and continued applying the second coat of finish paint, focusing on the ceiling seams and areas around the light fixtures. At 5 PM, the walls throughout the house finally took on a soft, uniform, milky white sheen.

events.name: Check the water-tightness test and drain the water.
events.description: After finishing the wall work, he briefly checked the watertightness test in the kitchen and bathroom, confirmed that the water level had not dropped and there were no signs of seepage downstairs, then opened the floor drain to let the water run out and dried the floor.

events.name: Cleared renovation debris and put tools away.
events.description: In the evening, the first major cleaning since the renovation began was carried out: waste paint buckets, empty packaging bags, used brushes, and gloves were sorted into garbage bags; tools were wiped clean and put back in the toolbox; the floor was swept and mopped. The remaining materials were gathered in a corner of the balcony to make room for the next step of laying the floor.

events.name: Had a video call with my father to check the wall, and stewed some soup.
events.description: At 7 p.m., had a video call with his father Yin Jianguo, holding the phone around the room to show the freshly finished wall, and shared the painting techniques he had summarized. After watching, his father praised repeatedly: "I didn't expect you could do this all by yourself—it's better than I imagined!" and formally said that after the Spring Festival he would definitely come to Shanghai to help lay the floor. After the call, he stewed a pot of winter melon and pork rib soup with the ribs bought that morning. While drinking the soup, he felt the warmth dispel the fatigue of the week.

events.name: Body fat scale measurement.
events.description: Before bed, he measured his body composition with the body fat scale: weight 69.7 kg, body fat percentage 18.2%, slightly lower than at the beginning of the month. He recorded it with satisfaction.

events.name: Keeping accounts and uploading renovation photos
events.description: Uploaded today's renovation photos to the family group, and my father gave a thumbs-up. Then I recorded the day's expenses, turned off the lights, and rested.

start_state.mood: Clear goals, ready for a busy weekend

end_state.location: Inside the rented apartment
end_state.mood: Relaxation and pride interwoven after the main renovation was completed

2025-12.daily_overview: On the winter solstice, Yin Hao organized the community dumpling-making event from start to finish, spent the traditional festival with his neighbors, and brought warmth to elderly residents living alone, earning praise from the community. After the event, he rested briefly. In the afternoon, he held a key celebration with friends at his new home, with barbecue and a movie, and gained new ideas for an aerial photography side business. Chen Jianguo, the owner of a repair shop, brought a refurbished refrigerator and an old stereo for repair. In the evening, he called his mother to ask about her blood pressure, keeping family care in mind. Before bed, he recorded expenses and stretched.

events.name: Morning core training and weighing.
events.description: Got up at 6:15, did 15 minutes of core training, weighed 70.0 kg (possibly due to last night's soup), and took vitamins.

events.name: Purchased supplies for the dumpling-making activity.
events.description: At 7 a.m., he drove to the market and bought according to the list: dumpling wrappers, ground pork, chives, Chinese cabbage, eggs, dried shrimp, seasonings, plus disposable gloves and storage bags. At 8:30, he returned to the residential community and, together with Aunt Chen who had arrived early, carried the ingredients to the activity room, set up tables, chairs, and tableware, and set up the induction cooker and a pot.

events.name: Host the Winter Solstice dumpling-making event
events.description: Starting at 9 a.m., more than twenty tenants and homeowners arrived one after another and gathered around the long table to make dumplings. Yin Hao moved among them, personally demonstrating how to pinch even pleats and helping several young tenants master the technique. Auntie Chen, while wrapping dumplings, told in authentic Shanghai dialect the custom of eating dumplings and drinking winter-brewed wine on the Winter Solstice. In between, Yin Hao also had to boil water, put dumplings in the pot, scoop them out, and invite everyone to taste. The activity room was steaming hot and full of laughter.

events.name: Delivered dumplings to Grandpa Wang, an elderly person living alone
events.description: At about 12:30 noon, as the event was drawing to a close, Yin Hao specially used a clean lunch box to pack a plate of steaming dumplings and knocked on the door of Wang Jianguo (76), an elderly man living alone downstairs. Smiling, he said, "Grandpa Wang, happy Winter Solstice." The old man took the dumplings, his eyes moist, and repeatedly thanked him, pulling Yin Hao inside to sit down. Yin Hao chatted with him about daily life for over ten minutes, left his phone number, and told him to contact him anytime if he needed anything.

events.name: Clean up the event venue and distribute leftover ingredients
events.description: From 1 PM to 2 PM, together with Aunt Chen and several other enthusiastic residents, they washed pots, bowls, plates and basins, wiped tables, mopped the floor and disinfected, and distributed the leftover dumpling wrappers and filling to neighbors who were willing to take them home. He posted a message in the owners' group thanking everyone for participating, along with a group photo of the event, and the neighbors all liked it. Afterward, he took the two boxes of dumplings he had kept for himself home and refrigerated them.

events.name: Purchasing supplies for the celebration and decorating the new home
events.description: At 2:30 in the afternoon, drove to the supermarket to buy barbecue ingredients (beef, chicken wings, vegetables), drinks, disposable tableware, etc., then hurried to the new house on Guangfulin Road. Cleaned up the living room, set up the portable barbecue grill, took out the old projector and adjusted it against the white wall, and connected the phone to play aerial videos in preparation.

events.name: Hold a key celebration party
events.description: At 4 p.m., friends Wang Lei, Gao Zhiyuan, Ma Xiaofeng, and Chen Jie arrived at the new house one after another. Seeing the freshly painted walls, everyone marveled at Yin Hao's handyman skills. They had a barbecue and drank beer in the empty living room, and the atmosphere was lively. Chen Jianguo, the repair shop owner, also came by afterward, bringing a small refrigerator he had refurbished as a housewarming gift. Yin Hao was deeply moved. As he was leaving, Chen Jianguo carried an old speaker out of his car, saying it had some static noise and asking Yin Hao to take a look sometime to see if it could be fixed.

events.name: Show aerial photography works and discuss side hustles.
events.description: In the evening after dinner, the projector played a collection of aerial footage—the morning light over Dianshan Lake, the sprint at the Sheshan Half Marathon, and the sunset by the East China Sea—which drew repeated praise from friends. After watching, Gao Zhiyuan slapped his thigh and said, "With this level of skill, you could definitely make money doing wedding aerial photography!" Zhang Fei, a gaming friend on a video call, also suggested he learn editing software and turn the footage into a demo reel to take orders. Yin Hao immediately took out his phone and noted the suggestion in his memo app, planting the seed of an aerial photography side business in his mind.

events.name: Clean up after the celebration ends.
events.description: At 9 p.m., the friends gradually left. Yin Hao stayed alone to clean up: he washed the barbecue grill and utensils, swept the floor, moved the new refrigerator to a corner and plugged it in for a test, and checked again that devices such as the projector were turned off. He also moved the old sound system into the house, placed it in a corner, and planned to repair it another day. Although cleaning up alone was a bit lonely, ideas for a side business were spinning in his mind.

events.name: Calling mother to check on her blood pressure
events.description: Before bed, he remembered to ask about his mother's blood pressure, so he made a brief WeChat video call. His mother said her blood pressure had been stable at around 130/85 recently and she had been taking her medicine on time. Yin Hao told her to keep paying attention to her diet. After hanging up, he felt somewhat reassured.

events.name: Yu'e Bao automatic transfer
events.description: Today is Sunday. The mobile banking app automatically transferred 500 yuan to Yu'e Bao as the weekly forced savings.

events.name: Expense recording and stretching
events.description: Recorded the day's expenses and today's Yu'ebao transfer, and did 10 minutes of evening stretching to relieve the leg and foot fatigue from a busy day.

end_state.location: Inside the rented apartment
end_state.mood: Filled with community warmth and joy of friendship, eager to try aerial photography as a side hustle

Everyone's morale was high.

events.name: Start sorting and organizing room items
events.description: After running and taking a shower, he changed into old clothes and took out all the items in his rental apartment from cabinets, drawers, and under the bed, spreading them across the living room floor. He sorted them into six categories: "clothing," "tools/parts," "books and documents," "electronics," "kitchenware," and "souvenirs/miscellaneous," covering the floor. He checked each item one by one. Trying on a few old work pants, he found them a bit tight at the waist; he assessed an old wrench as severely worn and slipping, so he put these into the to-be-disposed pile. During the sorting, he came across the red epaulettes from his military discharge and the rental contract from when he first arrived in Shanghai, and was momentarily dazed. But then he shook his head and continued focusing on the present.

events.name: Before bed: keeping accounts and stretching
events.description: Finished sorting by nearly midnight, then recorded accounts, did some simple stretching to ease the fatigue from running and bending over to tidy up.

start_state.mood: Invested energy in work and running; clear thinking

end_state.location: Inside the rental apartment, facing a room full of sorted items
end_state.mood: Feeling nostalgic about the past, but even more determined to let go and declutter.

state.daily_exercise: Core training for 15 minutes, 10 km run.

2025-12.daily_overview: On Christmas Eve, Yin Hao didn't celebrate specially. He worked in the morning, and during the lunch break did simple strength training (pull-ups) in the workshop to get back into the groove. After work in the afternoon, he threw away all the old items he had sorted out, symbolizing a clean break from his renting days. In the evening, after tidying up briefly, he exchanged holiday greetings with Lin Yue online, feeling calm inside. Before bed, he did accounting and stretching.

events.name: Morning core training and weighing.
events.description: Got up at 6:25. Because it was cold, core training was shortened to 10 minutes. Weighed 69.8 kg and took vitamins.

events.name: Workshop production and equipment inspection.
events.description: As the year-end approached, production tasks decreased. After completing the daily workpiece processing in the morning, he assisted team leader Wang Lei in the annual inspection of two CNC machine tools and recorded operating data. During the lunch break, Wang Lei teased everyone about whether they had a date on Christmas Eve. Yin Hao laughed and replied, "Today's date is the trash bag."

events.name: Midday light strength training
events.description: Seeing a pull-up bar in the corner of the workshop, he used the lunch break to do 3 sets of pull-ups, 6 reps per set. He felt that his upper body strength had decreased somewhat after pausing the renovation, but it was still fairly stable.

events.name: Final confirmation and disposal of old items
events.description: In the evening, he returned to his rental apartment and double-checked the items to be disposed of that he had sorted the day before: badly worn wrenches and screwdrivers, clothes that were too small or faded, accumulated empty packaging boxes, and expired flyers. He put recyclable waste into a blue trash bag and non-recyclable waste into a black bag, then carried them in two trips to the sorted waste disposal point downstairs. When he threw away the last bag, he stood in front of the trash bin and let out a long sigh, as if formally cutting ties with the past few years of renting.

events.name: Short video call with Lin Yue.
events.description: At 9:30 p.m., he received a video call request from his girlfriend Lin Yue. The two exchanged Christmas Eve wishes. Lin Yue reminded him not to throw away too many things that had sentimental value. Yin Hao showed her the military shoulder insignia and their first photo together that he had deliberately kept, saying that everything important had been kept. Lin Yue told him she was packing up and planned to move to Shanghai next week. Yin Hao happily told her to ask him anytime if she needed help. The call lasted just over ten minutes, but it added warmth to an otherwise plain Christmas Eve.

events.name: Expense recording and stretching
events.description: After the call, I recorded the expenses and did 10 minutes of evening stretching.

start_state.mood: Worked as usual, preparing to say goodbye to the clutter

end_state.location: Inside the rented apartment
end_state.mood: Relieved, feeling a sense of freshness and freedom

state.daily_exercise: Core training for 10 minutes, 3 sets of pull-ups, carrying trash up and down the stairs (light activity).

2025-12.daily_overview: Christmas did not disrupt the routine. During the day, the whole team was on duty to complete pre-holiday work. At noon, he called his mother to check her blood pressure and reminded her about holiday eating. In the evening, the running group had a relaxed and enjoyable holiday run at the Sports Center. Afterward, Yin Hao carefully packed the items he wanted to keep using cardboard boxes he had bought, making big progress on moving preparations. Before bed, he tracked expenses and stretched.

events.name: Morning core training and weighing.
events.description: Got up at 6:10, did 15 minutes of core training, weighed in at 69.7 kg, took vitamins, and prepared a packed lunch.

events.name: Year-end production data review
events.description: In the morning, I worked with the production statistician to conduct a final verification of the year's machine tool operation data, organized equipment maintenance records, and filed documents related to the digitalization project. I noticed that the machine I was responsible for had no major failures throughout the year, which gave me a small sense of accomplishment. In the afternoon, I proactively confirmed the pre-New Year's Day schedule with team leader Wang Lei, and after learning that I could have two consecutive days off, I began planning a moving timeline.

events.name: Called to ask about his mother's blood pressure.
events.description: At noon, he called his mother to ask about her recent blood pressure and holiday plans. She told him she was frying meatballs today and asked him to remember to come back for them during Chinese New Year. Yin Hao smiled and agreed, and reminded his mother to use less salt.

events.name: Special Christmas training session with the running group
events.description: At 7 p.m., he gathered with Wang Lei, Liu Zhiqiang, and Zhang Wei at Songjiang Sports Center. The running group did a fun and relaxed 10K Christmas run today. Everyone wore the red Santa hats prepared in advance. Yin Hao told jokes while running, and the atmosphere was lively. With a pace of 5:40, after the run he bought hot ginger tea at his own expense to warm everyone up, and announced that this year's running group training had come to a successful conclusion, with the goal to keep working hard next year.

events.name: Systematically pack and keep items
events.description: After the run and dinner gathering, he returned to the rental apartment and started packing with the cardboard boxes and tape he had bought a few days earlier. First, he folded clothes by season and placed them in boxes, arranged books by height, wrapped kitchen utensils in newspaper to prevent damage, and then put fishing gear and camping stove separately into heavy-duty boxes labeled 'heavy items.' For the laptop and mechanical watch, he wrapped them repeatedly in protective foam and placed them in a small box marked 'fragile.' Packing continued until late at night, filling 8 large boxes and 3 small boxes, neatly stacked against the wall. Looking at all his belongings compressed into a dozen or so boxes, he found it unbelievable.

events.name: Before bed: keeping accounts and stretching
events.description: Once packing was done, he logged today's team-building drink expenses, did 10 minutes of waist and back stretches to relieve the soreness from bending over while packing.

start_state.mood: Uneventful but positive, completed all tasks as planned

end_state.location: Inside the rented apartment
end_state.mood: Packing complete. Everything is ready, just waiting for the instruction to move.

state.daily_exercise: Core training for 15 minutes, 10 km run.

2025-12.daily_overview: On the company's annual summary day, Yin Hao won the "Annual Technical Contribution Award", and his mentor encouraged him to compete for the position of team leader. In the afternoon, he resumed strength training at the community. In the evening, he celebrated with colleagues at KTV. Late at night, he returned to his rented room, recorded his reflections, set a promotion plan, and finished organizing the last corner. Before bed, he did budgeting and stretching.

events.name: Morning core training and weighing.
events.description: Woke up at 6:00, did 15 minutes of core training, weighed 69.9 kg, took vitamins. Since there was an event today, I deliberately brought extra fruit as lunch.

events.name: Arrived at the company to attend the year-end summary meeting.
events.description: At 9 a.m., I arrived early at the company auditorium on Xinzhuan Highway. After signing in at the outer hall, I picked up the meeting agenda and annual souvenir. I briefly exchanged greetings with colleagues Wang Lei, Liu Zhiqiang, Sun Jianguo, and others, and everyone was looking forward to the awards segment.

events.name: Received the Annual Technical Contribution Award.
events.description: At the summary meeting, company leaders gave speeches in turn. Around 10 o'clock, Manager Zhang from the production department read out the list of annual outstanding employees. When he read “Annual Technical Contribution Award — Yin Hao”, warm applause broke out. Yin Hao walked to the stage amid the applause, took the honorary certificate and 2,000 yuan bonus from Manager Zhang, and gave brief remarks: “Thank you to the company and Master Sun for your guidance. I will keep improving my skills and strive to create greater value for the workshop next year.” As he bowed and stepped off the stage, he caught a glimpse of Master Sun nodding proudly in the audience.

events.name: Midday celebration with colleagues at the cafeteria
events.description: The summary meeting ended at 12 o'clock, and I had lunch with colleagues including Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang in the cafeteria. Wang Lei patted Yin Hao on the shoulder and teased, “This cafeteria meal doesn't count; tomorrow you have to treat us to a big dinner!” Yin Hao smiled and agreed, setting Sunday to treat the running group and shift colleagues to KTV.

events.name: Afternoon strength training recovery at the community
events.description: After work, returned to the residential community fitness area for the first strength training session after a two-week break: 3 sets of pull-ups (6 reps each), 2 sets of push-ups (15 reps each), and 2 sets of squats (20 reps each). I did feel that my upper-body strength had dropped, but muscle memory was still there, and I was satisfied with how it went.

events.name: Evening KTV celebration
events.description: In the evening, honoring his Sunday promise, Yin Hao invited friends Wang Lei, Liu Zhiqiang, Gao Zhiyuan, and others to a KTV in Songjiang to sing and celebrate. Everyone took turns singing; Yin Hao also indulged in a few songs, a rare treat, releasing the stress built up over days of renovation.

events.name: The master had a private talk with him and encouraged him to apply for the position.
events.description: During a break at KTV, Master Sun called, once again affirming Yin Hao's growth over the past year and urging him to be sure to compete for the team leader position next year, developing along both technical and management tracks. Yin Hao solemnly agreed.

events.name: Evening: recording the day's gains and planning ahead
events.description: Back at the rental apartment in the evening, he put away the award certificate and the bonus red envelope, then opened his notebook and wrote down his reflections: the company values practical work, the master's support, and good relationships are also capital. He drafted a work and study plan for the first half of next year, highlighting 'competing for team leader' and 'obtaining a senior technician certificate.' Then he briefly shared the award news in his childhood-friends group and his comrades-in-arms group, and received a stream of congratulations.

events.name: Tidy up the repair bench and the balcony clutter.
events.description: Before going to bed, he struck while the iron was hot and tidied up the last remaining corners of the room—the pliers, multimeter, and other tools on the maintenance bench were sorted into dedicated tool bags; the Honor of Kings figurines, photos with comrades, and other keepsakes in the bedside cabinet were carefully placed into storage boxes; and the half-box of fishing bait and camping stove on the balcony were packed separately and labeled. After all the scattered odds and ends were neatly put away, the rented room was left with only a dozen or so cardboard boxes, feeling empty.

events.name: Before bed: keeping accounts and stretching
events.description: Logged KTV expenses and taxi fare, stretched for 10 minutes, then fell asleep.

start_state.mood: Filled with anticipation for the year-end meeting

end_state.location: Inside the rented apartment
end_state.mood: Full of honors and encouragement, career goals are now clearer

state.daily_exercise: 15 minutes of core training, community strength training (pull-ups, push-ups, squats)

2025-12.daily_overview: Weekend pace was tight: morning final grocery shopping and processing/storing food, then fixed the old stereo brought back from Chen Jianguo's shop and successfully got it to play; afternoon thoroughly cleaned the rented apartment; evening attended the running club's year-end dinner, received the Best Leader Award, and agreed on new goals with running friends; came back late at night, tired but deeply warmed. Did the accounts and stretched before bed.

events.name: Morning core training and weighing.
events.description: Woke up at 6:30, did 15 minutes of core training, weighed 69.8 kg, and took vitamins.

events.name: Final bulk purchase and preprocessing of ingredients
events.description: At 9 a.m., drove to the supermarket for the last big shopping trip of December, buying a final full week's supply of chicken breast, eggs, mixed grains, broccoli, tomatoes, and two sea bass. After returning home, spent over an hour portioning and marinating the chicken breast, washing and portioning the vegetables for freezing, and cleaning the sea bass into fresh-keeping boxes, ensuring quick cooking for next week's weekday dinners.

events.name: Repair the old stereo
events.description: Remembering that the old sound system Master Chen Jianguo had sent over before had an electrical hum, Yin Hao took advantage of the free morning to take it apart and repair it. He found the capacitors had aged, replaced them with capacitors of the same specifications found on the repair bench, and after soldering and testing, the sound quality was restored to pure. Satisfied, he connected his phone and played 'Blue Lotus,' and the atmosphere of his new home gradually began to take shape.

events.name: Thoroughly clean the rental apartment
events.description: In the afternoon, he started a deep clean of the rental apartment before moving: mopped the floor three times, wiped the windowsills and baseboards, scrubbed kitchen grease and bathroom corners with cleaner, took down the curtains and bedding and put them in the washing machine. He checked the wall cabinets, drawers, and under the bed one by one to make sure nothing was left behind, and folded all clothes to be changed into the suitcase. When the cleaning was done, the room had returned to the neat state it was in when he first moved in two years ago. Standing in the middle of the living room and looking around, he couldn't help thinking of the time in 2020 when he had just retired from military service and came to Shanghai to look for an apartment, filled with mixed emotions.

events.name: Walked to the running club's year-end dinner.
events.description: At 5:30 in the evening, he made a point of walking to a restaurant near Guangfulin Road to attend the Songjiang Machinery Running Group's year-end dinner. He carried a small notebook under his arm with the whole year's running mileage recorded in it. The cold wind brushed his face along the way, but his spirits were high.

events.name: Awarded the running group's Best Team Leader Award
events.description: The dinner gathering started at 6:30 p.m. In his speech, the running club captain announced: Yin Hao, with a total annual mileage of 1,100 kilometers, more than thirty organized group training sessions, and bringing three colleagues into the club, was named 'Best Team Leader of the Year' and awarded an engraved trophy. After accepting the trophy, Yin Hao said excitedly, 'Thank you all for your cooperation. Next year, let's go for 1,500 kilometers—not a single one of us can be missing!' Warm cheers erupted.

events.name: Exchange winter training plans with running friends
events.description: During the meal, they had in-depth discussions with fellow runners Chen Jie, Wang Lei, and others about winter training techniques. Chen Jie suggested adding core strength training to improve endurance, and Yin Hao took careful notes. Everyone agreed to increase monthly running volume by 20 kilometers starting from January next year, gradually moving toward the annual target of 1,500 kilometers. The dinner lasted until 9:30 pm, and everyone left happily.

events.name: Walking home and reviewing
events.description: After the gathering ended, he walked back to his rental apartment along the familiar Guangfulin Road. Feeling the night breeze, he savored the sense of accomplishment brought by the two awards, silently planning tomorrow's moving arrangements and ideas for decorating the new home, his steps growing more and more firm.

events.name: Before bed: keeping accounts and stretching
events.description: After getting home, I recorded the shared dinner expense in the accounts, took a hot shower, and stretched to relax my leg muscles.

start_state.mood: Diligent as usual, with a fully packed schedule

end_state.location: Inside the rented apartment
end_state.mood: Content and highly motivated, full of confidence in the new year

state.daily_exercise: Core training for 15 minutes, and a longer walk

2025-12.daily_overview: On the last day of the lease renewal, in the morning he did a final check of his luggage and sealed the boxes for shipping, moved some luggage to the new apartment, and did the second strength training session while he was at it. In the afternoon, he went to the new apartment to install the light fixtures his brother had given him, tested the repaired stereo, and enjoyed a little time in his new home. In the evening, he studied video editing, taking the first step toward a side business. Before bed, he did his bookkeeping and stretching.

events.name: Morning core training and weighing.
events.description: Got up at 6:45. Although a bit late, he still completed 15 minutes of core training. Weighed 70.0 kg (due to party food and water retention), and took vitamins.

events.name: Final count and packing of luggage
events.description: In the morning, he did a final count and numbering of the cardboard boxes and luggage packed the day before yesterday, checked each box against the item list on his phone, and wrote the sequence number and a brief description of the contents on each box with a thick marker. He then stacked all the boxes in the corner of the living room, leaving only one suitcase and a backpack on the floor. Looking at the empty room, he took out his phone and snapped a photo as a final memento of the little room that had accompanied him for two years.

events.name: Move belongings to the new home
events.description: At 10 AM, called a Lalamove truck to move some lighter boxes and personal belongings to the new house. Made two round trips and carried them up to the second floor by myself. Though a bit out of breath, I was in a good mood.

events.name: Strength training at the new home
events.description: After moving the luggage, I used the fitness equipment in the new housing community for the second recovery training: pull-ups in 4 sets (5 reps each), push-ups in 3 sets (12 reps each), and squats in 3 sets (15 reps each). I feel that upper body endurance still needs improvement.

events.name: Install the light fixture my brother gave me.
events.description: In the afternoon, at the new house, he opened a package sent by his older brother Yin Tao; it was a living room chandelier. Following the instruction manual, he sketched out the layout, drilled holes in the ceiling with an electric drill, and struggled alone to hold it up and install it. After an hour and a half, it finally lit up. The light spilled onto the freshly painted milky-white walls, making the place feel even more like home.

events.name: Debugged and repaired the audio system
events.description: He connected the repaired old stereo and played Hotel California from his phone via Bluetooth. The sound was surprisingly good. He made a cup of tea, sat in the empty living room, and quietly enjoyed the moment.

events.name: Start learning video editing
events.description: In the evening, I opened my laptop and, following the plan set yesterday, searched Bilibili for "zero-basics video editing tutorial" and saved three collections. I downloaded and installed CapCut Pro, tried importing an aerial clip, and explored the cutting feature. I set a study alarm for 9 PM every Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday.

events.name: Yu'e Bao automatic transfer
events.description: Today is Sunday, and 500 yuan was automatically transferred from mobile banking to Yu'ebao.

events.name: Body fat scale measurement.
events.description: Before bed, I measured with a body fat scale: weight 70.0 kg, body fat percentage 18.1%, slightly lower than mid-month.

events.name: Keeping accounts and stretching before bed.
events.description: Updated the bookkeeping app, recorded the Lalamove fee and recent expenses. Did 10 minutes of stretching in the evening, then fell asleep.

start_state.mood: Lighthearted, preparing for the move transition

end_state.location: Inside the bedroom of the new home
end_state.mood: Busy but rewarding; the new home is starting to take shape.

state.daily_exercise: Core training for 15 minutes, strength training (pull-ups, push-ups, squats), and carrying and moving work

2025-12.daily_overview: During the day, he completed routine machining tasks in the workshop and helped prepare the equipment maintenance plan after New Year's Day. At noon, he had a video call with his father. In the evening, after returning home, he officially started learning video editing, downloaded the software, saved tutorials, made a plan, and put his side-business idea into action. Before bed, he did his bookkeeping and stretched to relax.

events.name: Morning core training and weighing.
events.description: Got up at 6:20, did 15 minutes of core training, weighed 69.7kg, and took vitamins.

events.name: Commuting to work by bike
events.description: Rode to work by bike at 7:20 a.m.; the weather was cold and overcast, so he rode a bit faster to keep warm.

events.name: This week's production tasks and equipment scheduling.
events.description: On Monday morning, had a brief team stand-up meeting with shift leader Wang Lei and colleague Liu Zhiqiang, confirming that this week's task is to finish up several batches of non-urgent orders. In the morning, operated the lathe to complete the finishing of a batch of shaft sleeves, and midway asked Liu Zhiqiang for advice on optimizing tool compensation in programming. In the afternoon, proactively assisted the Equipment Department in organizing the machine tool maintenance schedule after the New Year's Day holiday, using Excel to list the wear parts that need to be replaced. Stretched during work breaks.

events.name: Video call with father.
events.description: During the lunch break, Yin Hao had the regular Monday video call with his father. His father asked about the finishing touches on the renovation. Yin Hao told him the lights had been installed and thanked him again for the financial support. His father reminded him to check the wall-hung boiler connection.

events.name: Officially started learning video editing.
events.description: In the evening, sat at the desk, opened the laptop, and continued watching tutorials on Bilibili as planned, learning video splitting and transitions. Actually operated CapCut to edit the previous day's aerial footage into a 30-second short video, added background music, and successfully exported it. Although it was rough, it gave a strong sense of accomplishment. Wrote a study schedule on a sticky note and stuck it next to the monitor.

events.name: Updated the accounts and read before bed
events.description: After studying, he opened the bookkeeping app to log today's lunch delivery expense and checked this month's spending. Before bed, he read The Biography of Zeng Guofan on Kindle for half an hour, then turned off the lights and rested.

start_state.mood: Started the new week in an orderly way

end_state.location: Inside the rented apartment
end_state.mood: Fulfilling; learning new skills brings a sense of freshness.

state.daily_exercise: 15 minutes of core training and 15 minutes of commuter cycling

2025-12.daily_overview: Final sprint of the workweek. In the morning, completed the year-end maintenance of the machine tools; in the afternoon, found time to discuss the new home layout with his older brother on WeChat; in the evening, led the running group to complete the final run of December, with cumulative mileage ending at 80 kilometers. Teammates encouraged each other and looked forward to 2026. Before bed, did the accounts, stretched, and relaxed by listening to music on the repaired sound system.

events.name: Morning core training and weighing.
events.description: Got up at 6:10, did 15 minutes of core training, weighed 69.8 kg, and took vitamins.

events.name: Year-end maintenance wrap-up for machine tools
events.description: In the morning, with his team colleagues, Yin Hao finished the annual deep maintenance of the CNC machine tools they were responsible for: replacing the coolant filter element, checking the guide rail lubrication system, and cleaning the chip collection box. They signed the maintenance record sheet and marked the equipment status as "sealed for the holiday". During the lunch break, everyone talked about New Year's Day holiday plans. Yin Hao planned to move and to accompany Lin Yue.

events.name: Communicate with older brother via WeChat.
events.description: During an afternoon work break, Yin Hao received a WeChat message from his older brother Yin Tao, who sent renderings of his new home's decoration. Yin Hao replied with photos of the light fixtures he had installed himself. The brothers discussed the layout of the kitchen shelf and agreed to buy more soft furnishings together during the Spring Festival.

events.name: December finale 10K run.
events.description: At 7 p.m., he appeared on time at Songjiang Sports Center for the last training session of the month with the core members of the running group, including Wang Lei, Liu Zhiqiang, and Zhang Wei. He maintained a 5:31 pace throughout, encouraging everyone to take deep breaths of the cold air and feel the freedom of winter running. During post-run stretching, he showed his mileage stats: 80 km accumulated in December and 1,100 km for the whole year. Zhang Wei exclaimed, "You really are a running machine." Yin Hao replied with a smile, "Upgrade the machine next year." The training ended joyfully with a group photo and mutual good wishes.

events.name: Packed running gear and postcards
events.description: Back at the rental apartment, he scrubbed his running shoes clean, washed his quick-dry clothes, and prepared the Shanghai scenery postcards to send to his parents and older brother and sister-in-law tomorrow.

events.name: Listened to music on the repaired audio system before bed
events.description: After washing up, he turned on the repaired speaker and played the piano piece Moonlight, then did 15 minutes of meditation and stretching before bed, feeling extremely relaxed in both body and mind.

start_state.mood: Feeling relaxed, looking forward to the evening run.

end_state.location: Inside the rented apartment
end_state.mood: Full of a sense of achievement, welcoming the New Year with the running group

state.daily_exercise: Core training for 15 minutes, 10 km run.

2025-12.daily_overview: On New Year's Eve, he completed multiple role transitions: he discussed it in the morning and officially resigned as tenant representative in the afternoon, receiving a thank-you letter, and said warm goodbyes to his neighbors. In the evening, he video-called his parents, elder brother and sister-in-law, and girlfriend to show the new house, and promised a reunion at Spring Festival. Late at night, alone, he solemnly wrote a comprehensive plan for 2026 covering career, side business, health, and relationships, and encouraged himself with the phrase, 'Start from debt, but build your own future.' Before bed, he relaxed his eating discipline and his weight rose slightly to 70.0 kg.

events.name: Morning core training and weighing.
events.description: Got up at 6:30, did 15 minutes of core training, weighed 69.8 kg, took vitamins, and brought a packed lunch.

events.name: Contact the owners' committee to resign as tenant representative
events.description: In the morning, I contacted the head of the neighborhood owners' committee via WeChat to let him know that I would be moving out tomorrow, and to formally resign from the position of tenant representative this afternoon, while expressing gratitude for the committee's support. The head warmly tried to persuade me to stay, but understood Yin Hao's situation, and agreed to meet at 3 p.m. at the owners' committee office.

events.name: Handed in his resignation and received a letter of thanks.
events.description: At 3 p.m., he arrived on time at the owners' committee office and had a face-to-face conversation with the committee director and the property manager. He formally submitted his written resignation, briefly reviewed his experience over the past half year in organizing activities and coordinating repairs, and finally recommended Aunt Chen Xiuying, who lives across the hallway, to take over the tenant representative position. The director said on the spot that he would consider Aunt Chen's appointment, and on behalf of the owners' committee and property management, presented Yin Hao with a joint thank-you letter, in which he was called "the most responsible tenant representative."

events.name: Saying a warm goodbye to neighbor Aunt Chen
events.description: After leaving the office, he met Aunt Chen Xiuying taking a walk in the community garden. He went up to tell her he was about to move away. Aunt Chen held his hand, her eyes reddening: "Xiao Yin, come back often in the future. Auntie will still make braised pork for you." Yin Hao kept nodding, promised to bring his girlfriend to visit her, and asked her to look after Grandpa Wang downstairs. The two chatted about everyday things for a long time, holding hands in the glow of the setting sun.

events.name: Send out the New Year's postcard.
events.description: In the evening, he dropped the written postcards into the mailbox, one for his parents and one for his brother and sister-in-law, wishing them a happy New Year.

events.name: Video call with parents to show the new home and celebrate the New Year
events.description: At 8 p.m., at the new house, he connected a video call with his parents. He slowly panned the camera across every freshly painted wall and said excitedly, "Dad, Mom, this is our new home! This secondary bedroom is reserved for you." His mother Wang Xiuying wiped away tears on the other side of the screen, and his father Yin Jianguo said "Good, good" repeatedly, reminding him to check the wall-mounted boiler. Yin Hao solemnly promised, "I will definitely bring Lin Yue home for the Spring Festival, and our family will have a wonderful reunion." The call lasted nearly half an hour, and the new house was filled with deep family affection.

events.name: Had a phone call with older brother Yin Tao to share the joy.
events.description: After their parents hung up, he immediately called his older brother Yin Tao via WeChat video. He turned the phone around to show the various rooms, and his brother teased, "The little renovation worker is online now." Yin Hao laughed and replied, then asked in detail about the delivery status of the lighting fixtures his brother had ordered. The brothers agreed to both go back to Nantong for Spring Festival, and Yin Hao also asked for tips on installing a bathroom storage rack. Before hanging up, Yin Tao said, "Little brother, you've made it in Shanghai. I'm happy for you."

events.name: Had a New Year's Eve call with girlfriend Lin Yue to plan the coming year.
events.description: Near midnight, he called Lin Yue on video. After they exchanged New Year wishes, Lin Yue asked him what his biggest wish for the coming year was. Yin Hao said emotionally, "I want to pay off the down payment I borrowed from my parents as soon as possible, then bring you to live with me in the new house—our own home." Lin Yue's eyes curved into a smile, and she promised to go back with him to Nantong for Spring Festival, and revealed that she would officially report to Shanghai after New Year's Day. The two chatted back and forth, imagining the details of living together, until the countdown sounded.

events.name: Seriously Drafting the 2026 Plan
events.description: The call had just ended when it was past midnight. Sitting in the empty living room of the new house, under a temporary light bulb, he began writing in his notebook. At the top of the page, he wrote "2026 Annual Plan", then listed item by item: 1. Compete for the production team leader position (prepare materials in January); 2. Learn video editing and try taking aerial photography gigs (practice weekly, complete the first sample reel before April); 3. Increase monthly running mileage to 100 km and annual mileage to 1500 km; 4. Repay his parents 5000 yuan every month (plan to pay off the 150,000 yuan in 2 years); 5. Support Lin Yue in adapting to her new job and run our life together. Finally, he wrote: "Starting from debt, but I will build my own future." He solemnly closed the notebook.

events.name: Review December dietary records and new goals
events.description: Before going to sleep, he opened the memo on his phone and reviewed his healthy eating throughout December item by item: he had given up late-night snacks, basically brought his own lunch, simmered pork rib soup three times in total, and his body fat dropped from 18.5% at the beginning of the month to 18.0%. Satisfied, he checked it off and set the first New Year goal: maintain a healthy diet and cook soup at least four times a month. Then he drank a small glass of warm milk to help him sleep and ate two slices of whole-wheat crackers; his weight rose slightly to 70.0 kg.

2025-02.daily_overview: On the fourth day of the Lunar New Year, Yin Hao enjoyed a rare holiday at his hometown in Rudong. After a morning run, he talked with his brother, spent the morning with his parents, sang and dined with childhood friends in the afternoon, video-called his girlfriend in the evening, and received greetings from his comrades-in-arms. It was warm and fulfilling.

events.name: Morning run
events.description: Yin Hao and his brother Yin Tao, who had returned home for the New Year, ran 5 kilometers together along the village road in the morning at a pace of 6 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer. They caught up on each other's news while running. Yin Tao shared funny stories about working in sales in Suzhou, and Yin Hao talked about his CNC technology study plan.

events.name: Family time
events.description: In the morning, Yin Hao accompanied his father Yin Jianguo to check recent blood pressure records (his father's blood pressure is a bit high and he has started a low-salt diet), and helped his mother Wang Xiuying prepare lunch. His mother specially made his favorite Shanghai-style braised pork.

events.name: Childhood friends gathering
events.description: In the afternoon, childhood friends Zhang Wei and Li Qiang drove over. The three of them drove to a KTV in town and sang for two hours. Yin Hao ordered military songs such as 'The March of the Chinese People's Liberation Army', and the atmosphere was lively. Afterwards, they had hot pot at a nearby restaurant and talked about their respective work and lives. Zhang Wei shared the progress of his wedding preparations, and Yin Hao shared his initial thoughts on buying a home in Shanghai.

events.name: Video-called with my girlfriend.
events.description: After returning home late at night, Yin Hao had a WeChat video call with Lin Yue, who was far away in Hangzhou, for about 30 minutes. They shared their Spring Festival stories. Lin Yue mentioned she would come to Shanghai for business after the holiday, and Yin Hao jokingly invited her to Songjiang to try his braised pork. They said goodnight and ended the call.

events.name: Greetings from a comrade-in-arms
events.description: In the evening, Yin Hao received a WeChat New Year greeting from his comrade-in-arms Zhang Jianguo. They had a brief voice call. Zhang Jianguo asked about the recent condition of Yin Hao's knee and reminded him to warm up before running. The two agreed to play online games together after the holiday.

2025-02.daily_overview: On the last day of the holiday, Yin Hao packed his luggage in the morning, repaired household appliances with his father in the afternoon, and in the evening his mother cooked a hearty dinner. His older brother Yin Tao also came to say goodbye. The whole family gave Yin Hao an early send-off, with a warm and reluctant atmosphere.

events.name: Pack luggage.
events.description: In the morning, Yin Hao carefully packed into his suitcase the specialties his mother had already put in lunchboxes—braised pork, steamed clams, Nantong crispy biscuits—and checked the car (oil, tires) to ensure a smooth return trip tomorrow.

events.name: Repair small household appliances.
events.description: In the afternoon, Yin Hao helped his father repair an old radio at home. He used a multimeter to check the circuit, replaced a capacitor, and the radio returned to normal. His father praised his practical ability, and the two smiled at each other.

events.name: Family dinner and farewell with brothers.
events.description: In the evening, his mother prepared a table of dishes: steamed sea bass, xiaolongbao, sweet and sour spare ribs, and more. His father brought out a bottle of treasured yellow rice wine, and the three raised their glasses. After dinner, his older brother Yin Tao also came to the living room. They talked about future development plans, and Yin Tao reminded Yin Hao to take care of himself in Shanghai and stay in touch. His parents told him to call often, and Yin Hao promised to video chat at least four times a month. The atmosphere was warm.

2025-02.daily_overview: On the last day of the Spring Festival, Yin Hao drove back to Shanghai, bringing hometown dishes his mother had prepared back to Songjiang. After cleaning his room, he gave some local specialties to his neighbor, Aunt Chen. Feeling the warmth of human kindness in a foreign place, he was full of energy and ready to return to work.

events.name: Saying goodbye to parents
events.description: In the morning, Yin Hao said goodbye to his parents at his hometown in Rudong. His mother, Wang Xiuying, packed homemade hometown delicacies such as braised pork, clams, and lion's head meatballs and handed them to him, repeatedly telling him to take care of his health and eat on time in Shanghai. Yin Hao put the local specialties into the trunk of the car, checked that his luggage was all correct, hugged his parents, and set off.

events.name: Drove back to Shanghai.
events.description: In the afternoon, Yin Hao drove his own car from Rudong County back to Shanghai along the Shenhai Expressway. On the way, he made a brief stop at the Sutong Bridge service area and had a cup of coffee. The whole trip took about 3 hours by car, and he arrived at his residence on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, at 17:30 in the evening.

events.name: Arrive home and tidy up
events.description: After returning home in Songjiang in the evening, Yin Hao put away his luggage, began tidying the room, mopping the floor, and wiping windows, and sorted the local specialties brought back from his hometown. He divided some braised pork and clams into fresh-keeping boxes, planning to give them to his neighbor Aunt Chen.

events.name: Gave local specialties as gifts
events.description: At around 19:00, Yin Hao took the portioned hometown specialties, knocked on Aunt Chen Xiuying's door across the hallway, gave her the food, paid a brief New Year visit, and thanked her for her usual care. Aunt Chen thanked him in surprise, and they exchanged a few pleasantries.

events.name: Rest and preparation.
events.description: In the evening, after putting all his things in order, Yin Hao set the alarm for 6:20 the next morning and did a quick wash. Because of the long drive, he felt sore in his back and waist, so he did 15 minutes of stretching and went to bed, getting enough rest for the next day's return to work.

2025-02.daily_overview: On the first day back at work, Yin Hao threw himself into his work with high spirits. After receiving his salary, he skillfully recorded and allocated it. He joined the five-axis machine tool evaluation team. In the evening, he had a video call with his girlfriend Lin Yue and accepted a new task, kicking off the new year's technical challenges.

events.name: Return to work
events.description: At 6:40 a.m., Yin Hao drove his private car to Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd. at No. 666 Xinzhuan Road. He arrived at work at 7:45, exchanged New Year greetings with his mentor Sun Jianguo and colleagues Wang Lei, Liu Zhiqiang, and others, and quickly held a team morning meeting before getting into work mode. Because he needed to arrive early on the first day back to work, Yin Hao canceled his morning run and only did 5 minutes of stretching at home.

events.name: Salary credited to account.
events.description: At 10 a.m., while Yin Hao was debugging equipment in the workshop, his phone vibrated with a bank text message showing that his after-tax salary of 8,500 yuan had arrived. He took out his phone to check, confirmed the amount was correct, and felt reassured.

events.name: Checked accounts and kept books
events.description: During lunch break, Yin Hao opened the mobile banking app to check his account balance, then opened the bookkeeping app and allocated his salary according to his pre-set financial plan: transferred 3,000 yuan to the dedicated rent e-wallet, reserved 1,000 yuan for the automatic mutual fund investment deduction, budgeted 2,500 yuan for daily expenses, and transferred the remaining 2,000 yuan to a savings account.

events.name: Join the evaluation group.
events.description: In the afternoon, Master Sun Jianguo found Yin Hao and recommended that he join the company's evaluation group for the newly introduced five-axis CNC machine tool equipment, helping to investigate the pain points of the existing four-axis machines. Yin Hao gladly accepted and immediately discussed the task details with the team leader, Manager Zhang.

events.name: Video-called with my girlfriend.
events.description: After coming home from work in the evening, Yin Hao had a simple dinner (heated up his mother's braised pork). At 21:00, he proactively contacted his girlfriend Lin Yue via WeChat video. They talked about their daily lives: Yin Hao shared the assessment team tasks and the challenges of the five-axis machine tool, while Lin Yue talked about the pressure of her project. The call lasted about 40 minutes. The two agreed to video chat around 9:30 every night from now on to strengthen their long-distance relationship.

events.name: Study before bed
events.description: After the video ended, Yin Hao used his phone to browse technical forums about five-axis machine tools, bookmarked two introductory articles, and planned to start systematic study tomorrow. He then washed up and went to bed around 22:40.

events.name: Morning jog and audiobook listening.

After the run, he weighed 71.6 kg, slightly lower than before the Spring Festival, and he felt satisfied with his weight management.

Master Sun Jianguo accompanied him and helped with communication. In total, about 15 pieces of frontline feedback were collected.

events.name: Exchange during lunch break

Liu Zhiqiang pointed out that the five-axis machine might require more programming, so Yin Hao decided to learn about it in advance.

events.name: Organizing notes
events.description: In the afternoon, at his workstation, Yin Hao organized his research notes into a table in Excel, categorizing them into four categories: clamping, tooling, programming, and efficiency, and initially marked the severity levels, preparing for the later report writing.

events.name: Study after work.
events.description: After getting off work and returning to his residence, Yin Hao had a simple dinner and at 19:30 began reading the first chapter of the previously downloaded five-axis programming electronic document to learn the basic principles of five-axis machining, jotting down key terms in a notebook. He finished studying at 21:00, did 30 push-ups, washed up, and went to bed at 22:30.

His father reminded him not to be afraid of hardship at work, to learn more from the masters, and told him that everything was fine at home and to rest assured. The call lasted 20 minutes.

events.name: Wrote an improvement plan.
events.description: In the morning, at his workstation in the company, Yin Hao systematically organized the research data from the previous two days and, drawing on his two years of hands-on experience, wrote a written fixture improvement plan covering structural optimization (suggesting adding auxiliary support blocks), material selection (recommending spring steel instead of ordinary steel), cost estimates (an increase of about 200 yuan per set), and expected results (a 15% improvement in clamping efficiency).

events.name: Solution presentation
events.description: In the afternoon, at the department evaluation team meeting, Yin Hao reported the proposal in detail to the department head, Manager Zhang, and several colleagues, using 3D drawings to show the improvement details. Manager Zhang highly praised the proposal's approach and feasibility and encouraged Yin Hao to further refine it to push forward trial production.

events.name: Lunch break gaming and socializing
events.description: During the lunch break, to relieve the stress of writing the proposal, Yin Hao and his colleague Wang Lei played a game of Honor of Kings together in the lounge. Wang Lei used a jungle hero, Yin Hao played marksman, and they won quickly, which relaxed his mood.

events.name: Getting familiar with the new machine tool
events.description: After the proposal presentation, Yin Hao went alone to the workshop and carefully inspected the newly installed five-axis machine tool, familiarizing himself with the layout of its operation panel, button functions, and display menu structure, and took photos to record the SIEMENS 840D sl control system model.

events.name: Buying books and self-study.

That evening he did not go out for a run; he only did a short stretching routine.

events.name: Cleaning up

Wang Lei and Yin Hao took notes carefully and discussed the programming difficulties they had recently encountered with their respective machines. The atmosphere was harmonious.

At the restaurant table, they opened Honor of Kings on their phones and queued up together, playing two ranked matches in a row. Yin Hao used the marksman Yu Ji, Wang Lei was the jungler Zhao Yun, and Liu Zhiqiang was the support Ming Shiyin. They chatted about work and games while playing, and Yin Hao felt his stress relieved.

events.name: Return and report safety

Each of them reported their safe arrival in the WeChat group "Songjiang Three Brothers".

events.name: Video call with mother.

2025-02.daily_overview: On Monday, Yin Hao took leave in the morning to handle the residence permit endorsement and consult about the points policy. He found the rent had skyrocketed and, feeling anxious, studied the points manual. Because of slight discomfort in his right knee, he decided to stop morning running and instead do joint stretching. He also coordinated schedules with his girlfriend, and after studying in the evening, his mood eased.

events.name: Morning knee self-check
events.description: After getting up at 6:15 in the morning, Yin Hao felt a slight soreness and swelling in his right knee when going up and down stairs (the first time it had occurred). He immediately remembered that he hadn't stretched enough after yesterday's morning run, so he decided to suspend morning runs to prevent injury, and switched to knee stretching and quadriceps activation exercises. He also decided to seek medical attention if the discomfort continued.

events.name: Requesting leave and preparing materials
events.description: At 7:50 in the morning, Yin Hao asked team leader Wang Lei for half a day off via WeChat, explaining that he needed to go to the Community Affairs Service Center to handle the residence permit endorsement. Then at home he sorted out the necessary materials, including the original ID card, original residence permit, and house rental contract, and put them into his document bag.

events.name: Handle residence permit renewal.
events.description: From 8:45 to 9:30 in the morning, Yin Hao drove his private car to the Guangfulin Subdistrict Community Affairs Reception Service Center in Songjiang District. At the counter, he submitted his ID card and the original residence permit to apply for a residence permit endorsement to maintain its validity. After verifying the information, the staff completed the endorsement. Yin Hao then went to the information desk to ask about the details of the residence permit points policy and the points required for housing purchase qualification. The staff provided an explanation of the points application process and gave him a copy of the Shanghai Residence Permit Points Management Brochure. Yin Hao put the brochure into his bag.

events.name: Research the points policy
events.description: After returning home at 10:00 in the morning, Yin Hao sat on the sofa in the living room and flipped through the "Shanghai Residence Permit Points Management Brochure" obtained from the service center, using his phone's memo app to record key points indicators (such as education, age, social insurance years, and skill certificates) and the requirements for meeting the threshold. Given his secondary technical school education and his position as a CNC machine operator, he initially assessed that his current points might be insufficient, and planned to later register for a senior technician certificate to increase his points.

events.name: Rent payment and surprise.
events.description: At 2 PM, Yin Hao transferred this month's rent of 3,000 yuan to his landlord Li Xiuying via Alipay, with the note "February rent." After the transfer, he checked the previous payment records and found that last month's rent was only 1,700 yuan, an increase of as much as 76%. He suddenly felt a sharp increase in financial pressure. He took a screenshot to save the receipt and reminded himself to pay close attention to the rent clause when renewing the contract next month.

events.name: Learning in the workshop
events.description: After the lunch break, Master Sun Jianguo sent a short video of operating the five-axis machine tool simulation software via WeChat. Yin Hao watched it on his phone and saved it, planning to go to the workshop again during tomorrow's lunch break for hands-on practice.

events.name: Study after work.
events.description: After work, back in the dormitory, he continued studying Chapter 2 of Introduction to Five-Axis Machining Programming, covering tool compensation (G41/G42) and machining plane selection (G17/G18/G19). While reading, he drew simple workpiece coordinate systems on paper and tried to verify the offsets with a calculator. At 9:30 PM, he organized his study notes and then played soft music on his phone to relax.

events.name: Coordinate daily routines with girlfriend.
events.description: At 21:40 in the evening, Yin Hao connected a video call with Lin Yue. He first shared his frustration over today's rent increase and the process of applying for the residence permit, then tactfully raised the issue of their different daily schedules, saying that he was used to getting up early and hoped Lin Yue could also go to bed earlier. Lin Yue admitted that her habit of staying up late to watch shows was affecting her ability to answer video calls in the morning. The two had an in-depth exchange about coordinating the pace of life in a long-distance relationship. Lin Yue agreed to try to sleep before midnight, and Yin Hao also agreed to postpone the morning video call to after 8. Both sides reached a preliminary adjustment plan. After the call, Yin Hao felt slightly better.

Because his lower back was slightly sore, he switched to indoor strength training, and noticed the company's senior technician training notice, which strengthened his determination to study.

events.name: Early-morning back soreness and training.
events.description: In the morning, I felt slight soreness in my lower back muscles (due to prolonged sitting while studying) and my right knee was still mildly uncomfortable, so I didn't go out for a morning run. Instead, I did 3 sets of push-ups (20 reps each) and 2 sets of crunches (25 reps each) indoors to maintain my fitness.

events.name: Consulting in the workshop
events.description: During the lunch break, Yin Hao asked team leader Wang Lei about the key points of daily maintenance for five-axis machine tools (such as checking spindle coolant and guide rail lubrication), and personally observed the complete process of Master Sun Jianguo debugging a simple five-axis machining program, paying close attention to the display of the tool tip following function (RTCP). He recorded a short video for reference.

events.name: Watch for training notices.
events.description: At the bulletin board in the cafeteria, Yin Hao saw the registration notice for the Senior CNC Technician training published by the company's HR department. Excited, he immediately took a photo and planned to learn more about the registration requirements after work.

events.name: Self-study of rotary axis programming
events.description: After getting off work, Yin Hao bought some convenience food and returned to his residence. At 7:30 p.m., he began studying Chapter 3 of the textbook: Rotary Axes (A-axis, C-axis) and Inclined Plane Programming. He read through the examples repeatedly and used his own three-dimensional diagrams to understand the relationships between the axes. He studied until 10 p.m., and feeling somewhat tired, he played a round of Honor of Kings to relax, then washed up and rested.
