2025-02.daily_overview: On the Lantern Festival, Yin Hao went to work as usual. Due to discomfort in his right knee, he cancelled his morning run and instead did knee rehabilitation training at home. During the lunch break, he studied five-axis coordinate parameter settings. After work, he exchanged food with his neighbor Aunt Chen, tasted tangyuan, and felt the warmth of the neighborhood. In the evening, he continued self-studying programming and did laundry, spending a fulfilling and festive day.

events.name: Knee rehabilitation training
events.description: At 6:40 in the morning, because his right knee still felt sore and swollen, Yin Hao canceled the outdoor morning run and instead performed 20 minutes of knee rehab exercises in the living room at home, including straight leg raises, wall sits, side leg raises with an elastic band, and used a foam roller to relax the front thighs.

events.name: Seeking advice during the lunch break
events.description: During the lunch break, Yin Hao proactively approached Engineer Liu Zhiqiang and asked him to demonstrate how to enter parameters for multiple coordinate systems (G54.1 P1-P48) on the five-axis machine. Engineer Liu explained the precautions for workpiece offsets while operating. Yin Hao watched carefully and used his phone to take photos to record the steps, and also asked how the offset values were measured.

events.name: Left work and went home.
events.description: After getting off work at 5:30 p.m., Yin Hao drove his car from the company back to his residence on Guangfulin Road. He parked in the community, walked upstairs, and arrived home at about 18:15. He had just changed into his home clothes when he heard the doorbell.

events.name: Neighbor brings sweet rice balls
events.description: Aunt Chen Xiuying, the neighbor across the hall, stood at the door with a bowl of freshly cooked black sesame tangyuan, warmly saying that today was the Lantern Festival and that she had specially made tangyuan to give him some to try, wishing him a happy festival. Yin Hao quickly thanked her and took the tangyuan.

events.name: Returning hometown dishes as a gift
events.description: After taking the tangyuan, Yin Hao remembered that his mother had sent from Nantong some Shanghainese-style braised pork and stir-fried clams. He quickly went back to the kitchen, packed a portion in a food storage container, and planned to give it to Auntie Chen in return as a neighborly gesture.

events.name: Gift exchange and conversation
events.description: Yin Hao took a food container with braised pork and clams to the door across the hall and knocked on Aunt Chen's door. He first thanked Aunt Chen for the sweet rice balls, then handed her the return dishes. Aunt Chen happily accepted and asked Yin Hao about his impressions of returning to his hometown in Nantong for the Spring Festival. She also asked with concern whether he was dating anyone, reminding him to start thinking about his personal life while he was young. Yin Hao smiled and replied that he knew what he was doing. The two chatted in the hallway for about ten minutes, in a warm and friendly atmosphere.

events.name: Tasting glutinous rice balls
events.description: After the gift exchange, Yin Hao returned home, rinsed the bowl with hot water, and sat at the dining table to taste the sesame tangyuan sent over by Aunt Chen. The tangyuan skin was soft and sticky, and the sesame filling was sweet and fragrant. As he ate, he reflected on the conversation with his neighbor and felt that the Lantern Festival spent alone in a strange city was especially warm because of this human warmth.

events.name: Evening study and organizing
events.description: After dinner (with tangyuan as a snack, and noodles as the main course), Yin Hao continued studying Chapter 4 of Introduction to Five-Axis Machining Programming: Basic Programming Rules for Multi-Axis Linkage. Referring to his notes from the past few days, he personally wrote a very simple three-axis linkage program (within the five-axis framework) using simulation software on his computer and verified the correctness of the coordinate calculations. He studied until 21:30, felt he had gained a lot, ended his study session early, washed the clothes he had accumulated this week, and went to bed at 22:20.

events.name: Rest and recovery, and purchase of knee pads.

Zhang Jianguo asked about his knee, suggested he reduce running volume and wear knee pads, and shared amusing stories about his work as a fitness coach in Hangzhou. The two agreed to play online games together when they had time. After the call, Yin Hao also searched for knee care information.

2025-02.daily_overview: On Valentine's Day, Yin Hao began looking at property information in the morning due to rent anxiety. In the afternoon, he took leave from work and drove to Hangzhou to meet his girlfriend for the first time in person. At dinner, he gave her a gift, and the atmosphere was harmonious. After checking into the hotel, he contacted his cousin to arrange a meeting the next day, while also keeping an eye on his right knee.

events.name: Checked real estate during a break at work
events.description: In the morning at his workstation, stimulated by yesterday's sharp rise in rent, Yin Hao opened the Beike Zhaofang app on his phone for the first time during a break, browsing price information for new properties and second-hand homes in Songjiang District and surrounding areas (Huaqiao, Jiashan). He found that small units were basically priced above 1.5 million yuan, and secretly calculated the down payment gap.

events.name: Preparing Gifts and Setting Out
events.description: At 2 p.m., Yin Hao asked his team leader Wang Lei for half a day off. He packed a simple travel backpack (a change of clothes, a charger, and gifts for Lin Yue—an interesting book on CNC technology and a pair of Bluetooth earbuds), checked the car, and brought his knee braces (the online order had arrived). Then he set off by car from his home in Songjiang and drove along the Shanghai-Kunming Expressway to Hangzhou. On the way, he made a brief stop at Jiaxing Service Area to stretch and relax his knee.

events.name: Arrive in Hangzhou and check in.
events.description: Arrived in Xihu District, Hangzhou at around 16:30 and checked into a Home Inn Express hotel booked in advance via mobile phone (located on Wensan Road, relatively close to West Lake). After putting down his luggage, he applied a hot compress to his right knee in the hotel and took a walk around to familiarize himself with the area. He contacted his cousin Chen Xiaowen, who lives in Xihu District, via WeChat and arranged to meet for lunch the next day.

events.name: First meeting dinner.
events.description: At 18:30 in the evening, Yin Hao met Lin Yue at a Hangzhou-style restaurant near the train station. Lin Yue was more delicate than in her photos. The two were a little reserved at first, but gradually relaxed as they discussed the dishes (Yin Hao recommended steamed sea bass, and Lin Yue ordered Longjing shrimp) and chatted about interesting stories from work. Yin Hao gave her a pair of Bluetooth earphones. Lin Yue was pleasantly surprised, accepted them, and said she liked them very much. Dinner lasted an hour and a half, and the atmosphere was harmonious. When they parted, both felt satisfied and agreed to visit West Lake together the next day.

events.name: Initial communication with girlfriend
events.description: After returning to the hotel, Yin Hao and Lin Yue said goodnight to each other via WeChat. Lin Yue sent a West Lake sightseeing guide, and Yin Hao reminded her to wear more clothes tomorrow (the temperature would be low). He fell asleep with anticipation, and still applied a hot compress to his knee for 10 minutes before sleeping.

2025-02.daily_overview: On Yin Hao's last day in Hangzhou, he visited West Lake and climbed Baoshi Mountain with Lin Yue in the morning, and the dull pain in his right knee worsened; at noon his cousin treated the two to lunch, and in the afternoon the three went cycling together. In the evening he had dinner at his cousin's home. Both romance and family bonds deepened, but the knee pain remained a concern. After returning late, he applied a hot compress and decided to see a doctor for a checkup next week.

events.name: Financial check.
events.description: At 7:30 in the morning at the hotel, Yin Hao logged into his personal account through mobile banking and checked whether the automatic deduction of 1,000 yuan for the monthly index fund auto-investment set at the beginning of the month had been completed successfully. After confirming the deduction was normal, he checked his current account balance and last month's fund returns (slightly up), and briefly calculated the gap between his current savings and his home-buying goal.

events.name: Visiting West Lake with Lin Yue (right knee discomfort worsened)
events.description: At 9:00 a.m., Yin Hao and Lin Yue met at the Broken Bridge and Remnant Snow scenic spot. They strolled along Bai Causeway and Su Causeway, enjoying the early spring scenery of West Lake and taking photos from time to time. As they walked and chatted, their relationship gradually warmed. At the southern end of Su Causeway, Yin Hao suggested climbing Baoshi Mountain to see Baochu Pagoda. Although the mountain was not high, there were many steps. The round trip totaled about 8 kilometers. Yin Hao’s right knee pain worsened (pain level about 3, with a slight limp when walking), but he did not take it seriously and continued to accompany her on the outing.

events.name: Had lunch with my older female cousin.
events.description: At noon 12 o'clock, as agreed, his cousin Chen Xiaowen came to Zhiweiguan (Hubin Road branch) by West Lake to meet Yin Hao and Lin Yue. Chen Xiaowen warmly greeted Lin Yue and ordered xiaolongbao, Dongpo pork, steamed sea bass, and other dishes Yin Hao liked. The three chatted while eating. The cousin shared funny stories about her UI design work, and Lin Yue talked about her experience at a medical device company. Laughter filled the meal.

events.name: In the afternoon, the three of them toured together.
events.description: After dinner, his cousin suggested cycling to Longjing Village and Nine Creeks and Eighteen Ravines. The three rented shared bikes and rode along Longjing Road, stopping in the tea gardens to take photos. Yin Hao slowed down because of discomfort in his knee, but neither Lin Yue nor his cousin noticed anything unusual. At 4 p.m., after the trip, his cousin invited Yin Hao and Lin Yue to her place for dinner.

events.name: Dinner at cousin's home
events.description: In the evening, Yin Hao and Lin Yue followed their cousin back to her rental apartment on Wensan Road in Xihu District. The cousin cooked a few home-style dishes (scrambled eggs with tomatoes, braised pork ribs, and greens). The three chatted about the past six months while eating. Lin Yue seemed especially at ease in the relaxed family atmosphere. The cousin quietly told Yin Hao that Lin Yue was a nice girl. After dinner, the three enjoyed the night view of West Lake outside the window.

events.name: Knee discomfort worsened
events.description: After returning to the hotel, Yin Hao felt increased pain in his right knee (pain level about 3, with a slight limp when walking). He thought it was caused by climbing too many mountains and stairs during the day. He boiled some water with the hotel's electric kettle, soaked a towel in hot water, and applied it to his knee for 15 minutes. At the same time, he searched for knee pain symptoms on his phone, suspected patellar tendinitis, and decided to make an appointment for an orthopedic outpatient exam as soon as he returned to Shanghai next Monday.

events.name: Had a heart-to-heart talk with Lin Yue.
events.description: In the evening, Lin Yue came to the hotel to accompany Yin Hao. The two had an open and in-depth conversation about coordinating their daily routines in a long-distance relationship. Lin Yue admitted that her habit of staying up late would be difficult to fully correct in the short term, but she was willing to make an effort to adjust. Yin Hao promised to be more patient and agreed not to force video calls in the morning according to his own schedule. They also made an initial agreement to meet at least once a month, and their relationship grew even closer after the conversation.

events.name: Farewell and Plans
events.description: At 22:00, Lin Yue left the hotel and went home. Yin Hao packed his luggage, set an alarm for 8 a.m. the next morning (planning to return to Shanghai in the morning), thanked and said goodbye to his cousin via WeChat, exchanged 'good night' messages with Lin Yue, and fell asleep at 23:20. Before sleeping, he felt soreness in his lower back from the day's activities and tossed and turned for a while before falling asleep.

events.name: After checking out, drove to Yuhang to meet a former comrade-in-arms.

events.name: He did strength training at the gym where his comrade worked and also took a tour.

They ordered signature dishes such as West Lake vinegar fish and Dongpo pork, and chatted while eating about their career development and life plans. Zhang Jianguo asked Yin Hao how things were going in his love life and encouraged him to stick with his running goals. Yin Hao, in turn, asked about his fellow veteran's prospects as a coach. After the meal, they wished each other well and agreed to meet again next time.

events.name: In the afternoon, drove back to his residence in Songjiang, Shanghai.
events.description: At 1 p.m., Yin Hao said goodbye to Zhang Jianguo, turned on his phone's Bluetooth to connect to the car stereo, played a playlist of classic old songs, and drove east along the G60 Shanghai-Kunming Expressway. On the way, he recalled the details of the date and felt happy. Around 4 p.m., Yin Hao safely arrived at the residential community at No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, parked, and carried his luggage upstairs.

events.name: Returned home, tidied up briefly, and took a relaxing shower.
events.description: Yin Hao put the local specialties he brought back from Hangzhou on the coffee table and tossed his dirty clothes into the washing machine. He took a hot shower and changed into comfortable loungewear, feeling the fatigue of the trip melt away. Then he simply ordered takeout for dinner.

events.name: After dinner, prepare for a video call with my brother.
events.description: After dinner, Yin Hao washed the dishes and returned to the living room sofa. He checked the Wi-Fi signal, opened WeChat to confirm the network was stable, fixed his phone on the stand, adjusted the angle and lighting, and then sent a WeChat message to his older brother Yin Tao to confirm the video call time.

events.name: Had a 30-minute video call with my elder brother Yin Tao.
events.description: At 8 p.m., the video call connected. The two brothers greeted each other and talked about their work and life after the Spring Festival. Yin Tao had recently signed several car sales orders in Suzhou and shared some funny stories about customers. Yin Hao candidly told him about how he and Lin Yue got together in Hangzhou. Yin Tao reminded him that dating costs a lot and he should budget carefully. The two chatted for 30 minutes in a relaxed atmosphere.

events.name: After the video call, teamed up with his brother to play Honor of Kings and agreed to go home for Qingming Festival
events.description: After the call ended, Yin Tao suggested playing a game, and the two quickly teamed up for ranked matches in Honor of Kings. After winning, they agreed to go back together during the Qingming Festival holiday to visit their parents in Rudong, Nantong, and initially confirmed their leave arrangements.

events.name: Texted Lin Yue goodnight on WeChat before bed
events.description: After the game ended, it was already 10:30 pm. Yin Hao finished washing up, lay in bed, and sent Lin Yue a message saying goodnight and missing her, along with a cute emoji. Lin Yue replied quickly, and the two chatted briefly. Yin Hao put down his phone and fell asleep with a smile.

2025-02.daily_overview: Monday workday. In the morning, when trying to resume running, my right knee suddenly had a sharp pain, forcing me to stop — a wake-up call about the injury. During the day, I learned to operate a new five-axis machine tool in the workshop and asked my master for advice; the work was fulfilling. In the evening, I devoted myself to self-study of five-axis programming; sitting for long periods worsened the back and waist pain, but still I studied late into the night without noticing the time. Before bed, I searched for residence permit policies, taking a small step toward the dream of buying a house. A day intertwined with injury and dreams. My weight rose slightly to 71.2 kg due to takeout dinner.

events.name: Morning run cut short by a sudden stabbing pain in the right knee.
events.description: At 6:30 a.m., Yin Hao set out on his usual morning run along Guangfulin Road. After running about 1 km, a sharp pain suddenly hit his right knee, and he had to walk slowly back home. When he got home, he wrapped an ice pack in a towel and applied it to his knee, and recorded the aborted run in the running app on his phone. He felt upset and had a premonition that the injury might affect his half-marathon plan.

events.name: In the morning, operated a new five-axis machine tool in the workshop and consulted Master Sun.
events.description: After breakfast, Yin Hao drove about 20 minutes to the company (666 Shenzhuan Highway, Songjiang). In the morning, he entered the workshop and, under the guidance of master Sun Jianguo, tried to independently operate a new five-axis machine tool to complete the rough machining of a datum surface. He asked questions while working and recorded the key operating points. Master Sun praised him for being quick to learn.

events.name: Lunch break with colleagues, chatting about weekend experiences
events.description: At noon in the cafeteria, Yin Hao sat at the same table as Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang. The two asked about his weekend trip to Hangzhou. Yin Hao smiled and shared details of the date, but mentioned the pain in his right knee. Liu Zhiqiang suggested he reduce his running volume, while Wang Lei invited him to play a mobile game together over the weekend to unwind. Yin Hao felt warmed by his colleagues' camaraderie.

events.name: In the afternoon, continued practicing on the machine tool and thinking about optimizing the process
events.description: In the afternoon, Yin Hao continued operating the five-axis machine tool and tried machining the second part. He checked the drawings, adjusted the cutting parameters, and found a slight deviation in the fixture positioning. He wrote down the problem in his notes and planned to discuss improvement solutions with Master Sun later. During the work breaks, he occasionally stretched his waist and back, which felt slightly sore.

events.name: After work, go home for a simple dinner and dive into self-study of five-axis programming.
events.description: After work, Yin Hao drove home, took out the braised pork his mother had left from the refrigerator, heated it up, and had a simple dinner with rice. At 7:30 p.m., he sat at his desk, opened the textbook "Introduction to Five-Axis Machining Programming," studied the chapter on coordinate systems with examples downloaded from the internet, and drew diagrams in his notebook to understand the concepts. This lasted nearly two hours. Because of prolonged sitting, he began to feel back pain, but he persisted and completed the planned content.

events.name: In the evening, searched for Shanghai residence permit points policy.
events.description: After studying programming, it was already 10 p.m. Yin Hao lay in bed and used the browser on his phone to search for the Shanghai residence permit points policy, carefully reading the points rules and home-purchase qualification requirements. He calculated his own points and realized he still needed to improve his education or skills, so he silently resolved to obtain an advanced technician certificate. He bookmarked the relevant webpages for later in-depth study.

events.name: Video call with Lin Yue before bed
events.description: At 10:30 p.m., Yin Hao initiated a WeChat video call. Lin Yue picked up, and the two chatted about the day's work. Yin Hao mentioned his right knee injury, and Lin Yue urged him to see a doctor. Yin Hao agreed to be careful and reminded her not to stay up late. After about 15 minutes, they said good night, and Yin Hao fell asleep with some anxiety about the future.

events.name: In the morning, continue operating the five-axis machine tool and try writing machining programs

In the evening, after consulting his running friend Chen Jie, he confirmed that his right knee was likely patellar tendinitis. Although he didn't see a doctor immediately, he decided to suspend running and adjust his half-marathon training plan. He began to confront the injury, with mixed feelings. events.name: In the morning, he cared for his knee and searched for rehabilitation knowledge.
events.description: At 6:45 a.m., Yin Hao applied a hot towel to his right knee while searching on his phone for what to do about runner's knee pain. He browsed several sports rehabilitation articles and learned that it might be iliotibial band friction or patellar tendinitis, so he decided to consult his running friend Chen Jie that evening. He did a few simple non-weight-bearing quadriceps contraction exercises.

events.name: In the morning, organized this week's practice and programming study notes.
events.description: During a break at work, Yin Hao opened his notebook and transcribed the machine tool operating parameters and programming insights from the past two days into an electronic document, adding a simple diagram for each key point. He planned to use these as reference materials for future review. The organizing took more than an hour, and his back and waist felt slightly sore from the uncomfortable sitting posture, so he got up and moved around twice.

events.name: Report the phased learning results to Master Sun after the lunch break.
events.description: Before afternoon work, Yin Hao carried his computer to the technical room to find Sun Jianguo and showed him the notes he had organized and the simple programs he had written. Master Sun read them carefully, pointed out several coordinate-setting errors, and praised his clear summarization. Yin Hao carefully noted the improvements and asked about approaches to tool-path optimization.

events.name: In the evening, he consulted fellow runner Chen Jie via WeChat about his knee injury.
events.description: At 8 p.m., Yin Hao described to his running buddy Chen Jie on WeChat the location and onset of the pain in his right knee. Based on his experience, Chen Jie judged it might be patellar tendinitis and advised him to stop running immediately for at least two weeks and go to the hospital as soon as possible for an MRI to rule out other problems. Yin Hao said he was busy at work recently and couldn't take time off for the moment, planning to wait two weeks and see. Chen Jie told him not to push himself.

events.name: Adjust the half-marathon training plan and re-plan the exercise direction.
events.description: After the consultation, Yin Hao opened the training plan app on his phone and changed the originally planned long-distance run to swimming and strength training. He looked up swimming pools near his home and reasoned that if his knee injury did not improve, he would get a monthly pass. But whenever he thought that the half-marathon goal might be postponed, he could not help sighing, and he marked the May half-marathon as pending on his calendar.

start_state.mood: Actively adjust

end_state.location: Home, 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai
end_state.mood: Anxious about the injury, but an adjustment plan has already been made.

2025-02.daily_overview: On Thursday, Yin Hao, amid his busy work, seized the lunch break to filter second-hand housing listings and buy advanced five-axis programming materials. In the evening, he successively activated the online course and planned his study. The minor hiccup in the morning when the video call with Lin Yue failed was resolved after honest communication in the evening, and the two began to take the issue of coordinating their schedules seriously. Study and home-buying advanced on two fronts, and the pace of life quickened. Because lunch was light, his weight dropped to 71.0 kg.

events.name: The early morning video call fell through, and he left a message expressing concern.
events.description: At 8 in the morning, Yin Hao made a video call to Lin Yue as agreed. The phone rang but no one answered, and he guessed she had probably stayed up late again and overslept. Yin Hao hung up helplessly and sent a gentle voice message: Yueyue, you stayed up late again, didn't you? Remember to eat breakfast. Don't push yourself so hard. Although he was not angry, he felt they needed to seriously talk about her sleep schedule.

events.name: In the morning, continued five-axis machine tool practice and completed collection of evaluation data.
events.description: After arriving at the company, Yin Hao operated the new machine tool to machine test pieces according to the evaluation project requirements, recording data such as machining time and surface roughness. With the help of an experienced master worker, he also measured the positioning accuracy of the machine tool, and the data would be used for the final evaluation report. He worked with focus; the knee pain did not affect standing or walking, but after prolonged standing his right knee felt slightly swollen.

events.name: During the lunch break, searched for and purchased advanced five-axis programming books and an online course.
events.description: During the lunch break, Yin Hao searched for advanced five-axis CNC programming on a shopping app, compared reviews of several books including Five-Axis CNC Machining Technology and Programming Examples, and finally selected two. Then he browsed online courses and chose a well-reviewed online course, Five-Axis CNC Programming: From Beginner to Mastery. The total cost was about 500 yuan. After completing the payment, the order showed that the books would arrive in three days and the activation code for the online course would be sent immediately.

events.name: After work, activated the online course and browsed the course catalog to set learning requirements.
events.description: At 5:30 p.m., after getting off work and going home, Yin Hao opened the activation link in the text message on his phone, entered the redemption code, and successfully activated the online course. He browsed the course catalog and found that it included modules such as coordinate systems and tool path planning, just what he needed. He immediately added the course to his mobile study plan and set a goal of learning one lesson every night at 8:30, ambitious.

events.name: In the evening, reached an initial consensus with Lin Yue via video call about sleep schedules.
events.description: The video call connected at 9 p.m. Lin Yue apologized for not making the morning call, explaining that she had been working on design drafts until early morning. Yin Hao said he understood, but suggested making a more specific schedule, such as moving the morning video call to lunch break or a fixed evening time. Lin Yue agreed to be more disciplined, and the two agreed to supervise each other and try to implement it starting next Monday. After the video call, Yin Hao felt more secure in the relationship.

events.name: Before going to bed, he browsed a real estate app and saved several small-unit properties to favorites.
events.description: Expense tracking and work preparation

state.daily_exercise: Yin Hao rode a shared bike to the door of the Lianjia Real Estate Songjiang New City store at 925 Xinsongjiang Road. His girlfriend Lin Yue, wearing a light blue trench coat, was already waiting there. The enthusiastic salesperson first showed them a 70-square-meter two-bedroom apartment in a residential area north of Guangfulin Road, listed at 2.85 million yuan; it faced south with good natural light. Yin Hao focused on checking the load-bearing wall structure and piping layout, while Lin Yue paid attention to the nearby supermarkets and distance to the metro station. Then they drove to see another slightly larger apartment in the new city area, giving them a basis for comparison. After viewing, they briefly talked by the roadside. Lin Yue was impressed with the first one, but she needed to recalculate the monthly mortgage payment. They agreed to discuss it in detail on WeChat in the evening.

2025-02.daily_overview: On Friday evening, Yin Hao started an online course, starting with basic interface operations, taking the first step in systematically learning five-axis programming. Afterwards, he played a ranked match of Honor of Kings online with two comrades, and they discussed knee injury recovery and the idea of a National Day trip to Qingdao. Because he logged off early to rest, his sleep time was adjusted to 23:30, and the evening was overall relaxed and moderate. The takeaway dinner was greasy, and his weight slightly increased to 71.4 kg.

events.name: In the afternoon, formally notify Chen Jie via WeChat to suspend the scheduled run.
events.description: At 4 p.m., during a break at work, Yin Hao sent a WeChat message to his running buddy Chen Jie: "Brother Jie, my right knee still hurts. I can't run for a while. Could you let the group know? I'll set up a run once I recover." Chen Jie immediately replied with concern and again suggested he get an MRI. Yin Hao said he would go in a while. He turned off notifications for the running group to avoid feeling tempted.

events.name: After dinner, started the five-axis programming online course
events.description: At 7 p.m., after finishing his takeout, Yin Hao turned on his computer, logged into the online course platform, and opened Lesson 1, Software Interface and Basic Operations, of Five-Axis CNC Programming from Beginner to Mastery. He followed the video to familiarize himself with the toolbar and view controls, tried creating a new project, spent an hour and a half, and took notes on key points. Although the content was basic, he felt he had taken a key step.

events.name: In the evening, played Honor of Kings online with army buddies.
events.description: From 9 to 10:30 p.m., Yin Hao, Zhang Jianguo, and Zhou Xiaofeng agreed online via WeChat to get on. They played only one ranked match; Yin Hao played the marksman position, and with good coordination they won. Considering that he had plans for the weekend the next day and needed to sleep early, he took the initiative to log off, and the three agreed to get together another day.

events.name: During game breaks, discussed knee injury recovery and alternative exercises.
events.description: On the game's hero-selection screen, Zhang Jianguo learned that Yin Hao had stopped running due to a knee injury and suggested he switch to strength training to maintain fitness, such as squats and deadlifts. Yin Hao politely declined, saying he should not do weight-bearing exercises before the knee healed. Zhou Xiaofeng agreed and suggested trying swimming or cycling. Yin Hao said he would rest for two weeks and then consider it. The three cared about each other, showing deep comrade-in-arms friendship.

events.name: Preliminary discussion about a Qingdao trip during the National Day holiday
events.description: As the game was nearing its end, it was already 10:30 p.m. Zhang Jianguo brought up National Day plans, and the three of them had a lively discussion about the possibility of going to Qingdao. Yin Hao checked train tickets and suggested taking the high-speed rail directly; Zhou Xiaofeng said they could stay at an Airbnb. They talked about eating seafood and climbing Laoshan Mountain, but did not settle on a specific itinerary, only roughly setting it from October 1 to 7, with details to be discussed later.

2025-02.daily_overview: The planned Saturday fishing trip fell through because of a rear-end collision. In the morning he dealt with the accident and took the car in for repairs; in the afternoon he sorted out his finances; and in the evening he kept up his programming studies. This unlucky day cost Yin Hao money and energy, but it also strengthened his determination to work harder and save on expenses. Because of the accident errands, lunch was simple, and his weight dropped slightly to 71.2kg.

events.name: Got into a rear-end collision on the way to Dianshan Lake in the morning.
events.description: At 8 a.m., Yin Hao loaded the fishing gear into the car and drove enthusiastically toward Qingpu. While waiting at a red light at an intersection in Songjiang New City, he heard a sudden bang and the rear of the car was hit. He got out to check; the rear bumper was slightly deformed. The other driver got out and apologized repeatedly, admitting full responsibility. Yin Hao calmly called the police and contacted the insurance company. The traffic police arrived and issued the accident liability confirmation. After the loss adjuster made an assessment, the morning passed in handling the matter.

events.name: Contacted fishing buddies to cancel the plan after handling the accident.
events.description: After the accident was handled for the time being, Yin Hao regretfully sent a WeChat message to his fishing buddy Wu Zhiqiang: 'Brother Wu, I just got hit, I can't make it today.' Wu Zhiqiang replied with comfort and asked if he was okay. Yin Hao said he wasn't hurt, but the car needed repairs, so they would have to plan another time. He looked helplessly at the fishing gear in the trunk and decided to head back.

events.name: Send the vehicle to the repair shop for repairs
events.description: At noon, Yin Hao drove to a certified repair shop in Songjiang according to the repair shop address recommended by the insurance company. After completing the authorization procedures, the repair technician told him that the rear bumper needed to be replaced and that the car would be ready in about three days. After signing, Yin Hao took out his personal belongings and waited alone by the roadside for the bus, feeling depressed.

events.name: Take the bus home and calculate the gap between savings and down payment
events.description: At 2 p.m., Yin Hao finally got home after transferring buses. He brewed a cup of tea, sat at the desk, opened the expense-tracking app, and did the math: his current savings were about 355,000 yuan, but at least 500,000 yuan was needed for the down payment on a small apartment in Songjiang. Today's accident meant an extra expense. He wrote down the phrase "increase income and reduce expenses" in his notebook and decided to cut all unnecessary spending and replan his monthly savings amount.

events.name: In the evening, continued learning the basic interface operations of the online course
events.description: At 8 p.m., Yin Hao composed himself, opened the online course, and continued with consolidation exercises for the first lesson. Following the video, he tried the toolbar functions one by one, created a simple milling project, and adjusted the view settings. Although his operations were not yet smooth, after an hour and a half of exploration he gained a more intuitive understanding of the basic environment, preparing for the next lesson on the coordinate system.

events.name: Before bed, video-called Lin Yue to vent and was comforted
events.description: At 10:30 PM, on a video call, Yin Hao told Lin Yue about the bad luck he had during the day. Lin Yue comforted him, saying it was fine as long as no one was hurt, and that losing money wards off disaster. She jokingly said she could go fishing with him in the future. Yin Hao was amused and his mood improved. The two chatted about next week's plans, agreed to supervise each other's daily routines, and then said goodnight.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to fishing, feeling excited.

end_state.mood: A costly and exhausting effort, but my resolve is firm.

2025-02.daily_overview: Stayed at home on Sunday. In the morning, received a postal package of programming books, adding to his study library. In the afternoon, had a detailed video chat with his childhood friend Zhang Wei about being a groomsman at the wedding, carefully noting his duties to contribute to his friend's big life event. In the evening, continued the online course on coordinate systems; though the difficulty increased, he made steady progress. The day was focused on personal growth and maintaining friendship. Because of the sausages and cured meat his mother sent, dinner was rich, and his weight rose to 71.6 kg.

events.name: In the morning, picked up two programming books from the community parcel locker.
events.description: At 9 a.m., Yin Hao received a parcel locker pickup code and, realizing the books he had bought the day before had arrived, immediately went downstairs. After opening the package, he quickly flipped through the table of contents of Five-Axis CNC Machining Technology and Programming Examples and Advanced Five-Axis Programming Practice, saw many machine tool diagrams and code examples, and felt they were well worth the money. He placed the books in a prominent spot on his desk, planning to study them with the online course in the evening.

events.name: Before noon, organized notes on best man duties and prepared for a video call
events.description: After brunch, Yin Hao remembered that he was going to video chat with his childhood friend Zhang Wei in the afternoon to discuss wedding matters. He opened the memo app on his phone and pulled up the best man key points he had noted earlier: the bridal procession games, ring keeping, helping with toasts, etc. He also listed details to confirm on paper, including suit color, shirt style, and the budget for the wedding gift. He checked the network to ensure a smooth video call.

events.name: In the afternoon, had a video call with childhood friend Zhang Wei to discuss wedding preparations.
events.description: At 2 p.m., the video call connected, and Zhang Wei was at his hometown in Rudong. He excitedly showed the renderings of the wedding venue and explained the bridal pickup route in detail. The two confirmed each item: Yin Hao needed to wear a dark blue suit and a tie of the same color, follow the car throughout the procession, and deliver the rings. Zhang Wei also complained about the wedding company's high fees, and Yin Hao patiently comforted him and promised to share the miscellaneous tasks. They also talked about changes in their hometown. The call lasted 40 minutes, and the atmosphere was warm.

events.name: After the call, organized the best man procedures and searched for suit rental information
events.description: After the video ended, Yin Hao immediately organized the key points into digital notes, including the schedule, contacts, and so on. He then opened Taobao to search for best man suit rentals and saved information on several local rental shops. He also set a calendar reminder for the wedding date (known to be September 6) to make sure no preparation was overlooked.

events.name: Received hometown specialties sent by my mother
events.description: At 4 p.m., Yin Hao received a notification from Cainiao Station and picked up the package his mother Wang Xiuying had sent from Rudong. It contained homemade sausages, cured meat, and two jars of Nantong clam sauce. He took a photo and sent it to his mother to thank her, and decided to steam one sausage link that evening to taste.

events.name: Evening study of five-axis programming coordinate systems
events.description: At 8 PM, Yin Hao started the coordinate system chapter of the online course. He followed the video to understand the relationship between the workpiece coordinate system and the machine tool coordinate system, and tried setting the coordinate origin using the simulation software on his computer. The coordinate transformation for multi-axis linkage felt somewhat abstract to him, so he kept pausing while taking notes. After studying for an hour and a half, although he hadn't fully mastered it, it laid the foundation for subsequent tool path planning.

start_state.mood: Focused and organized.

end_state.location: Home, 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

2025-02.daily_overview: On Monday, because his car was still under repair, Yin Hao commuted by public transit. He stayed in work mode during the day and asked Master Sun about his confusion with coordinates during the lunch break. In the evening, he officially launched his systematic study plan, but encountered a comprehension obstacle in coordinate system conversion and inevitably felt frustrated. Urban commuting and study bottlenecks made Monday feel somewhat heavy. Because public transit commuting consumed a lot of energy, he ate a bit more at dinner, and his weight rose to 71.8 kg.

events.name: Taking the bus to work in the morning and adapting to the new commute
events.description: Because his car had not been repaired yet, Yin Hao got up 20 minutes earlier than usual, walked to the Guangfulin Road bus stop, and took Songjiang Route XX to the company. The bus was crowded, so he listened to the news with earphones. After nearly 50 minutes he arrived, feeling more tired than when driving. He reminded himself to drive carefully and not have any more accidents in the future.

events.name: Carried out normal five-axis machine tool operation and data recording in the morning
events.description: After arriving at the factory, Yin Hao changed into his work clothes and continued operating the new five-axis machine tool, machining a batch of test samples, and organized last month's comparison data from the old machine tool into a table. His right knee still ached slightly while he worked, but standing was not a problem. Before the lunch break, he asked Sun Jianguo about the coordinate system conversion problem he had encountered in yesterday's online course.

events.name: Asked Master Sun about the coordinate issue during the lunch break.
events.description: In the workshop break room, Sun Jianguo drew a schematic diagram on the floor with chalk, explaining the relationship between rotary and linear axes and giving an example to illustrate the G68 coordinate system rotation command. Yin Hao suddenly understood and wrote it down in his pocket notebook, feeling that it was much more intuitive than just reading a book. Master Sun urged him to do more simulation verification on the actual machine tool.

events.name: In the evening, took the bus home and contacted the repair shop.
events.description: After work, Yin Hao squeezed onto the bus again. On the way, he contacted the repair shop via WeChat and learned that the vehicle's sheet metal and painting had been completed and it was undergoing a final inspection, expected to be ready for pickup tomorrow afternoon. He replied “OK, thanks,” feeling relieved, but a little helpless at the thought of having to take the bus again tomorrow.

events.name: From 8 to 10 p.m., studied according to plan and encountered setbacks.
events.description: After dinner, following the plan he had made, Yin Hao started studying at 8 o'clock. He first read the chapter "Five-Axis Machine Tool Structure and Coordinate Systems" and took notes; then he opened the online course and went to the composite transformation section on coordinate system conversion. An example involving simultaneous rotation and translation left him unable to understand it even after watching repeatedly, and his head felt swollen. He held his frustration and browsed forums for half an hour but found no clear explanation, so he had to set it aside for now and ask someone tomorrow.

events.name: Before bed, video-called Lin Yue to vent and encourage each other.
events.description: During a video call at 10:30 p.m., Yin Hao looked frustrated and said studying was too hard. Lin Yue shared that she had also broken down when learning new design software, but insisted and it got better. She suggested that Yin Hao break big problems into smaller ones. After hearing this, Yin Hao felt a bit relieved, and they agreed to keep working on it tomorrow. They talked until 11 p.m., and Yin Hao felt his motivation returning.

2025-02.daily_overview: Tuesday brought double gains: in the morning I completed and submitted the five-axis machine tool evaluation report and received the project bonus; in the afternoon I picked up my repaired car, gave it a thorough check, and resumed commuting by car. In the evening I used an online forum to solve the coordinate transformation problem, and faced my knee injury by making an outpatient appointment at the hospital. Work achievements, the return of normal life, and health actions all moved forward together, and I kept a positive attitude. In the evening I tried home core training for the first time; my weight increased to 72.0 kg.

events.name: In the morning, organize and submit the five-axis machine tool evaluation report.
events.description: As soon as he got to work, Yin Hao compiled the data collected over the past three weeks on machine tool ease of operation and machining accuracy comparison into a formal report, inserting charts and conclusions. He printed it out, took it to Sun Jianguo for review, and Master Sun praised the clear data, only suggesting that risk warnings be added to the conclusions. After revising it, Yin Hao signed it and personally delivered it to the Technical Department office for filing.

events.name: Learned about the project bonus incentive before noon.
events.description: Soon after submitting the report, department supervisor Manager Zhang stopped Yin Hao and told him in person that because his evaluation report provided key reference for the purchasing decision, the company would issue an additional project bonus of 2,000 yuan, to be paid with next month's salary. Yin Hao thanked him repeatedly, felt that months of effort had been recognized, and resolved to continue studying the technology.

events.name: Pick up the repaired vehicle in the afternoon and give it a thorough inspection
events.description: At 4 p.m., he received a call from the repair shop. After work, Yin Hao took the bus there. Inspecting the car, he found the rear bumper looked brand new. He paid the 200 yuan deductible not covered by insurance, then drove to a nearby vehicle inspection station for a safety check including brakes, tires, and engine; everything was normal. As he drove away, he thought: I must drive safely, this is the lesson from the accident.

events.name: Returned home to prepare dinner and rest for a while
events.description: After picking up the car, Yin Hao stopped by the supermarket to buy vegetables and eggs, and went home to make a simple tomato and egg rice bowl. After the meal, he lay on the sofa and browsed a real estate app on his phone. When he saw a listing in Songjiang New Town that had dropped by 20,000 yuan, he immediately saved it. He vaguely felt the pressure of buying a house, but at the moment he just wanted to rest first.

events.name: Evening study and using a forum to solve the difficult coordinate transformation problem
events.description: At 8 p.m., before studying, Yin Hao logged into the course forum and posted a detailed post about the composite coordinate transformation confusion he encountered last night. He then spent an hour browsing answers to similar problems. Based on an illustration from a helpful netizen and using a paper-folding model he made himself, he finally gained a preliminary understanding of the linkage principle between the rotation axis and the translation axis. He let out a cheer and, striking while the iron was hot, finished the next video lesson.

events.name: Having made up his mind to see a doctor, he made an appointment at the Sports Medicine outpatient clinic
events.description: After studying, Yin Hao still felt occasional swelling and pain in his right knee. Remembering the advice of Chen Jie and Zhang Jianguo, he finally opened the WeChat official account of Shanghai Sixth People's Hospital, consulted a sports rehabilitation specialist online, and the specialist recommended an MRI. He took a deep breath, made an appointment for the morning of March 2 at the Sports Medicine outpatient clinic, and set an alarm reminder. This was his first step in proactively facing the injury, and he actually felt reassured.

events.name: Tried core training at home in the evening.
events.description: Since the doctor advised him to avoid running, Yin Hao followed the guidance on his phone app before bed and did 15 minutes of core training, including planks, crunches, and glute bridges. He felt soreness in his abdominal muscles and considered it a good start to an alternative workout.

2025-02.daily_overview: During the day on Wednesday, work went on as usual. In the evening, after tackling the tool path planning chapter, Yin Hao rewarded himself with music and tidying up. He rediscovered old CDs and posted on Moments, drawing interactions from old friends. The nostalgic night eased his tense nerves, and his weight was 72.0 kg.

events.name: Do waist and back stretches during work breaks
events.description: At 10 a.m. and 3 p.m., Yin Hao spent about 5 minutes each time doing a set of office stretching exercises he had learned from the massage therapist, including seated twists and cat stretches. His lower back felt much more relaxed. He decided to keep this habit.

events.name: Continue the five-axis machine tool practice in the morning and participate in workshop discussions.
events.description: After starting work, Yin Hao adjusted the program according to the newly learned tool path parameters, and the surface smoothness of the machined parts improved significantly. At the midday short meeting in the workshop, he also briefly shared his ideas on fixture improvement; several veteran coworkers expressed approval, and Master Sun nodded encouragingly. The work atmosphere was good.

events.name: Evening study of core concepts in tool path planning
events.description: At 7 p.m., Yin Hao first previewed the tool axis control and step distance settings according to the book, then opened an online course and learned the tool path generation process demonstrated by the instructor. Through simulation software, he observed path changes under different parameters and intuitively understood the relationship between depth of cut and scallop height. After studying for an hour and a half and taking three pages of notes, he felt that the abstract theories had become concrete.

events.name: After studying, turned on the Bluetooth speaker and played classic old songs to relax.
events.description: At 9 p.m., Yin Hao stretched his back, walked into the living room, connected his phone to the Bluetooth speaker, and played his playlist of classic old songs. The melodies of Li Zongsheng and Wang Fei flowed out. He listened with his eyes closed for a while, and his fatigue gradually melted away.

events.name: Organize the desk and CD shelf and find nostalgic CDs.
events.description: To the music, Yin Hao began tidying up his messy desk and CD shelf. He arranged his programming books in order of learning sequence and wiped off the dust. In the corner of the CD shelf, he was pleasantly surprised to find the first album by Dao Lang from 2002 and Phoenix Legend's CD 'Above the Moon,' which he had brought from his hometown. He carefully wiped them clean and put them into a special storage box.

events.name: Took photos of nostalgic CDs and posted them on Moments.
events.description: Yin Hao used his phone to take a nostalgic photo of two CDs, captioned "Nostalgia Night" and posted it to Moments. Before long, friends such as Zhang Wei, Chen Ming, and Gao Zhiyuan liked and commented, with Chen Ming teasing him about giving away his age. Yin Hao smiled and replied, memories flooding back. He continued listening to music while putting away the remaining clutter, enjoying this rare moment of comfort.

start_state.mood: Normal

2025-02.daily_overview: On the last day of February, Yin Hao completed a stage summary of his programming studies outside work and conducted a rigorous financial review. Facing the reality that his savings had grown minimally, he resolutely decided to activate an extreme frugality mode. In the evening, he had a candid video call with Lin Yue about his financial pressure and daily schedule plans, and received understanding and support. His weight reached 72.5kg, marking the rebound after suspending running. This was both an end and a beginning, setting the tone of austerity and growth for March.

events.name: During the day, keep doing waist and back stretches during work breaks.
events.description: Following the new habit, Yin Hao took 5 minutes each in the morning and afternoon to stretch, and felt that the soreness from prolonged sitting was significantly reduced. He has already set a scheduled reminder on his phone.

events.name: During the day, completed this week's production tasks in the workshop and prepared for the handover.
events.description: On Friday, a working day, Yin Hao efficiently completed the five-axis trial production tasks scheduled for the week and sent the machine tool status records to the colleague taking over. He also compiled the tool wear conditions that the next shift needed to pay attention to before leaving work, handling his work steadily. During the lunch break, he discussed with Wang Lei whether to go fishing on the weekend to relax (but it was later canceled due to rain).

events.name: In the evening, summarized the current stage of five-axis programming study.
events.description: At 7 p.m., Yin Hao sat at his desk and spent an hour and a half reviewing the notes for the first two chapters, redoing typical coordinate transformation problems. He sorted out the knowledge framework and drew a mind map in his notebook, planning the next stage of study focus on tool path simulation and post-processing. He closed the book with satisfaction, feeling that he had basically mastered the first two chapters.

events.name: Conduct a February financial review and discover a savings crisis.
events.description: After studying, Yin Hao opened the bookkeeping app and online banking, and checked February income and expenses item by item: rent 3,000, books and online courses 500, vehicle repair 200, massage 198, plus daily expenses. He found that the dedicated home-buying savings only increased by 1,800 yuan this month, totaling 356,800 yuan. He was silent for a long time, then wrote down on paper: extreme frugality—starting in March, cut back on takeout, entertainment, and non-essential shopping. Goal: save at least 4,500 yuan per month.

events.name: Had a month-end summary video call with Lin Yue
events.description: At 9:30 p.m., Yin Hao had a video call with Lin Yue. He frankly told her about his financial pressure and the upcoming saving plan. Lin Yue expressed understanding and suggested reducing the cost of meeting by taking turns visiting each other's city or choosing low-cost activities. The two also reviewed this month's routine adjustment. Lin Yue took the initiative to propose making a weekly schedule from March to supervise each other. Yin Hao gladly agreed, and they agreed to review every Sunday evening.

events.name: Heat-compress the right knee before bed and set March goals.
events.description: After the video call, Yin Hao applied a hot water bottle to his right knee for 15 minutes, then wrote down his key goals for March in his phone notes: 1. See a doctor to treat the knee injury; 2. Keep learning programming every day; 3. Follow a saving plan and reduce expenses; 4. Have an in-depth conversation with Lin Yue once a week. He set the alarm for tomorrow morning, turned off the light, and listened to the rain outside the window, looking forward to a fresh start in March.

2025-11.daily_overview: On Sunday morning, Yin Hao finished a half marathon at Jinji Lake in Suzhou, setting a new PB of 2:05. His family cheered him on at the scene, and his girlfriend Lin Yue sent remote congratulations. In the afternoon, he drove back to Shanghai, tired but full of a sense of achievement.

events.name: New personal best at the Suzhou Half Marathon
events.description: Woke up at 5:30 in the morning, had a simple breakfast, then headed to the start of the Jinji Lake Marathon. During warm-up, he met many fellow runners and the atmosphere was lively. The gun went off at 7:30, and he ran at a steady pace according to his pre-race plan, refueling at water stations along the way and maintaining his rhythm throughout. His older brother Yin Tao and his family cheered for him at the 8 km and 15 km marks. When he crossed the finish line, the timer showed 2 hours 5 minutes, nearly 4 minutes faster than his previous personal best. He excitedly pumped his fist in celebration. Then he collected his finisher medal and refreshment pack.

events.name: Reunion at the finish line and long-distance well wishes from girlfriend
events.description: Met up with his older brother's family at the finish area and took a photo holding his little nephew. His girlfriend Lin Yue was attending the final interview for an internal company transfer that day, so she sent a WeChat video congratulating him on setting a new PB and said her interview also went well. Yin Hao replied with a video call, and they encouraged each other. At noon he had lunch at Yin Tao's home to celebrate; his sister-in-law had prepared a lavish meal, and his brother privately slipped him a 2,000 yuan red envelope, saying it was a small token for the decoration of their future new home. After lunch and a short rest, Yin Hao drove back to Shanghai at 3 pm and arrived at his home in Songjiang in the evening. After getting home, he did some light stretching and weighed 71.5 kg (dehydrated from heavy sweating). In the evening, he shared the good news with his parents via video.

2025-11.daily_overview: On Thursday, Yin Hao voluntarily took on the commissioning task for the new five-axis machining center. Under his mentor's remote guidance, he independently solved the machining deviation problem, achieving precision better than required and earning praise from the team. To reward himself, he played online games with colleagues Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang in the evening, slightly delaying his bedtime.

events.name: Take on the task of debugging new equipment.
events.description: Got up at 6:20 in the morning, weighed 71.4 kg, and did 15 minutes of core training. At the morning workshop meeting, team leader Wang Lei said the newly introduced five-axis machining center had workpiece roundness deviation. Yin Hao voluntarily raised his hand to take on the task. After the meeting, he consulted the operation manual and prepared measuring tools and cutting tools.

events.name: Consulted mentor Sun Jianguo remotely.
events.description: Facing the deviation problem, he first used his phone to take photos of equipment parameters and defective trial-cut parts, then contacted his master Sun Jianguo via WeChat video. Master Sun pointed out that it might be caused by spindle thermal growth or excessive tool overhang, and suggested adjusting the spindle speed and using a short, rigid tool holder. The two rehearsed the debugging steps over the video.

events.name: Independent test cutting and precision inspection
events.description: According to the agreed plan, he re-clamped the cutting tool, entered the new program, increased the spindle speed by 5%, lowered the feed rate, and added one extra semi-finishing pass. He kept his eyes on the cutting state throughout. After finishing, he inspected the part with a coordinate measuring machine, and the accuracy reached 0.018 mm, better than the 0.02 mm tolerance. He photographed the data and sent it to Master Sun and Wang Lei.

events.name: Commendation from the team and relaxing evening games
events.description: At the afternoon team review meeting, Wang Lei publicly praised Yin Hao and encouraged him to prepare for the skills competition. Yin Hao shared the key debugging points. Afterwards, he signed up for volunteer service at Songjiang District Nursing Home through the company union system. When he got home in the evening, feeling a strong sense of accomplishment, he and Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang agreed in the WeChat group to team up to play Honor of Kings, and they played from 9 to 11, which made him go to bed half an hour later than usual.

2025-11.daily_overview: On Saturday morning, Yin Hao went to Songjiang Nursing Home for volunteer service, using his repair skills to help the elderly, and met two other enthusiastic colleagues from the company, agreeing to go regularly together in the future. In the afternoon, he went for an autumn cycling trip and aerial drone photography, feeling refreshed in body and mind. In the evening, he went to bed early to make up for insufficient sleep the night before.

events.name: Repair service at the nursing home
events.description: At 7:00 in the morning, he finished the final check of the tools. At 8:00, he drove to a nursing home in Songjiang District and arrived at 8:30. Guided by the staff, he first went to the activity room to repair two old floor fans (replacing capacitors and speed control switches), then went to Grandpa Zhang's room to fix a radio that could not change stations (soldering a loose wire), and then went to Grandma Li's room to repair another radio (cleaning the potentiometer). During the repairs, the elderly people gathered around to watch. He chatted about everyday life while repairing and asked about their health. The atmosphere was harmonious.

events.name: Met new colleagues who share the same volunteer interests
events.description: During a maintenance break, I chatted with Li Ming, a technician from the production department, and Zhao Li, a human resources specialist, who were also volunteering. We found that all three of us were visiting this nursing home for the first time and were all enthusiastic about public welfare. We exchanged contact information, and Li Ming suggested that we could participate as a group in the future. Before the activity ended, the three of us met up. Zhao Li proposed creating a WeChat group and volunteering for community service at least once a month. We set up the Public Welfare Trio group on the spot and agreed to visit another nursing home together next time.

events.name: Autumn cycling and drone aerial photography
events.description: At noon, he returned home at 12:00 and weighed 71.3 kg (due to the morning's physical exertion). After a simple lunch, at 1 p.m. he brought out his road bike and drone, started from Songjiang University Town, and rode along Guangfulin Road to the Sheshan National Tourism Resort. He circled Sheshan and Tianma Hills, covering about 40 kilometers in total. During a break, he flew the drone to film the forested hills and the distant city in the sunset, and taught the basic operation to Chen Jie, a fellow runner who came along. Chen Jie succeeded on a trial flight and felt a great sense of achievement. In the evening, he rode back to the starting point and went home to take a shower.

events.name: Evening photo sorting and early bedtime
events.description: After dinner, he imported the autumn scenery photos taken by the drone into his old computer, selected a few and posted them to Moments with the caption 'A fulfilling day of volunteering and cycling at Sheshan in autumn'. Running buddy Chen Jie liked it, and fishing buddy Wu Zhiqiang left a message inviting him to go fishing on the weekend. Because he had slept little the night before, he deliberately went to bed at 22:30 tonight.

2025-11.daily_overview: On Sunday, Yin Hao enjoyed a home-cooked meal at neighbor Aunt Chen's and gained some home renovation experience. In the afternoon, he went to Master Chen Jianguo to learn carpentry and make a simple shoe cabinet, improving his hands-on skills. In the evening, he called his mother and went to bed early to recharge for next week's competition preparation.

events.name: Exam prep theory and a neighbor's family dinner
events.description: Woke up at 8 a.m., weighed 71.4 kg; since it was the weekend he got up a bit later, but still completed 15 minutes of core training. He watched 2 hours of theory sprint videos for the skills competition on his old computer, focusing on the servo-system fault diagnosis section. At 11, as arranged, he went to Aunt Chen Xiuying's house across the hall for lunch. Aunt Chen made four dishes and a soup: Shanghai-style braised pork, steamed sea bass, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and tomato and egg soup. During the meal, Aunt Chen asked about the new apartment's decoration. When she learned that he would get the keys in two months, she enthusiastically shared lessons from her own renovation years ago: how to distinguish engineered wood flooring from laminate flooring, the need to remove the old base layer before painting walls, and not to buy cheap bathroom hardware. Yin Hao carefully noted everything in his phone's memo app. Aunt Chen also agreed to accompany him to the building materials market. After the meal, he helped clean up and wash the dishes.

events.name: Learning woodworking to make a shoe cabinet
events.description: At 2 p.m., I drove to Jianguo Electric Appliance Repair Shop. Master Chen Jianguo had already prepared wood boards, a hand saw, a try square, sandpaper, and so on. Under his guidance, Yin Hao first measured and marked lines with a pencil, then carefully cut out four side panels and two partitions with the saw. Several times the hand saw veered off course, and Master Chen corrected his posture. Next, he assembled the frame with wood glue and screws, and finally smoothed the rough edges with sandpaper. After about four hours, a simple shoe cabinet 80 cm high and 60 cm wide took shape. Master Chen teased him, ‘You bite off more than you can chew—wanting to learn both electrical work and carpentry.’ Yin Hao smiled and replied, ‘I want to make something for the new house with my own hands, even if it’s a bit rough.’ The shoe cabinet was temporarily stored in the shop, to be picked up after the paint dried.

At 8 o'clock I called my mother, asked whether she had received the blood pressure medication (she said she received it the day before yesterday in the afternoon and the packaging was intact), told her to take it on time, and also asked about my father's work renovating the kitchen in our hometown. Mother chattered on, telling me to rest and not get too tired. The call lasted 15 minutes. Afterward, I chatted for a while in the 'Charity Trio' group chat and confirmed the next event. Since I had to get up early for work the next day, I turned off the lights at 22:40.
