He worked normally during the day and in the evening began planning the home renovation, realizing he needed to tighten spending. He skipped the evening's strength training to catch up on sleep.

events.name: Double 11 early-morning shopping spree
events.description: At midnight, he waited by the computer and placed an order on JD.com's self-operated store for a Lenovo Legion Y7000 gaming laptop, using JD Baitiao's 12-month interest-free installment plan and a 200-yuan coupon for purchases over 5000 yuan, finally paying 6500 yuan. At the same time, he bought a Xiaomi air fryer and matching food containers from another store at a discounted price of 269 yuan. When paying, he chose his CCB credit card to enjoy an additional discount. After placing the order, he took a screenshot of the order and confirmed that delivery was expected on November 13. Staying up late meant he only slept about 5 hours.

events.name: During the day, communicated with colleagues at work.
events.description: In the morning, he processed a batch of urgently needed transmission gears in the workshop. Due to lack of sleep, he relied on coffee to stay alert. During the lunch break, his colleague Wang Lei excitedly said that he had bought a new mechanical keyboard, and Liu Zhiqiang had grabbed a projector. Yin Hao shared his decision to buy a gaming laptop and an air fryer. Wang Lei teased him, 'You've finally decided to upgrade your gear.' Master Sun walked over and said, 'The computer is a good buy; programming requires a higher configuration.' After getting off work in the afternoon, he went straight home to catch up on sleep.

events.name: Evening budget review and browsing renovation materials
events.description: After dinner, he caught up on an hour of sleep. When he woke up, he used the expense-tracking app to check this month's spending. The Double 11 shopping had made his expenses surge this month, and he frowned. He then browsed online for prices of wall paint and laminate flooring, and got a sense of what future renovation costs would be. At 9 p.m., he chatted with his friend Gao Zhiyuan on WeChat and learned that he hadn't bought anything on Double 11. Yin Hao smiled wryly at being unable to resist, and decided to reduce KTV trips and takeout over the next few weeks. He wrote the spending reduction plan in his phone memo, and then went to bed earlier than usual because he was sleepy.

start_state.mood: Excited but sleepy

end_state.location: At home
end_state.mood: Satisfied with the spending but with a slight sense of guilt.

state.daily_exercise: None (only simple stretching after staying up late)

2025-11.daily_overview: On Wednesday, Yin Hao received the new gaming laptop and finished unboxing and setup. After work, he consulted his mentor about a difficult five-axis programming problem until 8 p.m. After getting home, because it was too late, he did not do strength training, but he did keep up his core training.

events.name: New computer delivered and unboxed.
events.description: At noon I received the pickup code from Cainiao Station. After work, I went to pick up two packages. I first opened the Lenovo Legion packaging and carefully checked that the exterior had no scratches, the screen had no dead pixels, and all accessories were complete. I turned it on following the steps, activated Windows, used Master Lu to test the hardware, and the hard drive had only 3 hours of use, confirming it was brand new. After the initial setup, I installed CAD and commonly used programming software. I also picked up the air fryer at the same time; I put it in the kitchen for now and plan to clean it tomorrow.

events.name: Asking the master about a five-axis programming problem
events.description: Before leaving work, he used the workshop computer to organize three difficult problems he had encountered recently while practicing five-axis programming: rotary-axis coordinate transformation code, tool compensation changes after enabling the RTCP function, and methods for controlling nonlinear errors. Notebook in hand, he walked to Master Sun Jianguo's workstation. Master Sun was debugging equipment, so he asked Yin Hao to prepare first. When he finished, the two sat down. Drawing on his own competition experience, Master Sun explained practical application tips for RTCP in detail and gradually demonstrated the parameter adjustments on the machine controller. Yin Hao listened and took notes, and the two discussed enthusiastically. Before they knew it, it was 8 p.m. After saying goodbye, Yin Hao drove home.

events.name: Evening core training and connection
events.description: After returning home and finishing dinner at nearly 9 PM, he still persisted in doing 15 minutes of core training. Then he opened CAD software on his new computer and practiced drawing a simple part to become familiar with the operations. At 10:30 PM, he teamed up with Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang in a WeChat group for a game of Honor of Kings (no recharge, pure entertainment), then washed up and rested. Since he had not done strength training, he planned to make it up tomorrow. Before bed, he weighed 71.4 kg.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to the new computer

end_state.location: At home
end_state.mood: Fulfilling but slightly regrettable (no strength training)

state.daily_exercise: 15 minutes of core training.

2025-11.daily_overview: On Thursday, Yin Hao helped his neighbor Aunt Chen fix her clothes drying rack, deepening their neighborly bond. After receiving the air fryer, he successfully tried cooking a lower-oil version of chicken wings that evening. To make up for skipping training yesterday, he added an extra community strength session today.

events.name: Helped repair the neighbor's clothes drying rack
Air fryer unboxing and first use.
events.description: After helping out, he returned home, unboxed the air fryer, read the instruction manual, washed the fryer basket and baking tray with hot water and neutral detergent, and let them dry. At 7:30 p.m., he took out the thawed chicken wings, marinated them with soy sauce, minced ginger, and cooking wine for 15 minutes, placed them in the fryer basket, and set it to 200°C for 15 minutes. He flipped them once during cooking. When they came out, they were golden in color, with slightly crispy skin and tender, juicy inside. He plated them, took a photo, and sent it to Lin Yue on WeChat: "First chicken from the air fryer—success!" Lin Yue replied instantly: "Looks healthy. Wait until I get there; I'll make more varieties for you." His heart warmed.

events.name: Community strength training and study.
events.description: After dinner he rested for an hour, then went to the community fitness area at 8:30 and did 4 sets of pull-ups, 4 sets of push-ups, and 15 minutes on the air walker to make up for the training missed yesterday. After returning home and taking a shower, he opened CAD on his new computer for further practice and did not go to bed until 11:00. Before bed he weighed 71.3 kg.

start_state.mood: Willing to help others

end_state.location: At home
end_state.mood: Warm, and life feels fresh

state.daily_exercise: 15 minutes of core training, community strength training (pull-ups, push-ups, air walker)

2025-11.daily_overview: After work on Friday, Yin Hao bought camping supplies and checked his equipment, making full preparations for the weekend camping trip at Dianshan Lake. In the evening he helped Lin Yue with another mock interview, greatly boosting his girlfriend's confidence. Because he was busy packing, he only did core training.

events.name: Purchasing camping supplies
events.description: After work, cycled to the RT-Mart supermarket in Songjiang New City to buy barbecue ingredients such as lamb skewers, chicken wings, potatoes, and eggplants, two 5L bottles of mineral water, as well as barbecue charcoal, aluminum foil, and disposable tableware. At the nearby Decathlon, bought a pack of new solid alcohol. After returning home, sorted these supplies into storage bins.

events.name: Organizing camping gear
events.description: In the living room, he spread out the tent, sleeping bag, ground mat, tarp, and folding table and chairs to check for damage. He fully charged the drone battery and formatted the memory card; checked the fishing rod and line, and prepared earthworms and commercial bait; and confirmed that the portable speaker's Bluetooth connection was working. He packed all the gear into the car trunk and was busy until 8 p.m.

events.name: Second-round mock interview and final confirmation
events.description: At 9 o'clock, Lin Yue initiated a video call for the final rehearsal. This time she was much smoother and was able to respond calmly to questions that had tripped her up before. Yin Hao gave a few final suggestions: slow down the speaking pace, keep smiling, and state her personal value clearly in the closing summary. After the call ended, Lin Yue said the interview was next Monday and she was 80 percent confident. Yin Hao encouraged her: “You can definitely do it. I'll be silently cheering for you by the shores of Dianshan Lake.” After hanging up, he confirmed in the “Songjiang Three Brothers” group that they would set off at 7 a.m. tomorrow; Gao Zhiyuan and Ma Xiaofeng both replied OK. Before bed, he did 15 minutes of core training, weighed 71.4 kg, and turned off the lights at 22:50.

start_state.mood: Busy but efficient

end_state.location: At home
end_state.mood: Looking forward to camping

state.daily_exercise: 15 minutes of core training.

2025-11.daily_overview: On Saturday, Yin Hao and his friends Gao Zhiyuan and Ma Xiaofeng went camping at Dianshan Lake. They set up tents, fished, flew a drone, and had a barbecue over a campfire, spending a perfect autumn weekend. The day's activities were of moderate intensity, and his weight had dropped 0.5 kg compared with the beginning of the month.

events.name: Departure and Camp Setup
events.description: Got up at 6:00 in the morning, did some simple core training at home, then weighed 71.5kg on an empty stomach. Afterward he drove to pick up Gao Zhiyuan (in Songjiang Old Town), then went to Minhang to pick up Ma Xiaofeng, and arrived at a free camping spot on the west bank of Dianshan Lake at 8:30. The three chose a flat grassy area and worked together to set up two tents and a tarp, spread out the table, and arrange the cookware. Ma Xiaofeng was in charge of fetching water, and Gao Zhiyuan collected dry branches.

events.name: Lakeside fishing and drone teaching
events.description: After lunch, Yin Hao set up two fishing rods and fished the bottom with commercial bait. In less than half an hour, the float dipped, and he struck and landed a crucian carp of about 150 grams, followed by several small topmouth culter. Gao Zhiyuan's hands itched watching, so Yin Hao taught him how to adjust the float and bait the hook; Gao Zhiyuan successfully caught a small crucian carp. At 4 p.m., when the light was soft, Yin Hao took out the drone, took off, and hovered over the lake, capturing panoramic shots of the sunset, the lake, and the campsite. He explained the flight controller and let Ma Xiaofeng try a test flight; Gao Zhiyuan also gave it a try. Both successfully took off and landed and were very interested.

events.name: Campfire Barbecue and Night Talk
events.description: As the sky darkened, they lit a campfire, set up the grill, and roasted the marinated meat skewers and chicken wings until they sizzled. Yin Hao grilled a batch of his special chicken wings (an improved version of an air-fryer recipe) that won everyone's praise. The three of them sat around the fire, drinking beverages, and talked about their work frustrations, military memories, and future plans. Yin Hao mentioned the new house he was about to take delivery of and his plan to renovate it himself, and the other two gave him plenty of advice. A portable speaker played old songs, and the atmosphere was warm. At 10 p.m., they climbed into their sleeping bags and fell asleep to the gentle lapping of the lake.

start_state.mood: Excited, looking forward to nature.

end_state.location: Dianshan Lake Lakeside Campground
end_state.mood: Relaxed and fulfilled.

state.daily_exercise: Camping/hiking, fishing, and 15 minutes of core training.

2025-11.daily_overview: On the last day of camping, after packing up the campsite and returning, I tried a new air fryer dish. In the evening, I video-called my father to discuss the renovation plan. The pace of life was busy but fulfilling.

events.name: Morning chat at the campsite
events.description: At 7 a.m. on November 16, Yin Hao woke up in a tent at the campsite. After washing up briefly, he sat around with Gao Zhiyuan and Ma Xiaofeng enjoying a breakfast of bread and milk. The three chatted about future travel plans in the morning light. Gao Zhiyuan suggested going to Anji, Zhejiang next spring for a combined activity of drone aerial photography, fishing, and camping, and everyone agreed, deciding to settle the specific details later.

events.name: Pack up camp and return
events.description: At 10 a.m., the three began taking down the tent and canopy, cleaning up the site's trash, and packing all the gear. Yin Hao drove his car, first taking Gao Zhiyuan and then Ma Xiaofeng back to their respective homes in Songjiang District, before returning to his home on Guangfulin Road. After arriving, he carefully cleaned and stored the drone, tent, and other equipment, and copied the aerial footage to his computer for backup.

events.name: Weight Recording and Core Training
events.description: At 1 p.m., Yin Hao stood on the digital scale and recorded his weight at 71.5 kg. Then he spread out a yoga mat in the living room and did a 15-minute core workout, including planks, side bridges, and cat-cow stretches, to relieve muscle fatigue after camping.

events.name: Try making garlic eggplant in the air fryer
events.description: At 12:30 noon, Yin Hao used his newly purchased air fryer to try making a low-oil version of garlic eggplant. He mixed minced garlic, light soy sauce, and a little oil, spread it on the eggplant, and set it to 200°C for 15 minutes. The finished dish was golden in color. He sent the photo to his girlfriend Lin Yue, who praised his greatly improved cooking skills via a WeChat voice message. The two then had a video call for half an hour and agreed to research more healthy recipes together after reuniting next year.

events.name: Video call with my father to discuss the renovation
events.description: At 8 p.m., Yin Hao had a WeChat video chat with his father, Yin Jianguo, in his rented apartment. He showed his father photos of the new house's unfinished shell and his preliminary renovation ideas. Drawing on years of machinery maintenance experience, his father suggested that water and electrical lines should be routed through the ceiling rather than the floor, and reminded him to pay attention to the location of the kitchen exhaust duct. The father and son also agreed to buy some building materials together when they returned to their hometown for the Spring Festival. The call lasted half an hour.

events.name: Evening relaxation for body and mind
events.description: After the video ended, Yin Hao sorted out the renovation points his father mentioned in the video, then made a cup of hot tea, sat on the sofa listening to music for a while, and washed up and went to bed before 11 o'clock.

start_state.location: Inside the tent at the campsite
start_state.mood: Happy

end_state.location: Rented home
end_state.mood: Fulfilling and warm

state.daily_exercise: Pack up the campsite, do a short hike, and do 15 minutes of core training.

2025-11.daily_overview: Start of the workday: a technical training notice arrived in the morning, and in the afternoon he attended a lecture on five-axis machining and discussed applications with colleagues — a professional recharge day.

events.name: Morning core training and cycling commute
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Yin Hao got up, first weighed himself on an empty stomach at 71.3 kg, then did 15 minutes of core training in the living room (plank, dead bug), followed by a simple breakfast. At 7:30 he commuted on his mountain bike and arrived at the company in 15 minutes. He wore windproof gloves and a headband to cope with the temperature drop.

events.name: Reviewing training content during the lunch break
events.description: At 10 a.m., Yin Hao received a notice of the afternoon technical training via the company's internal communication group. During the lunch break, he took a notebook and pen to the workshop lounge and briefly reviewed the basic concepts of five-axis machining to prepare for the afternoon lecture.

events.name: Attend five-axis machining technology training
events.description: At 2 p.m., Yin Hao went to the company conference room to attend a training lecture on five-axis machining technology given by an external expert. The content covered high-speed cutting and new intelligent compensation technologies. He carefully noted key points and, during the Q&A session, asked the expert about precision problems encountered in actual operations and received detailed answers.

events.name: Dinner discussion with colleagues
events.description: After the training, Yin Hao returned to his workstation, organized the key new technical points into electronic notes, and archived them. During dinner, he sat with colleagues Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang in the cafeteria, shared their understanding with each other, and planned to try applying some of the new processes to existing projects later.

events.name: Evening free time, meditation, and stretching
events.description: After getting home from work, Yin Hao took a quick shower and turned on the stereo to listen to some light music for a while. Before bed, he used the Tide app for 10 minutes of meditation and stretching, then turned off the lights at 23:00.

start_state.mood: Peaceful

end_state.location: Rented home
end_state.mood: Fulfilling and slightly rewarding.

state.daily_exercise: Core training for 15 minutes, commute by bike

2025-11.daily_overview: After work, he focused on sprint preparation for the CNC competition, from theory to simulation and hands-on practice, not stopping until late at night.

events.name: Morning weigh-in and simplified core workout
events.description: Got up at 6:30 and weighed 71.1 kg. Because he had gone to bed late the night before, he shortened his core training to 10 minutes (plank + stretching). After breakfast, he drove to work at 7:20.

events.name: Daily work and pre-competition preparation
events.description: During the day, he operated the CNC machine as usual in the workshop and completed two batches of parts processing. During the lunch break, he took out the competition review materials and flipped through the fault diagnosis chapter, warming up for the evening study.

events.name: Return home to prepare for study.
events.description: After getting off work at 6 p.m. and returning home, Yin Hao quickly ate the takeout rice with toppings, then went to the desk in his study, took out his newly purchased gaming laptop, and plugged it in. Meanwhile, he took the CNC competition review materials 'CNC System Parameter Setting Manual' and 'Fault Diagnosis Case Analysis' from the bookshelf and organized his notebook and pens.

events.name: Review CNC system parameter settings.
events.description: At 7 p.m., Yin Hao concentrated on reviewing the CNC system parameter setting section of the competition's theoretical exam points. He read the materials page by page, focusing on memorizing common servo parameters, spindle parameters, and acceleration/deceleration time constant settings, and marked key data and precautions in red pen in his notebook.

events.name: Study fault diagnosis methods.
events.description: Next, he focused on reviewing CNC system fault diagnosis. By studying the textbook and past exam questions, he understood the meanings of common alarm codes, troubleshooting approaches, and methods for measuring signals with a multimeter. As he read, he drew diagnostic flowcharts on scratch paper to reinforce logical memory.

events.name: Simulation software hands-on practice
events.description: At 9 p.m., Yin Hao opened his gaming laptop, installed and launched the CNC simulation software, and applied the parameter settings and fault diagnosis theory he had just reviewed to simulated scenarios. He set the servo and spindle parameters of the simulated machine tool one by one, deliberately entered wrong values to observe system alarms, then performed troubleshooting based on the alarm information, continuing the combined virtual-and-real training until 11 p.m.

events.name: Wrapping up studying and a quick wash.
events.description: After the simulation training, Yin Hao reviewed his notes and sent questions he didn't understand to Master Sun Jianguo via WeChat for advice, then quickly washed up and went to bed at 24:00.

start_state.mood: Nervous but focused

end_state.location: Rented home
end_state.mood: Tired but fulfilled.

state.daily_exercise: 10 minutes of core training

2025-11.daily_overview: During the day, he organized the draft renovation plan and applied for leave. In the evening, he had an in-depth video call with his father about renovation details. The renovation blueprint gradually became clearer.

events.name: New low in morning body weight and core training
events.description: After getting up at 6:30, he weighed himself at 70.9 kg, a new recent low, and felt happy. He completed 15 minutes of core training seriously and deliberately did two extra sets of bicycle crunches. After breakfast, he drove to work at 7:30.

events.name: Daily work and leave application.
events.description: In the morning, he was busy in the workshop. Before the 11 a.m. lunch break, Yin Hao filled out a leave request form in advance and asked team leader Wang Lei for half a day of personal leave the next morning (the 20th), explaining that he needed to attend the preliminary round of the municipal CNC skills competition. Wang Lei approved and told him to do his best.

events.name: Draft key points of the renovation plan
events.description: During an afternoon break, Yin Hao organized the previously recorded measurement data of the new house into a document and, based on his own needs, initially drafted the key points of plans for plumbing and electrical renovation, wall treatment, and flooring, so as to communicate with his father in the evening.

events.name: Have a detailed video call with father about the renovation
events.description: At 7 p.m., Yin Hao had a two-hour video call via WeChat on his phone with his father Yin Jianguo, who was at home in Nantong, Jiangsu. Yin Hao showed the organized measurement data and draft plans, and the father and son discussed details such as water and electrical routing, selection of wall putty materials, and tiling and flooring installation. Drawing on his mechanical maintenance experience, his father gave several practical suggestions on pipe layout and waterproofing, and verbally promised to come to Shanghai at the end of the year to help with the construction.

events.name: Organizing advice and bedtime meditation
events.description: After the video ended, Yin Hao immediately organized the practical suggestions his father mentioned into a notes document, and marked the measurement data that needed to be re-confirmed. He then did pre-sleep meditation and stretching, and fell asleep at 23:10.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to it.

end_state.location: Rented home
end_state.mood: Full of gratitude and confidence

state.daily_exercise: 15 minutes of core training.

2025-11.daily_overview: A key day: in the morning he drove to take the theoretical exam for the preliminary round of the skills competition and did well; after the exam he returned to the company for work, set up automatic wealth management for his salary card, and in the evening helped his girlfriend Lin Yue with a mock interview.

events.name: Early rise to go to the exam
events.description: Woke up at 6:30 in the morning, washed up briefly, and did only 5 minutes of stretching without completing the full core training. Weighed 70.8 kg. Left home by car at 7:00, bought bread and mineral water at a convenience store on the way for breakfast. Arrived at the Vocational Skill Assessment Center at No. 600 Xinzhuan Road around 7:30.

events.name: Took the theory exam in the preliminary round of the skills competition
events.description: From 8:30 to 10:30 in the morning, Yin Hao took the preliminary theoretical exam of the Shanghai Workers' CNC Skills Competition at Examination Room 2 on the third floor of the Appraisal Center. The test covered five-axis machining technology, tool selection, coordinate system transformation, safety regulations, and programming theory. He answered calmly, finished 15 minutes early, and reviewed the exam paper. After the exam, the proctor announced that results would be published tomorrow morning.

events.name: Returning to work after the competition and reporting the situation
events.description: At 10:30 the exam ended. Yin Hao did not go straight home but drove back to the company, arrived at the workshop before 11:00, and reported back to Wang Lei with a brief summary of the exam. Afterwards he had a simple lunch in the cafeteria and worked as usual until 17:30.

events.name: Set up automatic wealth management on the salary card.
events.description: During his lunch break, Yin Hao logged into the ICBC App on his phone, went to the automatic transfer settings in the wealth management module, and set up an automatic monthly transfer of 3,000 yuan to the Tianlibao money market fund account on the day after his salary was credited. After completing identity verification, he confirmed it took effect.

events.name: Assisted Lin Yue with her third mock interview.
events.description: At 8 p.m., Lin Yue arranged a third mock Q&A session specifically for the types of questions she had performed poorly on last time. Yin Hao cooperated with her via video call, repeatedly practicing behavioral interview questions and imitating the interviewer's follow-up tone. Afterward, Yin Hao shared his experience dealing with stress in the military and at work, encouraging her to regard it as an opportunity to show herself. The call lasted about an hour, and Lin Yue's responses were noticeably smoother.

events.name: Rest and recovery.
events.description: After the mock interview, Yin Hao felt the day had been completely full. He did a simple stretch and fell asleep before 23:00.

start_state.mood: Slightly nervous

end_state.location: Rented home
end_state.mood: Excited and fulfilled

state.daily_exercise: Stretch for 5 minutes

2025-11.daily_overview: In the morning, he checked the results of the preliminary competition and successfully advanced, receiving congratulations from his master and colleagues; in the evening, he carefully prepared the PPT for the second presentation, fully preparing for the weekend campus presentation.

events.name: Check the preliminary round results and share them.
events.description: During the 10 a.m. work break, Yin Hao used his phone to log into the competition's official website and check his scores. He scored 86 on the theory exam, ranking in the top 20%, and successfully advanced to the finals. Excited, he took a screenshot and shared it to family and close friends' WeChat groups. He soon received congratulatory messages from his master Sun Jianguo and colleague Wang Lei.

events.name: Midday celebration and weight regain
events.description: At noon, colleagues held a celebration for Yin Hao. Wang Lei treated everyone to milk tea, and Liu Zhiqiang brought snacks. Yin Hao indulged a little and ate two cookies. In the afternoon he weighed 71.0 kg. Master Sun came over, patted him on the shoulder, and encouraged, "Not bad. You need to practice hard for the practical final."

events.name: Continue working in the workshop
events.description: In the afternoon, Yin Hao calmed down and continued with his daily parts processing. During the gaps between workpiece measurements, he silently planned the key points of practical training for the coming month in his mind.

events.name: Evening: carefully preparing the presentation PPT
events.description: After getting home from work, Yin Hao first completed 15 minutes of core training, then spent about 2 hours organizing and optimizing the PPT and script for the second presentation. Incorporating feedback from the first presentation, he focused on improving the content on machine tool operation safety regulations and digital transformation case studies, added several new interactive questions, and tested the laptop and presentation clicker in advance to make sure the equipment worked properly.

events.name: Simple late-night snack to unwind
events.description: After finishing preparations, Yin Hao felt a sense of relief. He heated up two soup dumplings in the air fryer as a late-night snack, watched short videos for a while, and went to bed at 23:00.

start_state.mood: Nervous

end_state.location: Rented home
end_state.mood: Gratified and motivated

state.daily_exercise: 15 minutes of core training.

2025-11.daily_overview: In the morning, I went to Minhang Vocational School for the second presentation on the spirit of craftsmanship and performed more naturally; in the afternoon, I measured the new house and planned the renovation; in the evening, I met my gaming friend Zhang Fei in person for the first time, and our friendship became real.

events.name: Early-morning weighing and core training
events.description: Got up at 7:00, weighed 70.7 kg on an empty stomach. After completing 15 minutes of core training and foam roller relaxation, had a simple breakfast.

events.name: Drove to the school for the presentation.
events.description: At 7:30 in the morning, Yin Hao drove his car from his home in Songjiang District to Minhang Vocational and Technical School. He drove along Xinzhuan Highway and the Humin Elevated Road, arriving at 8:10. He met the liaison teacher at the school gate and was guided to park inside the campus.

events.name: Gave a presentation on the spirit of craftsmanship
events.description: From 8:30 to 10:00, Yin Hao gave a presentation in the school auditorium to about 200 CNC major students and some teachers. He first introduced his military and professional experience, focused on machine tool operation safety regulations, shared the company's digital transformation cases, and showed typical problems he had solved at work. During the presentation, he spoke fluently with interactive Q&A, and the atmosphere was good.

events.name: Interactive Q&A and discussion
events.description: From 10:00 to 10:40, after the presentation ended, the interactive Q&A session began. The students asked questions enthusiastically, covering safety details, digitalization's impact, career paths, and more. Yin Hao answered them one by one based on his experience and shared learning resources and certification advice. Afterwards, Yin Hao had a brief exchange with school leaders in the Academic Affairs Office, accepted a thank-you letter, and left by car at 11:10, returning to his home in Songjiang around 11:50.

events.name: Write a summary log of the presentation
events.description: From 14:00 to 14:30 that afternoon, Yin Hao used his laptop at home to write the summary log for the second presentation, recording his progress in expression fluency and interaction skills, as well as several thought-provoking questions raised by students, and archived the presentation PPT and photos.

events.name: Accurate measurement of the new house.
events.description: At 3:00 PM, Yin Hao went to his newly purchased unfinished house in Songjiang District carrying a tape measure, notebook, and laser rangefinder. He carefully measured the wall dimensions, floor areas, and door/window positions of the living room, master bedroom, secondary bedroom, and kitchen, noted the floor height and beam/column locations in each room, and used the data to make a preliminary plan on paper for wall paint colors and floor-laying direction. He also took photos and marked the key areas for renovation.

events.name: Contacted gaming friend Zhang Fei
events.description: At 4:30 p.m., Yin Hao used WeChat to confirm the evening meeting arrangement with his gaming friend Zhang Fei, who was on a business trip to Shanghai. They chose a local Shanghainese restaurant in the old city area of Songjiang and agreed to meet at 6:30 p.m.

events.name: First in-person dinner gathering with Zhang Fei.
events.description: At 18:30 in the evening, Yin Hao arrived at the reserved restaurant on time to meet Zhang Fei. The two chatted about topics ranging from online games to their respective work and lives. Yin Hao ordered Shanghai-style braised pork and xiaolongbao, and the atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant.

events.name: Took Zhang Fei on a tour and used a drone for aerial photography
events.description: After dinner, Yin Hao brought Zhang Fei back to visit his rental apartment on Guangfulin Road, and then they used a drone in the open area of the residential complex to take an aerial photo together, documenting this cross-city friendship.

events.name: Farewell and photo sharing
events.description: At 21:00 in the evening, Yin Hao said goodbye to Zhang Fei at the entrance of the residential complex. Zhang Fei returned to the hotel, while Yin Hao went back inside and sent Zhang Fei the drone photos via WeChat, and they agreed to meet again in the future if they had the chance.

start_state.mood: Slightly nervous but confident

end_state.location: Rented home
end_state.mood: Satisfied and happy.

2025-11.daily_overview: Early in the morning, went to Dianshan Lake for winter fishing to learn fine float adjustment and enjoy the tranquility; in the afternoon, after returning, teamed up online with comrades to play games and strengthen their friendship.

Yin Hao operated carefully and finally tuned a float signal suitable for the day's water conditions.

events.name: A peaceful fishing experience
events.description: After adjusting the float, the two baited with red worms and started fishing in earnest. Yin Hao stayed quiet in the cold wind, focusing on the subtle movements of the float, occasionally lifting the rod to catch small crucian carp. Although he caught little in three hours, he enjoyed the peace away from the noise, and Brother Wu also shared winter fish teasing techniques.

events.name: Return and enjoy lamb noodles
events.description: After finishing fishing in the afternoon, the two drove away from the wild pond and headed straight to the Zhiqiang Auto Care Center that Wu Zhiqiang runs in Qingpu. Brother Wu personally cooked two large steaming bowls of mutton noodles. As they ate, they reviewed the day's fishing. Brother Wu encouraged Yin Hao to come and practice more in winter, and they agreed to have another session next week.

2025-06.daily_overview: The Dragon Boat Festival was also Yin Hao's 28th birthday. In the early morning, he went alone to the Suzhou Creek riverside to watch the dragon boat race and shared it remotely with his girlfriend Lin Yue. At noon, he picked up Lin Yue, who came to Shanghai to celebrate. In the afternoon, they flew a drone and strolled around Chenshan Botanical Garden. At dinner, Lin Yue prepared a small cake for a simple celebration. Afterwards, for the first time, they seriously discussed the future of their long-distance relationship; the atmosphere grew heavy under the pressure of social class. That day he also received news that his older brother had a son, and the two emotions were intertwined.

events.name: Received the news that my brother was blessed with a son
events.description: When he got up in the morning, Yin Hao saw a WeChat message from his older brother Yin Tao, saying that his sister-in-law had given birth to a son smoothly and that both mother and child were safe, and that red envelopes had already been sent in the family group. Yin Hao happily replied with congratulations and agreed to take Lin Yue to Suzhou to visit them on the weekend.

events.name: Went alone to Suzhou Creek riverside to watch the dragon boat race and shared it with Lin Yue.
events.description: After finishing breakfast, Yin Hao set out from his home on Guangfulin Road in Songjiang and took the subway to the Tian'an Thousand Trees section by the Suzhou Creek, the whole trip taking about an hour. He found a suitable spot by the river and watched the dragon boat race with full attention. He shot several short videos of the fierce paddling, drumbeats, and splashes, and took photos of the festive decorations on site. After the race, he bought a traditional fresh pork zongzi at a stall and ate it. He sent the videos to Lin Yue via WeChat with a vivid voice message describing the scene, and they agreed to watch it together next year. Then he took the subway back to Songjiang the same way.

events.description: At noon, Yin Hao drove to Hongqiao Station to pick up Lin Yue, who had come from Hangzhou. Lin Yue handed him a carefully chosen drone filter set as a birthday gift, and Yin Hao happily thanked her. The two drove back to Songjiang, catching up on recent news along the way.

events.description: In the afternoon, Yin Hao and Lin Yue went to Chenshan Botanical Garden. Using the newly acquired filter on a drone, they took aerial shots, capturing the beautiful sea of flowers and a photo of the two of them together, and spent two hours there. While resting, they shared snacks and drinks on a bench, enjoying a relaxed moment between lovers.

events.name: Birthday dinner and first serious discussion about the future
events.description: In the evening, the two had dinner at a local Shanghainese restaurant in Songjiang to celebrate. Lin Yue had prepared a small cake for Yin Hao, and they had a simple celebration at the restaurant. During the meal, Lin Yue was low-spirited and sighed, mentioning that her father had urged her to go on a blind date again. The two faced the future of their long-distance relationship seriously for the first time. Yin Hao was silent for a long time, feeling the pressure of class differences in economic conditions and family backgrounds. The atmosphere was heavy. The discussion lasted about an hour, and they finally decided to maintain the status quo for now, but both realized that the contradictions were surfacing.

In the evening he studied drafting in the National Open University livestream course. Before bed he tried meditation to relax, and his sleep improved slightly.

Yin Hao put on a waterproof windbreaker and jogged 3 km on the streets near the neighborhood, at a pace of about 6:40 per kilometer, maintaining his exercise habit. After the run, he went home, took a shower, and prepared a simple breakfast. Because of his fat-loss plan, he did not eat high-calorie breakfast foods.

While updating the development log, he felt a faint tightness in his lower back, but didn't pay attention to it.

events.name: Pre-bedtime relaxation and meditation attempt.

start_state.mood: The light rain brought coolness; I felt in good spirits, with slight discomfort in the lower back but ignored it.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home.

After the afternoon safety training, prolonged sitting worsened the soreness in his lower back. In the early evening, taking advantage of a pause in the rain, he did a fartlek run with Wang Lei. As they worked together, they gradually regained their tacit understanding, but due to lower back discomfort, he frequently changed his standing posture.

After it ended, the soreness in his lower back and waist worsened, so he used a mineral water bottle against his waist at his workstation to relieve it.

Yin Hao persisted to the end but felt obvious lower-back discomfort during the run. After training, Wang Lei pressed on his back muscles and advised him to reduce prolonged sitting.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home.

2025-09.daily_overview: Yin Hao and his girlfriend Lin Yue drove back to Rudong to attend the wedding of his childhood friend Zhang Wei, but in the festive atmosphere he had a serious disagreement with Lin Yue over marriage issues. The intertwining of family financial pressure and emotional conflict kept him awake all night.

events.name: Drove back to his hometown in Nantong with his girlfriend.
events.description: At 6:30 a.m., Yin Hao drove his family car, with his girlfriend Lin Yue, from his rented apartment on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, along the Shanghai-Xi'an Expressway via the Sutong Bridge back to his hometown in Rudong County, Nantong, Jiangsu. They stopped once at a service area along the way. The trip took about 2.5 hours, and they arrived at his parents' home in Juegang Town at 9 a.m.

events.name: Meet up with parents and go to the wedding venue together
events.description: After Yin Hao and Lin Yue met up with his parents Yin Jianguo and Wang Xiuying, he changed into the prepared groomsman suit. His mother reminded him of some wedding procedures and drinking precautions, and Lin Yue helped him adjust his outfit. Then the family drove to the village where his childhood friend Zhang Wei was.

events.name: Participate in the entire wedding as a groomsman and handle social obligations
events.description: From the morning bridal pickup to the afternoon wedding banquet, Yin Hao, as best man, kept the atmosphere lively throughout and helped Zhang Wei complete the bridal escort, ceremony, and toasting segments. At the midday wedding banquet, the bride's side gave a new car as dowry, and the atmosphere was exuberant. During the banquet, Yin Hao helped Zhang Wei greet guests and caught up with several old classmates, relatives, and friends.

events.name: Mother privately lamented financial pressure.
events.description: After the wedding luncheon, his mother Wang Xiuying pulled Yin Hao aside in private and, looking at the dowry car, sighed: "We can't give this much... what will you do when you get married in the future?" Her tone revealed her concern about her son's future marriage. Yin Hao remained silent with mixed feelings, but his strong-willed nature kept him from arguing; he just gently patted his mother's shoulder.

events.name: Serious talk with Lin Yue by the river in the evening about the terms of marriage
events.description: After the wedding ceremony ended in the evening, Yin Hao and Lin Yue avoided the crowd and walked along a small river outside the village. Lin Yue proactively brought up what her mother had said that afternoon and seriously stated her position that "we must have a house before getting married," explaining that she hoped for a stable living environment after marriage and did not want to live apart anymore. Yin Hao felt the pressure mounting and honestly said that with his current financial ability, it would be difficult to buy a house in Shanghai in the short term. The two failed to reach an agreement, the atmosphere was heavy, and Lin Yue's words carried disappointment.

events.name: Spent the night at parents' home, feeling low and struggling to fall asleep.
events.description: At night, after Yin Hao and Lin Yue returned to the wedding venue to say goodbye to Zhang Wei and his wife, they drove back to his parents' home in Juegang Town. After washing up, the two lay on the bed in the guest room, silently turning their backs to each other. Yin Hao repeatedly thought about Lin Yue's demands, his mother's words, and the huge shortfall in funds for buying a house. Feeling low, he tossed and turned and only fell into a dazed sleep in the early morning.

end_state.location: Guest room at parents' home in Rudong County, Nantong, Jiangsu

2025-09.daily_overview: Spent Sunday at his hometown in Rudong. In the early morning, Yin Hao cycled alone along the sea dike to clear his mind. In the morning, he helped his parents tidy up the courtyard. After lunch, his relationship with Lin Yue remained cold. In the afternoon, he drove back to Shanghai, and the two were silent the whole way.

events.name: An early morning bike ride along the seawall to clear his mind.
events.description: Yin Hao tossed and turned all night, got up at 5 a.m., changed into sportswear, and wheeled his father's old bicycle out of the house. He cycled along the sea wall near Juegang Town, Rudong County, basking in the early autumn morning light. The sea breeze blowing in his face slightly eased the gloom in his heart. He rode about 35 kilometers, passing Yangkou Fishing Port, where he stopped briefly to gaze into the distance and ponder the balance between buying a home and marriage in the future. He returned home two hours later.

events.name: Helped my father tidy up the courtyard at the family home in the morning
events.description: After returning from cycling, Yin Hao gave himself a quick wash, ate the breakfast his mother had made, and saw his father Yin Jianguo pruning the persimmon tree and repairing the courtyard wall in the yard. He went over to help. As they worked, father and son talked about the possible sale of the old house, but Yin Hao did not want to say much about the pressure of buying a home, so the topic shifted to new tasks at work.

events.name: After lunch, returned to Shanghai with Lin Yue, their relationship cold.
events.description: Lunch was the Nantong clams and braised pork belly carefully prepared by his mother, but Yin Hao and Lin Yue barely exchanged a word, and the atmosphere at the table was dull. After the meal was cleared away, at two in the afternoon, Yin Hao said goodbye to his parents, and his mother stuffed some hometown specialties into the car. He drove Lin Yue back to Shanghai. The trip took over two hours, and apart from the necessary navigation, the two hardly spoke, with the air of a cold war filling the car. After arriving in Songjiang, Yin Hao first took Lin Yue back to her place, then returned alone to his rented apartment.

2025-09.daily_overview: Yin Hao was severely criticized by his master for dozing off in the workshop after several consecutive late nights, so he adjusted his routine. During the lunch break, he squeezed in a short run. In the evening, after a video call with Lin Yue, the relationship eased, and they agreed to talk in person in detail at the end of the month.

events.name: Fragmented run during lunch break
events.description: At the start of the lunch break, Yin Hao changed into running shoes and jogged 3 kilometers on the tree-lined path near the company, taking about 18 minutes at a pace of 6:00. He tried to refresh himself with a short run to avoid getting drowsy in the afternoon again.

events.name: Dozed off in the workshop in the afternoon, was criticized by his master, and re-planned his work-rest schedule.
events.description: Because of staying up late for several days to prepare lessons and exams, Yin Hao dozed off leaning against the toolbox while waiting for the machine to change dies in the afternoon. Master Sun, passing by, noticed and sternly criticized him: “Are you kidding with safety? You don’t sleep at night and you’re groggy during the day—if something happens, who’s responsible?” Yin Hao’s face turned red and he sincerely admitted his mistake. With his master’s approval, he immediately drew a new schedule on the whiteboard, moving the nighttime hands-on practice earlier to immediately after work (17:30-20:00), ensuring he went to bed before 23:00. Only then did Master Sun’s expression soften.

events.name: In the evening, had a deep conversation with Lin Yue via video call.
events.description: At 8 p.m., Yin Hao adjusted his phone in the living room and, feeling uneasy, made a WeChat video call to Lin Yue. After they exchanged greetings, Yin Hao brought up the discussion that had ended badly last weekend. Lin Yue was silent for a moment, then confided that she was not materialistic, but hoped their marriage would have basic security, and she was also worried that Yin Hao was under too much pressure. Yin Hao candidly talked about his current difficulty in buying a house and the fact that he was preparing for a mortgage pre-approval. Nearly forty minutes of frank conversation visibly eased the tension.

events.name: Agreed to meet at the end of the month, and the situation began to ease.
events.description: As the call was drawing to a close, Yin Hao suggested meeting in person at a café in Shanghai on September 27 (Saturday) for a detailed discussion, and Lin Yue softly agreed. After hanging up the video call, Yin Hao let out a long sigh of relief, feeling that the relationship had stopped its downward trend. Although the fundamental problem remained unresolved, at least the communication channel had been reopened. He decided to prove himself through his actions.

start_state.mood: Felt a little guilty about staying up late and lacking self-discipline, and wanted to correct it in the new day.

end_state.location: On the bed in the rental room
end_state.mood: After being criticized, he thought deeply about it, but the reconciliation with Lin Yue was invaluable. His feelings found a balance between self-blame and relief, and he followed the new daily routine and went to bed early.

state.daily_exercise: Run 3 km during lunch break

date_attribute.weather: Back home, I opened the Dewu app on the living room sofa and directly bought the Xtep 160X 3.0 running shoes in size 44. I confirmed the delivery address was correct, paid 599 yuan with my China Merchants Bank card, and the order is expected to arrive the day after tomorrow.

2025-09.daily_overview: Yin Hao signed up for the weekend friendly tournament through the fishing buddies group and started organizing his fishing gear; in the evening he and Lin Yue exchanged a few daily photos, and their relationship gradually warmed up. events.name: Registered for the Fishing Association friendly tournament and organized the gear.
events.description: During his lunch break, Yin Hao browsed messages in the fishing buddies' group and found that the fish farm in Maogang Town, Songjiang, would hold a friendly competition on September 13. He signed up online without hesitation. After work, he went home on purpose, took out the surf rod, hand rod, and tackle box from the balcony storage cabinet, checked the rigs and floats, and replenished earthworms and commercial bait. He also casually put the tackle bag in the trunk of his car so he could set off early Saturday morning.

events.name: In the evening, had a relaxed interaction with Lin Yue to ease the relationship.
events.description: In the evening, while revising his presentation draft at home, Yin Hao received a photo from Lin Yue of her drinking coffee in the office. Yin Hao also photographed the messy drafts and electronic components on his desk, captioned it 'A desk in battle mode', and sent it to her. The two exchanged a few casual messages back and forth, the atmosphere relaxed and natural, as if last weekend's dark clouds were slowly dispersing.

events.name: Completed the main part of the training manual ahead of schedule.
events.description: Because he had adjusted his daily routine, Yin Hao finished his other tasks before 10 PM. Using the hour before bed, he completed the main chapters of the new machine tool training manual on the computer, leaving only the common faults section in the appendix to finish the next day. After checking for typos, he scheduled the email to be sent to Master Sun for review.

start_state.mood: After a night of relatively good sleep, his mental state recovered considerably.

end_state.location: On the bed in the rental room
end_state.mood: Signing up for the fishing competition brought a glimmer of anticipation to the recent high-pressure life, and breaking the ice with Lin Yue also brightened my mood.

2025-09.daily_overview: A busy but fulfilling day: an 8-kilometer morning run and chatting with running friends; during the lunch break, went to the bank to consult about loan pre-approval and told Lin Yue the initial results; in the evening, broke through the practical technical bottleneck.

events.name: In the early morning, he arranged to go for a run with his running partner Chen Jie and talked with him.
events.description: Woke up at 5:30 in the morning. Yin Hao changed into his gear and left at 6:10 to meet fellow runner Chen Jie at Songjiang Sports Center. After warming up together, they jogged 8 kilometers along a route around the Guangfulin Cultural Heritage Site, at a pace of about 5 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer. Chen Jie noticed that Yin Hao's running had been irregular in recent weeks and asked with concern. Yin Hao explained that exam preparation and training pressure had taken up a lot of his time, but promised he would not give up running. Chen Jie encouraged him to adjust his pace and shared stress-relief tips from his experience as a fitness coach. After the run, the two went to a nearby breakfast shop for soy milk and fried dough sticks, and talked for 40 minutes. Yin Hao felt the warmth of his running buddy.

events.name: Prepare and go to the bank to consult about housing loan pre-approval
events.description: Before 9:30, Yin Hao returned to the company. In the morning, he organized his payroll records, personal credit report, ID copy, and other materials in the rest area and put them into a document folder. At 12:00 noon, he took a short leave in advance and drove to the XX Bank Personal Loan Center in Songjiang District, about a 15-minute drive.

events.name: Met with the bank account manager and learned the preliminary credit limit.
events.description: At the bank, Yin Hao met with client manager Li Qiang. After submitting the documents, he asked about the pre-approval process for a second-hand home loan. Manager Li assessed the situation and told him the preliminary loan amount was about 1 million yuan, and listed in detail the materials needed to supplement, such as income proof and a statement of the source of the down payment. Yin Hao took careful notes and asked about the details of the combined loan interest rates.

events.name: Share the loan progress with Lin Yue in real time
events.description: After leaving the bank, Yin Hao took a photo of the supplementary materials list with his phone and sent it to Lin Yue via WeChat with the message: 'Today I went to the bank for a pre-approval consultation. These are the materials that need to be supplemented; I'll take care of it promptly. Don't worry.' (Forwarded from internal thinking.) Lin Yue saw it and replied with an encouraging emoji. Though brief, it conveyed trust.

events.name: Returned to work promptly in the afternoon and overcame practical technical difficulties.
events.description: Yin Hao rushed back to the company before 1 o'clock to continue working. In the afternoon, during a break in production, he compared Teacher Liu Jianjun's courseware and repeatedly debugged a loop jump logic in a CNC macro program on the simulation software, finally eliminating the simulation alarm. He screenshotted the problem-solving process and sent it to Teacher Liu, who praised his progress.

events.name: In the evening, alone in the workshop, verified the improved program.
events.description: After work, Yin Hao changed into his work clothes and ran the new macro program he had written on an idle old machine tool in the workshop, producing a test piece. The measured dimensions were completely within tolerance. He carefully stored the test piece, planning to show it to Master Sun the next day.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to the morning run, but feeling a bit anxious about the loan consultation.

end_state.location: On the bed in the rental room
end_state.mood: The morning run energized his body, the loan pre-approval brought substantial progress on buying a house, and the technical breakthrough further boosted his professional confidence. It was a rare day in recent days where efficiency and fulfillment coexisted.

state.daily_exercise: Morning run 8 km

2025-09.daily_overview: Yin Hao joined the fishing association's friendly tournament and learned a new fishing technique. In the evening he recorded his reflections, and at night he had a brief call with Lin Yue, finding a balance between his hobby and his relationship.

events.name: Drove in the early morning to attend the Maogang fishing friendly tournament
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Yin Hao took his fishing gear bag and lunch box, and drove along Shenzhuan Highway to the fish farm in Maogang Town, 30 kilometers away. After arriving at 7:15, he signed in, received his numbered tag, exchanged greetings with his fishing buddy Wu Zhiqiang and other participants who had already arrived, and learned the competition rules.

events.name: Spent the whole day participating in a competition, learning raft fishing, and making new fishing friends.
events.description: The competition started at 8:00. Yin Hao mainly fished the bottom with a hand rod, but the fish were not active in the morning. He noticed that raft fishing with earthworms in the deep water worked better, so in the afternoon he switched to a rock rod, adjusted the rigging, and tried raft fishing, successfully catching several yellow catfish. During breaks, he humbly asked a few veteran anglers about the lift-and-tease techniques and bait condition for raft fishing. Although he did not win a place, he gained new fishing methods and friendship. The competition ended at 3 PM, and he and Wu Zhiqiang and others agreed to compete again next time.

events.name: After returning home, recorded fishing insights and relieved stress.
events.description: At 4 p.m., Yin Hao returned to his residence in Songjiang, released the few small yellow catfish back into the water, then took a shower. After dinner, he opened his computer in the study and recorded in detail in his fishing memo today's competition experience, key points of yellow catfish fishing, bait recipes learned from exchanges, and the water conditions of the fishing ground. He felt his nerves, tense for days, relax by the clear water, and his stress eased as he lifted the fish basket.

events.name: In the evening, talked with Lin Yue on the phone and shared weekend life.
events.description: At 9 p.m., Yin Hao took the initiative to make a video call to Lin Yue, showing her photos of the catch and telling her amusing stories from the competition. Lin Yue smiled and said he had finally found a way to relax, and mentioned that she had been sorting out her moving checklist over the past two days. The two chatted briefly about meeting at the end of the month, said goodnight before the call ended, and the atmosphere was warm.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to the long-awaited relaxing fishing trip

end_state.location: On the bed in the rental room
end_state.mood: Relieved stress through hobbies, relationship with Lin Yue continues to improve, mindset positive and stable

start_state.mood: He was looking forward to the homeowners' committee proposal and his mother's birthday, but lack of sleep made him somewhat weary.
