2025-09.daily_overview: On Sunday, Yin Hao went to the repair shop to help out and repaired an old stereo, feeling a mix of accomplishment and career confusion. In the evening, he jogged 3 kilometers to clear his thoughts. At night, he reflected on his future plans, which led to insomnia late into the night.

events.name: Went to Jianguo Appliance Repair Shop to help out
events.description: At 9:00 a.m., Yin Hao set off from his home on Guangfulin Road and walked about 20 minutes to the Jianguo Electrical Appliance Repair Shop on Rongle Middle Road, Songjiang District, ready to help Master Chen Jianguo handle appliances brought in by customers.

events.name: Buy an old stereo at a low price and fix it up yourself.
events.description: At the repair shop, a regular customer, Mr. Wang, wanted to sell a faulty old stereo. Chen Jianguo saw its repair value and guided Yin Hao to buy it at a low price. Under Chen Jianguo's on-site guidance, Yin Hao replaced the capacitors and re-soldered the wiring, successfully restoring the stereo to working condition, and planned to take it back for his own use. Chen Jianguo praised him for being 'quick on the uptake,' and Yin Hao felt quite proud.

events.name: Evening jog, 3 kilometers.
events.description: After returning home at 16:30, Yin Hao changed into sports clothes and jogged 3 kilometers along the roads around the neighborhood, at a pace of about 6:00. While running, the scene at the repair shop during the day kept circling in his mind as he tried to sort out his confusion about career development.

events.name: Carry the repaired audio equipment home and reflect on the future
events.description: Lying in bed at night, Yin Hao repeatedly thought back on the day's experiences and felt hesitant about the career path of staying at a repair shop like Chen Jianguo. He asked himself, ‘Will I end up keeping a small shop like Uncle Chen in the future?’ Feeling somewhat confused about his future development, he did not fall asleep until the early morning.

start_state.mood: Energy restored, looking forward to helping out

end_state.location: Rented home
end_state.mood: Feeling lost, but thoughts somewhat clearer after exercise

state.daily_exercise: Evening jog of 3 kilometers (pace 6:00).

2025-09.daily_overview: On Monday, a workday, Yin Hao picked up the repaired speakers and learned in the evening that his mother had been diagnosed with mild hypertension. Feeling heavy-hearted, he sorted out his thoughts through music and his first attempt at meditation.

events.name: Picked up the repaired old sound system
events.description: At 16:30 in the afternoon, Yin Hao took time to go to Jianguo Electrical Appliance Repair Shop, picked up the old audio system he had bought cheaply and had been fully repaired, briefly exchanged repair insights with Master Chen, and then brought the audio system back to his rented apartment.

events.name: Received a call from father and learned the results of mother's physical exam
events.description: At 19:30 in the evening, Yin Hao, who was reviewing his studies, received a call from his father Yin Jianguo and was told about his mother Wang Xiuying's physical examination results that day—mild hypertension (140/90). The doctor had prescribed antihypertensive medication and recommended a low-salt diet and daily blood pressure monitoring. His mother had already started taking the medication. Feeling heavy-hearted, Yin Hao urged his father to supervise his mother's medication schedule and dietary adjustments, and said he would follow up by phone every day. The call lasted nearly 20 minutes.

events.name: Connect the speaker, play music, and try meditating.
events.description: After the call ended, Yin Hao connected the repaired old speakers to his phone and placed them by the small desk. From 20:00 to 21:00, he played classic old songs to relax. From 21:00 to 21:10, he tried a 10-minute breathing exercise using a meditation audio on his phone for the first time. Although his thoughts occasionally drifted, he felt much calmer afterward.

start_state.mood: Slightly looking forward.

end_state.location: Rented home
end_state.mood: Worried, but meditation and music brought calm.

state.daily_exercise: None, 10 minutes of evening meditation

2025-09.daily_overview: On Tuesday, Yin Hao felt the autumn chill in the workshop. After work, he video-called his mother to confirm her medication. In the evening, he focused on reviewing, and before bed he relaxed with a mobile game. Because of the weather and exam preparation, he did no dedicated exercise today.

events.name: Wrapping up work and training in the autumn chill.
events.description: In the morning, Yin Hao wore a long-sleeved work uniform in the workshop. As it turned cooler with light rain, he paid extra attention to the parameters when debugging the new machine tool. During the lunch break, instead of arranging training, he stayed alone in the break room doing practice questions to prepare for the exam, and did 5 minutes of stretching during the break.

events.name: Video-called mother after work to remind her to take care of her health
events.description: At 18:30 after work, Yin Hao had a WeChat video call with his mother, Wang Xiuying, and asked about her blood pressure and medication. His mother said her morning self-measured blood pressure was 135/88, and that she had taken her medication on time and reduced salt intake. Yin Hao felt somewhat reassured and urged her to buy an electronic blood pressure monitor and record readings daily.

events.name: Evening systematic review of practical key points
events.description: After dinner, Yin Hao reviewed the troubleshooting procedures for the practical exam for the technician certificate at his desk. Combining Master Sun's guidance from last week, he organized memory cards and studied until 22:00.

events.name: Relaxing with a light mobile game before bed
events.description: After 22:00, Yin Hao logged into Honor of Kings and played two matchmaking matches with his game friend Zhang Fei, ending around 22:30. Afterward, he washed up and went to sleep as a way to relax.

start_state.mood: Stable, but worried about his mother

end_state.location: Rented home
end_state.mood: Slightly relaxed.

state.daily_exercise: Stretch for 5 minutes during a work break

2025-09.daily_overview: On Wednesday, Yin Hao resumed his morning run and did core training, feeling a long-lost vitality. During his lunch break he handled property management matters. In the evening he worked steadily, then ended the day gaming with his comrades-in-arms. Self-discipline brought satisfaction.

events.name: Morning run of 4 kilometers and core training
events.description: After getting up at 6:15 in the morning, Yin Hao went for a 4 km morning run at a pace of 5:55, which was noticeably easier than previous runs. After the run, he did 15 minutes of core training at home (three 1-minute planks and two sets of crunches), and stretched carefully.

events.name: Received property management feedback and discussed it during lunch break.
events.description: At noon, Yin Hao received a call from Zhao, the property manager, who told him that the installation site for the fitness equipment had been surveyed and the quotation was basically consistent with the plan from the beginning of the month, and that he needed Yin Hao to confirm it on behalf of the owners' committee. Yin Hao used his lunch break to go to the property office, looked over the project details, gave preliminary approval but asked for an anti-slip floor to be added, and agreed to sign the agreement next week.

events.name: Evening mock operation for technician exam preparation
events.description: From 19:00 to 22:00 in the evening, Yin Hao simulated the technician practical exam environment in his rental apartment using scrap circuit boards and tools, practicing circuit diagnosis and replacement, and recorded the entire process for review.

events.name: Playing online games with fellow soldiers to relieve stress.
events.description: After review ended at 22:00, Yin Hao and his comrades Zhang Jianguo and Zhou Xiaofeng agreed in the 'Iron Triangle' WeChat group to get online and play Honor of Kings. The three formed a team and played three ranked matches, chatting about their recent lives via voice in a relaxed atmosphere. The game ended at 23:00.

start_state.mood: Decided to resume exercise, feeling motivated.

end_state.location: Rented home
end_state.mood: Self-discipline brings a sense of achievement, and comrades' care brings warmth.

state.daily_exercise: Morning run of 4 km (pace 5:55), 15 minutes of core training

2025-09.daily_overview: On Thursday, Yin Hao was reviewing exam key points during his lunch break, but unfortunately strained his lower back while carrying a workpiece. However, he agreed with his running buddies to arrange a morning run next week depending on his recovery. In the evening, he endured the discomfort, persisted with reviewing, and went to bed early.

events.name: Lunch break training for reviewing key exam points
events.description: During the lunch break, Yin Hao gave his colleagues who were preparing for the technician theory exam a half-hour review of the key points, explained commonly missed questions and review strategies, and helped them organize the knowledge framework.

events.name: Suffered a right lumbar muscle strain while carrying heavy objects.
events.description: Around 2:00 p.m., while Yin Hao was helping a colleague move new machine tool accessories, he suddenly felt a sharp pain in his right lower back because the accessories were too heavy and he squatted in an improper posture. Wang Lei helped him to the break room and applied an ice pack. The workshop director allowed him to leave work early to recover.

events.name: Agreed with running friends to arrange another morning run depending on the situation.
events.description: Lying on the bed in his rented apartment at night, Yin Hao endured lower back pain while chatting with his running buddy Chen Jie on WeChat. Chen Jie asked how he was recovering. He took a photo of the ice pack and replied, 'Today I strained my back moving a workpiece, so I probably can't run on Sunday.' Chen Jie suggested that he rest fully and then arrange a run depending on his recovery. The two decided to set a specific date next week based on how well Yin Hao's back injury recovered.

events.name: Evening study for exam (adjusting posture)
events.description: Yin Hao moved his exam prep materials to the bedside and, lying on his side, used his phone to review incorrect questions and watch Teacher Liu Jianjun's practical operation explanation videos, persisting for one hour of review. Before going to bed, he applied an analgesic patch.

start_state.mood: Feeling stressed from exam preparation and a bit tired.

end_state.location: Rented home
end_state.mood: Worried about the pain, but determined to set the running plan according to how recovery goes.

state.daily_exercise: None (back injury)

2025-09.daily_overview: On Friday, a workday, Yin Hao still felt discomfort in his lower back, but he used his lunch break to finish the Q&A session, tried swimming after work to relax, studied moderately in the evening, and prepared for the weekend volunteer service.

events.name: Lunch break Q&A and end of the training cycle
events.description: During the lunch break, Yin Hao gave one-on-one Q&A to the newcomers who had questions from the previous training, and told them to focus mainly on self-study from then on. With this, his work as an internal training instructor for over two weeks largely concluded.

events.name: Went swimming after work to relax the lower back.
events.description: At 17:30 in the afternoon, Yin Hao drove to Songjiang Swimming Pool. After soaking in hot water for 10 minutes, he swam breaststroke slowly for 30 minutes, using the water's buoyancy to relieve lower back muscle tension. After swimming, his lower back felt more comfortable.

events.name: In the evening, lightly organize exam-prep notes
events.description: After dinner, Yin Hao did not do intensive review. Instead, he reorganized the practical mistake notebook accumulated over the week, marked priorities, and studied until 21:30, leaving enough energy for the next day's volunteer service.

events.name: Prepare maintenance tools and materials for the nursing home
events.description: Before going to bed, Yin Hao put the prepared first-aid instruction materials (cards on fall handling steps and CPR key points) into his backpack, and checked repair tools such as screwdrivers and a multimeter to ensure they were all there, making material preparations for the next day's service at the nursing home. He also checked the lumbar patch again.

start_state.mood: Lower back is improving, but still needs caution.

end_state.location: Rented home
end_state.mood: Looking forward to volunteer service, feeling relaxed in body and mind.

state.daily_exercise: Swimming for 30 minutes (slow breaststroke, rehabilitative).

2025-09.daily_overview: On Saturday, Yin Hao applied a medicated patch and, despite his injury, volunteered at the nursing home: repairing electrical appliances, teaching first aid, and accompanying the elderly. He also joined the Mid-Autumn Festival gathering. Serving others also healed himself. In the early morning he did light core training. After the volunteer service ended in the afternoon, he met Lin Yue and had an in-depth conversation about buying a home and future plans; their relationship warmed up again.

events.name: Morning core training and meditation.
events.description: After getting up at 6:30 in the morning, Yin Hao did 15 minutes of light core training (2 sets of crunches, 10 bird-dog reps on each side, avoiding direct pressure on the lower back) and 10 minutes of meditation and stretching to warm up for the day's activities.

events.name: Met up with colleague Wang Lei and headed to the nursing home.
events.description: At 9:00 a.m., Yin Hao drove from his home in Songjiang. On the way, he received a call from colleague Wang Lei confirming they would meet at the entrance of the nursing home. He stopped by a fruit shop to buy bananas and apples as gifts. At 9:30, he arrived at the Songjiang District Nursing Home and met up with Wang Lei and about 10 other volunteers who were waiting.

events.name: Repair small appliances for the elderly
events.description: Under the guidance of the staff, Yin Hao first repaired damaged small appliances for elderly people with limited mobility. He checked a fan that wouldn't spin and two desk lamps that wouldn't light. Using his own multimeter, screwdriver, and other tools, he replaced the fan's start capacitor and the lamp bulbs, and fixed a loose wire connection in one lamp. It took about half an hour in total, and the elderly people repeatedly thanked him. Wang Lei took the initiative to help when moving heavier items.

events.name: Use old parts to explain first aid knowledge.
events.description: After the repair was completed, Yin Hao used the replaced old parts as teaching aids. In the activity room, he explained to the elderly residents and caregivers seated around him the emergency response for falls (do not help the person up immediately; first check consciousness and injuries), and demonstrated the hand placement, depth, and frequency of chest compressions for CPR. He invited the caregivers to practice on site and corrected their movements hand by hand. Participation was very high.

events.name: Clean the room and keep the elderly company
events.description: At 11 a.m., Yin Hao and another group of volunteers cleaned rooms and made beds for the elderly on the third floor, and chatted with several seniors while listening to stories from their youth. He noted down the TV signal issue the seniors reported and promised to come back later for repairs.

events.name: Had lunch with the elderly and set up the venue for the get-together
events.description: At 12:00 noon, volunteers and the elderly had lunch together in the cafeteria. After the meal, Yin Hao and Wang Lei helped the nursing home staff set up the venue for the afternoon Mid-Autumn Festival party, hanging lanterns and banners and adjusting the audio equipment.

events.name: Mid-Autumn Festival party: military song performance and first aid demonstration.
events.description: At 13:30, the Mid-Autumn Festival party began. Yin Hao was in charge of audio playback and also went on stage impromptu to sing a military song, 'Strong Army Battle Song,' which won thunderous applause. During the break, he again demonstrated CPR and fall-handling procedures to the elderly and caregivers present as reinforcement publicity.

events.name: Cleaned up the site and returned
events.description: After the get-together ended, Yin Hao and the volunteers cleaned up the venue and cleared away the trash, and took a group photo with the nursing home staff and the elderly. At 4 p.m., he drove back to Songjiang city area with Wang Lei, exchanging their thoughts about volunteer service on the way and agreeing to participate in more such public welfare activities in the future.

events.name: Meet Lin Yue at a cafe in the evening for a detailed discussion
events.description: After returning from the nursing home at 16:00, Yin Hao went back to his place, quickly washed up and changed, and at 17:45 went to 'Border Town Coffee' near Songjiang University Town to meet Lin Yue. After ordering coffee, the two had an in-depth conversation for about two hours covering the home-buying plan, financial support from the sale of the old house, and Lin Yue's willingness to transfer for work. Yin Hao explained in detail the loan amount approved by the bank's pre-review on September 12, the 150,000 yuan down payment support promised by his parents on September 15, and the 1.35 million to 1.45 million yuan listings he was browsing. Lin Yue also honestly shared her specific expectations for married life. The two reached a consensus of 'look at houses first, then set goals' and agreed to visit houses together after the National Day holiday. The atmosphere gradually shifted from cautious to relaxed, and the relationship was substantively repaired.

start_state.mood: Energetic and enthusiastic service

end_state.location: Rented home
end_state.mood: Volunteer service enriched his heart, and the in-depth communication with Lin Yue resolved his emotional knot. The warming relationship brought renewed hope, but he still had a clear awareness of the pressure of buying a home.

state.daily_exercise: Morning core training 15 minutes, meditation and stretching 10 minutes; volunteer work was physically demanding.

2025-09.daily_overview: Early Sunday morning, Yin Hao and his running buddy Chen Jie resumed a 6 km morning run at the Guangfulin Cultural Heritage Site. The long-missed exercise invigorated him, and they agreed to restart formal training, but the slight discomfort in his lower back reminded him that he was not fully recovered. After returning home, he caught up on sleep and did rehabilitation exercises. The previous night, after confirming his back had improved, he contacted Chen Jie to arrange the morning run.

events.name: Contacted Chen Jie after confirming the lower back had improved the previous night
events.description: On the evening of September 27, Yin Hao found that his lower back pain had significantly eased and his mobility had recovered, so he contacted Chen Jie via WeChat to ask if he was free for a morning run together the next day. Chen Jie happened to be free, and they agreed to run 6 kilometers at Guangfulin Ruins at 6:00 on September 28.

events.name: Woke up, drove to meet for a morning run.
events.description: At 5:40 in the morning, Yin Hao got up, washed up briefly, changed into running gear, drove to the Guangfulin Cultural Relics Park, and met his running partner Chen Jie at the agreed spot at 5:55.

events.name: 6 km recovery morning run
events.description: At exactly 6:00, the two started their morning run along the park trail. Because his back injury had not fully healed, Yin Hao was somewhat conservative, but relying on willpower he maintained a 5:40 pace and completed 6 km. After the run, he was drenched in sweat and refreshed. During the run, he occasionally felt a pulling sensation in his lower back, but he adjusted his posture and completed it smoothly.

events.name: Stretching, communicating, and agreeing to practice together.
events.description: After the morning run, Yin Hao and Chen Jie did leg stretches in the rest area near the ruins and chatted about their recent lives. The two agreed to train together at least twice a week starting in October and restart systematic training toward the half-marathon goal. Chen Jie noticed him rubbing his lower back after the run and advised him to rest fully.

events.name: Rehabilitation training and rest after returning home.
events.description: Returned home around 7:30. Yin Hao took a shower, changed his medicated patch, did 15 minutes of low-intensity core training (cat-cow, dead bug, etc.) and meditation stretching, then ate a nutritious breakfast. He caught up on sleep for 2 hours in the morning, browsed his notes in the afternoon, organized next week's plan in the evening, and turned off the lights at 22:45.

start_state.mood: Excited and expectant

end_state.location: Rented home
end_state.mood: Energy is back, but the waist still needs care

state.daily_exercise: Morning run of 6 km (pace 5:40), 15 minutes of core training, 10 minutes of meditation and stretching

2025-09.daily_overview: On a Monday workday, Yin Hao went to work as usual, discussed his intention to apply for the position during the lunch break, continued preparing for the exam in the evening, and kept an eye on his mother's blood pressure records. Morning core training and evening meditation had become fixed routines, and a sense of order returned to his life.

events.name: Morning core workout and diet tracking
events.description: Got up at 6:20, did 15 minutes of core training (plank variations, side bridges, etc.), and weighed in and recorded it in the app. After breakfast, prepared a chicken breast and broccoli lunchbox and photographed and uploaded it to the diet app.

events.name: During the lunch break, I discussed the team leader competition with Master Sun.
events.description: During the lunch break, Yin Hao took the initiative to ask his mentor Sun Jianguo for advice about his intention to compete for the team leader position mentioned last month. Master Sun suggested he organize past project cases and training results, write a competition report, and encouraged him to formally submit it before the end of the year.

events.name: Browsed house-buying information during work breaks
events.description: During the afternoon break, Yin Hao browsed small-unit listings in the old town of Songjiang District on his phone. He added two houses priced between 1,350,000 and 1,450,000 yuan to his favorites, planning to contact an agent to view them after the National Day holiday.

events.name: Evening exam preparation and following up on mother's health
events.description: In the evening, after reviewing practical operations for the technician certificate for an hour and a half, Yin Hao called his mother Wang Xiuying at 21:00 for 5 minutes, confirmed today's blood pressure reading (130/85) and medication status, and urged his father to supervise a low-salt diet. After the call, he continued studying until 22:00.

events.name: Meditation and relaxing music before bed
events.description: 22:30-22:45, Yin Hao used the Tide app for a 15-minute meditation and stretching session (white noise environment), then turned on the repaired speaker and listened to light music for 10 minutes, and went to bed at 23:00.

start_state.mood: Self-discipline, career planning gradually becoming clearer

end_state.location: Rented home
end_state.mood: Career direction is clear, and healthy habits are gradually being consolidated

state.daily_exercise: 15 minutes of core training in the morning and 15 minutes of meditation and stretching in the evening.

2025-09.daily_overview: On the last day of September, Yin Hao attended a public memorial ceremony at the Martyrs' Cemetery in the morning to remember the martyrs, handled the vehicle annual inspection appointment at noon, rested and reviewed the bento plan in the afternoon, and packed his luggage in the evening to prepare for the National Day trip to Moganshan. He was in good shape all day; the morning core workout and meditation reinforced his healthy routine.

events.name: Received a vehicle inspection reminder text message
events.description: Around 8 a.m., Yin Hao received a text message reminder at home from the traffic management department, telling him that his Buick Excelle sedan would soon be six years old and needed to complete the annual inspection at a testing station before the end of October 2025. After reading it, he decided to book an appointment immediately.

events.name: Online booking for vehicle annual inspection
events.description: After receiving the text message, Yin Hao opened the Traffic Management 12123 app, logged into his personal account, and selected "Online Annual Inspection Appointment" under "Motor Vehicle Services." Following the system prompts, he chose the Yongfeng Motor Vehicle Inspection Station in Songjiang District, Shanghai, picked a morning inspection slot on October 14, 2025 (09:00-10:00), confirmed, and successfully submitted the appointment.

events.name: Organized the materials needed for the annual inspection.
events.description: After the appointment was made successfully, Yin Hao took out the motor vehicle license, electronic compulsory traffic insurance policy, vehicle owner's ID card, and last annual inspection qualification sticker from the file organizer, put them into a dedicated folder, and set them aside for use on October 14.

events.name: Morning core training and meditation.
events.description: After waking up at 6:30, Yin Hao did 15 minutes of core training in the living room (focusing on stability exercises such as quadruped and glute bridge) and 15 minutes of meditation and stretching, using white noise from the Tide app. After training, he weighed himself and recorded 72.8 kg.

events.name: Go to the Martyrs' Cemetery to attend the public memorial event.
events.description: At 9:00 a.m., Yin Hao put on a white flower and drove to the Martyrs’ Cemetery in Songjiang District. He gathered with other representatives of retired veterans and staff from the Veterans Affairs Bureau, and lined up to attend the public memorial ceremony. After the national anthem was played and a moment of silence was observed, he and the representatives jointly presented flower baskets to the martyrs’ monument and reaffirmed their enlistment oath. Afterwards, he wrote in the guestbook, “Retired but never fade, build new achievements in your post.” The event was solemn and dignified, evoking his military memories and sense of professional honor.

events.name: Returned home after the public memorial ceremony.
events.description: The public memorial ceremony ended at 11:30 a.m. Yin Hao said goodbye to his companions and drove back alone to his home on Guangfulin Road. Along the way, he savored the spiritual motivation brought by the event, which injected energy into his upcoming work.

events.name: Afternoon rest and review of the bento plan.
events.description: After going home at noon, Yin Hao had a simple lunch and then took a nap until 14:00. In the afternoon, at the dining table, he used his laptop to review the two-week homemade bento plan, compared his physical sensations and weight (down from 73.0 to 72.8 kg), analyzed data from the diet-tracking app, and confirmed that his morning drowsiness had significantly improved. He decided to maintain the bento habit over the long term and planned to change the main dish once a week to keep things fresh.

events.name: Organize exam preparation materials and relax.
events.description: In the afternoon from 15:00 to 17:00, Yin Hao sorted and archived his recent practical exam error notebook and key notes for the technician certificate, then relaxed by listening to music and browsing his phone, preparing to pack his luggage in the evening.

events.name: Pack luggage for the Moganshan trip.
events.description: After dinner at 19:00, Yin Hao started packing. He put the camping gear, drone, change of clothes, and the gift prepared for his girlfriend Lin Yue into the backpack one by one, and checked the car's condition and fuel level, confirming that he could depart smoothly from Shanghai for Mogan Mountain with his girlfriend on the morning of October 1. After finishing packing, he went to bed at 23:45.

start_state.mood: Solemn and awe-inspiring, with a heart full of reverence.

end_state.location: Rented home
end_state.mood: Fulfilled and satisfied, looking forward to the trip.

state.daily_exercise: 15 minutes of morning core training, 15 minutes of meditation and stretching.

date_attribute.weather: Partly cloudy, 23°C to 28°C, southeast wind force 2

2025-10.daily_overview: On the first day of the National Day holiday, Yin Hao experienced a major turning point in his rented apartment. In the morning, he received 600,000 yuan from his father as a down payment for buying a home, along with a voice message, and felt a mix of emotions. The strain in his lower back still ached faintly. After weighing himself in the early morning, he recorded 72.8 kg. His emotions fluctuated throughout the day. He shared the news with his girlfriend but felt a distance between them. While video-calling his mother, he struggled to hold back tears. Late at night, he tossed and turned, repeatedly recalling the hard work his parents had put into selling their house over the past few months. Thinking of his mother's dizziness after the old house was sold in September, he felt a pang of sadness and finally resolved to work even harder.

events.name: Morning weigh-in and light stretching
events.description: After waking up at 6:50 in the morning, Yin Hao weighed himself on an empty stomach as usual, weighing 72.8 kg. He gently moved his right waist in front of the mirror, felt a lingering pulling pain at the strain, so he did a few minutes of gentle lateral stretching and avoided strenuous movements.

events.name: Father transferred money and left voice-message instructions.
events.description: In the morning, Yin Hao's father, Yin Jianguo, at his hometown in Rudong County, Nantong, Jiangsu, transferred the 600,000 yuan down payment from the sale of the family's old house to Yin Hao's bank account through a bank counter. This money was the full proceeds after the decision to sell the house in July, finding a buyer in August, and the final closing in September. After the transfer, Yin Jianguo recorded a WeChat voice message and sent it to Yin Hao: 'Haohao, this is all the money the family can come up with. Your mother and I have rented a small apartment, so don't worry.' The voice carried both relief and reluctance, expressing unconditional support for his son's house purchase.

events.name: Received the transfer and voice message, feeling a mix of emotions.
events.description: In the afternoon, Yin Hao received a bank deposit notification text message and a voice message from his father. He sat on the edge of the bed and listened to the voice message twice. His father's tone was calm, but Yin Hao knew very well how hard his parents had worked over the past few months to sell the house, and his eyes could not help but grow warm. This money was his parents' life savings, and this trust made him feel an unprecedented weight. The discomfort of his back injury made him realize even more clearly the responsibility he carried.

events.name: Sharing with his girlfriend and feeling the distance
events.description: After calming down, Yin Hao sent the transfer screenshot to his girlfriend Lin Yue via WeChat with the message: 'This is a debt, but also motivation.' Lin Yue quickly replied with a hugging emoji. Yin Hao looked at the simple reply and felt that there seemed to be an unbridgeable distance between them; the pressure of material reality weighed on his heart.

events.name: Had a video call with my mother to express gratitude
events.description: In the evening, Yin Hao made a video call to his mother, Wang Xiuying. In the screen, his mother sat in her newly rented small apartment in Rudong, smiling gently. Yin Hao thanked his parents for using all their savings to support him in buying a house; his mother instead comforted him not to be too pressured. The call lasted about 20 minutes. Yin Hao held back tears and promised to work hard, so that in the future his parents could live in a house of their own.

events.name: Thinking about future plans late at night.
events.description: Late at night, Yin Hao lay in bed tossing and turning, repeatedly thinking about the details of his parents' efforts since July to support his home purchase, and his future life plans after taking on the mortgage. When he thought of his mother's dizziness after the old house was sold in September, his heart ached. He opened the notes app on his phone, roughly calculated the down payment ratio and monthly payment, and imagined a future with Lin Yue. The dull pain in his lower back reminded him of the importance of health, and he decided to gradually resume running once his strain improved.

start_state.location: Bedroom of the rental unit, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai
start_state.mood: As usual, looking forward to the holiday, with slight lower back discomfort

end_state.location: On the bed in the bedroom of the rented house at No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai
end_state.mood: Heavy but determined, with mixed feelings

state.daily_exercise: None, only simple stretching to relieve the lower back injury.

2025-10.daily_overview: On the second day of the holiday, Yin Hao quickly transferred his father's down payment into a dedicated financial account. He weighed 72.9 kg in the morning, normal fluctuation from yesterday. He organized the documents, drove to ICBC, successfully opened a dedicated account for the housing down payment, and purchased R2-grade short-term wealth management products. During the process, he communicated carefully with the wealth manager. After returning home in the afternoon, he called his girlfriend to inform her of the arrangement, feeling much more at ease. In the evening, considering his back injury, he did a set of gentle core activation exercises at home.

events.name: Confirm the down payment has arrived.

events.name: Organized the account opening documents.
events.description: Yin Hao took out his ID card, household register, and the transfer receipt screenshot from the filing cabinet, verified them, put them into a document folder, and carefully checked the safety of his bank card.

events.description: At 9:00 a.m., Yin Hao drove his family car from Guangfulin Road to the Songjiang Sub-branch. On the way, he filled up at a gas station and chatted with the attendant briefly about holiday travel.

events.name: Open a dedicated account for the home purchase down payment

events.name: Transfer funds and purchase short-term wealth management products
events.description: Yin Hao transferred 600,000 yuan into a newly opened dedicated account and, on the recommendation of the wealth manager, purchased an R2-level low-risk short-term wealth management product with a term of 90 days and an expected annualized return of 2.8%. He carefully asked about the redemption rules before signing to confirm.

events.name: Call girlfriend to report progress

After the workout, he felt his body stretched out and applied a hot compress to relax the injured lower back area.

2025-10.daily_overview: On the third day of the National Day holiday, Yin Hao drove to Mogan Mountain with his girlfriend Lin Yue to meet up with his comrade-in-arms. His morning weight was 73.0 kg, slightly up because the previous day's food was a bit salty. After a 3-hour long drive, the four of them drank tea and caught up in the courtyard after arriving at the guesthouse, took a walk in the evening to get familiar with the surroundings, and at night drank beer on the terrace reminiscing about fun moments from military life until late. The bond of comradeship let him temporarily forget his stress, but his lower back still reminded him from time to time to watch his posture.

events.name: Drove off to Mogan Mountain
events.description: At 8:00 in the morning, Yin Hao drove his own car, with his girlfriend Lin Yue, from Songjiang, Shanghai, via the Shanghai-Chongqing Expressway and then onto National Highway G104. They rested once at a service area on the way, and Lin Yue bought some snacks. After about a 3-hour drive, they arrived at Mogan Mountain Scenic Area at 11:00 a.m. While driving, he deliberately used a lumbar support to reduce strain on his lower back.

events.name: Meet up with comrades-in-arms and settle in
events.description: At the parking lot of Green Bamboo Mountain House, he met his former comrades Zhang Jianguo and Zhou Xiaofeng, who had arrived earlier. After brief greetings, the four checked in. Yin Hao shared a room with Lin Yue, while Zhang Jianguo and Zhou Xiaofeng each had their own room. After the room assignments, they organized their luggage.

events.name: Drinking tea and chatting in the courtyard
events.description: After settling in, the four of them sat around the courtyard of the guesthouse, drinking tea and eating snacks while chatting. Zhang Jianguo shared funny stories about a Hangzhou fitness trainer, Zhou Xiaofeng talked about workplace experiences in Shenzhen, and Yin Hao talked about the pressure of buying a house and getting certified. They discussed the itinerary and decided to take a walk in the surrounding area in the afternoon and officially start the mountain hike the next day.

events.name: Evening stroll around the homestay
events.description: At 5:00 p.m., Yin Hao took Lin Yue for a walk along the bamboo path around the homestay. They held hands and took photos. Lin Yue was in a slightly better mood than in previous days but still spoke little. Yin Hao brought up the transfer, but Lin Yue only replied briefly. They returned as it was getting dark.

events.name: Late-night drinks on the terrace to catch up
events.description: At 8:00 p.m., the four of them sat around the terrace, opened the beer and snacks they had brought. Under the moonlight, they recalled their military experiences. Yin Hao told amusing stories about joining the camp, making everyone laugh. His comrades noticed that he occasionally rubbed his lower back, and he explained it was a strain from lifting something heavy; they told him to be careful. The atmosphere was warm and harmonious, and they didn't return to their rooms until after 11 p.m.

2025-10.daily_overview: On the second day of the Moganshan trip, Yin Hao went for a solo 5 km jog in the early morning to keep up his morning running habit, at a pace of 7:15 per kilometer. He still felt a pulling sensation in his lower back but managed to keep going. Later, he spent the whole day hiking the main peak scenic spots with his former comrades and girlfriend. On the way down, Zhang Jianguo privately urged Yin Hao to think about his future with Lin Yue; Yin Hao stayed silent on the surface but was inwardly moved. In the evening he soaked in a hot spring to relax his lower back, and had a barbecue dinner with the group, during which Zhou Xiaofeng shared his experiences in Shenzhen. After returning, he weighed 72.8 kg, showing the obvious effects of the exercise.

events.name: Early morning solo run
events.description: At 6:00 in the morning, Yin Hao got up alone and jogged 5 kilometers along the bike path next to the guesthouse at a pace of 7:15. The air in the bamboo grove was fresh. He carefully controlled his stride and checked his lower back reaction every kilometer. Although there was still slight pain, it was bearable. After the run, he stretched carefully and took photos with his phone to send to his running buddy Chen Jie.

events.name: Set out for a hike after breakfast
events.description: Back at the guesthouse, the four of them had breakfast together. At 8:00 in the morning, they set out with water and snacks to hike the main peak of Mogan Mountain, visiting attractions such as Sword Pool and Reed Flower Marsh in turn, and took a group photo by Sword Pool. When carrying his backpack, Yin Hao deliberately switched shoulders from time to time.

events.name: Farmhouse lunch
events.description: At 12:00 noon, he had a meal at a farmhouse restaurant on the mountain, tasting free-range chicken soup, braised pork with dried bamboo shoots, and wild vegetables. Yin Hao consciously controlled his intake of red meat and ate more vegetables.

events.name: Fellow soldier privately admonished him on the way down the mountain.
events.description: In the afternoon, as they went down the mountain along Jianggong Road, Zhang Jianguo slowed down to walk side by side with Yin Hao and said privately, “You and Lin Yue have been in a long-distance relationship for almost two years. Dragging it on forever is not a solution. How can her family not have objections? You need to make plans early.” Yin Hao was deeply touched and only gave an “Mm” in response.

events.name: Relax by soaking feet in the hot spring
events.description: In the evening, they returned to the guesthouse, and Yin Hao and Lin Yue went to the hot spring pool to soak their feet. The warm water eased the fatigue in his lower back. The two sat side by side chatting; Lin Yue's mood softened, and she voluntarily shared some small achievements at work.

events.name: Evening barbecue gathering.
events.description: At 7:00 p.m., the four set up a grill in the courtyard. Zhang Jianguo grilled the meat, Zhou Xiaofeng prepared the sauce, and Yin Hao and Lin Yue put food on skewers. During the meal, Zhou Xiaofeng shared interesting stories from the cybersecurity industry in Shenzhen, and the atmosphere was harmonious.

2025-10.daily_overview: On the third day at Mogan Mountain, Yin Hao went for his usual morning 5-kilometer run (pace 7:10/km), and his weight dropped to 72.7 kilograms. In the morning, he toured the town with Republic of China style and bought souvenirs. In the afternoon, he prepared barbecue ingredients. In the evening, during the barbecue, Zhang Jianguo again bluntly suggested that Yin Hao consider developing his career back in Nantong or Hangzhou. After a long silence, Yin Hao said he would seriously consider it. At night, they sang and played guitar around the campfire until late, in a warm yet wistful atmosphere. Before going to bed, he applied a medicated patch to his injured lower back.

events.name: Solo jog in the early morning
events.description: At 6:00 in the morning, Yin Hao jogged 5 kilometers along the bike path again, at a pace of 7:10. This time the run was easier, and the discomfort in his lower back was reduced. After the run, he took a photo of the misty mountain view with his phone and sent it to Chen Jie. During breakfast, the four of them discussed the day's itinerary.

events.name: Visited a town with Republic of China-era charm
events.description: At 9:00 AM, the four of them went to the Republic-of-China-era town at the foot of Moganshan, strolled around, visited the old station and café, and tasted bamboo-shoot beans and green rice balls. Lin Yue bought bamboo earrings, and Yin Hao bought a small bamboo carving. At the town post office, Yin Hao sent a postcard to his parents.

events.name: Return at noon to rest.
events.description: At 12:30 noon, they returned to the homestay to rest. Yin Hao and Lin Yue each scrolled on their phones in the room. He took the initiative to ask Lin Yue about the job transfer. Lin Yue said it was still being approved and told him not to worry.

events.name: Preparing ingredients for a barbecue in the afternoon
events.description: At 3:00 PM, the four divided the work: Yin Hao and Zhang Jianguo set up the grill, Zhou Xiaofeng cut the meat, and Lin Yue washed vegetables and made lemonade. During this time, Yin Hao helped Zhou Xiaofeng open a stuck seasoning bottle, showing off his practical skills.

events.name: Evening barbecue dinner and another in-depth conversation
events.description: At 5:30 in the evening, as the sun set, they started the barbecue. Zhang Jianguo once again said to Yin Hao in private, "Are you really going to struggle on in Shanghai with a mortgage of over one million yuan? If you go back to Nantong or to Hangzhou, the pressure will be half." Yin Hao was silent for a long time, then said frankly that he would seriously consider it, but since he had already taken the step of buying a house, he didn't want to give up halfway. Zhang Jianguo patted him on the shoulder.

events.name: Sang and played guitar by the campfire until late at night
events.description: At 8:30 p.m., a bonfire was lit in the courtyard. Zhang Jianguo played the ukulele and sang military songs, and everyone joined in. Later, they talked about the loneliness of striving in big cities, and the mood gradually turned melancholy. The gathering broke up at 11:30 p.m. Before bed, Yin Hao applied a medicated patch to his lower back injury.

2025-10.daily_overview: Mid-Autumn Festival and the last day of the trip. After his morning 5 km run, Yin Hao weighed 72.8 kg. In the morning, he and Lin Yue hiked alone in the Dakeng Scenic Area, reliving their time as a couple. At noon, they met up with his comrades for lunch. In the afternoon, they rode a greenway for 1.5 hours. After nightfall, Yin Hao used a drone to lift an electronic lantern into the sky and video-called his parents in Nantong to admire the bright moon together. His mother was moved to tears and showed fatigue, so Yin Hao secretly decided to take her for a medical checkup after the holiday. Afterwards, the three comrades continued to drink on the terrace. Zhang Jianguo bluntly said that Lin Yue's family might be putting pressure on her, which stung Yin Hao inside and strengthened his resolve to support his family.

events.name: Morning jog.
events.description: At 6:00 in the morning, Yin Hao did his usual 5 km jog at a pace of 7:05. While running, he thought back on his comrade's advice and felt unsettled. After the run, he stretched and weighed himself at 72.8 kg.

events.name: In the morning, went hiking alone with Lin Yue at the Dakeng Scenic Area
events.description: At 8:30 a.m., Yin Hao and Lin Yue went hiking alone at the Dakeng Scenic Area in Mogan Mountain. They walked hand in hand and asked a passerby to take a photo of them together. Lin Yue was visibly more relaxed and proactively talked about interesting stories at work.

events.name: Met with a former comrade-in-arms for lunch at noon.
events.description: At 12:00 noon, they met up with Zhang Jianguo and Zhou Xiaofeng at another farmhouse restaurant, where they enjoyed free-range chicken hotpot and braised pork. Yin Hao deliberately ate more vegetables.

events.name: Afternoon cycling on the greenway
events.description: At 2:00 p.m., the four of them rented bicycles and rode along the Mogan Mountain Greenway for about 1.5 hours, enjoying the scenery along the way. Yin Hao felt his waist was fine, and the ride was relatively easy.

events.name: Mid-Autumn Festival drone video call with parents
events.description: At 6:30 p.m., Yin Hao was in the courtyard of the guesthouse, flying a drone with an electronic lantern to about 30 meters, and connected via video call to his parents in Nantong on his phone. His mother, Wang Xiuying, was moved to tears when she saw it, and his father reminded him to be safe. Lin Yue also said hello to the old couple. The call lasted about 20 minutes, and the scene was heartwarming. His mother seemed in good spirits in the video, but Yin Hao noticed a hint of fatigue beneath her smile. He remembered what his father had mentioned during the transfer on October 1 about his mother's difficulty adjusting after renting a small apartment, and also remembered his own promise to let his parents enjoy their old age. Secretly, he decided to take time after the holiday to go home and take her for a physical examination.

events.name: Late-night deep conversation with a comrade-in-arms while admiring the moon.
events.description: After the Mid-Autumn Festival reunion, Yin Hao, Zhang Jianguo, and Zhou Xiaofeng continued drinking and admiring the moon on the terrace. Zhang Jianguo said bluntly, 'Do you think Lin Yue's family has no concerns? If you still don't give a definite answer, they may arrange a blind date for her.' Yin Hao clenched his fist, not only because his comrade-in-arms had bluntly exposed his anxiety, but also because he realized that he had to hold this family together — not just the mortgage, but also his parents' health. Zhou Xiaofeng also expressed understanding. The group talked until 11:30 and then dispersed.

events.name: Saying goodbye to the homestay and comrades-in-arms

events.name: Took Lin Yue to Songjiang South Railway Station to take the high-speed train back to Hangzhou.
events.description: At 2:00 p.m., Yin Hao arrived in Songjiang. After Lin Yue picked up her belongings, Yin Hao drove her to Songjiang South Station to take the high-speed rail back to Hangzhou. He asked about her train number and told her to be safe. They hugged goodbye and agreed to meet again before the end of the month.

events.name: Pack luggage and let family know you are safe.

At 8:00 PM he had a brief video call with his mother to report that he was safe, and she reminded him to rest well. Before bed, he weighed himself and saw 72.7 kg, satisfied with maintaining his weight.

2025-10.daily_overview: Early in the morning, Yin Hao drove back to his hometown in Rudong, Nantong, accompanied his mother to the county people's hospital for a comprehensive physical examination. She was diagnosed with mild hypertension and received antihypertensive medication. In the afternoon, he patiently taught his father how to use an electronic blood pressure monitor and fill in a health record form, establishing a daily home monitoring routine. In the evening, after returning to Shanghai, he confirmed via video that his mother had taken her medication. He was exhausted from the day's running around, and his weight dropped to 72.5 kg. His back injury was no longer a problem, and he felt no discomfort while lifting and carrying things throughout.

events.name: Drove back to Rudong in the early morning.
events.description: At 5:30 in the morning, Yin Hao set off from his home in Songjiang, Shanghai, drove via the Shanghai–Xi'an Expressway onto the Shenyang–Haikou Expressway, and arrived at the residential community his parents rent in Rudong County, Nantong at 8:30 AM.

events.name: Accompanied my mother to the hospital for a physical examination
events.description: At 9:00 a.m., Yin Hao accompanied his mother Wang Xiuying to Rudong County People's Hospital and, as scheduled, completed a full examination including blood routine, urine routine, liver function, electrocardiogram, and ultrasound, which took about 2 hours. His mother was slightly nervous, and Yin Hao stayed with her the whole time.

events.name: Pick up the physical examination report and get a diagnosis.
events.description: At 1:30 p.m., Yin Hao accompanied his mother back to the hospital to collect the report. The internal medicine doctor explained: blood pressure 145/95mmHg, diagnosed with mild hypertension, recommended a low-salt diet and moderate exercise, and prescribed nifedipine extended-release tablets.

events.name: Pick up medicine and go home to explain health management
events.description: After picking up the medicine at 2:00 pm, Yin Hao and his mother returned to the rented apartment, explained to his father the purpose of creating a health record form, and his parents said they would cooperate.

events.name: Create a health record sheet
events.description: Yin Hao took out the template and, together with his mother, filled in personal information, medication names and dosages, then posted the record sheet in a prominent place in the living room.

events.name: Teach father to use the blood pressure monitor.
events.description: Yin Hao took out the electronic blood pressure monitor, explained its functions to his father, demonstrated how to put on the cuff, and had his father try it once while guiding and correcting him, making sure he could measure independently. About 30 minutes.

events.name: Agreement on daily monitoring and remote follow-up
events.description: Yin Hao agreed with his father to measure his mother's blood pressure every morning at 7:00 and keep a record. His father said he would strictly follow the plan. Yin Hao promised to check the records via video every week.

events.name: Return to Shanghai in the evening and confirm via video.
events.description: Drove back to Shanghai at 5:00 p.m. and arrived home at 8:30 p.m. Then confirmed via video call that his mother had taken her medicine and felt no discomfort, reminded her to watch her diet, and agreed to a follow-up appointment in one month.

2025-10.daily_overview: Yin Hao faced the practical exam for the senior CNC technician certification. After a morning jog to wake up his body, he went to the assessment center to complete the five-axis simultaneous machining test and felt he performed normally. Exhausted after the exam, he gave up the originally planned programming practice and went home to browse materials and meditate to relax. He went to bed early, looking forward to the results.

events.name: Morning jog.
events.description: At 6:00 in the morning, Yin Hao jogged 3 kilometers near home as a warm-up before the exam, with a pace of 6:30. He felt no discomfort in his lower back and felt his condition recovering. After the run, he weighed 72.6 kg.

events.name: Pack exam supplies and set off.
events.description: At 6:45 in the morning, Yin Hao checked and organized the tools, ID card, and admission ticket required for the practical exam, then drove from Guangfulin Road to the Shanghai Vocational Skills Appraisal Center.

events.description: At 7:45 a.m., arrived at the assessment center on time, presented ID to sign in, entered the waiting area to be assigned a workstation, and used the waiting time to mentally review the key operating points.

events.name: Took the practical exam
events.description: At 9:00 a.m., he went to his workstation and began the assessment for machining a complex curved surface part with five-axis simultaneous machining. He completed tool clamping, program import and debugging, parameter setting, and machining monitoring in sequence. Thanks to recent experience, he finished smoothly and rated his performance as normal.

events.name: Clean up and return after the exam.
events.description: The assessment ended at 11:00 a.m. He cleaned the machine tool, handed in the parts, and left after a brief exchange with the examiner. On the drive back to Songjiang, he had a simple lunch. He was thinking about the original practice plan for the afternoon, but decided to go home and rest.

events.name: In the afternoon, went home to rest and browsed through materials.
events.description: Around 1:30 p.m., Yin Hao arrived home. He felt tired but was still thinking about the skills competition, so he flipped through his previous programming notes and related textbooks for about an hour, then did a 10-minute meditation to relax and calm down.

events.name: Rest early in the evening.
events.description: Washed up at 9:00 PM, got into bed at 10:30 ready to sleep. Felt relieved but slightly tired, looking forward to the exam results.

2025-10.daily_overview: On Friday, Yin Hao took leave due to a toothache to get a filling. After examination and filling treatment, he went home to rest. In the evening, he briefly adjusted the PPT and speech script, and before bed did meditation and stretching to relieve tension.

events.description: After getting up at 6:20, because his right molar was aching slightly, Yin Hao did only a simplified 10-minute core workout, avoiding movements that required clenching his teeth, focusing mainly on stretching.

events.name: Cavity diagnosis and filling treatment.
events.description: Dr. Zhang Ming tested with a probe and an ice cotton ball, then took X-rays and confirmed moderate caries on the adjacent surfaces of teeth 6 and 7 in the lower right quadrant. He then removed the decay under local anesthesia, filled it with layered glass ionomer, and adjusted the bite. The whole procedure took about 40 minutes. Yin Hao gripped the armrest and stayed calm.

events.name: Settle the costs and schedule a follow-up appointment
events.description: After the tooth filling, Yin Hao went to the front desk to settle the bill: the total was 800 yuan, with 300 yuan paid out of pocket after medical insurance; the doctor advised him not to eat for two hours and not to chew on the affected side within 24 hours, and scheduled a follow-up teeth cleaning on October 24. Yin Hao collected the anti-inflammatory medicine and left.

events.name: Returned to the rented apartment to rest
events.description: At 3:30 p.m., Yin Hao drove home, cooked millet porridge with greens and a salted duck egg, ate simply, took anti-inflammatory medicine, and lay in bed resting with his eyes closed. After the anesthesia wore off, the pain was mild.

The loan disbursement was delayed, but double happiness arrived; after reporting the good news that evening, he meditated.

events.name: At the desk at home, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

events.description: After signing the contract, he called the loan manager and learned that the year-end credit quota was tight, and disbursement was expected to be delayed to January. Yin Hao accepted this calmly and confirmed the subsequent materials.

events.description: At 7 p.m., cooked tomato and egg noodles for a simple celebration. In a video call, told his mother that both the certificate and the house were settled. His mother's eyes reddened and she told him not to overwork. Yin Hao showed her the contract and the certificate.

events.name: Meditation and stretching before bed.

His brother suggested replacing all water pipes and electrical wires, using 4 mm² wire for the electrical lines, redoing the kitchen and bathroom waterproofing, and stripping the walls down to the base and repainting them. He shared his own renovation lessons and recommended the half-package approach. Yin Hao took rapid notes.

events.description: After the video call, I organized key points in my notebook regarding plumbing and electrical work, waterproofing, walls, a budget of 150,000 yuan, and the construction schedule, drew a simple furniture layout, and took a photo to send to my brother for confirmation.

events.name: Meditation and stretching before bed.

2025-03.daily_overview: Saturday was sunny. Because of persistent dull pain in his right knee, Yin Hao tried to resume jogging, but the pain quickly worsened and he had to give up. In the afternoon he stayed home alone repairing an old desk lamp. In the evening he had a video call with his girlfriend Lin Yue. Before bed he applied a hot compress to his knee and was in low spirits.

events.name: Attempted to resume morning running but failed.
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, I tried jogging along Guangfulin Road. After only 2 kilometers, a sharp stabbing pain appeared on the outside of my right knee, so I stopped immediately. After stretching while holding onto the roadside railing, I limped home and applied an ice pack for 20 minutes, feeling frustrated.

events.name: Repairing an old desk lamp to pass the time
events.description: In the afternoon, I rummaged through the storage cabinet and found an old desk lamp with a loose connection. I opened it with a screwdriver, re-soldered the detached wire ends, and replaced the switch. The lamp lit up again, giving me a brief sense of accomplishment.

events.name: Video call with Lin Yue to vent
events.description: At 9 p.m. he had a video call with his girlfriend Lin Yue and told her about his frustration with the recurring knee injury. Lin Yue comforted him, telling him not to worry, and offered to come visit him in Shanghai next week. Yin Hao agreed on the surface, but inwardly he was still worried that his running plan would be interrupted.

events.name: Hot compress and music before bedtime
events.description: After washing up, he applied a hot towel to his right knee for 15 minutes while playing soft music. He went to bed at 22:45 but tossed and turned until 23:30 before falling asleep.

start_state.mood: Agitated and restless (knee pain)

2025-03.daily_overview: On Sunday morning, Yin Hao invited his running buddy Chen Jie to evaluate his knee injury, which was diagnosed as iliotibial band syndrome, and was told to stop running for three weeks. In the morning he joined a rehabilitation group and discussed cross-training; in the afternoon he went alone to the supermarket to buy groceries; in the evening he indulged in games late into the night, feeling anxious.

events.name: Fellow runner Chen Jie diagnosed with a knee injury
events.description: At 8 a.m., he met his running buddy Chen Jie at Songjiang University Town. After palpation and movement tests, Chen Jie diagnosed the pain on the outside of the right knee as iliotibial band syndrome, advised stopping running completely for at least three weeks, and prescribed a cross-training plan of swimming and cycling. Yin Hao recorded it on his phone on the spot.

events.name: Join the rehabilitation group and receive encouragement
events.description: Chen Jie added Yin Hao to the "Songjiang Runners Recovery Exchange Group". Several injured runners in the group shared their recovery experiences. After browsing the chat history, Yin Hao posted his own situation and received a few encouraging replies, feeling somewhat comforted.

events.name: Purchase high-protein foods.
events.description: At noon, I drove alone to Yonghui Supermarket and, following Chen Jie's suggestion, bought chicken breast, eggs, broccoli, milk, and more, determined to adjust my diet to support rehabilitation.

events.name: Late-night gaming to vent emotions
events.description: In the evening, feeling restless because he couldn't go running, he opened Honor of Kings ranked mode. After winning several games in a row, he ended up playing until 1 AM without realizing it. For the first time, the thought of uninstalling the game crossed his mind. After lying down, his mind stayed excited and he couldn't fall asleep for a long time.

events.name: Brief phone call with her mother
events.description: At 8 p.m., his mother Wang Xiuying called via video, asking how he was doing. Yin Hao only mentioned his chronic knee problem, and his mother told him to apply a hot towel and said she would send some medicated patches.

start_state.mood: Lacking the strength to rally.

end_state.location: In bed at home on Guangfulin Road
end_state.mood: Anxious and exhausted

state.daily_exercise: None (stopped running due to injury)

2025-03.daily_overview: On Monday, work nearly went wrong due to lack of sleep. After work, Yin Hao went directly to Songjiang Natatorium to complete his first swimming training; his knee was pain-free and his condition was improving. In the evening, he was shocked after checking his game bill and had a small argument with Lin Yue during a video call about his knee injury, then received a reminder about the knee pads Lin Yue had ordered.

events.name: A near miss at work
events.description: In the morning, while operating the CNC machine tool, he was distracted and almost used the wrong cutting tool, and was reminded by his mentor Sun Jianguo. During the lunch break, he reviewed the attendance records and resolved to stop staying up late playing games.

events.name: First swimming cross-training session
events.description: After work, I went alone to Songjiang Swimming Pool and swam freestyle and breaststroke for 40 minutes. My right knee felt no discomfort in the water. After swimming, I checked in on the rehabilitation group, and Chen Jie liked it and encouraged me to keep going.

events.name: Shocked by the game recharge bill.
events.description: In the evening, while reviewing his phone bills, he found that his total top-ups in "Honor of Kings" over the past three months had exceeded 1800 yuan. Remembering his goal of saving to buy a house, he was full of regret and immediately disabled the in-game payment function.

events.name: Had a video argument with Lin Yue.
events.description: At 9:30 pm, Lin Yue video-called to ask about his knee. When she learned that he had aggravated it by running on his own, she scolded him for not taking care of his body. Yin Hao responded defensively, and their voices gradually turned cold. After hanging up, Lin Yue quietly ordered knee pads and calcium tablets to be shipped to Shanghai.

start_state.mood: Fatigue (after-effect of staying up late)

end_state.location: In bed at home on Guangfulin Road
end_state.mood: Guilty and helpless.

state.daily_exercise: Swimming for 40 minutes

2025-03.daily_overview: On Tuesday morning, I completed a bike ride in light rain. During the day, I discussed recovery experiences with colleagues at the factory. In the evening, I received knee pads sent by Lin Yue and felt warm inside. At night, I had a video call with Chen Jie to finalize a detailed home rehabilitation plan, and I made a diet list, determined to follow it.

events.name: Early morning cycling training.
events.description: Rode for one hour along the greenway of Songjiang Central Park from 6:00 to 7:00 in the morning, keeping a low gear ratio to avoid pressure on the knees. Although the light rain wet my clothes, my right knee felt relaxed after completing the training.

events.name: Support from colleagues and exchange
events.description: During the lunch break, colleagues Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang asked about his knee injury. Yin Hao told them the diagnosis. Wang Lei shared his own recovery experience from spraining his ankle last year, and Liu Zhiqiang suggested trying swimming.

events.name: Received a heartwarming package from Lin Yue.
events.description: In the afternoon, the package arrived. Upon opening it, he found a pair of professional knee pads and two bottles of calcium tablets, along with a handwritten note from Lin Yue: "Focus on recovering from the injury first; there's no rush for anything else." Yin Hao took a photo, sent it on WeChat to thank her, and the relationship between the two eased.

events.name: Video call with Chen Jie to develop a rehabilitation plan
events.description: At 8 p.m., Chen Jie initiated a video call, explained the principle of iliotibial band syndrome in detail, and drew up a daily plan for foam roller relaxation and gluteus medius training with resistance bands, requiring that it be carried out starting the next morning.

events.name: Create a high-protein diet plan.
events.description: According to the advice, he wrote a four-week diet adjustment list in his phone memo, including two eggs and a glass of milk for breakfast every day, a chicken breast salad for lunch, and reducing carbohydrates at dinner.

start_state.mood: Regret and determination coexist

end_state.location: In bed at home on Guangfulin Road
end_state.mood: Somewhat hopeful.

state.daily_exercise: Cycled for 1 hour

2025-03.daily_overview: After work on Wednesday, he went swimming and gradually got into the swing of it. In the evening, Yin Hao proactively checked his accounts and found that game spending was seriously eroding his savings. He decisively canceled the auto-renewal and placed an order for rehabilitation equipment. At the same time, he began keeping a mood journal in a memo app. Lin Yue told him that she had bought a ticket to Shanghai for the weekend, and his mood brightened.

events.name: Swimming training: improved feel for the water.
events.description: Swam again for 40 minutes in the evening, paying attention to adjusting his breathing rhythm, and swam 1,000 meters freestyle continuously. Afterward, he posted his swimming data in the rehabilitation group. Someone asked about the pool information, and the interaction was active.

events.name: Start a mood journal
events.description: Following Chen Jie's suggestion, he created a Daily Mood note in the mobile memo app, wrote that day's entry as having made a little progress but missing running, and set a reminder for 9 p.m. every night.

events.name: Calculate game spending and quit
events.description: Before going to bed, he made a detailed tally of his gaming expenses over the past year. The total came to nearly 5,000 yuan, shocking him. He immediately canceled the auto-renewal of all game memberships and removed the Alipay quick-payment binding.

events.name: Ordered rehabilitation equipment
events.description: Immediately placed an order on JD.com for a foam roller and resistance band set, costing 178 yuan, expected to arrive on March 7.

events.name: Lin Yue sent a screenshot of the train ticket.
events.description: At 10 p.m., Lin Yue sent a WeChat screenshot of the high-speed rail ticket order from Hangzhou East to Shanghai Hongqiao on March 8. Yin Hao replied, “I’ll pick you up,” and began planning the weekend itinerary.

start_state.mood: Slightly calm.

end_state.location: In bed at home on Guangfulin Road
end_state.mood: Full of anticipation

After work, colleague Wang Lei invited him for a walk, which stirred up memories of running. After returning home late, he contacted fishing buddies to arrange a weekend fishing trip and looked up information about Open University of China degree advancement.

events.description: At 6:30 a.m., he unrolled the yoga mat and, following a video, slowly rolled the outside of his right thigh with a foam roller. Despite the pain, he persisted for 10 minutes; then he did 3 sets of glute bridge abductions with a resistance band.

2025-03.daily_overview: On Sunday, his day off, Yin Hao met his fishing buddy Wu Zhiqiang at Dianshan Lake and enjoyed a long-missed time outdoors. Early in the morning he packed his gear and drove there. Amid the lake and mountain scenery, he caught a big carp, and Wu Zhiqiang's drone aerial photography sparked a new interest, but after calmly weighing the pros and cons that night, he decided to delay the purchase, demonstrating financial discipline. He was happy and fulfilled all day, and kept up his home rehabilitation training and bedtime reading habits.

events.name: Organize fishing gear and head to Dianshan Lake.
events.description: At 7 a.m., Yin Hao loaded fishing rods, bait, a folding chair, a sun umbrella, and other equipment into the trunk of his car at his home on Guangfulin Road in Songjiang. He confirmed the specific fishing spot on the west bank of Dianshan Lake and the 8 a.m. meeting time with his fishing buddy Wu Zhiqiang via WeChat. Then he drove his silver-gray Volkswagen Lavida to Dianshan Lake in Qingpu District via the G50 Shanghai-Chongqing Expressway, arrived on time, and met up with Wu Zhiqiang.

events.name: Go fishing at Dianshan Lake and catch a big carp
events.description: Yin Hao and Wu Zhiqiang chose a fishing spot with lush water plants by Dianshan Lake, skillfully set up their rods, cast bait, and watched the float intently. They chatted about family matters and recent fishing conditions in a relaxed atmosphere. After about two hours, Yin Hao noticed the float suddenly sink, quickly lifted the rod, and after about ten minutes of patiently playing the fish, successfully caught a large golden carp weighing about three jin, its scales glittering in the sunlight. Excitedly, he asked Wu Zhiqiang to take a photo as a souvenir, and sent the photo to the family WeChat group.

events.name: Watching Wu Zhiqiang's drone aerial video.
events.description: During the afternoon break, Wu Zhiqiang took out his newly purchased DJI Air 3 drone and began aerial filming next to Yin Hao. He operated the drone to shoot the scenery of Dianshan Lake from a height of a hundred meters, and deliberately zoomed in for a close-up of Yin Hao and the large carp he had just caught. In the frame, the green lake surface and the plump carp created a strong visual impact. Watching in real time on the tablet connected to the drone remote controller, Yin Hao was deeply impressed by the vastness of the lake from the high angle and the dynamic footage of the catch, and suddenly became very interested in aerial photography.

events.name: Packed up, returned home, and sorted the catch.
events.description: At a little past 3 p.m., Yin Hao and Wu Zhiqiang packed up their fishing gear, bagged the trash and took it away, and said goodbye to each other. He put the carp in a foam box and drove back along the same route to Songjiang District. After getting home, he washed and dried the fishing gear, kept the carp in a temporary basin of water, and planned to steam it the next day. After tidying up, he took a hot shower to ease the day's fatigue.

events.name: Searched for drone information and decided not to buy one for now.
events.description: In the evening, while resting alone in the living room, Yin Hao kept picturing the magnificent aerial footage from the day's drone shooting. He used his phone to search on Taobao and JD.com for models such as the DJI Mini 3 and Mini 4 Pro, checking prices (3,000-5,000 yuan) and review videos. But when he opened mobile banking to check his balance and remembered that next week's rent of 2,500 yuan was due, and that he also had to cover his mother's birthday banquet and gift expenses at the end of the month, reason told him that buying a drone now was a non-essential expense that would affect his emergency savings. He sighed softly, closed the shopping pages, and decided to make aerial photography a goal for when he was financially better off.

start_state.location: Home bedroom, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai
start_state.mood: Full of energy, looking forward to the fishing trip

end_state.location: Living room sofa at home.
end_state.mood: Content and satisfied, having enjoyed pure outdoor time; though tempted by aerial photography, I chose rational restraint.
