2025-03.daily_overview: On Thursday, Yin Hao spent the day in a regular rhythm of work and study. After settling the cost sharing for the birthday banquet with his older brother, he went for an easy 15 km bike ride after work. In the evening, he also learned file reading and writing techniques in a Python online course and was able to apply them to simple CNC program generation, steadily improving his technical skills.

events.name: Discussing the cost-sharing of the birthday banquet with his older brother Yin Tao.
events.description: During the morning work break, Yin Hao had a detailed discussion with his brother Yin Tao over a WeChat voice call about splitting the cost of their mother's birthday banquet. They agreed that the total meal cost would be about 3,000 yuan, with Yin Hao covering 1,500 yuan (including the cake) and transferring it to Yin Tao via WeChat, while Yin Tao would handle the bill. In addition, Yin Hao mentioned that he planned to buy an extra gift for his mother, and his brother agreed. After the transfer, Yin Hao felt he had done his part.

events.name: Easy cycling workout after work
events.description: After getting off work at 5 p.m., while it was still light, Yin Hao changed into his cycling gear and did about 15 kilometers of relaxed cycling training along the road on the west side of the university town, passing by Guangfulin Ruins Park on the way, where early spring was showing and willows were budding. His right knee felt relaxed during pedaling, with no discomfort. After finishing the training, he did some simple stretching on a roadside bench and took a photo of the park waterscape in the sunset, sending it to the recovery group with the caption "Recovery is almost over, looking forward to the track."

events.name: Studied Python online course in the evening
events.description: From 7 p.m. to 9 p.m., Yin Hao continued his Python online course. This session covered file reading and writing and string processing. The instructor demonstrated how to use Python to read part machining parameter files in Excel format and automatically generate CNC program code. Yin Hao followed along and successfully converted a workpiece dimension table into macro variable assignment code recognizable by the machine. He felt the huge potential of programming to improve work efficiency. After class, he thought of a problem mentioned by Master Sun Jianguo in the workshop during the day — low efficiency in entering part parameters — so he used the file reading and writing method he had just learned to write a small script that could automatically convert Excel-format part parameters into machine-readable macro variable assignment code. After testing it successfully, he decided to show it to his master tomorrow.

start_state.mood: Woke up in the early morning feeling a bit tired, but quickly perked up

end_state.location: Home study room
end_state.mood: Feel excited and grounded because of the technology's real application prospects

state.daily_exercise: Cycled 15 km; home rehabilitation training (10 minutes of foam roller relaxation).

2025-03.daily_overview: Friday was a highlight-filled day for Yin Hao. The macro program he wrote ran successfully in a trial at the workshop, improving efficiency by 12% and earning recognition from the team leader, which greatly boosted his sense of professional achievement. After work, he kept up his swimming training. In the evening, he carefully selected a gold bracelet as a birthday gift for his mother, placed it in his backpack to take back to his hometown the next day. Although it was a fairly large expense, filial piety and a sense of accomplishment intermingled, and he felt uplifted all day.

events.name: Before work, ask his master for advice on macro programs.
events.description: At 7:30 a.m., Yin Hao arrived at the company cafeteria half an hour early, found his teacher Master Sun Jianguo, printed out the first draft of the macro program he had written the previous night, handed it to him, and explained in detail the design idea and expected results. Master Sun carefully reviewed it while drinking soy milk, pointed out several conservative parameter settings and possible tool-path interference risks, and gave specific optimization suggestions. The master and apprentice talked for about twenty minutes, and Yin Hao took careful notes.

events.name: Modified and confirmed the macro program in the workshop.
events.description: During the morning break, Yin Hao opened his laptop in the workshop break area and, under the guidance of his mentor, modified the macro program line by line: he adjusted the feed rate parameters and tool entry angle, added a safety clearance code segment, and re-ran the computer simulation. After the modification, he asked Master Sun to review it again and, after receiving approval, was allowed to conduct actual testing.

events.name: Macro program trial run achieved results.
events.description: At 2 p.m., under the witness of team leader Wang Lei, Yin Hao imported the modified macro program into the CNC machine tool control system via a USB drive. He selected ten parts from this batch for trial machining, monitored the cutting status throughout, and found no anomalies. After machining, he compared the data with the original program and found that the average machining time per part was reduced from 150 seconds to 132 seconds, an efficiency increase of 12%, and the quality of the finished products fully met the standards. He excitedly recorded all the data and parameters.

events.name: Reported to the team leader and was praised.
events.description: After the trial run succeeded, Yin Hao immediately reported the test results to team leader Wang Lei. Wang Lei carefully reviewed the machining data and product quality. After confirming, he patted Yin Hao on the shoulder with satisfaction, praised him for his initiative in innovation and problem-solving, and encouraged him to promote the optimized program within the team. Yin Hao felt a strong sense of achievement and resolved to continue deepening his study of programming optimization techniques.

events.name: Evening swim training
events.description: After work, Yin Hao went to the swimming pool at Songjiang Gymnasium as planned for his third swimming session of the week, completing a 2000-meter workout alternating between freestyle and breaststroke. During the session, he tried a light kicking movement, and his right knee's range of motion was almost back to normal. After swimming, he chatted briefly via voice messages with several fellow runners in the rehab group, encouraging each other to stick with the recovery plan.

events.name: Buying a birthday gift for his mother and preparing to bring it back
events.description: At 8 p.m., Yin Hao drove to Wanda Plaza in Songjiang District and walked into the Laofengxiang gold store. With the sales assistant's recommendation, he carefully chose a solid gold bracelet - simple in style, moderate in weight, priced at 2,800 yuan. He paid by credit card and asked the assistant to wrap it beautifully. He carefully placed the gift in his backpack, planning to take it back to his hometown the next day. During a video call with his mother that evening, he didn't reveal what the gift was, only saying he had brought Shanghai specialties. His mother's voice reply was full of surprise and affection.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to verifying my programming results, a little nervous.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home.
end_state.mood: Felt extremely gratified and inspired because his work was recognized and he expressed filial devotion

2025-03.daily_overview: Saturday was his mother's 50th birthday. Yin Hao drove back to his hometown in Rudong early in the morning to reunite with his family. The birthday banquet at noon was warm and lively. His mother was deeply moved wearing the gold bracelet. In the evening, he had a heartfelt late-night talk with his older brother Yin Tao in the room where he had lived since childhood, sharing their pressures and dreams. The warmth of his family swept away the fatigue of city life and strengthened his motivation to work hard. The whole day was filled with deep family affection.

events.name: Drove back to his hometown in Rudong, Nantong early in the morning.
events.description: At 6:00 in the morning, Yin Hao set out from his residence in Songjiang District, Shanghai, driving a Volkswagen Lavida north on the G40 Shenhai Expressway. He made a brief stop at a service area to rest and refuel. The whole trip was about 200 kilometers, and he arrived at his hometown in Juegang Town, Rudong County, around 10:30 a.m. As soon as he parked, his father Yin Jianguo and older brother Yin Tao came out to greet him and carried the gifts for his mother and his change of clothes into the house.

events.name: Birthday banquet at Ruyi Restaurant.
events.description: At 12 noon, Yin Hao's family and close relatives, including his maternal uncle Chen Zhigang and his cousin Chen Xiaowen, gathered in a private room at Ruyi Restaurant to hold a 50th birthday banquet for his mother, Wang Xiuying. The table was filled with Nantong local dishes, with a large two-layer cake in the center. During the banquet, Yin Hao took an exquisite gift box from his backpack and personally put a gold bracelet on his mother. His mother was overjoyed and her eyes became red on the spot. Yin Hao offered his blessings, and the relatives chatted happily. Yin Hao had a few cups of rice wine with his father and shared details of his work and life in Shanghai with his brother and cousin. The banquet lasted until 2:30 p.m.

events.name: After the birthday banquet, returned home to rest and chat.
events.description: After the birthday banquet, the whole family returned to the old house. Mother busied herself tidying up the gifts relatives had brought, while father pulled Yin Hao aside to talk about spring farm work in the hometown and the condition of the house. Yin Hao took a walk around the courtyard, looking at familiar corners from his childhood, and felt nostalgic. In the evening, mother cooked another simple meal, and the family of four had a warm dinner.

events.name: Transfer the birthday banquet fee to elder brother
events.description: After dinner, Yin Hao transferred 1,500 yuan to his older brother Yin Tao via WeChat to cover the meal and cake costs for the birthday banquet. After the transfer, he sent a message: "Bro, thanks for your hard work. I've transferred the money; please accept it." Yin Tao quickly received it and replied with an 'OK' emoji. The tacit understanding between the brothers made everything go smoothly.

events.name: Late-night talk between brothers
events.description: At night, Yin Hao and his older brother Yin Tao returned to Yin Hao's room (which is now used as a guest room but still has the bookcase and award certificates from those years). The two sat side by side on the edge of the bed and talked until the early hours. Yin Tao mentioned that the car he had just replaced came with a monthly car loan of more than 3,000 yuan, and with raising a child, the pressure was considerable. Yin Hao also candidly spoke about the agony of having to stop running for three weeks due to his right knee injury, his regret over squandering money on games, his determination to learn programming and enroll in the Open University of China, and his helplessness when his washing machine broke down while he was alone in Shanghai. After listening quietly, Yin Tao patted him on the shoulder and said, “If you can't hold on out there, come back and rest for a while. Home will always be here. But your brother knows you can do it.” These words made Yin Hao's nose tingle, and the nerves that had been tense for so long finally relaxed a bit.

events.name: Apply for credit card installment
events.description: Before going to bed, Yin Hao logged into the China Merchants Bank mobile app to check his credit card bill and found that the 2,800 yuan purchase of a gold bracelet had been posted. Considering his large expenses this month, he applied for the purchase to be paid in 6 installments. The system showed each installment would be about 476 yuan (including the handling fee). He confirmed and submitted to reduce the pressure of a one-time payment.

start_state.mood: Eager to see family, excited and a little nervous

end_state.location: Room at his hometown in Rudong
end_state.mood: Embraced by family affection, his heart was warm and firm, and he felt more courageous about the future.

state.daily_exercise: No formal exercise, but helped move heavy objects and had quite a lot of activity.

2025-03.daily_overview: Sunday was the last day of the running break period. In the early morning, Yin Hao completed a final cycling ride around his hometown, declaring his recovery a success. After returning to Shanghai, he booked a follow-up appointment with Chen Jie and shared a summary in the rehabilitation group. In the afternoon, he tidied up the house; in the evening, he relaxed by reading and having a video call with his girlfriend Lin Yue, feeling relaxed and optimistic.

events.name: Finishing an early morning bike ride around my hometown in Rudong.
events.description: At 7 a.m., Yin Hao took out an old mountain bike stored at his hometown and completed an easy 12-kilometer ride on the rural cement road, as the last cross-training session during his running break. In the fields, the rapeseed flowers were just beginning to bloom, the air was fresh, and his right knee felt completely fine. After the ride, he deliberately got off the bike to photograph this familiar land and posted it to the recovery group, declaring: “Three weeks of no running is over; check-up tomorrow, looking forward to getting back on the track!”

events.name: Returned to Shanghai and scheduled a follow-up appointment
events.description: At 9 a.m., Yin Hao said goodbye to his parents. His mother stuffed a bag of homemade glutinous rice cakes and pickled clams into his car. He drove back to Shanghai and arrived home in Songjiang shortly after noon. After a simple lunch, he contacted his running buddy and fitness coach Chen Jie via WeChat to schedule a rehabilitation assessment at Vitality Fitness Center for tomorrow morning (March 24), preparing to resume running.

events.name: Post a training summary in the rehabilitation group
events.description: In the afternoon, Yin Hao posted a long message in the rehabilitation group, summarizing his three weeks of recovery, thanking group members for their encouragement and companionship, and sharing with newcomers his insights on going from anxiety to calm. Group members gave thumbs up, and Zhang Xin and Liu Jun also invited him to go jogging together next time.

events.name: Organizing household chores and preparing for next week's tasks
events.description: In the evening, Yin Hao began sorting the items he had brought back from his hometown, changed the sheets and duvet covers, cleaned out the refrigerator, and prepared the tool bag and materials needed for work next week. Then he opened his laptop, reviewed his Python online course notes, and previewed the next lesson.

events.name: Evening reading and video call with girlfriend
events.description: After dinner, Yin Hao sat on the sofa and used the WeChat Reading app to continue reading chapters of 'CNC Machine Tool Programming and Operation', maintaining his bedtime reading habit. Then he had a half-hour video call with his girlfriend Lin Yue in Hangzhou, sharing his Sunday trip to his hometown and the good news about his knee recovery. Lin Yue was happy for him, and the two agreed to meet next month for sure.

start_state.location: Bedroom at family home in Rudong
start_state.mood: Relieved, excited to be returning to the track soon.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home in Shanghai
end_state.mood: Relaxed and satisfied, full of anticipation for future training

2025-03.daily_overview: On Monday, Yin Hao reached a key milestone. In the morning, he got Chen Jie's medical clearance, and the running break officially ended; he felt relieved. Work went normally all day. In the evening, he carefully made a detailed recovery training plan for April, supplemented by reading and muscle stretching. Life got back on track, and he had a positive attitude.

events.name: Went to Vitality Fitness Center in the morning for a rehabilitation assessment.
events.description: At 9 a.m., Yin Hao took a half day off from work and went to the Vitality Fitness Center in Songjiang District to see Chen Jie. Chen Jie first asked how he had been, then had him lie down for a right knee range-of-motion test, stability check, and manual strength assessment, as well as movements like single-leg squats. After the assessment, Chen Jie smiled and said, “You’ve recovered well. Starting this week, you can gradually resume jogging, but don’t exceed 3 kilometers per session in the first week. Make sure to warm up and stretch thoroughly, and don’t stop strength training either.” Yin Hao felt relieved and noted everything down.

events.name: Return to the company to finish the afternoon work
events.description: After the assessment, Yin Hao had lunch at a nearby noodle shop and hurried back to the company for work. In the afternoon, he was in especially good spirits while operating the machine tool and shared the good news about resuming running with his mentor Sun Jianguo. His mentor told him to take it easy and not chase after a fast pace right away.

events.name: Made an April running recovery plan at night.
events.description: At 8 p.m., Yin Hao sat at his desk at home, turned on his computer, and created a new Excel spreadsheet. Based on Chen Jie's advice and his own condition, he developed a detailed April running recovery training plan. The plan included jogging three times a week (Monday, Wednesday, Saturday), starting at 8 minutes per kilometer for 3 kilometers in the first week, then increasing by 0.5 kilometers each week. He also arranged core strength training days (Tuesday, Thursday) and reserved Sunday as a rest day. He also set a weekly reminder in his phone calendar. After completing the plan, he felt that everything was beginning to fall into place.

start_state.mood: Slightly uneasy, waiting for the final assessment.

end_state.location: Home study room
end_state.mood: Relieved, full of confidence and a plan for resuming training.

Life was routine, but his enthusiasm for learning remained undiminished, and he continued to accumulate skills for future improvement.

events.name: Workshop work and core strength training
events.description: He worked normally in the morning. While operating the CNC lathe, Yin Hao used the work rhythm to do simple core-tightening exercises. After work, he did not go running; instead, he followed his plan to do a 45-minute core strength training session at home, including planks, lying leg raises, glute bridges, and other movements, to improve running posture stability. During the training, he stayed mindful of protecting his right knee.

events.name: Studied Python online course in the evening
events.description: From 7 to 9 PM, Yin Hao attended an online Python course. The session covered the basics of object-oriented programming (classes and objects). The instructor gave examples of defining different types of machine tools as classes, encapsulating machining parameters and macro program libraries. Yin Hao followed along typing code, and after class he built a framework for a machine tool class on his own and tried calling methods to generate simple machining instructions. Although he ran into some syntax errors, he eventually solved them by consulting the documentation and felt the joy of programming.

start_state.mood: Getting ready for work as usual, with a calm mind.

2025-03.daily_overview: On Wednesday, Yin Hao finally returned to the running track! After work, he did his first recovery jog, strictly keeping it to 3 kilometers, and his knees responded well. That evening, he invited colleagues Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang to a KTV to sing and celebrate his recovery, releasing three weeks of stress. It was a double win for socializing and exercise, and he felt especially carefree.

events.name: First post-recovery jog
events.description: After getting off work at 5 p.m., Yin Hao changed into his running shoes, went to the track at Songjiang Sports Center, and did a planned 3-kilometer recovery jog with a pace controlled at 7:30 to 8 minutes per kilometer. His right knee had no pain the whole time, only slight muscle soreness. After the run, he carefully stretched for 15 minutes and felt extremely excited. He immediately sent the running record to the recovery group and Chen Jie, and received likes from everyone.

events.name: Contact colleagues to celebrate knee recovery
events.description: After finishing the run, Yin Hao contacted colleagues Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang via WeChat on the way home, telling them his knee had recovered and he had successfully completed his first run, and invited them to go sing at Haoledi KTV in Songjiang District that evening to relax. The two readily agreed.

events.name: Celebrated by singing at KTV.
events.description: At 7 p.m., Yin Hao, Wang Lei, and Liu Zhiqiang met at the entrance of Haoledi KTV and booked a medium room. Yin Hao ordered classic old songs such as Boundless Oceans, Vast Skies and Friends, sang several Beyond songs with Wang Lei, and Liu Zhiqiang sang a few Jay Chou songs. The three sang at the top of their lungs, freely releasing the pressures of work and injury. Yin Hao also drank two bottles of beer. During the session, they ordered fried chicken and a fruit platter. The activity lasted until 10 p.m. After paying the bill, the three said goodbye happily at the door, and Yin Hao walked back to his home on Guangfulin Road in a great mood.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to the first run after work while also feeling the calm of routine work.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home.
end_state.mood: Very happy and relaxed because of the successful return to running and enjoyable KTV singing

While reading in the evening, he also contacted his girlfriend Lin Yue to share his progress with the new skills.

events.name: Core strength training
events.description: After work, Yin Hao spread a yoga mat on the living room floor and completed about 40 minutes of core strength training, including dynamic planks, bent-knee supine tucks, side bridges, and other moves. During rest between sets, he also did hip stretches. After the workout, he felt a slight burning sensation in his muscles — it was very rewarding.

events.name: Evening comprehensive Python practical online course
events.description: From 7 to 9 PM, Yin Hao continued his Python online course. This session was a comprehensive hands-on class requiring the use of Python to complete a full part machining program generator. Combining the knowledge of functions, file reading/writing, and object-oriented programming learned in previous sessions, he wrote a tool script that could automatically output roughing and finishing path code after inputting workpiece dimensions. Although he encountered a few bugs during integration, he finally solved them by asking the instructor online for help. After class, he saved the script as "part_maker.py" and felt a great sense of achievement.

events.name: Sharing with girlfriend Lin Yue on WeChat.
events.description: After the online class ended, Yin Hao sent several WeChat messages to his girlfriend Lin Yue, briefly telling her about today's programming breakthrough and asking about her work in Hangzhou. Lin Yue replied with encouragement. They chatted for more than ten minutes and agreed to video call again on the weekend.

2025-03.daily_overview: On Friday, Yin Hao fell into financial anxiety after inadvertently reviewing his income and expenses, and then spent the whole day organizing his finances: downloading a bookkeeping app, entering transaction records, setting a budget, and forcing savings. After completing the Python application development in the evening, his financial anxiety eased slightly. That day became the starting point of his stricter financial management; his life focus shifted from sports rehabilitation to financial discipline, and he gradually built up a sense of control over his financial situation.

events.name: Reviewed income and expenses in the morning and downloaded a bookkeeping app
events.description: After getting up at 7 a.m., Yin Hao habitually checked mobile banking. When he saw that this month's cumulative spending had reached nearly 10,000 yuan (rent 2,500, first installment for a gold bracelet 476, birthday banquet 1,500, repair tools 180, swimming and fitness, etc.), while March's salary had not yet been paid and his savings account balance was only a little over 2,000 yuan, his heart tightened. He immediately searched for the "Suishouji" app in the app store, downloaded and installed it, and completed registration and basic settings.

events.name: In the morning, entered this month's income and expenses and set a budget.
events.description: Before going to work, Yin Hao sat at his desk, opened the expense-tracking app, and entered all of this month's income and expense transactions one by one based on payment records and memory, including injury rehabilitation expenses, gifts for his mother's birthday banquet, a fishing gathering dinner, KTV, and so on. He set a monthly savings cap of 2,000 yuan (far lower than the previously planned 5,000 yuan), enabled the budget reminder feature, and resolved to record every expense strictly. When he saw the total expenditure chart, he felt a pang of guilt.

events.name: First full day using a money-tracking app to record expenses.
events.description: That day, Yin Hao immediately recorded on his phone everything from the fresh pork buns at breakfast (3 yuan) and transit card recharge (100 yuan) to the cafeteria set meal at lunch (15 yuan). He even discovered that the scattered expenses he had rarely paid attention to added up to a startling amount. During the lunch break, he sighed at the charts in the app and realized that saving money was not easy.

events.name: Adjust the savings target and move the money to Yu'ebao
events.description: After getting home from work that evening, Yin Hao calmly reviewed his financial situation. He decided to lower his monthly forced savings from 5,000 yuan to 4,000 yuan to leave emergency flexibility; at the same time, he transferred the last 1,000 yuan of demand deposits from his salary card into Alipay's Yu'ebao to earn a little interest. He also turned off some of the credit card's password-free payment settings to prevent impulse purchases. After finishing these operations, he let out a long sigh. Although the numbers were still not encouraging, the clear data gave him a feeling of control. In the notes field of his expense-tracking app, he wrote: “From today on, every yuan must have its mission.”

events.name: In the evening, completed a comprehensive Python application.
events.description: At 8 p.m., after digesting the anxiety about the financial adjustment, Yin Hao turned on his computer and comprehensively applied the Python knowledge he had learned before. For a common shaft-type part in the company, he wrote a script (shaft_macro_gen.py). The script could automatically generate macro program code for rough turning and finish turning based on input parameters such as diameter and length, and estimate the machining time. He used machine tool simulation software to verify the correctness of the code, and estimated that the machining time per part was shortened by about 6%, which somewhat eased his financial anxiety.

start_state.mood: Felt relieved about the weekend plans, but soon became anxious.

end_state.location: Home study room
end_state.mood: Felt anxious and self-blaming over financial issues, but determined to change; though anxious, felt like starting to regain the initiative.

state.daily_exercise: None (rest day), but did some simple stretching at home.

2025-03.daily_overview: On Saturday, Yin Hao had originally planned to meet friends, but when he woke up he found the washing machine had completely broken down, so he had to urgently buy a new one. The extra expense of 2300 yuan made his already over-budget finances worse. After the installation was completed in the afternoon, he still went to the gathering with Gao Zhiyuan and Ma Xiaofeng and relaxed for a short while. Reflecting alone at night, his anxiety about buying a house became even stronger. But he kept up his habit of bookkeeping, and life continued.

events.name: Discovered the washing machine was broken and decided to buy a new one.
events.description: At 8 a.m., Yin Hao was about to put a week's worth of dirty laundry into the washing machine when he found that pressing the power button did nothing. He checked the outlet and the leakage protector, both of which were normal, and realized the old washing machine was completely broken. He called repair shop master Chen Jianguo to ask, learned that the repair might cost 300-400 yuan and there were no parts, and reluctantly decided to buy a new machine.

events.name: Selected and ordered a Haier washing machine on JD.com
events.description: Yin Hao immediately searched for fully automatic front-load washing machines on the JD app. Based on his rental situation and budget, he compared brands such as Haier and Little Swan. After half an hour of comparing reviews, he finally chose a Haier 10 kg front-load washing machine priced at 2,300 yuan. After confirming the model and warranty policy, he paid with Alipay and selected afternoon delivery and installation service.

events.name: Afternoon: washing machine delivery and installation
events.description: At 2 p.m., the JD Logistics delivery driver brought the washing machine to the door. Then the installation technician arrived, removed the old machine, connected the water and electricity, and debugged it. The entire installation took about an hour. Yin Hao watched the whole process and was quite interested in the technician's technique. When testing the washing, the new machine was quiet and stable. He signed for receipt, but silently calculated the large additional expense he had incurred.

events.name: Met up with friends and kept track of expenses.
events.description: At 4 p.m., Yin Hao went out for an appointment and met Gao Zhiyuan and Ma Xiaofeng at a barbecue restaurant in Songjiang. The three ordered skewers and beer and talked about their recent lives. Yin Hao mentioned his worries about finances and replacing the washing machine. His friends comforted him by saying that losing money would ward off disasters. The gathering lasted about 2 hours, and the per-person cost was 80 yuan. Yin Hao immediately recorded the dining expense using a mobile bookkeeping app.

events.name: Evening reflection on home-buying goals
events.description: Back home, Yin Hao sat on the sofa, staring blankly at the new washing machine. He did a calculation: this month's unexpected expenses had already exceeded 4,000 yuan in total (washing machine 2,300, gold bracelet 2,800 first installment, birthday banquet 1,500, etc.), far exceeding the budget. Seeing that the monthly total expenditure in the expense tracking app exceeded 12,000 yuan and his savings plan had completely failed, he deeply felt the rigid costs of living alone, became even more determined to save up a down payment for a house within five years, and opened the real estate app to browse several low-price listings in Songjiang.

start_state.mood: Woke up looking forward to the gathering, but was hit by the washing machine breaking down.

end_state.location: Living room at home
end_state.mood: Frustrated by a large unexpected expense, but even more determined to buy a home.

state.daily_exercise: No formal exercise; only walked to the gathering.

2025-03.daily_overview: On Sunday, Yin Hao took advantage of the sunny and warm weather to do spring cleaning. He put away the winter quilts, organized seasonal clothes, and installed insect-proof screens, preparing for the new season of study and life. In the afternoon, he reviewed his Python notes and downloaded the National Open University course material preview, looking forward to the coming new semester. He had a video call with his girlfriend Lin Yue for nearly an hour, which was emotionally nourishing. In the evening, he continued his habit of reading, feeling calm and fulfilled.

events.name: Spring cleaning and seasonal reorganization
events.description: After breakfast, Yin Hao began a thorough cleaning of his rental apartment. He rolled up the thick quilt and electric blanket, put them into compression bags, and laid out thin quilts for spring and autumn. He put winter coats into the top of the wardrobe and took out spring clothes such as hoodies and jackets. He also used a vacuum cleaner to thoroughly clean under the bed and in corners, wiped the windows, and installed the previously online-purchased Velcro insect net onto the screen window to prevent mosquitoes in spring and summer. The whole cleaning took nearly three hours, and the room looked brand new.

events.name: Organizing study materials and reviewing notes
events.description: In the afternoon, Yin Hao sorted and organized the Python textbook, printed CNC programming materials, and notebooks on his desk, and saved useful courseware to his cloud drive. He took out last week's online course notes and re-derived the design of the machine tool class in object-oriented programming, deepening his understanding. He also downloaded the first-semester textbook preview and course schedule for the electromechanical integration associate degree program at the Open University of China starting in April, and learned that "Mechatronic System Design" and "CNC Technology" would be core courses. He briefly browsed the textbook table of contents and wrote in his diary, "April, OUC classes begin, keep going." He felt a little nervous but more expectant about the upcoming learning journey.

events.name: Video call with girlfriend Lin Yue
events.description: At 5 p.m., Yin Hao had a video call with his girlfriend Lin Yue, who was in Hangzhou, via WeChat. The two talked about their respective weeks. Yin Hao shared his financial anxiety and the washing machine incident; Lin Yue comforted him gently and shared her small achievements at work. They agreed to meet in person on a weekend after Qingming Festival. The call lasted nearly 50 minutes, and after hanging up, Yin Hao felt much better.

events.name: Evening reading and pre-bedtime review.
events.description: At 9:30 pm, after washing up, Yin Hao lay back against the headboard and read the last few chapters of Becoming Steve Jobs on the WeRead app, deeply impressed by Jobs's obsession with products. Then he opened his expense tracking app to check this week's spending chart. Though the numbers still pained him, seeing that he had kept up with recording expenses gave him a sense of control. He drew up a preliminary budget for April, then went to sleep with the resolve to improve his finances.

start_state.mood: Decided to organize life on the day off, feeling full of energy.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home.
end_state.mood: The clean environment and strengthened relationship brought a sense of stability, and I feel full of expectation for the new semester.

state.daily_exercise: Light housework, no dedicated training.

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy turning to showers, temperature 15°C to 22°C, northeast wind force 3.

2025-03.daily_overview: On the last day of March, Yin Hao started Monday with a recovery jog and went about his work as usual. In the evening, he carefully used his accounting app to review the month's finances and made a budget plan for April. Before bed, he looked back over the past 19 days of reading and mood notes, saw his growth and adjustments, and ended this month full of challenges and changes with relief.

events.name: Jogging training during the recovery period
events.description: At 6:40 in the morning, as planned, Yin Hao did a 3 km recovery jog on the track at Songjiang Sports Center at a pace of 7:40 per kilometer, with no issues in his right knee. After the run, he stretched carefully for 15 minutes. He felt his cardiorespiratory fitness had declined a bit, but believed it would recover soon. Today's running record was also synced to the exercise notes field of his expense-tracking app.

events.name: All-day workshop work
events.description: From morning to afternoon, Yin Hao operated CNC machine tools in the workshop, and the production tasks were not heavy. During the lunch break, he and Wang Lei discussed the plan of possibly going fishing in the suburbs next weekend as low-cost entertainment. Master Sun Jianguo asked about his recent Python studies, and Yin Hao shared his latest script results.

events.name: Evening financial review and April budget planning
events.description: At 8 p.m., Yin Hao sat at his desk and opened the monthly report in his budgeting app. He saw that March's total income was about 10,000 yuan (salary + a small amount of overtime pay), while total expenses were as high as 13,500 yuan, with major items including rent of 2,500, a washing machine 2,300, the first installment of the gold bracelet installment plan 476, a birthday banquet 1,500, and maintenance tools 180, leaving his savings negative. After analyzing, he found that besides unavoidable expenses, variable expenses (such as KTV and dinners) were also nearly 600 yuan. Based on this, he made an April budget: a forced savings target of 4,000 yuan, rent 2,500, living expenses controlled within 1,500 yuan, and entertainment budget cut to 200 yuan. He also wrote in his phone memo the monthly theme: "April: don't spend unless necessary, stick to jogging and Python, get ready for junior college classes."

events.name: Bedtime reading and mood reflection
events.description: After washing up at 10:30 p.m., Yin Hao leaned against the headboard and read some summaries in WeChat Reading of "CNC Machine Tool PMC Programming and Application". Then he opened his phone memo and reviewed his mood records since March 16, from anxiety and depression to regaining confidence. He sighed with emotion that he had gotten through the low period of his injury through self-discipline. Finally, he did a 3-minute abdominal deep-breathing exercise, calmly set his alarm, and fell asleep.

start_state.mood: Felt a little pressure at the end of the month, but resolved to re-plan

end_state.location: Bedroom at home.
end_state.mood: After completing the review, he felt calm inside and had a clear direction for the coming month.

state.daily_exercise: Jog 3 km; do 10 minutes of stretching at home

date_attribute.weather: Sunny and hot, with a high of 38°C.

2025-08.daily_overview: On the Friday workday, Yin Hao, driven by both financial anxiety and his determination to buy a house, began strict budget management and planned his review for the senior technician certification. During the day, he worked overtime on the digital project; in the evening, he organized his accounts and studied. Because of stress, he paused his morning runs and replaced them with stretching at home.

events.name: During the commute, sent a voice message to mother to report that he was safe.
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, on his way to the company, Yin Hao made a brief call through car Bluetooth to his mother Wang Xiuying, who had returned to her hometown in Nantong. He told her he had adapted to living alone and asked her to rest assured. His mother told him to eat a good breakfast.

events.name: Workshop operations and digital project assistance
events.description: During working hours, Yin Hao operated the CNC machine tool to complete the day's machining tasks and joined the company's digital transformation project team to assist Liu Zhiqiang in debugging data interfaces, experiencing for the first time the rhythm of working overtime on a project.

events.name: Started a strict budget plan to reduce spending
events.description: At 8 p.m., Yin Hao opened a mobile expense-tracking app at the desk in his rented room and reviewed July's expenditures, finding that food and transportation were over budget. He set an August budget: keep daily spending within 3000 yuan, save 4000 yuan per month into a special home-purchase fund, and organize the current status of his deposits and small amount of funds.

events.name: Formulated a review plan for the senior technician theory exam.
events.description: Then Yin Hao took out a notebook, divided PLC programming and CNC theory into four learning stages, compiled textbooks, online course links, and practice questions, and set a goal of studying at least 1.5 hours every evening.

events.name: Online research on basic home purchase information
events.description: Driven by the determination to buy a home that welled up the day before when seeing his mother off, Yin Hao browsed the Lianjia app on his phone, searching for the average price of two-bedroom units in Songjiang District, down payment ratio, and provident fund loan conditions, and roughly calculated the upper limit of monthly mortgage payments he could afford.

events.name: Discussed with colleague Wang Lei about filling in as pace leader for the running group.
events.description: After work, Yin Hao found Wang Lei in the company rest area and explained that because of frequent overtime on the digitalization project, he would not be able to serve as the Saturday pace leader for the Songjiang Machinery Running Group in August, and asked Wang Lei to take over for him. The two confirmed details such as the route and pace, and Wang Lei agreed.

start_state.location: Bedroom of the rental apartment on Guangfulin Road
start_state.mood: Suppressed, but determination reignited.

end_state.location: Bedroom of the rental apartment
end_state.mood: A packed plan; tired but determined

2025-08.daily_overview: On Saturday, Yin Hao spent the daytime with a morning run and PLC study, and in the evening received a video conference notice from his father. During the family meeting at night, his father announced his decision to sell the house to help fund the home purchase and had already commissioned an agent to list it. Yin Hao insisted on treating it as a loan, became emotional, and late at night worked out a repayment plan.

events.name: Core training before the morning run
events.description: At 5:50 in the morning, Yin Hao did 15 minutes of foam roller relaxation, resistance band activation, and yoga stretching at home.

events.name: Songjiang Machinery Running Club's regular morning run.
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Yin Hao arrived at Songjiang Sports Center on time. With Wang Lei leading the pace on his behalf, he completed a 10-kilometer easy run with a group of 10 including fellow runner Chen Jie, at a pace of 5 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer. After the run, he felt slight soreness in his legs, which had not been systematically trained for half a month, but he still felt refreshed. He then had a simple breakfast at a roadside shop with Chen Jie and discussed his half-marathon recovery training plan.

events.name: Introductory PLC programming study at home
events.description: At 9 a.m., after bathing, Yin Hao watched an introductory video tutorial on Mitsubishi PLC on his computer, learning about the hardware composition and the installation of GX Works2 software, and successfully created his first project in the simulation environment, experiencing the writing of basic program segments.

events.name: Received a family meeting notice from his father.
events.description: At 3 p.m., Yin Hao received a WeChat message from his father, Yin Jianguo, asking for a family video conference at 8 p.m. to discuss something important. Yin Hao checked the network and the webcam, feeling a little puzzled.

events.name: Family video call: father announced selling the old house to help fund the home purchase
events.description: At 8 p.m., during a video group chat, his father officially announced that he had decided to sell the old family house in Rudong and had already found a prospective buyer. After the sale was completed in September, he planned to give Yin Hao 600,000 yuan to help him buy a home in Shanghai. Yin Hao objected strongly, insisting that it should be considered a loan and that he would pay it back within five years. His father finally sighed and agreed. His mother Wang Xiuying then left the message, "Your home is also our home." Yin Hao remained silent for a long time.

events.name: Initial draft of the repayment plan framework
events.description: After the meeting, Yin Hao used a calculator to roughly estimate his monthly repayment capacity, wrote a draft installment plan in his notebook, and decided to refine it the next day. His heart was filled with a mix of gratitude and heaviness.

start_state.location: Bedroom of the rental apartment on Guangfulin Road
start_state.mood: Feeling light and relaxed after the morning run

end_state.location: Bedroom of the rental apartment
end_state.mood: Mixed emotions: both warmed and weighed down

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy turning to light rain, muggy.

2025-08.daily_overview: On Sunday, Yin Hao refined his repayment plan in the morning, sent the letter of commitment to his father, and received a brief reply. In the afternoon, he met his girlfriend Lin Yue, and they had a fierce argument over differences in values, sending the relationship into a cold war. Late at night, alone, he kept replaying the events. After sending Lin Yue a message asking for some space, he got no reply, and his insomnia worsened.

events.name: Formulate a detailed five-year repayment plan
events.description: In the morning, Yin Hao used an Excel spreadsheet at his desk, combined with his 120,000 yuan annual salary, to list a plan of 8,000 yuan monthly fixed repayments supplemented by his year-end bonus, and drafted a loan commitment letter. After signing it, he took a photo and sent it to his father via WeChat. His father quickly replied with a single word 'good.' Yin Hao stared at that word for a long time. He knew it meant the courtyard in his hometown where he had grown up would no longer be his place to return to, but it also meant he was one step closer to his dream of settling in Shanghai. During this time, he received a WeChat message from his landlord Li Xiuying asking whether he would renew the lease, and he replied that he was considering it.

events.name: A strong sense of fulfillment, more confident in my technical skills.
events.description: At 2 p.m., Yin Hao and Lin Yue met at a café near Songjiang University Town. When he brought up the matter of his father selling a house to lend him money, Lin Yue couldn't understand why he insisted on taking on five years of repayment pressure instead of accepting it openly. She felt family affection shouldn't be calculated so clearly. The two had a fierce argument over their differing values, and ultimately parted on bad terms, starting a cold war.

events.name: Returned alone to the rental apartment at the start of the cold war
events.description: After the quarrel, Yin Hao walked back to his lodging alone, buying canned beer and a boxed meal on the way. Back in his room, he sat silently on the edge of the bed, mulling over Lin Yue's words and realizing the gap in their values.

events.name: Bedtime meditation to ease anxiety.
events.description: At midnight, Yin Hao opened the Tide app and tried to meditate for 15 minutes, but his thoughts were scattered and the effect was poor. Afterwards, he tossed and turned, replaying Lin Yue’s words in his mind, unable to fall asleep.

events.name: Messaged Lin Yue late at night
events.description: In the early hours, Yin Hao picked up his phone and sent Lin Yue a message: 'Let's both calm down.' But Lin Yue did not reply, and the cold war officially began.

start_state.mood: Mentally tense but orderly.

end_state.location: Bedroom of the rental apartment
end_state.mood: Depression, confusion, insomnia

state.daily_exercise: Core training for 10 minutes (simplified plank and stretching).

In the evening, however, he devoted himself to learning PLC ladder diagrams, temporarily blocking out the emotional cold war through technical absorption.

events.name: Daily workshop work and project collaboration
events.description: During the day, Yin Hao machined a batch of connectors. After the lunch break, he and Liu Zhiqiang jointly debugged the MES interface at the test bench. The two had a minor disagreement over the data transmission method, but they stayed restrained and agreed to verify separately before discussing again. During lunch, he talked about the disagreement with Wang Lei in the cafeteria, and Wang Lei advised him to communicate patiently.

events.name: Evening focused study on PLC ladder diagram programming
events.description: After work, Yin Hao declined Wang Lei's dinner invitation and returned to his study. Following the textbook, he studied ladder diagram drawing rules, normally open and normally closed contacts, and basic logic operations, and successfully wrote start-hold-stop and interlock circuits using simulation software, taking study notes.

events.name: Short video call with my brother Yin Tao before bed
events.description: Before going to sleep, his older brother Yin Tao sent a WeChat video call to check on him. Yin Hao mentioned the argument with Lin Yue. His brother advised him to stay calm and suggested focusing on work first. The call lasted about 8 minutes.

start_state.mood: Sleep deprivation, low mood.

end_state.location: Study in the rental apartment
end_state.mood: After studying, his mood settled slightly, but he still felt lonely.

2025-08.daily_overview: On Tuesday, squeezed by both work pressure and an emotional cold war, Yin Hao argued fiercely with Liu Zhiqiang at the technical analysis meeting and nearly fell out. After work, he went on a long run alone for an hour to release the pent-up frustration, but the gloom in his heart did not completely dissipate.

events.name: Fierce disagreement at the technical analysis meeting for the digitalization project
events.description: At the morning technical analysis meeting, Liu Zhiqiang advocated aggressive code refactoring to solve the interface latency, while Yin Hao insisted on a conservative approach to avoid production line risks. The two argued for nearly an hour, making the team atmosphere tense. In the end, they decided to each verify in parallel.

events.name: Went on a long run alone to vent emotions
events.description: After work, Yin Hao put on his running shoes and headed straight to Songjiang Sports Center. He ran 12 kilometers on the track in one go, taking about 1 hour and 5 minutes, replaying the argument and cold war over and over in his sweat. After the run, he passed a convenience store to buy a sports drink, ran into Liu Zhiqiang, and the two nodded awkwardly and went their separate ways.

events.name: Evening study of sequential function chart programming
events.description: After running back, Yin Hao opened the PLC tutorial as planned and studied the concepts of steps, transition conditions, and actions in SFC. He then tried using SFC to write a sequential control program for material handling, observing state transitions through simulation and temporarily putting his worries aside.

start_state.mood: Tense, irritable.

end_state.location: Study in the rental apartment
end_state.mood: Physically tired, and mood still low.

In the evening, he systematically studied PLC timer and counter instructions and regained a sense of control through programming practice, but the loneliness caused by the cold war continued.

events.name: Workshop operations and independent technical verification.
events.description: All day he processed two specifications of gears. During the lunch break, Yin Hao alone verified the interface stability of the conservative plan on the test bench, and the data was trending well. Liu Zhiqiang, meanwhile, tested the aggressive plan on another device; the two had no direct communication.

events.name: Study PLC basic instruction system in the evening
events.description: In the evening, Yin Hao combined textbook learning with practice, focusing on mastering timers TON/TOF, counters CTU/CTD, and comparison instructions. He built a control loop with timing and counting functions in simulation software and verified the logic through a variable monitoring table. During this time, he received a WeChat message from his older brother Yin Tao, who suggested that he consider sending a small gift to Lin Yue to ease the tension. Yin Hao did not reply.

events.name: Exchanged brief greetings with running buddy Chen Jie on WeChat
events.description: Before bed, running buddy Chen Jie sent a message asking why he had missed the morning runs recently. Yin Hao replied that it was because of overtime and feeling down. Chen Jie encouraged him to go for a run on the weekend. The brief exchange made Yin Hao feel a little warmth.

start_state.mood: Dull, lacking desire to communicate

end_state.location: Study in the rental apartment
end_state.mood: Studying brings temporary fulfillment, but loneliness remains.

2025-08.daily_overview: On Thursday, Yin Hao coordinated the verification results between the two parties on the project, but the relationship remained strained. In the evening, he played online games with his childhood friend Zhang Wei and poured out his frustration over the cold war. His friend's comfort made him feel understood, and his mood eased a bit.

events.name: Reconciled and integrated technical solutions in the project.
events.description: In the morning, because neither proposal fully met the requirements, team leader Wang Lei organized a brief discussion. Yin Hao and Liu Zhiqiang reluctantly agreed to the hybrid approach—using a conservative architecture to accommodate part of the optimized code—but the atmosphere remained cold.

events.name: Confiding in childhood friend Zhang Wei over gaming
events.description: In the evening, Yin Hao took the initiative to invite Zhang Wei to team up in Honor of Kings. During the match, he told Zhang Wei in detail over voice chat about the quarrel with Lin Yue. Zhang Wei comforted him from his own experience: 'Communicate after calming down; she probably just said it without thinking.'

events.name: Writing a diary before bed to sort out emotions
events.description: After the game ended, Yin Hao took out a diary he had not used for a long time and wrote a few brief lines recording the conflict with Lin Yue and his sense of helplessness. He decided to temporarily let things cool down and let time fade the conflict.

start_state.mood: Loneliness, forbearance.

end_state.location: Bedroom of the rental apartment
end_state.mood: After confiding, I felt a bit relieved, but still lost.

2025-08.daily_overview: Friday was a fulfilling workday. Yin Hao handled orders in the morning, attended the company's internal PLC training in the afternoon and actively exchanged ideas, and in the evening applied PLC knowledge comprehensively to design a material counting and start-stop control program, feeling his skills steadily improving.

events.name: Completed the urgent machining task in the morning.
events.description: In the morning, Yin Hao received an urgent batch of flange parts to machine. He independently programmed and operated the machine tool, completing 20 pieces in 2 hours with all quality inspections excellent. Then he briefly cleaned his workstation to prepare for the afternoon training.

events.name: Went to the bank during lunch break to handle business
events.description: During the lunch break, Yin Hao went to a bank near his company, deposited this month's cash for the regular fund investment into his account, and printed nearly three months of transaction records to prepare for the subsequent loan consultation.

events.name: Attend internal PLC programming training
events.description: At 1:30 p.m., Yin Hao arrived at the company training room early with his notebook. The equipment department supervisor lectured on S7-1200 basic instructions and common fault cases. Yin Hao actively asked questions and had in-depth discussions with the instructor and colleagues about the transmission interface issues in the project.

events.name: Organize notes and plan applications after the training.
events.description: After the training, Yin Hao returned to his workstation and spent half an hour organizing his notes into three parts: key instructions, troubleshooting ideas, and materials to review. He planned to try using the new techniques to optimize the project program next week.

events.name: Evening comprehensive programming exercise: material counting and start-stop control system.
events.description: In the evening, Yin Hao comprehensively applied his knowledge of ladder diagrams and basic instructions to design a simple material counting and start-stop control system in simulation software. It included sensor triggering, counter, and sequential motor start-stop functions. After two rounds of debugging and corrections, it ran successfully. After the exercise, he previewed the requirements document for the traffic light control system planned for the next day and marked several key timing difficulties.

events.name: Checked the phone and found the chat history with Lin Yue.
events.description: Before bed, Yin Hao picked up his phone and found that his chat history with Lin Yue was still from a few days ago. He felt a tightness in his chest, but he restrained himself from contacting her.

2025-08.daily_overview: All day Saturday, Yin Hao went into focused mode to work on the PLC practical project — the traffic light control system — completing it in one go from requirements analysis to simulation debugging. During the afternoon rain shower, he briefly zoned out. In the evening, he organized all his study notes and fully prepared for the final exam.

events.name: After core training, threw himself into hands-on practice on the traffic signal control system
events.description: He got up at 7 a.m. After completing 15 minutes of core training, Yin Hao started at 9 a.m. to perform the requirements analysis, I/O assignment, and program structure design for the traffic signal control system according to the tutorial, wrote the ladder diagrams and SFC module by module, and simulated the switching sequence of four intersections.

events.name: A brief rest during an afternoon rain shower.
events.description: At 2 p.m., a sudden rain shower broke out. Yin Hao paused his programming, walked to the balcony to watch the rain, and memories of Lin Yue flashed through his mind. He shook his head and returned to the study to continue working.

events.name: Simulation debugging and emergency mode handling.
events.description: Yin Hao added emergency stop and fault alarm functions, ran a complete simulation and debugging. After resolving the timing conflict, the program ran stably. He captured waveform diagrams and variable monitoring screens and saved them as report material.

events.name: Received the local specialties my mother sent
events.description: In the afternoon, a courier delivered the dried clams and hometown pickled vegetables that his mother had sent from Nantong. Yin Hao shared some with his neighbor Aunt Chen, and Aunt Chen gave him some homemade mung bean cakes in return.

events.name: Organize intensive study notes
events.description: At 8 p.m., he compiled the common uses and precautions for ladder diagrams, SFC, and basic instructions he had recently learned into an electronic document, backed it up to a USB drive, marked the completed project cases, and prepared for the course completion exam.

2025-08.daily_overview: On Sunday, Yin Hao went alone to Dianshan Lake in the morning to fish and clear his mind. He felt calmer after catching several crucian carp. In the afternoon, he organized his fishing gear and prepared materials for the owners' committee meeting. In the evening, after being elected as a tenant representative, he attended his first meeting. Late at night, he received a WeChat apology from Lin Yue; the two made up, but a rift remained.

events.name: Early in the morning, he drove alone to Dianshan Lake for wild fishing.
events.description: At 5:30 in the morning, after a simple stretch, Yin Hao loaded the fishing gear into the car, drove 40 minutes to his familiar fishing spot on the shore of Dianshan Lake in Qingpu District, set up his fishing rods, and scattered bait. He met his fishing buddy Wu Zhiqiang, and the two fished side by side, quietly chatting.

events.name: Spent half a day fishing quietly and successfully caught a crucian carp.
events.description: All morning, Yin Hao stared intently at the float and successfully caught 5 wild crucian carp. The lake breeze and stillness made him temporarily forget the cold war and the pressure of buying a house, and his mood gradually relaxed.

events.name: Returned and cleaned the catch and fishing gear
events.description: Around noon, Yin Hao packed up his fishing rod and returned to Songjiang. At his doorstep, he cleaned the crucian carp and froze them for later use, then washed and dried the fishing rod, fishing line, and other gear one by one, and stored them neatly.

events.name: Accepted the tenant representative invitation from the owners' committee and ran for election.
events.description: At 3 p.m., neighbor Aunt Chen Xiuying found Yin Hao at the community entrance and, together with several homeowners, recommended him as a candidate for tenant representative. After understanding the responsibilities, Yin Hao agreed to run.

events.name: Elected as the tenant representative of the first owners' committee and attended the meeting
events.description: At 4:30 p.m., in a simple vote in the property management meeting room, Yin Hao was unanimously approved. At the subsequent meeting, he carefully took notes on topics such as community garbage collection and parking management, and promised to convey tenants' opinions on their behalf.

events.name: Helped Aunt Chen replace the kitchen faucet.
events.description: After the meeting, at Aunt Chen's request, Yin Hao used his portable tools to help her replace the leaking faucet. Aunt Chen thanked him repeatedly.

events.name: Received Lin Yue's WeChat apology and reconciled
events.description: At 9 p.m., Yin Hao checked his phone and found a long message from Lin Yue. She honestly reflected that her words had been hurtful and said she understood his persistence. After half an hour of WeChat communication, the two made up, but Yin Hao still felt an invisible rift in his heart. He realized that this quarrel had touched on fundamental differences between the two of them regarding family, money, and self-perception. Although they had reconciled, it would take time to heal.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to some alone time to relax

end_state.location: Bedroom of the rental apartment
end_state.mood: Relationship repaired but delicate; community responsibility adds steadiness.

events.name: Joint debugging of the project interface with Liu Zhiqiang

events.name: Had a brief video call with his father during the lunch break

His father told him not to push himself too hard and to take care of his health.

events.name: Continue learning PLC programming in the evening.

He used his sports watch to monitor his sleep and found that his deep sleep ratio had dropped below 20% recently.

events.name: First online contact with a real estate agent
events.description: During a study break, Yin Hao opened the Lianjia app and asked an online agent about two-bedroom apartments near Songjiang University Town with a total price of around 1.5 million yuan. The agent sent three recommended listings, and he briefly compared and saved the information.

start_state.mood: Calm, adjusting to the end of the cold war

2025-08.daily_overview: Tuesday was still busy. Yin Hao spent the whole day participating in project document organization and machine tool maintenance. In the evening, he cancelled his studies and went to the supermarket to buy daily necessities and pay attention to discounted vegetables, practicing a tight budget. Before bed, he had a brief video greeting with Lin Yue, and the atmosphere was polite and warm.

events.name: Assisted in organizing digital project documents
events.description: In the morning, Yin Hao wrote the interface debugging report and operating instructions according to the project requirements, documenting the process with text and images. Master Sun reviewed it and nodded in approval.

events.name: Routine machine tool maintenance and cleaning
events.description: In the afternoon, Yin Hao performed weekly maintenance on the two CNC machine tools he was responsible for, replacing cutting fluid, cleaning iron chips, and checking the lubricating oil circuit to ensure equipment precision.

events.name: Shopped at the supermarket after work and compared prices
events.description: After work, Yin Hao drove to Tesco supermarket to buy rice, eggs, and vegetables. He deliberately picked discounted items and kept the total cost under 60 yuan. At the supermarket, he ran into his landlord Li Xiuying and briefly discussed renewing the lease. Sister Li agreed to a month-to-month renewal at the original rent.

events.name: Brief video greeting with Lin Yue
events.description: At 9 PM, Lin Yue initiated a video call. Both asked about each other's recent situation. Although they had made up, the conversation felt a bit distant. Lin Yue mentioned she might come to Shanghai at the end of the month, and Yin Hao expressed welcome. The call lasted only 10 minutes.

events.name: Reading CNC professional magazines before bed
events.description: Before bed, Yin Hao flipped through a five-axis machining case in 'Modern CNC' magazine, took photos of the technical parameters with his phone, and accumulated material for the skills competition and daily self-improvement.

start_state.mood: Calm, emotionally stable

end_state.location: Bedroom of the rental apartment
end_state.mood: Daily routine restored, and taking a wait-and-see attitude toward romance.

2025-08.daily_overview: On Wednesday, Yin Hao used an app during work breaks during the day to filter housing listings and initially short-list the ones he was interested in. In the evening, he completed the comprehensive project assignment for the PLC course—a conveyor belt monitoring system with a touch screen. After the joint debugging succeeded and he submitted it, he felt even more confident about passing the course completion exam.

events.name: Filter housing listings through a real estate app
events.description: During lunch break, Yin Hao searched on Beike and Anjuke for two-bedroom apartments in the Songjiang University Town area with a total price of 1.5-1.6 million yuan, favorited 6 desirable listings, and noted down the agents' contact information.

events.name: Workshop machining and project wrap-up
events.description: Spent the whole day machining the stepper motor bracket and worked with Liu Zhiqiang to complete the final data verification of the project. The two made an exception and high-fived, and their working relationship clearly improved. Before leaving, Master Sun praised their collaboration.

events.name: In the evening, completed the project assignment for the conveyor belt monitoring system.
events.description: After work, Yin Hao wrote the conveyor belt control logic in PLC programming software, configured the HMI touchscreen interface, and set up Profinet communication. In simulation, he successfully commissioned start/stop, speed regulation, and fault alarms, then organized the report and submitted it on time. Because of prolonged sitting, he used a fascia gun to relax his lower back muscles.

events.name: Preliminary discussion with the real estate agent about the house-viewing time
events.description: After work and organizing swimming gear

start_state.mood: Focused, with slight anxiety about buying a house

end_state.location: Study in the rental apartment
end_state.mood: Felt relieved after finishing homework, and put house viewing on the schedule

2025-08.daily_overview: On Thursday, Yin Hao took time during work hours to buy a massage device online as a birthday gift for his father. After work, he focused on reviewing the entire PLC course content for a final sprint before the completion exam; he also contacted the agent to finalize three property viewings for the weekend. His pace of life was tight.

events.name: Purchase an AUX neck massager for father.
events.description: During a break in the morning, Yin Hao logged into the JD.com app and chose an AUX smart neck massager as a birthday gift for his father. When placing the order, he left a note saying, “Dad, don't look down to fix machines so much; use this more often.” He paid 358 yuan.

events.name: Daily workshop operations and preparation for the skills competition
events.description: In the afternoon, Yin Hao operated the machine tool to process routine parts, and used his spare time to review CNC programming theory, working out two practice problems on paper as a warm-up for the next day's skills competition.

events.name: Call the agent to schedule a house viewing this weekend
events.description: In the evening, Yin Hao talked with three real estate agents, explaining his budget and unit-type preferences. Lianjia and Woaiwojia each recommended two properties, and he scheduled three viewing slots: Saturday morning, Saturday afternoon, and Sunday morning, and recorded the routes.

events.name: In the evening, I did a final sprint review of the entire PLC course.
events.description: From 7 pm to 11 pm, Yin Hao systematically reviewed difficult topics such as advanced HMI design, industrial network troubleshooting, and multitasking optimization, reworked simulation questions, and practiced common exam operations in the simulation. When the review ended, his eyes felt sore and dry, so he used eye drops.

start_state.mood: Tense but orderly, with multiple preparations

end_state.location: Study in the rental apartment
end_state.mood: Well prepared for review, looking forward to the exam and house viewing.

2025-08.daily_overview: Friday was extremely packed: in the early morning, he made a video call to wish his father; in the morning, he participated in a skills competition and won second place in the workshop; at noon, he hosted the family of his older brother who had come from afar; in the afternoon, he visited Chenshan Botanical Garden and shot aerial footage with a drone; in the evening, he viewed a house; at night, he took the PLC completion exam and passed it; late at night, he organized his notes, feeling tired yet fulfilled.

events.name: Video call with father in the early morning to celebrate his birthday
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Yin Hao started a WeChat video call with his father. He saw that his father was already wearing a massager, saying it was a waste of money but with a smile all over his face. Yin Hao noticed his father's white hair and promised to try to buy an apartment next year so they could come and stay with him. The call lasted about 15 minutes.

events.name: Participated in the company's annual skills competition
events.description: At 8:30 a.m., Yin Hao took part in the hands-on skills competition in the workshop, machining a stepped shaft according to the drawing; afterwards, he took the closed-book theory exam. He performed normally and stayed calm.

events.name: Won second place in the workshop skills competition and received encouragement
events.description: At 11 o'clock the results were announced, and Yin Hao won second place in the workshop. Manager Zhang from the production department publicly praised him for his "solid on-site technical skills and ability to participate in innovation." After the meeting, Master Sun privately pointed out that he needed to improve his decisiveness, and Yin Hao thought deeply.

events.name: Host older brother Yin Tao and his family in Shanghai
events.description: At noon, Yin Hao's older brother Yin Tao, his sister-in-law, and their little nephew drove from Suzhou to Songjiang. Yin Hao met them at the company gate and took them to a nearby noodle shop for a simple lunch; his nephew excitedly grabbed his uncle's hand.

events.name: Accompanied a visit to Chenshan Botanical Garden and took aerial footage
events.description: At 2 p.m., Yin Hao drove his brother's family to Chenshan Botanical Garden. They toured the greenhouse and the Quarry Garden, and he used a drone to take a family group photo and an aerial panoramic view. His brother asked about the progress of buying a house and encouraged him to stay steady and take things step by step.

events.name: Saw off my elder brother and completed the home viewing appointment.
events.description: At 5 p.m., Yin Hao's older brother and his family set off back to Suzhou, and Yin Hao watched them leave. Afterwards, based on the consolidated list, he contacted the agent to confirm the order of the three property viewings for the next day.

events.name: Took the PLC online completion exam and passed successfully.
events.description: At 20:00, Yin Hao logged into the course platform to take the three-hour final exam, which covered programming, HMI, and network communication. He answered the questions calmly and submitted the program. The next morning after the exam, he checked and found that he had passed with a score of 86, and downloaded the electronic certificate.

events.name: Organize exam insights and notify the mentor and teacher.
events.description: After the exam, Yin Hao recorded the key points and common mistakes in his prep notebook in the study, then sent WeChat messages to Master Sun and Teacher Liu Jianjun to share the good news. Both replied with congratulations and encouraged him to keep improving. Before bed, he did a 10-minute meditation to relax.

start_state.mood: Nervous but full of anticipation.

end_state.location: Study in the rental apartment
end_state.mood: Exhausted yet filled with a mix of accomplishment and warmth

2025-08.daily_overview: After the Saturday running club group run, he used the rest day to intensively view apartments. In the morning and afternoon, accompanied by Lianjia and Wo Ai Wo Jia respectively, he looked at five properties near the university town and compared them carefully. In the evening, he organized the viewing notes and found time to review content for the senior technician exam. Before bed, he sent Lin Yue a good-night WeChat message.

events.name: Running club group run
events.description: Got up at 6:00 in the morning and went to Songjiang Sports Center for the Saturday routine activity of the Songjiang Machinery Running Group. He ran an easy 6 kilometers with Chen Jie and other running buddies at a pace of 6:20 per kilometer, chatting while running about recent overtime work and exam preparation.

events.name: Check exhibition information and prepare for apartment viewing
events.description: On Saturday evening, Yin Hao used his phone to look up details of the international exhibition at the Power Station of Art in Shanghai, planned the subway route from Songjiang for the next afternoon, and prepared a power bank, water, and a notebook.

events.name: Morning house viewing at Lianjia.
events.description: At 9 a.m., met Lianjia agent Xiao Li at Songjiang University Town Metro Station, then walked to Greenland Rose Nine to view an 85-square-meter two-bedroom apartment. Afterward, took the agent's car to Sanxiang Four Seasons Flower City to view a 78-square-meter two-bedroom apartment, and finally viewed an 82-square-meter two-bedroom apartment at Poly Xizi Bay. Yin Hao personally checked the lighting, walls, plumbing and electrical wiring, and asked about property management fees, school district, and parking spaces, taking quick notes in his notebook.

events.name: Lunch and switching agents
events.description: At noon I had a simple bowl of noodles at Wanda Plaza and rested for a while. At 2 p.m. I met up with Xiao Wang from Woaiwojia and continued viewing apartments.

events.name: In the afternoon, went to a house viewing with I Love My Family.
events.description: In the afternoon, he looked at Longfor · Good Hope Mountain 80 sqm (layout satisfactory but total price slightly over budget) and Vanke · Dream Pie 77 sqm (finely decorated but floor slightly low). Yin Hao learned about the room for price negotiation and transaction taxes and fees, and listed the pros and cons of each unit on the subway ride back.

events.name: Evening review of CNC principles
events.description: From 8 to 10 p.m., reviewed the first four chapters of CNC Machining Technology in the home study, organized notes, and made a concept map. Although house viewing was tiring, I still persisted in preparing for the end-of-month exam.

events.name: Chatted with Lin Yue on WeChat before bed
events.description: After lying down at 11 o'clock, exchanged WeChat messages with Lin Yue, sharing today's apartment viewing experience and tomorrow's exhibition plans. Lin Yue reminded him to take precautions against heatstroke.

start_state.mood: Wide awake and full of energy, feeling motivated about the day's plans.

end_state.location: Bedroom of the rental apartment on Guangfulin Road
end_state.mood: Despite the running around from viewing houses, he gained plenty of information and gradually fell asleep while thinking about comparisons.
