2025-08.daily_overview: In the early morning, he completed a 50 km cycling challenge around Songjiang with aerial photography along the way. In the afternoon, he went to the Museum of Contemporary Art to see an exhibition and tried interactive installations. In the evening, he shared his gains. A day of double breakthroughs, using both physical strength and mental energy—tiring but fulfilling.

events.name: Pre-ride preparations.
events.description: Got up at 5:30 a.m., checked the mountain bike's tire pressure, brakes, and gears on the balcony, put on professional cycling clothes, helmet, and gloves, packed two bottles of water and three energy gels, and fully charged the drone battery.

events.name: 50 km cycling route around Songjiang.
events.description: At 7:00, he gathered with cycling friends at Songjiang University Town and rode along the route of Guangfulin Country Park – Chenshan Botanical Garden – Thames Town. At the rest stop by Guangfulin Lake, Yin Hao used a DJI drone to take aerial footage of the cycling group and the lake view. The whole ride took about 4 hours. At 11:30, he completed his first long-distance challenge. He was excited but also a bit tired.

events.name: Returning home for a shower and aerial video editing.
events.description: After cycling, went home, took a shower, did simple stretching, and had lunch. In the afternoon, used a mobile video editing app to add music to the aerial footage, made a 2-minute short video, posted it to the cycling group, and received lots of likes.

events.name: Went to the Museum of Contemporary Art.
events.description: At 1 p.m., he took the subway to Huayuangang Road in Huangpu District and arrived at the Power Station of Art about an hour later, bought a ticket and went in.

events.name: Visited an exhibition
events.description: He browsed the installation, video, and abstract painting areas in turn. He could not understand most of the works, but he still stopped patiently. He lingered for a long time in front of an interactive installation that allowed touching, triggering light, shadow, and sound through movement, experiencing a novel aesthetic experience.

events.name: Return trip and sharing
events.description: The visit ended at 5 p.m., and we returned the same way. On the way back, I reflected on the exhibition. Although it wasn't my area of interest, I felt it broadened my horizons. At 8 p.m., I shared my exhibition experience with Zhang Wei and Gao Zhiyuan on WeChat, especially impressed by the interactive installations, and we made an appointment to go to the science and technology museum together next time.

events.name: Review before going to sleep
events.description: Despite many activities during the day, he still insisted on spending an hour in the evening going over the mistake notebook for section views and dimension labeling in Mechanical Drawing, but he ended early because of fatigue and went to bed at 23:00.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to the cycling challenge; slightly nervous but full of confidence.

end_state.location: Bedroom of the rental apartment on Guangfulin Road
end_state.mood: Extremely fulfilling; completed two important activities. Physically drained but mentally satisfied, yet extremely tired

2025-08.daily_overview: On Monday at work, the digital transformation project broke through its bottleneck under Master Sun's guidance, and in the afternoon it passed acceptance and earned a team bonus. During breaks at work, he dealt with the house-purchase matters and a Qixi Festival gift. In the evening, after a simple celebration with colleagues, he went to the company library to study mechanical drawing intensively, going all out for the weekend exam.

events.name: Project bottleneck and Master Sun's guidance
events.description: In the morning, Yin Hao and Liu Zhiqiang were still troubled by signal bit errors on the MES interface, each insisting on their own solution. During an inspection, Master Sun Jianguo examined the site and, based on experience, pointed out a possible signal interference that had been overlooked. He proposed a new idea combining a shielding layer with protocol optimization, and the two suddenly saw the light.

events.name: Successful commissioning and project acceptance.
events.description: In the afternoon, the two followed the advice by adding a shielding layer and optimizing parameters, and the bit errors disappeared. The technical director and the quality department conducted a joint acceptance test; all indicators met the standards, and the project passed smoothly. The company praised the team and announced a 2,000 yuan bonus for each person. It also mentioned Yin Hao's performance in last week's skills competition, where he won second place in the workshop, recognizing his technical progress. Yin Hao and Liu Zhiqiang looked at each other and smiled, letting all their previous grievances melt away.

events.name: Handle house purchase and Qixi Festival matters.
events.description: During a break at work, Yin Hao contacted three agents via WeChat to confirm the latest minimum prices and loan requirements for Longfor Haowangshan, Sanxiang Four Seasons Flower City, and Poly Xizi Bay, and requested recent three-month transaction prices. Meanwhile, he ordered a bouquet of roses and a preserved flower music box on the Flowerplus App, with delivery set for August 22 to Lin Yue's company.

events.name: Evening light meal, celebration, and review
events.description: After work, had a simple dinner with Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang at a small restaurant near the company to celebrate the project's success. The three talked about skills competitions and insights from certification exams. After the meal, Yin Hao went alone to the company employee library, took out drawing samples, and practiced three-view drawings of composite solids, sectional views, and thread drawing methods. When he had questions about dimensioning rules, he looked up the national standard on his phone and took notes. Before the library closed at 21:30, he also did speed-reading drawing exercises.

events.name: Go home and organize the day's notes.
events.description: Back at the rental apartment, I summarized the key points from the day's project and common drafting mistakes into the exam prep notes, and went to bed near midnight to store up energy for another day of hard work tomorrow.

start_state.mood: Slightly tired but must concentrate; a critical day for tackling the project

end_state.location: Bedroom of the rental apartment on Guangfulin Road
end_state.mood: A great sense of achievement; the bonus and project success were like a shot in the arm, giving him more confidence in preparing for the exam.

state.daily_exercise: During lunch break, did a fragmented 3 km run along streets near the company at a pace of 6:30

2025-08.daily_overview: After the project, wrote a summary report and asked Master Sun to review it; during the day, focused on reviewing CNC principles; in the evening, tackled weak points again; before bed, reported house-viewing progress to his father via video call. The day's work and study pace was intense but well-organized.

events.name: Organize project materials
events.description: As soon as I arrived at work in the morning, I retrieved the technical logs, meeting minutes, and experimental data for the digital transformation project from the computer, categorized and filed them, and prepared material for the summary report.

events.name: Wrote the project summary report
events.description: Based on the materials, reviewed the core difficulties and solutions, wrote a report of about 2,000 words according to the company template, focusing on MES interface debugging and tool compensation algorithm optimization, and summarized personal growth and lessons learned.

events.name: Master Sun reviewed and revised.
events.description: In the afternoon, he asked Master Sun Jianguo to review the technical section. Master Sun suggested adding a comparison table of tool compensation algorithms. After revising, Yin Hao submitted it to the document administrator through the internal system and copied the department supervisor.

events.name: Review CNC principles after work
events.description: In the early morning at home, I first reviewed the first five chapters of the textbook and drew coordinate system and interpolation logic diagrams. During the lunch break, I called Master Sun to ask about determining the direction of tool radius compensation. He gave practical machining examples, and I thoroughly understood it.

events.name: Discussing buying a home with father via video call
events.description: In the evening, sent the files of three key listings to his father on WeChat and gave a video report on the house viewing details. His father suggested prioritizing newer buildings and neighborhoods close to the subway, and reminded him to pay attention to the property maintenance fund. Yin Hao decided to schedule a second viewing on another day.

events.name: In the evening, I tackled weak knowledge points.
events.description: For the spindle orientation stop control logic, special M codes, and PLC step instruction pitfalls, he went through the textbook and notes again to make sure he fully understood them.

events.name: Deposit project bonus
events.description: After receiving the 2,000 yuan bonus in my account, I logged into mobile banking and transferred the full amount into the home-buying special fund savings account. Seeing the total increase gave me a little more confidence.

start_state.mood: Task list is full; need to execute step by step.

end_state.location: Bedroom of the rental apartment on Guangfulin Road
end_state.mood: After completing multiple tasks, he was tired but felt grounded; both the house purchase and exam preparation were moving forward.

state.daily_exercise: Morning core and stretching for 15 minutes, no cardio.

2025-08.daily_overview: In the morning, he thought about career advancement paths. In the afternoon, he met with Manager Zhang and got advice on applying for the team leader position. In the evening, he found a 69-square-meter two-bedroom apartment he liked. At night, he calculated the monthly mortgage payment, and his financial pressure suddenly increased, causing him to fall into insomnia and anxiety for the first time.

events.name: Preparing for the promotion discussion
events.description: In the morning, Yin Hao summed up his performance and shortcomings in the digital project, sorted out the senior technician certification and career development path, and listed key points for the afternoon meeting with Manager Zhang.

events.name: Face-to-face talk with Manager Zhang
events.description: In the afternoon, he took the initiative to go to department manager Zhang Ming and reported his insights on the project. Manager Zhang affirmed his technical growth, revealed that after completing the senior technician certification he could compete for the team leader position, and promised that the company would provide support. The talk lasted about 30 minutes and the exchange was sincere.

events.name: Record the promotion plan
events.description: Back at his workstation, he immediately wrote down Manager Zhang's suggestion in his notebook: he needed to obtain the senior technician certificate and accumulate management experience. Then he set a reminder on his phone to look up the certification registration requirements and to make an exam preparation plan within one week.

events.name: Viewing an apartment in the evening
events.description: After work, the agent accompanied me to view a 69-square-meter two-bedroom apartment near Songjiang University Town. The layout was regular, the lighting was good, and the residential complex was orderly. I initially felt inclined to purchase it.

events.name: Calculating the monthly mortgage payment triggered anxiety
events.description: That evening, he used a mortgage calculator to estimate: the 80-square-meter unit he liked at Longfor Haowangshan had a total price of 1.6 million yuan, with a down payment of 480,000 yuan — based on his father's promise of 600,000 yuan in support, most of that would go toward the down payment (but his father had clearly said the proceeds from selling the house would not arrive until the ownership transfer was completed, which would take about another month). With a loan of 1.12 million yuan over 30 years, the monthly payment would be nearly 8,000 yuan. Compared with his monthly salary of about 10,000 yuan, after deducting rent and basic expenses he would have almost nothing left, and he suddenly felt the heavy pressure.

events.name: Hesitating whether to tell his father
events.description: After calculating the monthly mortgage payment, he took a screenshot of the result and was about to send it to his father, but his finger hovered over the send button for a long time before he finally closed the chat window. He remembered that his father was still handling the transfer procedures for the old house yesterday, and the money had not yet been credited, so he shouldn't make the old man worry anymore.

events.name: Review mechanical drawing (interrupted)
events.description: Originally planned to tackle the three-view conversion difficulty in the evening. He forced himself to stay alert and drew several sets of composite solid views, but he kept being distracted, drawing dashed lines as solid lines, and finally closed the book in frustration. He flipped through the wrong-question notebook absent-mindedly, and finally lay down at 1 a.m., tossing and turning unable to sleep.

events.name: Try to relax and fall asleep
events.description: After lying down, he repeatedly looked at loan tips on his phone, and the more he read, the more anxious he became. He did not fall into a dazed sleep until after 2 AM, and his sleep quality was extremely poor. This was the first night of this bout of anxiety-induced insomnia.

start_state.mood: Feeling fairly energetic in the morning, preparing for the interview

end_state.location: Bedroom of the rental apartment on Guangfulin Road
end_state.mood: Overwhelmed with anxiety, the pressure of the monthly mortgage weighing like a boulder on his chest, hard to let go.

state.daily_exercise: Lunch break fragmented run of 3 km, pace 6:40

2025-08.daily_overview: After a sleepless night, he was dazed and kept getting distracted at work, and his mentor reminded him about it. In the evening he forced himself to review PLC programming and comprehensive exercises, but he was inefficient, and his anxiety continued to spread.

events.name: Insomnia and searching in the early morning
events.description: He woke up at 1 a.m. and couldn't fall back asleep. His mind kept calculating the monthly mortgage payment and income. He picked up his phone repeatedly to search for early repayment methods and housing price trends, and stayed awake until dawn.

events.name: Distracted at work during the day.
events.description: I went to work with dark circles under my eyes. While operating the CNC machine, I zoned out several times and almost entered the wrong parameters. Fortunately, my master Sun Jianguo reminded me in time. During the lunch break, I sat alone in a corner of the workshop in a daze, with no appetite to eat.

events.name: Review PLC ladder diagrams in the evening.
events.description: After returning home in the evening, he forced himself to open his laptop and the simulation software to practice basic ladder diagrams such as motor start/stop and traffic lights, but his thinking was sluggish, and debugging a program took twice as long as usual.

events.name: Comprehensive mock exam practice.
events.description: Then I did a mock exam paper covering PLC and drafting. Because I was in poor form, I got many questions wrong. While correcting them I felt frustrated, and closing the book, I felt there was little hope of passing.

events.name: Anxious Again Before Bed
events.description: Lay down at midnight, still calculating expenses in my head. Though exhausted, I couldn't relax and tossed and turned until past 2 a.m. before finally falling asleep, with intermittent sleep.

start_state.mood: Drowsy and exhausted, forcing himself to perk up and get ready for work.

end_state.location: Bedroom of the rental apartment on Guangfulin Road
end_state.mood: Frustration and self-doubt; poor review results only made the anxiety worse.

state.daily_exercise: None

2025-08.daily_overview: Second night of insomnia. After waking up with a start in the early morning, I kept going over my financial situation. I made mistakes at work during the day. On Qixi Festival, I gave Lin Yue a gift; both of us were moved during the video call, but the financial pressure did not ease. In the evening, I prepared my exam supplies, and before bed I still had to battle anxiety.

events.name: Midnight awakening and financial settlement
events.description: Woke up again with a start at 2 a.m., and in the dark carefully calculated monthly income and expenses: annual salary 120,000 yuan, monthly mortgage 8,000, remaining living expenses just over 2,000. I imagined a scenario of losing my job and defaulting on the mortgage, and fear spread.

events.name: Made small mistakes at work during the day
events.description: Because of sleep deprivation, he felt dizzy and light-headed, and made a small mistake while adjusting the machine tool parameters. Shift leader Wang Lei kindly reminded him. During the lunch break, he didn't go to the cafeteria and smoked alone outside the workshop (he rarely smoked), then called his childhood friend Zhang Wei to vent his stress. Zhang Wei advised him that things would work out in the end.

events.name: Qixi Festival gift delivery.
events.description: At 10 a.m., a Flowerplus courier delivered the roses and preserved-flower music box to the front desk of Lin Yue's company, and a colleague accepted them on her behalf. After she got off work, Lin Yue saw the signature and placed them beside her workstation.

events.name: Opened gifts via video call in the evening.
events.description: At 8 p.m., Yin Hao had a WeChat video call with Lin Yue. Lin Yue opened the gift in front of the camera and was moved to tears. Yin Hao awkwardly hummed a few lines of Confession Balloon, and Lin Yue smiled through her tears. The two poured out their longing for each other. Lin Yue said she would try to transfer to Shanghai next year. The video call lasted about 40 minutes, with a warm atmosphere.

events.name: Final review before the exam
events.description: After the video, I suppressed my anxiety and did a complete set of mock exam questions (following the exam time limit). After grading, I checked for gaps and filled them. Then I organized an exam emergency kit: copying the key points of the five major question modules onto A4 paper.

events.name: Checking exam supplies
events.description: Put ID card, admission ticket, pen, 2B pencil, eraser, calculator, and drawing ruler into a document folder. Used phone navigation to plan tomorrow morning's driving route, estimating 40 minutes to reach the exam center. Everything was ready, but after lying down his thoughts were still racing, and he only fell into a light sleep at 2:30 a.m.

events.name: Search for part-time job information
events.description: Before going to bed, I searched for side jobs on my phone again (such as weekend repair work) to try to increase my income, which only made me more anxious.

start_state.mood: Headache, restless and annoyed; managed to drag myself up, but I have no confidence in the upcoming exam

end_state.location: Bedroom of the rental apartment on Guangfulin Road
end_state.mood: A mix of emotion and exhaustion, worried about how the exam tomorrow would go, pressure weighing on the chest.

state.daily_exercise: None

2025-08.daily_overview: On the day of the senior technician theory exam, in the early morning he messaged Lin Yue on WeChat to strengthen their relationship, then drove to the exam. Answering questions went smoothly overall, but PLC was uncertain. After the exam, he ran into a colleague and chatted. In the afternoon he continued viewing apartments, and in the evening compiled a comparison of listings. His insomnia remained unsolved, so he started trying meditation to fall asleep.

events.name: Message Lin Yue on WeChat early in the morning.
events.description: Waking up in the morning, I sent Lin Yue a WeChat message to express my love. Lin Yue replied about how moved she felt from last night, and we went on to talk about plans to live together after reuniting next year. The atmosphere was warm.

events.name: Going to take the exam
events.description: Got up at 6:30, had a simple breakfast, drove from Guangfulin Road at 7:00, took Xinzhuang Highway and then the Humin Elevated Road, arrived at Shanghai Vocational Skill Appraisal Center at 7:45, and found the exam room.

events.name: Took the theory test.

He was confident in most of the modules, including CNC maintenance principles, PLC programming, and mechanical drawing, but was unsure about two PLC programming questions and did his best to write them out. After the exam, he submitted the paper as required.

events.name: Met Wang Lei at the exam site
events.description: After walking out of the exam hall, I met colleague Wang Lei at the door, who had also come to take the exam. We exchanged views on the exam difficulty, both felt the PLC paper was tough, and parted after wishing each other well.

events.name: View old town properties in the afternoon.
events.description: After lunch, at 2 p.m., I viewed an 83 m² unit at Tongji City Yazhu on Rongle Middle Road and an 85 m² two-bedroom at Fangzhouyuan Sancun with Xiao Zhang, an agent from Pacific Century Real Estate. I found that although the old town had lower unit prices, its environment and facilities were not as good as those in the university town area, so I leaned toward the new town.

events.name: Evening: organize house viewings and exam preparation.
events.description: After returning home, he ranked the 8 apartments he had viewed by scoring them on various criteria, shortlisted 2-3 promising ones, and consulted via WeChat about property status checks and loan policies. Meanwhile, he made a to-do list for the practical exam and prepared to contact Teacher Liu Jianjun.

events.name: Tried meditation to fall asleep
events.description: Insomnia at night did not improve. Before bed, I tried listening to white noise and guided meditation audio. Although the effect was limited, my mood calmed a bit, and I didn't fall asleep until 3 a.m.

2025-08.daily_overview: On the rest day, I helped Chen Jianguo at the repair shop fix a microwave, and also helped Aunt Chen, my neighbor, fix an electric fan. In return, I got dumplings and praise. In the afternoon, I sorted out my personal finances and began to face the monthly mortgage payment gap. After a phone call with my parents, I felt a bit calmer. My meditation gradually got better, and I fell asleep earlier.

events.name: Helping Chen Jianguo fix the microwave
events.description: In the morning, at the invitation of repair shop owner Chen Jianguo, went to Lao Chen Convenience Repair Shop to help. Under Master Chen's guidance, disassembled a high-voltage transformer for the first time, used a multimeter to detect a damaged fuse and capacitor, and after replacing them, successfully repaired the no-heating fault.

events.name: Chen Jianguo suggested a part-time job.
events.description: After the repair, Chen Jianguo praised Yin Hao for being quick to learn and suggested he come to the shop part-time to repair small household appliances. Yin Hao was tempted but clearly said he would prioritize his main job and certification exams.

events.name: Repairing the electric fan for Aunt Chen
events.description: In the afternoon, the neighbor Aunt Chen came knocking for help because her old electric fan wouldn’t turn. Yin Hao brought his tools over, opened the back cover and measured it, and found that the starting capacitor was bulging and had failed. He rode his e-bike to the electronics market and bought a capacitor of the same specification (1.5μF/450V). After soldering it in, the fan started working again.

events.name: Receive dumplings and chat
events.description: After fixing the fan, Aunt Chen insisted on giving him a box of celery and pork dumplings as thanks. The two chatted in the hallway for ten minutes about everyday topics such as property management and the breakfast shop. Yin Hao felt the warmth of the neighborhood.

events.name: Sort out finances and increase income while reducing expenses
events.description: In the evening, he opened the mortgage calculator and expense-tracking app again, compared the monthly payment calculated on August 20 with the tight budget set on August 1, and found that as long as he strictly controlled non-essential spending and relied on weekend part-time repair work, the monthly payment gap had narrowed to an acceptable range.

events.name: Video call with parents
events.description: In the evening, he video-called his parents. His mother advised him not to push himself too hard and said the family would help support the down payment. His father told him that a reliable buyer had been found for the old house; if all went smoothly, the deal could be completed next month. Of the expected 600,000 yuan, his father would first give him 400,000 yuan for the down payment, and keep the remaining 200,000 yuan at home as an emergency fund. If the monthly mortgage payments became really difficult, he could use it at any time. After hanging up, Yin Hao felt a warmth in his heart and sat alone for a while.

events.name: Meditation practice improvement
events.description: Played white noise and a guided meditation before bed. This time I was more focused, and my anxiety was reduced. I fell asleep at around 1:30 a.m., a clear improvement over the previous two days.

start_state.mood: Tired but happy to help others, slightly looking forward to a relaxing day

end_state.location: Bedroom of the rental apartment on Guangfulin Road
end_state.mood: Gained comfort from helping neighbors, saw hope after sorting out finances, and sleep improved slightly.

2025-08.daily_overview: After the early-morning running club activity, I drove to pick up my brother and his family and visit the Guangfulin Ruins, acting as the guide and sharing its history. My nephew was lively and adorable. At dinner in a Shanghai-style restaurant, we chatted about family matters, and my brother asked about the progress of my house purchase. The family reunion dispelled the previous gloom.

events.name: Running club morning run
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, went to Songjiang Sports Center for a group run. Completed 8 kilometers with fellow runners including Chen Jie, at a pace around 6:00 per kilometer, chatting while running, and agreed on interval training for next week.

events.name: Picking up my older brother and his family.
events.description: After running, go home to take a shower and change clothes, set off by car at 7:30 toward Suzhou, pick up elder brother Yin Tao, sister-in-law Wang Li, and 4-year-old nephew Yin Zixuan at the highway exit at 9, then head directly to Guangfulin.

events.name: Visit the Guangfulin Ruins
events.description: Yin Hao and his family entered the park at 10 a.m. Yin Hao deliberately took them to visit the underwater museum, ancient building complex, and archaeological ruins in turn, explaining the history based on materials he had looked up in advance. His nephew was excited about the fish in the underwater exhibition hall, running and laughing. During the tour, his older brother asked about the progress of the house purchase. Yin Hao described the house viewings and monthly mortgage pressure in detail. His brother said that 50,000 yuan of emergency loan was available at any time. The whole visit took about 4 hours, and they left at 3 p.m.

events.name: Dinner gathering
events.description: In the evening, they went to the reserved Songjiang local cuisine restaurant and ordered home-style dishes such as braised pork belly, sea bass, and xiaolongbao. During the meal, his older brother praised Yin Hao for being independent and organized, his sister-in-law told him to take care of his health, and his nephew said, "Uncle, your new home is so big." Yin Hao felt warm at heart. They talked about their parents' health and agreed to meet again on National Day. The dinner ended at 8:30 PM, and he sent his brother's family to a nearby hotel.

events.name: After returning home, had a brief exchange of messages with Lin Yue
events.description: Back in the rented apartment, he sent a WeChat message to Lin Yue sharing a funny story about his nephew. Lin Yue replied, "Adorable!" He meditated before bed and fell asleep at 23:00.

start_state.mood: In high spirits; the family day fills me with anticipation.

My brother reminded me to rest, and my nephew called me Second Uncle and said to fly the drone again next time. It was almost evening when I returned to Songjiang.

events.name: Organize photos and videos

events.name: Share to the family group

His mother said, “Zixuan has grown taller,” and his father commented, “The photos look professional.” Yin Hao replied to each one, and the atmosphere was warm and harmonious.

2025-08.daily_overview: Yin Hao successfully proposed installing fitness equipment at the owners' committee meeting. In the evening, while celebrating his mother's birthday, he learned that the old family house had been sold and that his mother was feeling dizzy. The family matters stirred complicated emotions. He stayed up late handling supplementary materials for the bank and resolved to adjust his diet starting tomorrow.

events.name: Draft and submit a proposal to install fitness equipment in the residential community
events.description: After work, Yin Hao organized in his home study the plan he had been thinking about over the weekend. Using his computer, he drew a simple diagram of the parallel bars and walking machine on the open ground east of the residential complex, estimated the cost at about 3,500 yuan, and wrote a short proposal including the background of residents' needs and expected effects, preparing to bring it to the evening owners' committee meeting.

events.name: Attended the monthly meeting of the owners' committee and gained support for the proposal.
events.description: From 18:00 to 19:30, Yin Hao attended the monthly meeting of the residential complex owners' committee on time. At the meeting, he stood up and clearly presented the proposal to Director Zhang, Committee Member Li, and others, emphasizing that the equipment would take up little space, require low maintenance, and benefit the elderly and children. After a brief discussion, the proposal received majority support. Director Zhang immediately arranged for Property Manager Zhao to implement it as soon as possible and promised to report on the progress next month. Yin Hao felt a surge of pride at contributing to the community.

events.name: Video-called mother to wish her a happy birthday and learned news about the old house and her health
events.description: After the meeting, Yin Hao returned home and made a WeChat video call to his mother at 19:35, discovering his father was also beside her. He sent birthday wishes and asked whether the massage device sent in early September last week had arrived; his mother smiled and said it was very comfortable to use. Unexpectedly, his mother casually mentioned feeling dizzy occasionally over the past few days. Yin Hao immediately became alert, suspecting it was a precursor to high blood pressure, and repeatedly urged his father to take her to the hospital for a check-up as soon as possible. His father then told him big news: the old house in their hometown of Rudong had been sold and the contract signed. On hearing this, Yin Hao felt a whirl of emotions—relieved that his parents were about to improve their lives, yet wistful that the old house carrying his childhood memories had changed hands.

events.name: Sharing the complicated feelings about selling the old house with Lin Yue
events.description: After ending the video call, Yin Hao sat alone on the sofa for a moment. He couldn't help sending Lin Yue a WeChat message, thanking her for helping choose the massager, then mentioning that the house in his hometown had been sold and he felt a little empty. Lin Yue quickly replied: "Your childhood is still there, just accompanying you in a different form. We'll have a home of our own someday." These words soothed Yin Hao's loss a little.

events.name: Stayed up late to sort out supplementary materials for the bank.
events.description: After calming down, Yin Hao remembered that the bank manager had sent a WeChat reminder that morning that he needed to submit the down payment source statement and the updated income certificate as soon as possible. He quickly pulled the materials out of his document bag, filled in the forms, scanned the files, and wrote a detailed explanation of the source of the home purchase funds, then emailed it to the bank. This whole process lasted until nearly midnight.

events.name: Decided to adjust his diet to address energy and weight issues.
events.description: After finishing his banking errands, Yin Hao reviewed his recent condition: he had been eating takeout and staying up late, felt sleepy in the morning, and his weight was trending upward. He made up his mind to bring a healthy packed lunch starting tomorrow (September 16). He searched several high-protein, low-fat recipes on his phone, planned lunches mainly of boiled broccoli, chicken breast, and multigrain rice, and made a shopping list. He also downloaded a diet tracking app and set daily limits for calorie and fat intake.

start_state.mood: He was looking forward to the homeowners' committee proposal and his mother's birthday, but lack of sleep made him somewhat weary.

end_state.location: On the bed in the rental room
end_state.mood: The sense of achievement from the approved proposal was mixed with nostalgia over the sale of the old house and worry about my mother's health; though physically exhausted after staying up late, I was mentally determined and resolved to improve my health to build strength for the future

events.name: Encountered and saw through a scam call
events.description: At 9 a.m., at home, received a call from someone claiming to be from the Shanghai Public Security Bureau. The caller accurately stated his identity information and claimed that Yin Hao was suspected of money laundering and needed to cooperate with the investigation. He was flustered at first, but then suddenly remembered the community anti-fraud campaign, immediately hung up, and proactively called 96110 for advice. After confirming that it was a typical scam impersonating police, prosecutors, and courts, he breathed a sigh of relief and wrote down the police tips.

events.name: Post an anti-fraud reminder and change the password.

In the afternoon, he checked his bank, Alipay, WeChat and other accounts one by one, changed them to more complex passwords, and enabled two-step verification to upgrade security.

2025-07.daily_overview: On Friday, Yin Hao had a highlight moment in solving a technical problem. After an entire day of focused debugging, he finally solved on his own the interface latency issue that had troubled him for a week, earning his mentor's recognition. In the evening, while sharing his joy with his girlfriend, he once again felt family pressure. Professional achievement and emotional worries went hand in hand.

events.name: Morning core training and a light morning run

events.name: Independently solved the MES interface latency issue
events.description: In the morning, he focused on debugging at his workstation. Based on last night's plan, he modified the cache parameters of the protocol conversion module. After several rounds of log analysis and segment-by-segment testing, he finally located the root cause: the cache pre-allocation was too small, causing frequent swapping. He independently adjusted it to a reasonable value, and in actual tests the latency dropped sharply from 300ms to 50ms, and packet loss disappeared.

events.name: Master Sun accepted the work and praised it.
events.description: In the afternoon, Master Sun Jianguo came to the workstation and personally ran 3 functional tests, confirming that the data interaction was stable and smooth. He patted Yin Hao on the shoulder, praised his noticeably improved diagnostic ability, and on the spot designated him as the person in charge of the subsequent joint debugging.

events.name: Organize debugging notes into assessment cases
events.description: In the evening, in his home study, he recorded the whole day's debugging process, technical key points, modified parameters, and the master's comments in detail in a notebook, planning to use it as typical case material for the practical essay portion of the senior technician examination.

Her words revealed worry, and the atmosphere turned from joy to slight heaviness.

Yin Hao operated carefully and recorded three measurement data points.

events.name: Fill out the maintenance log and archive it.

2025-07.daily_overview: Typhoon In-Fa hit Shanghai, and his mother was stranded due to train suspensions; the company notified everyone to leave work early in the morning; in the afternoon the wind and rain intensified, the ceiling of the rented apartment leaked badly, and mother and son worked hard to deal with the danger, also helping neighbor Aunt Chen and contacting Chen Jianguo to check the building's electrical circuits; a conflict with the landlord occurred and he recorded evidence, and in emotional turmoil he had a video argument with Lin Yue.

events.name: Mother was stranded due to the typhoon.
events.description: At 6:30, Yin Hao received a notice of railway suspension and reassured his mother to stay. At 7:30, he went to work as usual, while his mother followed the typhoon news at home.

events.name: Early dismissal from work and typhoon preparedness.
events.description: At 9:00 a.m., the company announced a halt to work in the afternoon, and at 11:00 all employees left work early. Yin Hao hurried home, reinforced the windows with tape together with his mother, moved in the balcony clutter, stored drinking water, and fully charged the power banks.

events.name: Ceiling leak and mother-son emergency response
events.description: At 14:00 in the afternoon, when the wind and rain were at their heaviest, water suddenly leaked from the seam in the living room ceiling. The mother and son hurriedly moved the sofa and appliances away and placed buckets to catch the water. The leak grew worse, large pieces of wall covering fell off, and the mother, heartbroken that her son had to live in such poor rental conditions, lost control of her emotions and burst into tears.

events.name: Yin Hao Contacts Landlord and Conflict Erupts
events.description: At 14:30, Yin Hao took photos and then called the landlord Li Xiuying to request repairs and compensation. Li Xiuying dodged responsibility by citing the typhoon as force majeure, claiming, "Renting is just like this; if you are not satisfied, you can move out." Yin Hao suppressed his anger, calmly made a recording to preserve evidence, and clearly told her that he would assert his rights in accordance with the lease contract. After more than ten minutes of deadlock, the two parted on bad terms.

events.name: Ask Master Chen Jianguo for help and troubleshoot the circuit
events.description: At 15:10, Yin Hao contacted Chen Jianguo, the owner of the appliance repair shop. Master Chen hurried over in the rain, checked the indoor circuit safety for free, and instructed him to temporarily cover the leaking spot with plastic sheeting. Then the two inspected the hallway meter boxes floor by floor, used a multimeter to detect and handle two damp hazards.

events.name: Helped neighbor Aunt Chen drain water
events.description: At 15:40, Aunt Chen from across the hall called for help; her home was seriously flooded. Yin Hao and Master Chen went over to help prop up the furniture and drain water with mops. It took about an hour, and Aunt Chen was extremely grateful.

events.name: Mother informed Father by phone.
events.description: At 16:30, after her mother's mood had calmed a little, she called her father Yin Jianguo, tearfully telling him about the leaking rental apartment. Her father comforted her and said he would find a way to support their son's home purchase.

events.name: Had a video call argument with my girlfriend Lin Yue.
events.description: At 5:30 PM, his girlfriend Lin Yue video-called him. Seeing the messy scene, she felt distressed and urged Yin Hao to accept help from his family. Yin Hao, under pressure for days, exploded emotionally and ended the video call, and the two fell into a cold war.

start_state.mood: He was somewhat nervous about the typhoon, but after his mother was stranded, this turned into a determination to deal with it together.

end_state.location: Bedroom in the rented home (under the temporarily laid leak-proof cloth)
end_state.mood: Feeling a mix of exhaustion, anger, and frustration, deeply tired of renting, but kept the evidence to leave room for later negotiation

state.daily_exercise: None (due to typhoon)

2025-07.daily_overview: On the first day after the typhoon, Yin Hao took leave and stayed home. In the morning, he received thanks from neighbor Aunt Chen; he contacted Chen Jianguo for advice on emergency repairs. In the afternoon, he drove alone to buy materials and patched the ceiling himself; his mother helped thoroughly clean up the indoor water. In the evening, following his mother's suggestion, he tried meditation and yoga to relax.

events.name: Aunt Chen came to the door to express her thanks.
events.description: At 9:00 in the morning, Aunt Chen from across the hall came to Yin Hao's home with zongzi she had wrapped herself, thanking him for his help yesterday. Yin Hao accepted them politely, and the neighborly relationship became even more harmonious.

events.name: Contact Chen Jianguo to ask for advice on repairs.
events.description: At 10:00, Yin Hao contacted Chen Jianguo via WeChat, described in detail the location and material of the ceiling leak, and asked for a temporary way to stop the leak. Master Chen suggested buying waterproof paint and sealant, and explained the key points for applying them.

events.name: Purchase repair materials.
events.description: After lunch at 12:30, Yin Hao drove to the Songjiang building materials market and bought waterproof coating, sealant, brushes, and other tools according to the list, spending about 320 yuan. He paid by phone and asked for an invoice for later negotiations with the landlord.

events.name: Repaired the ceiling on his own
events.description: After coming home at 14:00, Yin Hao turned off the circuit breaker, cleaned loose wall plaster, applied waterproof coating, and filled in sealant. His mother handed him tools from the side. The repair lasted about two hours, and the leak was basically brought under control.

events.name: Mother helped clean up the accumulated water and moisture-damaged items.
events.description: In the afternoon, his mother used a mop, bucket, and absorbent towels, and together with Yin Hao, drained the remaining water in the living room and bedroom, wiped the damp walls and furniture with dry cloths, and opened all windows to speed up drying.

events.name: Tried meditation and yoga in the evening
events.description: After dinner at 20:00, his mother noticed Yin Hao seemed tense and suggested meditating with his phone. At 21:45 Yin Hao did a 15-minute meditation in the bedroom using the Tide app, then did 10 minutes of basic yoga stretching, which relaxed his shoulders, neck and lower back.

start_state.mood: Slightly calmer, but still anxious about dealing with the aftermath of the water leak.

end_state.location: Bedroom of the rental apartment
end_state.mood: Anxiety eased, and he felt slightly more relaxed after the first meditation.

events.name: Manually transferred funds into Yu'ebao for savings

events.name: Abdominal breathing exercise before bedtime

start_state.mood: Energetic in the morning, eager to exercise to release stress.

end_state.location: Bedroom of the rental apartment
end_state.mood: The refreshing feeling after exercise and the reassuring sense of financial progress moving forward steadily.

2025-07.daily_overview: On Sunday, the mother and son continued the post-incident cleanup, drying the soaked books and contacting a repairman; in the morning Yin Hao joined the running club for a 10-kilometer group run; in the evening he took the initiative to end the cold war with Lin Yue, opened up during a video call, and their relationship visibly improved; before bed he persisted with abdominal breathing.

events.name: 10 km group run with the running club
events.description: At 6:20 Yin Hao arrived at the university town sports ground and met up with members of the Songjiang Machinery Running Group. Because of the early summer heat, the group run officially started at 6:30. The route was the tree-lined avenue of the university town, with a pace of 5 minutes 25 seconds per kilometer. They completed 10 kilometers, then chatted and stretched together after the run.

events.name: Air-drying books and scheduling a repair.
events.description: Yin Hao replaced Liu Fang’s phone battery and eased their relationship.

events.name: Yin Hao took the initiative to contact Lin Yue and reconcile
events.description: After three days of cold war, at 6:00 p.m. Yin Hao sent Lin Yue a WeChat message asking if she was free for a video call and saying he wanted to have a proper talk. After Lin Yue agreed, he made the video call at 8:00 p.m. He first apologized for hanging up on her before, admitting that he had lost control of his emotions. The two talked candidly about the loneliness of a long-distance relationship and the pressures of reality. Lin Yue admitted that she was under a lot of pressure too; her father asked about Yin Hao on every phone call, and she didn't know how to answer. After a moment of silence, Yin Hao said, "Give me a year. Before next Spring Festival, I'll have something to show for it." Lin Yue broke into a smile through her tears and said, "I'll wait for you — not for how much money you make, but because I want you to be willing to carry it together with me." The call lasted more than an hour, and the mood shifted from tension to understanding. They agreed to communicate calmly from then on.

events.name: Heartwarming news and reflections after reconciliation
events.description: The video call ended at 21:30. Yin Hao calmed himself down, sent Lin Yue a goodnight message, and recorded his reflections on the conversation in his phone's memo app, resolving to share stress more proactively.

events.name: Abdominal breathing exercise before bedtime
events.description: At 22:00, Yin Hao did a 5-minute abdominal breathing exercise in the bedroom. The continuous relaxation training helped quiet his mind, and his sleep time moved earlier to around 23:15.

start_state.mood: Feeling gloomy because of housing issues and the cold strategy.

end_state.location: Bedroom of the rental apartment
end_state.mood: Relieved after repairing the relationship, hopeful about tomorrow's repair work, and more resolute because of the promise

During this period, he read the advanced PLC programming cases shared by Teacher Liu Jianjun.

At 9:00 he lay on the blood collection chair and donated 200 ml of whole blood. During the process he was told his blood type was O Rh-positive. The doctor advised him to avoid strenuous exercise and drink plenty of water for three days. After a 15-minute observation period with no discomfort, he received a blood donation card and a nutritional gift box issued by the company union.

events.name: Returned to the company for handover and got compensatory leave
events.description: At 10:00, Yin Hao returned to the company, went to the union office with his blood donation certificate to register, received a nutrition gift box (milk, red dates, oats), and was granted half a day of compensatory leave, which could be used that afternoon. After briefly explaining the situation to his team, he went home to rest.

events.name: Clearing out items that cannot be repaired
events.description: At 14:00, Yin Hao and his mother inspected the items that had been dried over the past few days one by one. They wiped the still-usable books with alcohol and put them back on the shelves, folded the clothes and put them away; they packed the completely soaked books, moldy clothes, and deformed small furniture, planning to contact the property management for removal on the weekend.

events.name: Master Sun came to visit after work
events.description: At 18:30 in the evening, Master Sun Jianguo came specially to Yin Hao's home after work. Seeing the room still being put in order, he sighed, "This is how renting is—it's not easy!" He advised Yin Hao that in the long run, he should have his own house. These words made Yin Hao think more deeply about the limitations of renting.

events.name: Check the drone and prepare for aerial photography.
events.description: After dinner at 8 p.m., Yin Hao took out the drone, checked the battery level and memory card capacity, and used a mobile map to plan tomorrow's flight route over the Guangfulin Ruins, setting shooting points such as the underwater museum and Zhiye Zen Temple. His mother looked at the drone with curiosity and asked about it. Yin Hao said he would take her flying to take photos tomorrow, and his mother showed an expectant smile.

start_state.mood: Confident in his body and willing to help others.

end_state.location: Bedroom of the rental apartment
end_state.mood: Slight fatigue after donating blood, but anticipation of tomorrow's photo shoot masked it; thoughts about buying a house lingered.

state.daily_exercise: None (rest as advised by the doctor).

2025-07.daily_overview: On Friday, Yin Hao took a day off to accompany his mother. In the morning, he used a drone to take aerial photos and group photos with his mother at the Guangfulin Ruins and the underwater museum. At noon, they enjoyed local Shanghainese cuisine. In the afternoon, they went home to clean up and organize the photos. In the evening, he cast the photos to the screen to relive the moments, and his mother was very happy.

events.name: Depart for Guangfulin Ruins.
events.description: At 7:30 in the morning, after Yin Hao and his mother had breakfast, he brought the drone, spare batteries, and water, and drove a car along Guangfulin Road to Guangfulin Cultural Heritage Park. On the way, Yin Hao told his mother about today's shooting plan.

events.name: Drone aerial group photo and underwater museum
events.description: At 9:00, they arrived at the Heritage Park, and Yin Hao flew the drone in an open area. First, he took an aerial shot of the entire underwater museum; his mother praised, "High-tech is really amazing." Then he adjusted the angle to take a group photo of his mother and himself, and also took several close-up photos of his mother's smile and panoramic views of the ruins. His mother kept smiling at the phone screen and said she would send the photos to his father.

events.name: Park walk and lunch
events.description: After the aerial photography, the mother and son took a walk in the heritage park and visited ground attractions such as Zhiye Zen Temple and Fulin Tower. At noon, Yin Hao took his mother to the underwater dining area beside the park to enjoy Shanghai local cuisine and soup dumplings. His mother was very pleased.

events.name: Afternoon photo backup and simple editing
events.description: After returning home at 14:00, Yin Hao imported the data from the drone's memory card into his laptop, backed it up by category, and adjusted the brightness and cropping of a few group photos. His mother sat beside him watching. Yin Hao promised to print and frame the one he liked best.

events.name: Evening memories and sharing
events.description: After dinner, Yin Hao cast selected photos and videos to the TV and relived the moments with his mother. His mother was especially happy and kept praising how great high technology is. Yin Hao picked a few and posted them to the family group and Moments. In the family group, his father and brother all liked the posts.

start_state.mood: Feeling motivated, wanting to give his mother a wonderful memory

end_state.location: Bedroom of the rental apartment
end_state.mood: The bond between mother and son was deeply gratified, and the shadow of the typhoon temporarily lifted.

state.daily_exercise: None (still following medical advice the day after blood donation).

2025-07.daily_overview: On Saturday, the home-buying plan officially kicked off: Yin Hao called to consult about bank loan policies and checked his own credit report; in the afternoon he tidied his room in preparation for a video call with his father; in the evening he went to KTV with Gao Zhiyuan and Ma Xiaofeng to sing and relieve the pressure of the past few days.

events.name: Called to consult about home purchase loan policies.
events.description: At 9:00 a.m., after listing questions such as down payment ratio, interest rate, and combined loan in his phone memo, Yin Hao called the loan consultation number of Bank of China Shanghai Songjiang Sub-branch. The account manager explained the first-home mortgage policy in detail, stated the provident fund loan ceiling and the current interest rate after adding basis points to the LPR, and reminded Yin Hao to check his credit report first to ensure there were no adverse records. The call lasted about 15 minutes.

events.name: Checked my personal credit report online.
events.description: At 10:00, Yin Hao opened his laptop, logged on to the official website of the Credit Reference Center of the People's Bank of China, and submitted a credit inquiry application after identity verification. After the report was generated, he carefully checked the credit records and public records, confirmed there were no overdue payments and the credit score was good, and gained more confidence in getting a mortgage to buy a house.

events.name: Tidying up the room to prepare for a video call
events.description: At 14:00, Yin Hao spent two hours thoroughly cleaning the rented room, especially tidying up the bedroom and living room, and checking the repaired ceiling and electrical circuits. This made the room much tidier, in preparation for the video call with his father later that day.

events.name: Singing KTV with friends to relieve stress
events.description: At 17:30 in the evening, Yin Hao drove to Songjiang Baoledi KTV and met up with Gao Zhiyuan and Ma Xiaofeng around 18:00. The three booked a medium room. Yin Hao ordered “Boundless Oceans, Vast Skies” and shouted out his recent stress, earning applause. Between songs, they caught up; Yin Hao shared his typhoon experience, and Gao Zhiyuan comforted him, “Everything will be fine.” After it ended at 21:00, Yin Hao paid with a mobile coupon for about 200 yuan.

start_state.mood: Determined to advance the home purchase plan, slightly nervous in the morning

end_state.location: Bedroom of the rental apartment
end_state.mood: Yin Hao drove his family car, carrying his girlfriend Lin Yue, and set off from his home in Songjiang, Shanghai. They took the Shanghai-Chongqing Expressway, turned onto National Highway G104, and arrived at the Mogan Mountain Scenic Area about 3 hours later. At the parking lot of the booked Green Bamboo Mountain Residence guesthouse, they met up with his former comrades Zhang Jianguo and Zhou Xiaofeng, who had arrived earlier. The four of them checked in, distributed the rooms, and after briefly organizing their luggage, they sat in the guesthouse courtyard drinking tea and chatting, discussing the itinerary for the next few days. In the evening, Yin Hao took Lin Yue for a walk around the guesthouse to get familiar with the surroundings. At night, the four sat around the guesthouse terrace, drinking beer, recalling their army days, and talking until late at night.

state.daily_exercise: None

2025-07.daily_overview: On Sunday, his father Yin Jianguo called to say that he had decided to sell the family home in their hometown and promised to use part of the proceeds from the sale to help Yin Hao with the down payment for a house. Yin Hao showed the new look of his rental apartment via video and reported on his savings progress. The father and son had an in-depth discussion about the home-buying plan and agreed on a fixed weekly time to stay in touch. In the evening, Yin Hao went out for a walk and reviewed the home-buying decision.

events.name: Father informs him of the decision to sell the house
events.description: At 10:00 in the morning, Yin Jianguo called from his hometown in Rudong, saying that he had entrusted an agent to list the Rudong house for sale and that there were already interested buyers, with the transaction expected to be completed within a month. His father promised that once the money arrived, he would set aside part of it to help Yin Hao with the down payment on a house in Shanghai, telling Yin Hao to hurry up and look for a suitable place, but to act within his means and plan rationally.

events.name: Father and son video call showing the condition of the room
events.description: At 11:00, Yin Hao called his father back via WeChat video. He first showed his father the room he had just cleaned and tidied, explained in detail the lesson from the previous typhoon water leak and his current living conditions, and showed his father the savings progress he had recorded in his journal (current savings about 80,000 yuan, plus about 15,000 yuan in fund investments). His father encouraged him to work hard and, based on the anticipated proceeds from selling the house, had an initial discussion about home-buying plans, emphasizing that buying a house is a major matter and not to be too anxious.

events.name: Yin Hao records key points from the call and sets reminders
events.description: At noon, Yin Hao noted down in his phone memo the amount his father was willing to support (150,000–200,000 yuan), his own savings, and his father's advice. He also set a recurring reminder for a video call with his father every Sunday at 20:00, and began thinking about making a detailed home-buying budget plan before next year's Spring Festival.

events.name: Took an evening walk, thinking about buying a home.
events.description: After dinner at 18:00, Yin Hao went alone for a walk on the greenway around the residential area, thinking about the down payment gap, monthly mortgage payments, and work-life balance. He planned the next housing areas to visit and decided to focus on small units in Huaqiao, Kunshan, and Songjiang.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to Father's contact, yet feeling a little uneasy

end_state.location: Bedroom of the rental apartment
end_state.mood: With his father's clear support and commitment, buying a house now seemed promising. Although the sale of the house was still in progress, the path ahead had become much clearer.

state.daily_exercise: 40-minute walk

2025-07.daily_overview: Monday was a workday with plenty of tasks in the workshop. After work, Yin Hao went for his first 3-kilometer recovery jog since donating blood. In the evening, he focused on the rental app researching small-unit apartments in Huaqiao, Kunshan, shortlisted 4 options, booked viewings for the first weekend of August, and discussed the pros and cons of the properties with Master Sun on WeChat.

events.name: Daytime workshop work
events.description: After arriving at work at 8:00, Yin Hao operated two CNC machine tools to complete the new batch of machining tasks. At 10:00 a.m., he assisted Wang Lei in training a new intern on basic operations and shared operating tips. During the lunch break, he continued working on 15 questions from the technician question bank.

events.name: Recovery jogging after blood donation
events.description: After getting off work at 18:00, Yin Hao changed into sportswear and jogged 3 kilometers in the residential compound, with a pace of 6 minutes 15 seconds per kilometer. His body showed no abnormalities and he felt good. This was his first run after blood donation, and he strictly followed the doctor's advice to start at low intensity.

events.name: Filtering Huaqiao housing listings in the evening.
events.description: At 19:00 after dinner, Yin Hao opened the Lianjia app, set the search area to Huaqiao, Kunshan, and filtered for two-bedroom units with a total price of 1.2-1.5 million yuan. He carefully looked at more than a dozen residential communities, comparing transportation (Huaqiao Station on Line 11), floor plans, and construction years, and favorited 4 listings he quite liked.

events.name: Make an appointment to view the house this weekend.
events.description: At 20:00, Yin Hao consulted online with the agents of two of the listings via the app, asking about the actual usable area, property management fees, and whether the properties had been owned for at least five years and were the owners' only homes, and made an appointment to view them in person on Saturday afternoon (August 2).

events.name: WeChat discussion with Master Sun.
events.description: At 21:00, Yin Hao sent screenshots of one of the floor plans to Master Sun Jianguo. Master Sun reminded him to pay attention to the age of the property, whether it was a top-floor unit, and the decoration and maintenance costs, and gave him sensible advice. Yin Hao thanked him and decided to look at more options and compare.

start_state.mood: Slightly tired at work, but eager to move forward with the home-buying process

end_state.location: Bedroom of the rental apartment
end_state.mood: With a concrete home-viewing goal, excitement and anxiety coexist.

state.daily_exercise: Jogged 3 kilometers (recovery run after blood donation)

2025-07.daily_overview: On Tuesday, his mother confirmed her departure for the next day. During the day, she prepared a final hearty dumpling meal for Yin Hao at home, and in the afternoon she also taught him mending and storage techniques. After work, Yin Hao completed a 5-kilometer jog. In the evening, mother and son had a deep heart-to-heart talk; his mother encouraged him to work hard in Shanghai and hinted that she would support him. Although the night breeze was hot, the warmth was even stronger.

events.name: Mother makes dumplings and prepares for the return trip
events.description: Mother got up at 7:00, kneaded dough and chopped filling to prepare pork and shepherd's purse dumpling filling, wrapped a large batch of dumplings and put them in the freezer, so that Yin Hao could easily cook them for himself later. She also put the used bed sheets into the washing machine and gave her luggage a final tidy-up.

events.name: Yin Hao's daytime work and evening jog
events.description: From 8:00 to 17:00, Yin Hao completed production tasks in the workshop and, with Master Sun's permission, continued light exercise. After getting off work at 18:00 in the evening, he changed into sportswear and jogged 5 kilometers along Guangfulin Road at a pace of 6:20 per kilometer. He felt relaxed in his heart and lungs, and the blood donation had fully recovered. After the run, he stretched for 10 minutes and then went home.

events.name: Mother taught Yin Hao mending and organizing skills.
events.description: In the evening, after Yin Hao came home from running, his mother took out a sewing kit and taught him how to sew on a loose button and mend split seams, and shared tips for sorting and storing clothes (use vacuum compression bags to save space, put mothballs in the wardrobe to keep insects away). Yin Hao learned earnestly, and his mother said that living alone in Shanghai, he needed to learn to take care of himself.

events.name: Mother and son in-depth evening heart-to-heart talk.
events.description: Dinner was dumplings cooked by his mother, and the two chatted while eating. After dinner, at 20:00, mother and son sat on the sofa. His mother, Wang Xiuying, held Yin Hao's hand and said, "Haohao, Mom knows you want to rely on yourself, but your father and I only have you and Datao. When we should help, we will never hold back. Take good care of yourself in Shanghai; don't be too hard on yourself." Yin Hao agreed, saying he had already been looking at apartments and would steadily save up the down payment. The two agreed to have at least two video calls a week, and after she returned home, his mother would keep an eye on his father's health.

start_state.mood: Felt reluctant to see my mother leave

end_state.location: Bedroom of the rental apartment
end_state.mood: The soul was comforted; despite the sorrow of parting, he gained strength and practical skills.

state.daily_exercise: Jogged 5 km, stretched for 10 minutes

2025-07.daily_overview: On the day his mother was to return home, Yin Hao drove her to Shanghai Railway Station in the early morning. Before parting, she handed him a bank card containing 30,000 yuan and gave him words of advice. Yin Hao broke down in tears. After returning, he deeply felt his parents' care, and his determination to buy a house had never been stronger. That night, he began keeping a home-buying journal.

events.name: Drove mother to Shanghai Railway Station
events.description: At 6:00 in the morning, his mother Wang Xiuying did a final check of the luggage, and Yin Hao helped her carry the backpack with local specialties into the car. They set off at 6:30, drove along Jiasong South Road, and arrived at the South Square of Shanghai Railway Station at 7:10. Yin Hao parked the car and walked with his mother to the station entrance. Along the way, his mother repeatedly urged him to take care of his health and eat on time.

events.name: Mother gave me a bank card before parting
events.description: Outside the station entrance, his mother took a bank card from her inside pocket and pressed it into Yin Hao's hand, saying in a trembling voice: "Haohao, your mother and father aren't capable; we haven't saved much for you, but I put all my private money in it—30,000 yuan—to add to your down payment. A house is what gives you confidence." Yin Hao, who had been suppressing his emotions for days, broke down instantly, tears streaming down his face, and hugged his mother tightly. His mother was also choking with sobs, but afraid he would miss his train, she dried her tears and hurried into the station.

events.name: After returning home, he calmed down and reaffirmed his determination to buy a house.
events.description: At 8:00 he returned home. The rented room was empty, leaving only the neatness and the smell of cooking oil that his mother had left behind. Yin Hao sat on the sofa, looking at the bank card in his hand and a note his mother had left (written: “Mom’s backing”), and did not move for a long time. He put the card away safely and sent messages to Lin Yue and his father, telling them that his mother had boarded the train, and again expressed that he would definitely work hard to buy a house so his family could feel at ease.

events.name: In the evening, start the home-buying journal
events.description: At 21:00, Yin Hao opened the memo app on his phone and created a new note named 'Home Purchase Sprint'. He recorded how moved he was by his mother's words that day, his current savings, and the estimated support from his parents, and listed a target list of houses to view in August. He decided to record his progress daily from that day on, further tighten his living expenses, and also wrote in his diary his determination not to renew the lease.

start_state.mood: The reluctance of parting mingled with the warmth of being loved.

end_state.location: Bedroom of the rental apartment
end_state.mood: Determination after being deeply moved; goals are unprecedentedly clear, and pressure has been turned into motivation.

state.daily_exercise: None

2025-04.daily_overview: On the Tuesday workday, Yin Hao completed rehabilitation training and a 3 km recovery jog in the early morning, with no pain in his knee. During the day he operated CNC machines as usual. In the evening he began systematically researching half-marathon running shoes, comparing cushioning technologies, while sticking to evening stretching to prepare for resuming running.

events.name: Morning rehabilitation and recovery jogging.
events.description: At 6:00 a.m., Yin Hao got up, did 15 minutes of foam rolling and resistance band exercises for the gluteus medius on the yoga mat, then went out and jogged 3 kilometers along Guangfulin Road at a pace of 7 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer. He paid attention to his right knee during the run; afterward there was no pain, and his confidence increased.

events.name: Commute and daily work
events.description: At 7:30 drove to the company, attended the team morning meeting, then operated the CNC machining center to finish a batch of stainless steel bearing housings. During the lunch break in the cafeteria, discussed the debugging of new fixtures with Liu Zhiqiang.

events.name: Researching half-marathon running shoes
events.description: After getting off work, I went home and cooked vegetable noodles. At 19:30 I opened the Dewu app, systematically researched midsole cushioning technology for running shoes, and focused on comparing the specs of four shoes, including the Xtep 160X 3.0 and Li-Ning Feidian, reading reviews from fellow runners until 21:30.

events.name: Evening relaxation and reading
events.description: After the research, he played soft music, leaned against the headboard and read an article on cutting tool development trends in Modern Manufacturing magazine, turning off the light about 20 minutes later.

start_state.location: Bedroom at No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai
start_state.mood: Calm, looking forward to resuming running

After returning home, he further compared running shoe specs, and also had a video call with his girlfriend Lin Yue to finalize the specific arrangements for meeting during Qingming.

events.name: Daily work and lunchtime exchange

During the lunch break, he sat at the same table as Master Sun Jianguo, discussing the cutting difficulties of martensitic stainless steel. Master Sun suggested paying attention to the coolant concentration.

events.name: Swimming cross-training
events.description: After work at 18:00, I drove to Songjiang Natatorium and did 40 minutes of low-intensity freestyle and breaststroke as supplementary cardio during the running recovery period. My joints felt relaxed.

events.name: In-depth comparison of running shoe models.
events.description: At 19:30, returned home, opened the Dewu app, compared the midsole rebound rate, weight, and durability of four running shoes including Xtep, Li-Ning, and ASICS one by one, and looked through reviews from flat-footed runners, initially narrowing down to Xtep and ASICS.

events.name: Made a plan to meet my girlfriend at Qingming Festival
events.description: At 21:00, Lin Yue sent a WeChat message, Yin Hao called her via voice, and the two discussed that on April 4 Lin Yue would take the high-speed rail to Shanghai. Yin Hao would pick her up at the station and then they would visit the Bund and City God Temple together and taste local Shanghainese cuisine. The call lasted about half an hour.

2025-04.daily_overview: On Qingming Festival, Yin Hao had another sweet date with his long-distance girlfriend Lin Yue. After dressing up carefully, he drove to pick her up at the station. The two strolled along the Bund and visited the City God Temple together, getting along well. But Lin Yue casually mentioned that her mother hoped she would find a local Shanghai man, casting a shadow over Yin Hao's heart. In the evening, he recorded his complicated feelings alone.

events.name: Carefully preparing for the date
events.description: Got up at 7:00, washed up carefully and styled his hair with hair gel, changed into an ironed navy blue shirt and jeans, packed a box of Nantong dried clams as a gift into his backpack, checked the car, and set off.

events.name: Drive to pick up Lin Yue.
events.description: At 8:30, I drove along the G60 Shanghai-Kunming Expressway for 50 minutes and arrived at Hongqiao Railway Station. At 10:10, at the east exit of the arrivals level, I recognized Lin Yue at a glance: she was wearing a ponytail and a white hoodie. She walked over smiling. We smiled at each other, hugged, and then drove to the Bund.

events.name: Strolling on the Bund and intimate conversation
events.description: After parking, the two walked side by side on the viewing platform, talked about their jobs and their feelings about Shanghai, and took photos together. When they reached the Peace Hotel, they asked a passerby to take a photo of them.

events.name: Strolling and snacking at the City God Temple.
events.description: Passing through Gucheng Park, they walked across the Nine-Bend Bridge in Yuyuan Mall, fed koi, and tasted Nanxiang xiaolongbao and crab roe soup dumplings. Yin Hao bought a sandalwood bracelet for Lin Yue.

events.name: Felt pressure from Lin Yue's mother's expectations.
events.description: While resting at the Bagua Pavilion, Lin Yue casually mentioned that her mother always hoped she would find a local Shanghainese partner. Yin Hao's smile froze for a few seconds. He forced a natural response, then silently took a sip of soy milk, feeling heavy-hearted.

events.name: Driving back and saying goodbye.
events.description: At 16:30, he sent Lin Yue back to Hongqiao Station. Before she entered the station, she said with a smile in her eyes that she had a great day. Yin Hao watched her disappear past the ticket gates, then drove back to Songjiang alone, weighed down with thoughts all the way.

events.name: Recording feelings on a quiet night
events.description: Got home at 20:00. After showering, I opened my phone's memo app at my desk and wrote down today's little moments, including the weighty phrase 'local person.' I sat there for a long time before going to bed.

events.name: New running shoes arrived and tried on

events.name: Test jog in new shoes

events.name: Central Park bike ride

events.name: Python programming study

events.name: WeChat communication with Lin Yue to relieve stress
events.description: At 19:30 in the evening, Lin Yue proactively sent a WeChat message to ask if he was overthinking. Yin Hao admitted his stress. Lin Yue said she valued character rather than household registration and would slowly communicate with her mother. The two agreed to meet again on May Day. After the 30-minute call, Yin Hao felt much more relaxed.

2025-04.daily_overview: On Sunday, Zhang Wei, a close childhood friend, came to Shanghai from Nantong. Yin Hao did a thorough cleaning to welcome him. After picking him up at the station in the afternoon, Zhang Wei walked in and bluntly said the place was too cramped, which was a spatial shock to Yin Hao, but he still forced a smile. In the evening, the two shared a Shanghainese dinner and reminisced about old times. Their relationship was close, but there was an unspoken knot.

events.name: Clean the room to welcome Zhang Wei
events.description: In the morning, Yin Hao put on rubber gloves and thoroughly cleaned the rental apartment. He moved the folding dining table aside to free up space, spread clean sheets and pillows on the sofa, and took out spare towels and toiletries, trying to keep the small room tidy.

events.name: Receive new shoes and organize equipment
