2025-04.daily_overview: On Sunday, Yin Hao ran the Sheshan Half Marathon and finished in 1 hour 52 minutes, achieving his annual health goal and feeling a great sense of accomplishment as he crossed the finish line. However, when he returned to his rented apartment in the afternoon, the joy was gradually diluted by real-life pressure, stirring an even stronger desire to buy a home. That evening he began systematically looking at houses and calculating his financial shortfall, realizing that the half marathon was a staged victory and buying a home was the next challenge.

events.name: Half marathon pre-race preparation
events.description: At 5 a.m., Yin Hao put on his new Xtep 160X professional running shoes at home in Songjiang District, checked his race bib, energy gels, and other gear, and had a simple meal (a slice of whole wheat bread and a banana). He then drove to the starting area of Sheshan National Forest Park, jogged near the start to warm up, did dynamic stretching, and adjusted his state while waiting for the start.

events.name: Completed the Sheshan Half Marathon
events.description: At 8 a.m., Yin Hao set off from the Sheshan starting line with the other competitors in his group, running steadily at the planned race pace (about 5 minutes 20 seconds per kilometer). For the full 21.0975 kilometers, he focused on controlling his cadence and breathing, and his knee did not feel uncomfortable. He finally finished smoothly with a net time of 1 hour and 52 minutes. When he crossed the finish line, a strong sense of achievement surged through him, and he felt extremely proud of persisting in training and overcoming difficulties. This moment felt like an important coronation in his life.

events.name: Post-race recovery and social media sharing.
events.description: After crossing the finish line, Yin Hao picked up his finisher's medal and refreshment pack in the finish area. While walking slowly and stretching, he used his phone to take a selfie to record the moment. He then sent a screenshot of his results to his running friend Chen Jie via WeChat, and posted a post-race message in the local running group 'Songjiang Morning Run Group.' He received many likes and congratulations and felt the warmth of the community.

events.name: Noon return home for a simple meal and emotional ups and downs
events.description: At noon, Yin Hao drove back to his home in Songjiang District and had a simple lunch of a homemade sandwich. Sitting on the narrow living-room sofa, he first lost himself in the joy of completing the race, turning the medal over in his hands again and again. But after a moment, the pressure of reality quietly crept in — thinking about how he rented in Shanghai, earned 120,000 yuan a year, and had limited savings. Achieving the half-marathon goal made him realize he had the ability to complete stage-by-stage challenges, but it also revealed more clearly how far he was from the life he wanted. He decided to seriously begin considering buying property around Shanghai and made homeownership his next goal to conquer.

events.name: Systematically browsed property listings and did financial estimates
events.description: From afternoon to evening, Yin Hao opened the Lianjia app and focused on browsing second-hand homes in Songjiang District, especially affordable starter homes with unit prices below 30,000 yuan per square meter and total prices around 2 million yuan. He filtered by commute distance, floor level, layout, and other conditions, and saved more than ten listings. Using a calculator, he made a rough estimate: current savings of about 300,000 yuan; with a 30% down payment he would need 600,000-700,000 yuan, leaving a shortfall of about 300,000-400,000 yuan. Adding taxes and agent fees, the total gap was close to 500,000 yuan. He felt a strong sense of powerlessness and tossed and turned in bed. At night, he recorded his savings and possible borrowing sources in his notebook.

His legs still had slight soreness (delayed onset muscle soreness), so he was careful to reduce the intensity of his kicking while swimming, focusing on stretching and promoting blood circulation. He kept his heart rate at a low level to let his leg muscles fully relax. After swimming, he stretched for 10 minutes in the locker room and felt the soreness in his legs significantly relieved.

He carefully checked the average prices, floor plans, and surrounding amenities of each community, focusing on Jiuting, Sijing, and other areas. During the lunch break, he opened Anjuke again in the company cafeteria to compare listings with a similar budget. His mood dropped a bit when he saw a desirable listing that was over budget.

Dinner was still a homemade fat-reduction meal, and he kept a food diary.

The workshop director praised Yin Hao and his team at the pre-shift meeting for their voluntary overtime and efficient collaboration, and awarded the team performance points. Yin Hao and his teammates felt gratified, and the fatigue from days of overtime was completely swept away.

While changing clothes in the locker room, they started talking about buying a home. Master Sun had lived in Songjiang for more than ten years and knew the surrounding developments well. He suggested Yin Hao consider Qingpu New City or the Jiading North area, where unit prices were lower and there were future metro plans, while also reminding him to pay attention to the property rights term and developer reputation. The two walked and chatted all the way to the bus stop at the company gate. After parting, Yin Hao went straight home. On the way, he used the Lianjia app to check the communities Master Sun had mentioned and found that there were indeed some listings with total prices around 2.5 million yuan, which made him feel a little more at ease.

events.description: In the evening, when he returned to the downstairs of his rented house, Yin Hao found a large package from Rudong in the parcel locker. It was vacuum-packed braised pork, clams, and pickled vegetables sent by his mother, Wang Xiuying. He carried the package up to the attic. The fridge was stuffed full. The taste of home moved him, but the cramped space also caused storage pressure. He took photos and sent them via WeChat to thank his mother. His mother reminded him to take care of his health.

events.name: In the evening, called his parents to sound out their support for the down payment.
events.description: At 8 p.m., Yin Hao called his parents. He first asked about his father's lower back pain recovery, then tentatively asked whether the family could help with some of the down payment. After a moment of silence, his father, Yin Jianguo, said, "Wait until you're sure you want to buy; we'll discuss it then. The family will try to help a bit." His mother, Wang Xiuying, sighed beside him and said not to put too much pressure on himself. Yin Hao sensed his father's hesitation, but at least there was a preliminary commitment, and he felt conflicted. After hanging up, he updated his financial estimates in his notebook.

events.name: Morning run of 3 kilometers to test recovery.
events.description: At 6:00 in the morning, Yin Hao went on an easy 3 km recovery run at a pace of about 6:15 per kilometer. He felt no discomfort in his knees or legs, confirming that his body had largely recovered. However, after the run his throat was noticeably dry, and he had a feeling it might be the onset of a cold, so he decided to drink more water and keep an eye on it. He then stretched and prepared a fat-loss breakfast.

events.name: Routine machining in the morning and afternoon
events.description: In the morning and afternoon, Yin Hao resumed his routine production tasks, machining a batch of standard parts, with a steady work pace. He continued to bring his own fat-loss bento for lunch. However, throughout the day, the throat discomfort became increasingly noticeable, and he began clearing his throat frequently. In the afternoon, while chatting with Wang Lei in the locker room, his voice was somewhat hoarse. Wang Lei asked if he had a cold, but Yin Hao waved his hand and said it was nothing.

events.name: Evening financial planning for home purchase
events.description: At 8 p.m., Yin Hao, despite his sore throat, sat at the desk in his rented apartment, opened Excel on his laptop, and listed several down payment options: Option 1: 120,000 yuan of his own savings + 200,000 yuan from parents, a 320,000 yuan down payment for an old, rundown small apartment priced at 2.5 million yuan; Option 2: 120,000 yuan of his own savings + 200,000 yuan from parents + 80,000 yuan borrowed from a friend, a 400,000 yuan down payment for a small two-bedroom apartment priced at 2.9 million yuan; Option 3: use a combined provident fund loan to reduce monthly mortgage pressure. He calculated the monthly payment for each option and felt heavy-hearted. During the calculation, his sore throat gradually worsened, and swallowing was painful. He measured his temperature at 36.8°C with no fever and judged it to be a common upper respiratory infection. He drank a glass of warm water, decided to stop studying, and went to bed early at 22:00, taking a vitamin C tablet before sleep.

events.name: Rest at home and drink plenty of water.

For breakfast he only drank honey dissolved in warm water; for lunch he cooked plain rice porridge in a rice cooker and ate it with the pickled vegetables his mother had sent. He drank plenty of warm water throughout the day, gargled with salt water every four hours, and also took Banlangen granules.

Zhang Wei suggested that 'if the pressure is high, save up for another two years' and asked about his progress with his girlfriend Lin Yue. Yin Hao replied that they were still getting to know each other. Zhang Wei jokingly said he could buy a house in Nantong instead, where the pressure is lower, and Yin Hao politely declined.

events.name: Fourth Python study session: files and data processing.

Through an online course, he learned file reading and writing and simple data processing (such as reading CSV files and calculating averages), and tried writing a script to read a simulated data file from work (machine tool operating parameter records) for basic statistics and filtering. After the script ran successfully, he saved the code and wrote down his learning notes. This month's four study sessions were thus all completed; although progress was slow, he had persisted and built up a programming foundation.

Before bed, he had a short video call with his girlfriend Lin Yue, chatting about their respective weekends without mentioning the pressure of buying a house. At 22:30, he took cold medicine granules and went to sleep.

After work, he continued studying for exams and reading e-books, and in the evening attended a live course from the Open University of China, keeping a tight pace of life.

events.name: Received confirmation of registration for the first aid training.
events.description: In the morning, while at work, Yin Hao received a text message from the Songjiang District Red Cross confirming his successful registration for the basic first aid rescuer training, and providing the specific training time (May 10-11) and location (Songjiang District Red Cross Training Center). Yin Hao immediately took a screenshot of the notification and planned to arrange his work schedule in advance.

events.name: Morning 5 km run to regain form
events.description: At 5:30 in the morning, Yin Hao completed an easy 5-kilometer run along Guangfulin Road at a pace of 6 minutes 20 seconds per kilometer. He had no throat discomfort and confirmed he had fully recovered. He went home to stretch and prepare a fat-loss breakfast.

events.name: In the morning, consulted HR further about the talent apartment.
events.description: At 10 a.m., Yin Hao contacted HR Zhang again via WeChat Work, submitted scanned copies of his personal documents, and asked about the application progress. HR replied that they needed to wait for the company to submit applications collectively, and results were expected in May. Yin Hao felt both expectant and nervous. In the afternoon, he also searched online for actual photos of the talent apartments in Songjiang District and shared experiences of living there.

events.name: Afternoon workshop work and equipment maintenance.
events.description: In the afternoon, Yin Hao operated a CNC machine tool to complete the milling of a batch of fixing parts, then assisted Wang Lei in performing simple maintenance on the cooling system of an old machine tool, cleaning the filter screen and pipes.

events.name: National Open University livestream course in the evening and preparing training materials.
events.description: After work, Yin Hao returned home and, as required by the registration confirmation notice, took out his original ID card and one-inch bareheaded photo from the drawer, and prepared a notebook and pen for training notes. From 19:00 to 21:00, he attended the second class of the 'Fundamentals of Electrical Technology' live course for the OUC Mechanical and Electrical associate degree program, taking careful notes. After class, he read the e-book 'Introduction to Five-Axis Machining Programming' for an hour and took programming notes.

start_state.mood: Positive

end_state.location: At the desk at home
end_state.mood: Fulfilling but slightly anxious

state.daily_exercise: Morning run 5 kilometers.

2025-04.daily_overview: On the last day of April, Yin Hao reviewed his April finances in detail, found overspending, and made a May budget, transferring spare money into Yu'ebao. At the same time, still stimulated by rising housing prices, he decided to start visiting houses in person next month and prepared for a talent apartment application. Due to lack of sleep and anxiety, his weight dropped noticeably, but the fat-loss result (from 73.5 kg on April 11 to 71.0 kg) brought some comfort. He wrote down key April takeaways and May to-dos to prepare for the holiday and the future.

events.name: Month-end financial review.
events.description: On the evening of April 30, at his home in Songjiang District, Shanghai, Yin Hao took out his phone, opened the Shark Accounting app, went to the monthly bill page, and prepared to review all income and expenses for April in detail. He checked each April transaction one by one and confirmed his income was a salary of 8,000 yuan. Expenses included rent of 2,800 yuan, running shoes 799 yuan, Kindle 800 yuan, accident insurance 299 yuan, vehicle costs 750 yuan, and about 1,500 yuan for meals and other daily expenses. He calculated total expenses of 6,948 yuan, but after factoring in extra expenses such as Xtep running shoes, he actually overspent by about 948 yuan.

events.name: Develop a budget adjustment plan for May.
events.description: After checking the April bills, Yin Hao made a May budget adjustment plan to address the overspending: cut entertainment and takeout spending by 20% each, set May's entertainment budget at no more than 500 yuan and takeout budget at no more than 300 yuan, and planned to strictly control non-essential daily spending.

events.name: Transfer the emergency reserve fund to Yu'ebao
events.description: After completing the budget adjustment, Yin Hao transferred 5,000 yuan of idle funds from his bank card to Yu'ebao via mobile banking, setting the amount as an emergency reserve fund to earn stable returns and prepare for possible large expenditures in the future.

events.name: Prepare materials for the first aid responder training.
events.description: Yin Hao sorted out his original ID card and one-inch photo from the drawer, put them into a document folder together with a notebook and pen, and prepared for the first-aid training on May 10-11.

events.name: Organized talent apartment application materials
events.description: Yin Hao organized the previously collected materials required for the talent apartment application (including ID card copy, education certificate, labor contract, etc.) into a folder, put it into a document bag, and planned to officially submit the application after the May Day holiday, following up on his earlier consultation with HR.

events.name: Monthly review and May goal setting
events.description: In his phone memo, Yin Hao wrote down key April achievements: completing a half marathon, losing 2.5 kg of body fat (from 73.5 kg to 71.0 kg), studying Python 4 times, and starting the Open University of China course; he also listed May to-dos: visiting apartments in person, first aid training, and accelerating preparation for the senior technician exam.

events.name: Anxiety and decision-making about viewing apartments before bed.
events.description: On the evening of April 30, Yin Hao lay in bed tossing and turning, unable to sleep, his mind full of housing prices and down payments. He opened the Lianjia App again and saw that a two-bedroom unit in the old city area of Songjiang that he had favorited had risen from 2,680,000 yuan to 2,720,000 yuan, making him even more anxious. He calculated his current funds (120,000 from himself + 200,000 from his parents + maybe 50,000 from friends) totaling 370,000 yuan, so he could at most afford a house with a total price of 2,800,000 yuan, but few listings met the requirements. He sent “Buying a house is so hard” in the WeChat group with Wang Lei, Zhang Wei and others, and received some comfort. At midnight, he finally made up his mind: after the May Day holiday, he would start making appointments to view houses, first inspecting the 3-5 listings he was most interested in, and also prepare to apply for a talent apartment. He wrote the plan in his memo, and only then managed to fall asleep. At the same time, he realized that his recent fat-loss results (down from 73.5 kg on April 11 to 71.0 kg) might fluctuate due to stress and holiday meals, so he decided to try to keep recording his diet during the May Day holiday, while anticipating that his weight might rebound because of upcoming social activities. Since he had been anxious all day, he only ate a simple vegetable salad for dinner; combined with the previous day's exercise, his morning fasting weight dropped to 71.0 kg.

start_state.mood: Calm

end_state.location: In bed at home
end_state.mood: Anxious but determined, and worried about weight regain

state.daily_exercise: None

2025-05.daily_overview: On the first day of the May Day holiday, Yin Hao had no plans to go out and decided to use the whole day to study PLC programming in depth, laying a solid foundation for the senior technician exam. After his usual morning run, he weighed 71.2 kg, the same as last month, and felt somewhat relieved. He brewed a cup of tea and studied manuals in his study from morning to night. He also started using a bookkeeping app for budget management. In the evening, he contacted his family and his prospective girlfriend separately. Though the pace of life was tight, he felt fulfilled inside.

events.name: Morning run 5 kilometers.
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Yin Hao put on his running shoes and ran 5 km along Guangfulin Road at a pace of about 6 minutes/km. The May morning breeze was cool, and he felt no discomfort in his knees and was in good physical shape. After finishing, he went home to wash up, weighed himself briefly and recorded 71.2 kg, then ate a bowl of milk oatmeal for breakfast.

events.name: Preparing to systematically study PLC
events.description: At 8 a.m., Yin Hao walked into the study, neatly placed the PLC programming manual, notebook, and pen given to him by his mentor Sun Jianguo on the desk, turned on the desk lamp, poured a cup of boiled water, and put the calculator and scratch paper he might need within reach, creating a focused environment for a full day of study.

events.name: In the morning, studied the basic chapters of PLC
events.description: From 8:30 to 11:30, Yin Hao sat at his desk and focused on studying the first three chapters of the manual, covering the working principles of PLCs, basic logic instructions, and programming introduction. While marking key points in the manual, he recorded key knowledge points in his notebook. When encountering teaching cases, he tried to simulate the running process in his mind, gradually building a basic framework of automation control.

events.name: Have a simple meal during the lunch break.
events.description: At 11:30 a.m., Yin Hao put down the manual, went into the kitchen, and made a chicken breast salad with an air fryer, served with multigrain rice. He carried the plate to the sofa, ate while scrolling on his phone for a while, checking friends' updates and posts from WeChat public accounts in the machinery industry. After a short break, he closed his eyes and rested for half an hour.

events.name: In the afternoon, went deeper into PLC programming and ladder diagrams
events.description: From 13:00 to 17:00 in the afternoon, Yin Hao continued studying chapters 4 to 6 of the manual, focusing on ladder diagram programming language, timers, and counter applications. He took out a blank A4 sheet, manually drew several simple ladder logic diagrams, and used a pen to trace the signal flow. Where he did not understand, he put sticky notes and marked questions, planning to ask his master Sun Jianguo after the holiday.

events.name: Evening review and organizing the knowledge framework.
events.description: After dinner, from 19:00 to 21:00, Yin Hao sat on the living room sofa and went through the day's notes. Using the manual's table of contents, he organized the day's content into a mind map. He circled difficult points such as PLC scan cycle principles and set/reset instructions in red pen, and marked ladder diagram design specifications in orange pen. In the end, he produced a structured review outline. After closing the materials beside him, he felt his knowledge system had become clearer.

events.name: Start May bookkeeping and budget management.
events.description: At 21:30, Yin Hao opened the Shark Accounting app. Based on the lessons learned from reviewing April expenses, he set the total May budget to 6,000 yuan and specifically capped takeout at 800 yuan and entertainment at 500 yuan in the categories. He recorded today's expenditure and planned to strictly follow the budget starting today, controlling spending through daily records.

events.name: Video call with mother.
events.description: At 22:00 at night, Yin Hao contacted his mother Wang Xiuying in his hometown Rudong via WeChat video. He asked about his parents' health and reported his plan to study and recharge at home during May Day. His mother told him not to overwork and to pay attention to his diet. Seeing his mother's happy smile, Yin Hao felt warm inside and promised to call again in a couple of days.

events.name: Chatted with Lin Yue on WeChat
events.description: After finishing the call with his mother, Yin Hao sent a WeChat message to Lin Yue, his prospective girlfriend in Hangzhou, sharing today's study progress and future certification plans. Lin Yue replied with encouragement and revealed that she had also spent the May Day holiday at home binge-watching dramas and relaxing. The two chatted easily for half an hour, and Yin Hao fell asleep with a smile.

start_state.mood: In high spirits, ready to make full use of the holiday

end_state.location: Bedroom at home.
end_state.mood: Fulfilled and satisfied, learning was rewarding and interpersonal connections were warm

state.daily_exercise: Morning run 5 kilometers.

2025-05.daily_overview: On the second day of the holiday, Yin Hao focused on two things: the afternoon running shoe test and the evening murder mystery social event. In the morning he arranged light study on his own. In the afternoon he carefully tested the new gear at the stadium. In the evening, after playing the murder mystery game, he had dinner with the other players and consumed a moderate amount of high-calorie food; his weight rose to 73.3kg. He realized how serious it was that his diet had gotten out of control during the holiday.

events.name: Early morning check of running gear.
events.description: At 7:30 in the morning, Yin Hao got up, washed up briefly, and weighed himself, finding he was 72.2kg, slightly heavier than yesterday, probably due to holiday eating. He took the newly purchased cushioned running shoes out of the shoe box, carefully checked the lace tightness, insole fit, and midsole elasticity, and after confirming there were no flaws, put on professional running socks and running shorts. Then he ate a banana and two slices of whole-wheat bread for breakfast to store up energy for the afternoon test.

events.name: Morning: reading at home and Python preview.
events.description: From 9 to 11 a.m., Yin Hao leaned back on the sofa, opened his Kindle, and read the first two chapters of "Python Crash Course", understanding variables and simple data types. From time to time he used his phone's notes app to jot down key points such as the use of the print() function, and planned to officially start programming practice on the weekend. Weighing himself, he found he was 72.2kg, up 1kg from yesterday, which he estimated was due to holiday eating and water retention.

events.name: Simple meal preparation at noon
events.description: At noon, Yin Hao cooked a bowl of buckwheat noodles with steamed cod and oil-free mixed vegetables. After a simple meal, he took a short nap to store up energy for the afternoon exercise.

events.name: Received and confirmed Wang Lei's invitation to a script murder game
events.description: At 1 p.m., Yin Hao received a WeChat message from his colleague Wang Lei, inviting him to join a game at a murder mystery shop near Songjiang University Town that evening. The five-player game was short one person. Having never played this type of game before, and driven by curiosity and a desire to expand his social circle, he immediately replied to confirm and agreed to meet at 6:30 p.m.

events.name: Running shoe special testing at University City Stadium
events.description: At 2 PM, Yin Hao drove to the standard 400-meter track at Songjiang University Town. He first did a 10-minute dynamic warm-up, then completed a 3-kilometer tempo run at his target pace for the Sheshan Half Marathon of 5 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer. After resting for 2 minutes, he did 3 sets of 100-meter sprints. Throughout, he paid attention to how the new shoes fit and how the forefoot rebounded, noting his subjective feedback at every step.

events.name: Post-run stretching and data recording
events.description: After the run, Yin Hao did 15 minutes of static stretching beside the track, especially relaxing the quadriceps and gastrocnemius muscles. He took out his phone and noted in the fitness app: 'The new shoes have good forefoot support, no rubbing, and soft cushioning suitable for long distances.' After changing into dry clothes, he drank the electrolyte drink he had brought, then drove home to shower.

events.name: Evening drive to his murder mystery game appointment
events.description: At 6 p.m., Yin Hao changed into casual clothes and left home for the script murder mystery store near Songjiang University City. He checked real-time traffic conditions on Amap and sent Wang Lei a message in advance to let him know he was already on the way.

events.name: First experience with an immersive murder mystery game.
events.description: At 6:30 p.m., Yin Hao met up with Wang Lei and three other players at the store. Guided by the host, he drew a detective character and received a thick background story. At first he was a bit reserved, but as the storyline progressed, he gradually got into character, proactively asked for clues, analyzed the timeline, and worked with everyone to solve the puzzles. The three-and-a-half-hour game let him experience the dual joys of logical reasoning and social cooperation.

events.name: Dinner after gaming and returning home late.
events.description: The gaming session ended at 10 PM, and the group, still in high spirits, went to a nearby barbecue restaurant for a meal. Yin Hao ate a moderate amount of grilled meat and had two glasses of beer, and didn't drive back to his place in Songjiang until nearly midnight. After arriving home, he took a quick shower. When he weighed himself before bed, it had jumped to 73.3 kg. Three days of holiday eating had made his weight climb steadily, and he realized he needed to get it under control as soon as possible.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to trying new running shoes and social activities.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home.
end_state.mood: Returned home in high spirits, satisfied with both the new running shoes and the socializing.

state.daily_exercise: Tempo run 3 km + 3 sets of sprints, about 5 km total

date_attribute.weather: Overcast turning to showers, east wind force 2

2025-05.daily_overview: On the third day of the May Day holiday, Yin Hao and his fishing buddy Wu Zhiqiang participated in the Dianshan Lake fishing competition together. Although they encountered showers, their enthusiasm didn't wane, and they won third place in the amateur group through tacit cooperation. After the competition, they had a celebratory dinner together, and his weight continued to rise; when he got home, he weighed 73.8 kg. The stunning aerial footage from the drone during the competition ignited a new passion for aerial photography. After returning home, he immediately researched drone models and decided to save up to buy one. That evening, sharing the joy with Lin Yue also felt especially sweet.

events.name: Set off early in the morning for the race
events.description: At 5:30 a.m., as the sky was just beginning to lighten, Yin Hao got up, washed up quickly, and weighed himself at 73.5 kg (retained water from last night's dinner gathering). He loaded the fishing gear he had prepared the day before (rod bag, live bait box, fish basket, etc.) into the trunk. After a simple breakfast of two steamed buns, he drove to Songjiang city center at 6:00 to meet Wu Zhiqiang, and together they drove to the Dianshan Lake race venue in Qingpu.

events.name: Pre-race check-in and preparation
events.description: At 7:30 in the morning, the two arrived at the Dianshan Lake fishing competition venue. After checking in, they drew lots and were assigned to fishing spot No. 15 in Area A. Yin Hao began adjusting the float and preparing the bait, while Wu Zhiqiang set up the beach umbrella and fishing chair. A light drizzle began to fall, and they put on their outdoor jackets and continued.

events.name: Tacit cooperation during the competition and a big fish taking the bait.
events.description: The competition started at 8 a.m. Yin Hao focused on bottom fishing, while Wu Zhiqiang was responsible for bait advice and netting fish. Around 10:30, Yin Hao felt a heavy pull on the rod. After about 10 minutes of playing the fish, he successfully landed a black carp weighing about 4.2 kg, the heaviest of the entire competition. Wu Zhiqiang quickly took out the drone he carried, sent it up to film the exciting moment of Yin Hao netting the fish into the keep basket. The footage transmitted back showed the wide open lake and the thrilling scene of Yin Hao holding up the fish in celebration. Yin Hao looked up at the magnificent aerial view on the screen and felt a jolt in his heart.

events.name: Afternoon standoff and packing up the fishing rods
events.description: In the afternoon the rain gradually stopped and the fish bites became less frequent, but the two of them kept holding their fishing spots. At 3 p.m., Yin Hao caught another carp, but its weight was not advantageous. When they finally reeled in their rods, their total weight reached 11.8 kilograms.

events.name: Award presentation and event exchange
events.description: At 4 p.m. the results were announced, and Yin Hao and Wu Zhiqiang won third place in the amateur group, with a prize of 800 yuan. The two went on stage to accept the award and take a photo. Yin Hao specifically asked Wu Zhiqiang about the drone model and his experience using it. Wu Zhiqiang elaborated on the advantages of the DJI Mini series. After the competition, they exchanged tips with other fishing friends and agreed to meet up again next time.

events.name: Celebration dinner and return trip
events.description: At 5:30 p.m., the organizers arranged a dinner for participants at a nearby farmhouse restaurant, where Yin Hao again ate a good amount of braised pork and drank beer. He didn't drive back to Songjiang until 7 p.m., arriving home at almost 9 p.m. After showering, he weighed 73.8 kg; his weight had increased for three straight days of the holiday.

events.name: Evening research on drones and expense tracking
events.description: At 9 p.m., Yin Hao turned on his computer, browsed DJI's official website and Bilibili drone review videos, and compared several entry-level models. He recorded the 800 yuan fishing prize money as income in the Shark Accounting app, and in his memo planned a savings goal: saving up 2500 yuan to buy the drone, with the remaining amount earned by helping at Master Chen Jianguo's repair shop.

events.name: Sharing the joy with Lin Yue.
events.description: At 10 p.m., Yin Hao forwarded the aerial video that Wu Zhiqiang had sent him to Lin Yue, excitedly telling her about his fishing competition experience and his newly sparked dream of aerial photography. Lin Yue saw his enthusiasm, encouraged him to develop the new hobby, and the two agreed to go watch the sunset by West Lake together next time. The call lasted 30 minutes, and Yin Hao fell asleep with beautiful expectations for the future.

start_state.mood: Sleepy-eyed but excited

end_state.location: Bedroom at home.
end_state.mood: Filled with a sense of accomplishment, eager to try aerial photography as a new hobby

state.daily_exercise: Fishing competition doesn't count as formal exercise; can be omitted.

2025-05.daily_overview: At the tail end of the holiday, Yin Hao, whose weight had soared to 74.0 kg, officially started his fat loss plan, deliberately controlling everything from his morning run to breakfast. His main task on Sunday was study preparation: organizing the Open University of China course schedule, downloading Python textbooks, buying reference books, and watching introductory videos during the lunch break to plan his learning path. In the afternoon, he also went to the supermarket to buy low-fat ingredients, laying the foundation for a healthy diet in the new week.

events.name: Morning run and fat-loss breakfast attempt
events.description: At 6:40 in the morning, Yin Hao got up and stepped on the kitchen scale. The screen showed 74.0 kg, 3 kg more than before the holiday, which startled him. He changed into running shoes, completed a 5-kilometer jog, and, after returning home, weighed 74.9 kg. Referring to an online recipe, he pan-fried a chicken breast in a little oil and paired it with boiled broccoli and half a bowl of oatmeal as breakfast. Although the taste was bland, he forced himself to get used to it.

events.name: Organize the course schedule for the National Open University mechatronics program
events.description: At 9 a.m., Yin Hao turned on his computer and logged into the Open University of China learning platform. He downloaded the May live course schedule for the mechatronics associate degree program (every Tuesday and Thursday evening from 19:30 to 21:00) and added the course links to calendar reminders. He took a look at the textbook table of contents and decided to focus on the Electrical Circuits and Electronic Technology module in May.

events.name: Download Python tutorials and buy reference books.
events.description: At 10 a.m., Yin Hao found a Python beginner tutorial with high view count on Bilibili and saved it to his favorites. Then he opened JD.com and ordered two books, Python Crash Course (3rd Edition) and Fundamentals of Mechatronics. After applying a coupon, he paid 64.8 yuan in the end, and the books were expected to arrive on Wednesday.

events.name: Organize the Python study plan during the lunch break.
events.description: At 12:30 noon, Yin Hao lay in bed, opened the Python tutorial he had favorited on Bilibili, and watched the first introductory video (about 20 minutes). After that, he took out his phone memo and planned the subsequent learning path: first spend two weeks learning the basic syntax, then combine it with mechatronics project practice. He set a goal of studying 30 minutes every day.

events.name: Buy a kitchen scale and create a fat-loss diet plan
events.description: At 2 p.m., Yin Hao opened Taobao again and, following the doctor's advice from the physical examination report about mild fatty liver, ordered a kitchen scale with 0.1g precision (29 yuan after coupon). After that, he took out paper and pen, and referring to the health app's suggestions, made a simple one-week fat-reducing menu, specifying more whole grains at breakfast, steamed dishes at the cafeteria for lunch, less red meat at dinner, and adding sweet potatoes, Chinese yam, and other coarse grains.

events.name: Supermarket shopping for low-fat ingredients
events.description: At 3:30 p.m., Yin Hao drove to Yonghui Supermarket in Songjiang and bought chicken breast, broccoli, carrots, brown rice, olive oil and other ingredients according to the menu. He carefully checked nutrition labels in the food section, trying to avoid high-fat condiments, and finally spent 96 yuan before returning home satisfied.

events.name: Video-called parents in the evening and discussed health plans
events.description: At 8 p.m., Yin Hao initiated a family video call and reported his physical exam results and fat loss plan to his parents. His father reminded him to eat a balanced diet, while his mother was a little distressed and urged him not to eat too little. Yin Hao smiled and reassured her, and mentioned that he had already sent them a Mother's Day gift; his mother kept saying it was wasteful.

events.name: PLC review before bed
events.description: At 10 p.m. before bed, Yin Hao leaned against the headboard, opened his PLC notes, and reviewed the ladder logic he had learned the day before yesterday, focusing on the use of the set and reset instructions. Feeling that he had gained a deeper understanding, he decided to ask Master Sun about the difficult points at work the next day.

start_state.mood: Shocked by his weight, he resolved to change.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home.
end_state.mood: Strong sense of planning; full of desire to control the new week.

state.daily_exercise: Morning run 5 kilometers.

2025-05.daily_overview: On Monday, a workday, Yin Hao threw himself into work with great energy. He strictly followed his fat-loss diet, squeezed in time during his lunch break to work on advanced technician theory questions, and didn't forget to ask his master about difficult PLC points. After work, he confirmed the logistics of the Mother's Day gift, spent the evening self-studying Python, and had a brief exchange with Lin Yue. His pace of life was busy and positive.

events.name: Ate the fat-loss breakfast.
events.description: Yin Hao got up at 6:50 in the morning and stepped on the kitchen scale: 73.8 kg, down 0.2 kg from yesterday. He fried an egg without oil in his newly bought pan, paired it with whole wheat bread and a cup of unsweetened soy milk, and while eating, estimated the calories against the meal plan he had made yesterday, feeling that the new diet was not hard to stick to.

events.name: Engaged in operating the CNC machine tool.
events.description: At 8 a.m., Yin Hao arrived at the workshop and started machining a batch of precision bushings according to the production schedule. He skillfully called up the machining program, adjusted the feed rate, and measured dimensions multiple times during processing to keep product tolerance within ±0.01 mm. When his master, Sun Jianguo, passed by, he spot-checked the first piece and nodded in approval.

events.name: Doing Senior Technician Theory Questions During Lunch Break
events.description: At 12 noon, in the cafeteria, Yin Hao deliberately chose steamed sea bass and garlic greens for lunch, and took only half a bowl of rice. After eating, he sat in the rest area, opened the vocational qualification question bank app on his phone, and did 20 questions on PLCs and machining center principles. He got about 75% correct, and marked the wrong ones and saved them to his favorites.

events.name: Asked Master Sun about PLC questions
events.description: During a short break at 3 p.m., Yin Hao took his notebook to Sun Jianguo to ask about the effects of edge-triggered instructions and scan cycles on outputs in ladder diagrams. Master Sun explained for 10 minutes using real machine tool cases. Yin Hao suddenly understood and carefully noted down the key points.

events.name: Check delivery tracking information after work.
events.description: After getting off work at 5:30 p.m., Yin Hao immediately took out his phone and opened the Taobao order. Seeing that the logistics for the bouquet and crisp biscuits showed they had arrived at the Nantong transfer center and were expected to be delivered on Mother's Day, he breathed a sigh of relief and saved a screenshot of the logistics.

events.name: Home-cooked low-fat dinner
events.description: At 6:30 in the evening, Yin Hao cooked 100 grams of brown rice, paired with blanched shrimp and cucumber salad. He estimated the meal at about 400 calories and wrote down today's diet and approximate calorie intake on a sticky note.

events.name: Learning Python programming basics.
events.description: At 8 p.m., Yin Hao opened the Python tutorial he had saved on Bilibili, followed the video to install the Python interpreter and VS Code, and wrote his first print('Hello world') program. He also tried simple variable assignments. Though he typed slowly, the moment it ran successfully gave him a strong sense of accomplishment.

events.name: Interacting with Lin Yue on WeChat
events.description: At 9:30 p.m., Lin Yue sent photos she had taken by West Lake during the day. Yin Hao replied, praising the beautiful scenery, and shared his daily routine of learning programming and eating fat-loss meals. Lin Yue teased him for becoming a health enthusiast, and the two chatted pleasantly.

start_state.mood: Feeling energized about the new week's plan

end_state.location: Bedroom at home.
end_state.mood: Steady and fulfilling; a good start to fat loss and learning.

state.daily_exercise: No special exercise (did not run in the morning because of adjusting his sleep schedule).

2025-05.daily_overview: On a Tuesday workday, during his lunch break, Yin Hao asked Master Sun Jianguo about housing prices and living conditions in Songjiang's old residential communities, gathering information for his dream of buying a home. After work, he rode a shared bike to Chen Jianguo's electrical appliance repair shop to help out. He fixed a rice cooker and earned 60 yuan, then hurried home to attend the Open University of China's mechatronics course. It was a busy but rewarding day.

events.name: Morning fat-loss meal plan execution
events.description: At 6:50 in the morning, Yin Hao weighed 74.5 kg, a steady decrease. He had a banana, a boiled egg, and a cup of skim milk for breakfast. He is now used to planning his daily diet structure every morning.

events.name: Workshop CNC machining task
events.description: At 8 a.m., after communicating with team leader Wang Lei, Yin Hao took over a batch of newly arrived aluminum housing machining tasks. He wrote a simple macro program to reduce the number of tool changes. Liu Zhiqiang helped him optimize the tool path during debugging, and the three of them worked together to improve efficiency. By the time of the lunch break, 70% of the scheduled tasks had been completed.

events.name: Consulted Master Sun about home purchase information during lunch break
events.description: At noon, Yin Hao carried his lunch tray and sat down across from Sun Jianguo. After exchanging a few pleasantries, he steered the conversation toward the old residential neighborhoods in Songjiang. Master Sun shared that a friend of his owned an old public housing unit on Rongle Middle Road that was completed around 2000—a one-bedroom apartment with a total price of about 1.2–1.3 million yuan, convenient for daily life but with an old building age. Yin Hao silently estimated the down payment in his head, feeling pressure but also gaining a more concrete goal.

events.name: Afternoon work and continuation

events.name: After work, he cycled to Jianguo Electrical Appliance Repair shop to help out.

Master Chen praised his hands-on ability and gave him 60 yuan in cash as payment.

Tonight's course taught DC circuit analysis methods; the lecturer explained Kirchhoff's laws and the node-voltage method online. Yin Hao took screenshots while listening, derived example problems in his notebook, and asked two questions in the chat area, both of which were answered.

start_state.mood: Energized for the new day.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home.
end_state.mood: Satisfied—I've balanced making money, studying, and working.

His small daily life felt fulfilling and warm.

events.name: Fat-loss breakfast and morning weigh-in
events.description: At 7 a.m., Yin Hao got up and routinely stepped on the kitchen scale. Seeing 74.3 kg, down 0.8 kg from four days ago, he was secretly pleased. For breakfast he had unsweetened yogurt mixed with cereal and a few nuts.

events.name: Morning CNC machining and quality spot inspection

events.name: Night run at the stadium after work.
events.description: After getting off work at 5:30 in the evening, Yin Hao went home, changed into his running gear, and walked to the track at Songjiang Sports Center. He did a 5-kilometer jog at a pace of 6 minutes 10 seconds, paying attention to his breathing and cadence throughout. After the run, he stretched carefully, and his knees felt good.

events.name: Homemade low-fat dinner
events.description: After the run, Yin Hao went home, took a shower, made vanilla chicken breast in the air fryer, and served it with steamed sweet potato and blanched lettuce. He ate while watching the news and felt very comfortable.

events.description: From 8:30 PM to 10:00 PM, Yin Hao opened VS Code and tried to write a simple arithmetic calculator by following a tutorial. When he encountered a type conversion error with the input() function, he solved it by searching CSDN, and finally it ran successfully. He felt a great sense of accomplishment.

events.name: Low-fat takeout dinner

He asked the clerk to carefully pack the crisp cakes, dried clams, and flowers into three separate parcels to ensure they would arrive on Mother's Day.

2025-05.daily_overview: On Saturday, Yin Hao attended the Red Cross basic first aid theory training in the morning, earnestly studying CPR and AED knowledge. At noon, he went home and prepared a low-fat lunch. After the training ended in the afternoon, he hurried to Chen Jianguo's repair shop and helped repair a pair of powered speakers and a vacuum cleaner, earning 80 yuan. In the evening, while organizing his notes, he learned that Lin Yue had canceled their date due to an urgent meeting, but they agreed to meet tomorrow. Although he felt a little disappointed, he was full of anticipation.

events.name: Wake up early, prepare, and head to the training center
events.description: At 7 a.m., Yin Hao got up, weighed 73.9 kg, ate an oatmeal and yogurt breakfast, checked his backpack for the notebook, ID card, and water bottle, and at 8 o'clock rode a shared bike to the Red Cross Training Center on Xilin Road, Songjiang District. He signed in and entered at 8:15.

events.name: Morning first aid theory class
events.description: From 8:30 to 11:30, the instructor used PPT and videos to systematically explain the origins of the Red Cross Movement, the principles of cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR), AED operation steps, trauma bleeding control and bandaging techniques, and first aid for airway obstruction by foreign objects. Yin Hao listened attentively throughout, marked key points with a red pen, and memorized key details such as CPR compression depth of 5-6 cm and a rate of 100-120 compressions per minute.

events.name: Went home during the lunch break to make a low-fat lunch
events.description: At 11:30 a.m., after class ended, Yin Hao cycled home. He used a kitchen scale to accurately weigh his ingredients and made steamed sea bass, boiled broccoli, and brown rice. For the steamed fish, he used only a little steamed-fish soy sauce, and it was delicious. He took photos while eating and sent them to Lin Yue to share (note: Didn't see you, so I'm having a healthy meal on my own).

events.name: Afternoon: continued first aid theory lecture
events.description: From 13:30 to 15:30, the instructor continued explaining the management of special injuries (such as burns and fracture immobilization) and response to emergencies. In the second half of the course, the class discussed cases in groups. Group 3, which Yin Hao was in, analyzed the emergency first aid process for sudden death during exercise. He spoke actively, contributed the correct CPR steps, and was praised by the instructor.

events.name: After the training, he went to the repair shop in the rain to help.
events.description: At 3:30 p.m., the training ended early. It had started to drizzle, so Yin Hao rode his bike in the rain to Jianguo Electrical Appliance Repair Shop. Under Master Chen's guidance, he first disassembled a pair of active speakers that were silent, found a bulging capacitor during inspection, replaced it, and the test sound was normal. Next he handled a vacuum cleaner, replaced the worn carbon brush assembly, and the suction recovered. Satisfied, Master Chen gave him 80 yuan as labor fee.

events.name: Simple evening dinner and organizing training notes
events.description: The repair work lasted until 7 p.m. Yin Hao went home and cooked a bowl of seaweed and egg drop soup with whole wheat bread for dinner. After eating, he opened his laptop and used a mind map to systematize the day's first aid knowledge, then drew a simple diagram of the AED usage procedure and stuck it on the refrigerator. At 9:30 p.m., Lin Yue sent a message saying that an important meeting had been added at the last minute so she could not meet as planned today, but she said she would be free tomorrow afternoon (May 11) after the meeting. Although Yin Hao felt a little disappointed, he quickly replied to show understanding and agreed to meet tomorrow afternoon at Songjiang University Town for a simple meal.

start_state.mood: Serious and looking forward to the training

end_state.location: Bedroom at home.
end_state.mood: Though we didn't see each other today, tomorrow holds promise — the little joy of having both skills and love.

2025-05.daily_overview: It was both Mother's Day and the day of the first aid training assessment. Early in the morning, Yin Hao surprised his mother with a video call, then rushed to the training center for practical practice such as CPR, passed the assessment, and obtained the Red Cross Basic First Aid Certificate. After a short date with Lin Yue in the afternoon, he felt warm from the flower sharing in the family group chat and his father's private encouragement in the evening, and also received praise from Lin Yue during a video call. That day he gained family love, romance, skills, and pride.

events.name: Mother's Day morning video greeting
events.description: At 7:30 in the morning, as soon as he got up, Yin Hao contacted his mother Wang Xiuying via WeChat video. On the screen, his mother had just opened the package and was holding carnations and crispy biscuits with a beaming smile. Yin Hao wished his mother a happy Mother's Day and explained that he could not go home because he was preparing for a half marathon and a certification exam. His mother, in turn, told him to take care of himself and not push too hard. The warm call lasted 20 minutes.

events.name: Breakfast and travel to the training center
events.description: After hanging up the video call, Yin Hao quickly ate an oatmeal breakfast and weighed in at 73.8 kg. He set off at 8:10 for the Red Cross training center; today there would be practical exercises and an assessment.

events.name: Morning CPR and AED hands-on practice
events.description: From 8:30 to 11:30, the trainees took turns practicing CPR compressions and rescue breathing on a manikin and learned to use an AED. Yin Hao was on his knees, sweating profusely, but strictly followed the 30:2 ratio and gradually got the rhythm. He also practiced triangular bandage bandaging and fracture immobilization, and corrected his compression depth issue under the instructor's guidance.

events.name: Afternoon practical assessment and certificate collection
events.description: At 13:00, the group assessment began. Yin Hao was placed in Group 1 and was tested on the full CPR procedure. He performed calmly; his compression rate and depth met the standards, and his AED operation was standard. Then came the trauma bandaging assessment, which he completed smoothly. After the assessment, at 15:30, Red Cross staff issued the Red Cross Junior First Aider Certificate to the qualified trainees. Yin Hao received the certificate and took a group photo with his fellow trainees.

events.name: After returning home, he told his family about receiving the certificate
events.description: At 4 p.m., Yin Hao got home. The first thing he did was take a photo of the certificate and send it to his parents and older brother, with a message in the family group: 'Dad, Mom, I got my first aid certificate today! I can help in emergencies from now on.'

events.name: A short date with Lin Yue
events.description: At 5 p.m., Lin Yue arrived at Songjiang University Town as promised. Yin Hao took her to a local Shanghainese restaurant he often visited. They ate and chatted, sharing what they had each accomplished recently. Lin Yue was proud of him for getting his first aid certificate. Since Lin Yue still had an online meeting in the evening, the two parted reluctantly after a brief hour together. Watching her car drive away, Yin Hao felt sweet inside.

events.name: Mother initiated a flower-sharing interaction in the family group chat
events.description: At 7 p.m., Wang Xiuying sent a photo of the carnations she received during the day to the Yin family WeChat group, writing: "The son sent them from Shanghai; they are more beautiful in my heart than the flowers." Maternal uncles, older female cousins, younger male cousins, and other relatives all liked the post and praised Yin Hao for being sensible and filial. Yin Hao replied in the group: "Thank you, everyone. Happy Mother's Day to my mother and all aunts!" The atmosphere in the group was warm.

events.name: Father sent an encouraging message privately
events.description: At 8 p.m., Yin Hao's father Yin Jianguo sent him a private message: 'Son, the flowers arrived. Your mother is so happy she can't contain it. We're all well at home. Stay focused in Shanghai and don't worry about us.' Yin Hao replied: 'Dad, I'll work hard. Once I buy a house, I'll bring you both over to live with me.'

events.name: Share gains with Lin Yue
events.description: At 9:30 pm, Yin Hao and Lin Yue had a video call. He showed his brand-new first responder certificate and demonstrated the Heimlich maneuver. Lin Yue smiled and praised him for becoming more and more capable. The two agreed that if Yin Hao didn't have a race next weekend, they would definitely meet.

start_state.mood: Worried about my mother, looking forward to the assessment

end_state.location: Bedroom at home.
end_state.mood: Both family and love are going well, and my heart is full of strength.

events.name: Post-exam analysis and review plan formulation
events.description: After reviewing the detailed score report, he formulated a two-week targeted review plan for his weak areas, specified the daily chapters and question count, and decided to ask Master Sun to tutor him on Saturday.

events.name: Ask Master Sun for advice on a difficult problem.
events.description: At 10 p.m. that evening, he sent Master Sun a screenshot of the PLC ladder diagram and the five-axis tool path calculation from the mock exam via WeChat, and asked for advice by voice message. Master Sun patiently explained the key points and common errors. After taking notes, Yin Hao felt his thinking was much clearer.

events.name: Watched the replay of the electromechanical live course
events.description: After asking for advice, watch the replay of this Tuesday's mechatronics live course, learn the characteristics of semiconductor diode devices, and use a multimeter to measure the forward voltage drop of the rectifier diode in an old charger to deepen understanding.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home on Guangfulin Road
start_state.mood: Ready to face challenges, with a calm and steady mindset.

end_state.location: Study at his home on Guangfulin Road
end_state.mood: After identifying problems through a mock exam and making a plan, I feel much more grounded.

state.daily_exercise: Night cycling for 15 kilometers.

2025-05.daily_overview: On Wednesday, Yin Hao worked normally during the day. After work, he went to the swimming pool for routine training. In the evening he returned home and focused on reviewing PLC, and moved the repair shop study to tomorrow.

events.name: Morning weigh-in and reading
events.description: Got up at 6:20, weighed 73.4 kg on an empty stomach. After washing up, he used breakfast time to read a chapter of CNC Programming Technology and marked key points.

events.name: Swimming training after work
events.description: At 5:30 PM, went to Songjiang Natatorium for 45 minutes of mixed stroke training, keeping heart rate at 130-140, as a cross-training fat-loss exercise. Felt relaxed after swimming.

events.name: Evening focused review of PLC
events.description: At 8 PM, following yesterday's review plan, he focused on learning PLC timer and counter instructions, built a delay-start circuit in the simulation software, and the simulation succeeded, deepening his understanding of the mock exam errors.

events.name: Help neighbor Aunt Chen fix her electric fan.
events.description: Core training for 15 minutes, painting the whole house with latex paint (moderate-intensity physical labor), and sanding putty (moderate-intensity physical labor)

start_state.mood: Energetic, with clear plans.

end_state.location: Study at his home on Guangfulin Road

2025-05.daily_overview: On Thursday, after his morning run, Yin Hao went to the repair shop for hands-on learning. In the evening, he attended a National Open University live course to study transistor circuits and completed the simulation homework, keeping study and hobby going in parallel.

events.name: Morning run and core training
events.description: Woke up at 6:15, weighed 73.3 kg on an empty stomach, then went to Central Park for a 4-kilometer morning run at a pace of 5:50. After returning home, did 15 minutes of foam rolling and resistance band training, completing the daily lower-limb stability exercises.

events.name: Hands-on Learning at the Repair Shop
events.description: After work at 5:30 p.m., he went to Chen Jianguo's repair shop. Master Chen arranged for him to independently troubleshoot a faulty induction cooker control board. With guidance, he used a multimeter to trace the problem, found a broken IGBT transistor, replaced it, and successfully repaired it. Master Chen explained switching power supply techniques, and Yin Hao studied earnestly. He helped out for about 2 hours today, treating it as learning and taking no payment.

events.name: Organized maintenance study notes
events.description: After dinner at home, he took out his notebook, organized maintenance key points such as refrigeration equipment fault detection and microwave oven door switches, and added today's IGBT inspection steps as a technical reference.

events.name: Attended Thursday's electromechanical live course
events.description: At 7 pm he attended the live class, learning about transistor structure, the principle of current amplification, and the common-emitter amplifier circuit. Yin Hao drew equivalent circuits on scratch paper and clarified the setting of the quiescent operating point by asking questions. After class, he completed exercises on gain calculation and used simulation software to build a common-emitter amplifier circuit and observe the waveform relationships.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home on Guangfulin Road
start_state.mood: Methodical and even-keeled

end_state.location: Study at his home on Guangfulin Road
end_state.mood: Electronic technology study is gradually getting on track.

state.daily_exercise: Morning run of 4 km, home core training.

2025-05.daily_overview: On Friday, after his morning swim, Yin Hao weighed himself and completed the monthly fat-loss summary. His weight dropped slightly, but his body fat percentage improved significantly and his body composition was optimized. In the morning, he bought Dragon Boat Festival zongzi and placed an order for the drone. He worked in the afternoon, sorted out the monthly finances in the evening, and prepared for tomorrow's test flight and cycling.

events.name: Morning swimming and monthly fat-loss assessment
events.description: At 6:00 in the morning, he went to Songjiang Natatorium for a 45-minute morning swim, mainly breaststroke at low-to-moderate intensity. After returning home, he weighed himself on an empty stomach: 73.2 kg and 23.5% body fat. Summarizing the month's data: his weight had dropped from 74.0 kg on May 4 to 73.2 kg, a loss of 0.8 kg; body fat had fallen from the first measured 25.5% (May 17) to 23.5%, down 2 percentage points; fat mass had decreased by about 1.3 kg, and muscle mass remained basically unchanged. He recorded the analysis in his memo.

events.name: Bought zongzi at the supermarket
events.description: During the work break at 10 a.m., he went to the supermarket on Guangfulin Road and selected a box of Jiaxing zongzi (two each of red bean paste, fresh meat, and salted egg yolk) in preparation for the Dragon Boat Festival.

events.name: Placed an order for a DJI drone.
events.description: After receiving the final 150 yuan service fee transferred by Master Chen Jianguo at work, Yin Hao's drone fund reached 3,000 yuan. At 12:00 noon, after confirming his savings were sufficient, he placed an order on an e-commerce platform for a DJI Mini 3 SE bundle (about 2,800 yuan), expected to arrive the next day. Excited, he sent a WeChat message to Wu Zhiqiang to give him a heads-up about unboxing it together.

events.name: Preliminary month-end financial review
events.description: At 8 p.m., I opened the Shark Accounting app to enter all May income and expenses, and calculated the total savings for the month. I found that there were two large expenses this month: a road bike for 3,500 yuan and a drone for 2,800 yuan, partially offset by about 550 yuan in cumulative income from the repair shop. Overall spending exceeded the budget by about 5,800 yuan. But considering the investment in health and skill development, and that the side-business revenue model of the repair shop has been validated, I remain optimistic about the financial situation in June. May takeout spending dropped significantly because of homemade meals for fat loss, saving about 400 yuan that was used to buy health management tools such as a body fat scale and a kitchen scale.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home on Guangfulin Road
start_state.mood: Looking forward to the drone, making good progress on fat loss, feeling happy

end_state.location: Study at his home on Guangfulin Road
end_state.mood: Satisfied and looking forward to tomorrow.

state.daily_exercise: Swimming for 45 minutes.

2025-05.daily_overview: On the Dragon Boat Festival, Yin Hao got up early and exchanged fat-loss tips with running friends. In the morning, he received a drone and took a test flight. At noon, he enjoyed zongzi and video-called his family. In the afternoon, he rode his new bike. In the evening, he reviewed his finances and wrote down his home-purchase goal, spending a fulfilling and milestone-worthy holiday.

events.name: Morning run and exchange of fat-loss experience.
events.description: At 6:00 in the morning, he weighed himself on an empty stomach at 73.5 kg, with a body fat percentage of 23.5%, basically the same as yesterday. He then met up with fellow runner Chen Jie at Songjiang Sports Center for a 5 km morning run. After the run, they went to a breakfast shop to share their fat-loss experiences: Yin Hao shared his homemade low-fat meals and tracking methods, and Chen Jie gave nutritional supplement suggestions; they learned from each other.

events.name: DJI drone unboxing and setup
events.description: At 9 a.m., the drone was delivered. Yin Hao contacted his fishing buddy Wu Zhiqiang via WeChat video, and under his remote guidance completed unpacking, installing the battery, connecting the DJI Fly app, and activating the device. The process went smoothly.

events.name: First test flight at Guangfulin Ruins.
events.description: At 10 o'clock, he took the drone to an open lawn near the Guangfulin Cultural Heritage Site for a test flight. Still unskilled at operation, he nearly hit a tree, but stayed calm and made an emergency landing — a close call with no harm. He shot several panoramic videos of the site and enjoyed the fun of flying.

events.name: Edit and share the aerial video.
events.description: After the test flight, I went home, edited the aerial footage and the forced-landing process into a short video, posted it on WeChat Moments with a caption recording my first flight experience, and received likes and comments from friends.

events.name: Dragon Boat Festival lunch and family contact
events.description: At noon, he heated up Jiaxing zongzi for lunch. After the meal, he had a video call with his parents in his hometown of Nantong. They wished each other a safe and healthy Dragon Boat Festival. His mother showed the zongzi she had wrapped by hand, and Yin Hao shared the test flight video, so the family reunited online. Afterwards, he sent his girlfriend Lin Yue a small Dragon Boat Festival red envelope and had a brief video call to express his longing.

events.name: Drone photography experience sharing from a gaming friend.
events.description: After he posted it on Moments, his gaming friend Zhang Fei left a comment sharing drone aerial photography operation experience and precautions, and suggested communicating online about flying techniques later. Yin Hao replied with thanks and agreed to play together online when free.

events.name: Afternoon road bike ride
events.description: At 4 p.m., he rode his newly purchased road bike out of the residential community and followed a planned 20 km loop route around the university town, passing Guangfulin Road, Wenhui Road, and others, to test the bike's performance and his riding condition. His knees felt no discomfort, and he was satisfied with the new bike.

events.name: Monthly financial summary and savings record
events.description: At 7 p.m., summarize all income and expenses for May, compare with the budget, evaluate spending on takeout, entertainment, etc., calculate total savings (including 4 transfers into Yu'ebao), and record achievements and shortcomings as a reference for June financial management.

events.name: Write down home-purchase goal and action plan
events.description: At 9 p.m., he solemnly wrote down his home-buying goal in his diary in the bedroom: he must buy his own house in Songjiang District, Shanghai by December 31, 2026, and he listed specific steps for obtaining certifications, getting promoted, and saving a fixed amount every month to motivate himself.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home on Guangfulin Road
start_state.mood: Relaxing holiday, many plans to be fulfilled, full of anticipation.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home on Guangfulin Road
end_state.mood: Fulfilled and satisfied, more resolute in his future goals

state.daily_exercise: Morning run 5 km, afternoon cycling 20 km
